According to the quantiles of the results of multiple random simulations, the quantiles are estimated to form a series of interval predictions with a given confidence. Finally, the point prediction value is added to the error prediction interval to accomplish the wind speed prediction interval completely. The prediction eventually show that: (1) the model processed by VMD is more accurate and stable than the single neural network prediction method; (2) in the interval prediction, the combination of empirical error and MCMC method shows better prediction effect; (3) the interval prediction with different confidence represents the consistency of statistical significance. In this paper, the proposal of a neural network method of wind speed interval prediction based on empirical error and MCMC is helpful for the relevant departments to adjust the dispatching plan in time, formulate reasonable control strategy of the wind farm, and improve stability and reliability of the system operation.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term Wind Power Forecasting Based on Deep Belief Network and Wavelet Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Focusing on the limited generalization ability of traditional machine learning methods for wind power data, combined with deep learning theory, an ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on wavelet denoising and deep belief network (DBN) is proposed. Firstly, the signal-to-noise ratio of wind power data under different wavelet basis functions is compared and analyzed. And then selected db4 wavelet function to decompose the historical data in three layers. The wavelet soft threshold method is used to remove the high- frequency noise signal in the data, which is sent from the power plant to the master station of the power dispatch system. Based on the historical wind power data after de-noising, a DBN based wind power prediction model is constructed, which is optimized by unsupervised pre-training and BP algorithm. The DBN prediction model can effectively extract the characteristics of wind power data, and has good prediction performance and data generalization ability. Experiments with actual power system data, the results show that the proposed wind power prediction method has a better prediction effect than traditional machine learning algorithms such as BP and RBF.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Commutation Failure Recovery in Multi-infeed AC/DC Systems Based on Multi-infeed Operating Short Circuit Ratio
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In multi-infeed AC/DC systems, the simultaneous commutation failure of multiple HVDC systems will seriously threaten the safe operation of the system. A coordinated control strategy for commutation failure recovery is proposed. Firstly, by analyzing the shortcomings of the MIESCR, the multi-infeed operating short circuit ratio (MIOSCR) is proposed. Next, the recovery sequence coordination principles that should be followed for the commutation failure recovery are summarized. Then, based on the MIOSCR, a two-stage coordination control strategy is proposed. Finally, the simulation results of Jiangsu power grid in PSS/E show that the strategy can effectively shorten the duration of commutation failure recovery in multi-infeed AC/DC systems.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Prediction for Wind Farm Based on Clayton Copula Function and Deep Learning Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Complex spatio-temporal dependencies exist between wind speed (WS) of various wind turbines (WT) in wind farm (WF), which brings great difficulties to obtain accurate WS-prediction (WSP) results. Analyzing the spatio-temporal dependency of WS, clarifying the mutual influence between WT, and constructing high-precision wind- speed prediction models are still problems to be solved. For this reason, a WSP model combining long and short-term memory (LSTM) network and Copula function is proposed to realize WSP based on the analysis of the wind-speed spatio-temporal dependency. The effectiveness of the method is verified by using the measured wind-speed data of the WF. The method effectively solves the problem of windspeed spatio-temporal dependency analysis and significantly improves the WSP accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparison of Three-Level Cell Topology and Control for Solid State Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a solid state transformer (SST) consisting of a cascaded neutral-point-clamped (NPC) H-bridge ac-dc stage and a three-level LLC dc-dc stage. Two different three-level topologies, namely, diode-neutral-point-clamped (DNPC) LLC and series half bridge (SHB) LLC, are compared in terms of zero voltage switching (ZVS) condition and neutral-point (NP) voltage balancing performance. ZVS conditions are analytically derived and their ZVS regions are explicitly given, showing that SHB LLC is more efficient than DNPC LLC with easier ZVS conditions. The phase-shift-based three-level operation mode is proposed for the SHB LLC with not only strong NP balancing capability but also symmetric operation of all switches, which is superior to its DNPC counterpart. Experimental evaluation is done on a 15-kW silicon carbide (SiC) device based three-level cell operated at around 200 kHz and a multi-cell 10-kV SST system.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Modulation Strategy of LCC Resonant Converter with Capacitive Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With LCC resonant circuit as the topological high- voltage charging power supply, the commonly used modulation methods are pulse-frequency modulation (PSM) and phase shift modulation (PFM). Aiming at the problem of wide frequency modulation range, low utilization of magnetic parts when PFM, and narrow soft switching range when PSM, a functional relationship between output current and switching frequency is established, and a PSM-PFM hybrid modulation strategy is proposed based on the output current characteristics. This control strategy uses PSM at light load to increase the charging speed of the capacitor without increasing the switching current stress, expand the soft switching range, and use PFM at heavy load to narrow the frequency modulation range. The feasibility of the control strategy was verified by building a simulation and experiment platform. The charging speed is doubled, and the frequency range is reduced to a quarter of the original.

articleTitle: Influence of High Altitude Environment on Thermal Performance of Miniature Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In a high altitude environment, the temperature rise of miniature circuit breaker increases significantly due to slow heat dissipation. Based on the principle of heat transfer, this paper discussed the influence of the difference in pressure, relative humidity and temperature in different altitudes on the heat loss of miniature circuit breaker, a three-phase intelligent miniature circuit breaker thermoelectric coupling model was established, and the thermal convection coefficient of each cooling surface under different environmental parameters was calculated, the thermal convection and thermal radiation boundary conditions was applied, it was obtained that what the difference between the internal and external temperature rise of the circuit breaker at an altitude of 4300m and that at an altitude of 0m was by simulating. The temperature rise test and the trip test were carried out under different environmental parameters, and it was obtained that how temperature rise, thermal convection power and thermal radiation thermal power change with environmental parameters changing. That the difference between the stable temperature rise and time constant of the bimetal when 1.13 times rated current was applied, the trip temperature rise and the trip time when 1.45 times rated current is applied were also obtained.

articleTitle: An Inductive Filtering-Based Traction Transformer for High-Order Harmonic Suppression of HSR
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There is ever-increasing high-order harmonic pollution caused by high-speed locomotives with PWM rectifier in nowadays railway traction power supply system (TPSS). These high-order harmonic components injected from the electric train will aggravate transformer vibration, noise, and loss and interfere with other locomotives powered by the same power-supply station. Harmonic resonance will occur when the harmonic frequency matches the inherent resonance frequency of TPSS. An inductive filtering-based traction transformer is designed for the restricted installation space in this paper, aiming to eliminate high-order harmonic. A filtering winding is added in the traction transformer, which exhibits superconducting characteristics for high-order harmonics, thereby suppressing high-order harmonics without affecting the transmission of electric energy at power frequency. The winding arrangement of the abovementioned transformer is introduced. The compound short-circuits impedance of the traction transformer is calculated using the field-circuit coupling method. Phase shift modulation is employed to increasing equivalent switching frequency. A simulation model was built in the Simulink environment to verify the feasibility of the method, and the results show that the proposed method can effectively suppress high-frequency harmonics.

articleTitle: Influence of Driving State on Parameters of Three-phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The equivalent circuit model is an effective tool in the research of 3-phase induction motor. It can convert the complex electromagnetic phenomena into circuit ones and enable the study of motor control and operation to be processed with circuit theory and circuit analysis tools. Obviously, to achieve precise control of the induction motor, it is necessary to use the precise circuit parameters, and master how parameters change with voltage, current and frequency of the motor. Based on the equivalent circuit model with parallel excitation branch considering iron loss, the measurement methods to obtain the precise parameters are introduced and analyzed in the paper. The results show clearly the reasonable ways to get the precise motor parameters, which is significant to the R&D on high performance induction motor control and application.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis of Tri-axial HTS Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High temperature superconducting (HTS) cable has the advantages of high transmission density, low transmission loss, and basically no electromagnetic radiation. Therefore, HTS cable is thought to be suitable for expansion of urban power grids. The requirements for transmission reliability in urban power grids are particularly strict, and the stability of the superconducting cable system will be affected by superconducting tapes, cryogenic systems, and external faults. In this paper, the HTS cable applied in Shenzhen 10kV power grid was taken as the research object, the thermodynamic modeling of the cable is performed to analyze the thermal stability of cable under fault. The results will provide data reference for power grid transformation and protection configuration scheme, supporting the application of HTS cable in Shenzhen Power Grid.

articleTitle: Capacitance Design for Low-Capacitance Cascaded H-Bridge STATCOM Considering Inductive Demand
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power density of film capacitor is lower than that of electrolytic capacitor. It is significant to study how to reduce the capacitance for replacing electrolytic capacitor with film capacitor for cascaded h-bridge STATCOM. Increasing fluctuation amplitude on DC-link voltage is able to effectively reduce the capacitance for cascaded H-bridge STATCOM. However, there are few papers on the capacitance design of DC- link capacitor under increasing voltage fluctuation amplitude. The existing methods only consider the capacitive capacity of STATCOM when designing the capacitance. This paper first analyzes the relationship between capacitance and output current under capacitive and inductive conditions, respectively. In addition to considering rated capacitive capacity, a design method is proposed, where certain inductive capacity is retained according to the actual demand. Finally, the theoretical analysis is verified by some key simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Parameters and Loss Characteristics of Asynchronous Motor under Overload Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Overload capacity is a key factor in motor design. When the asynchronous motor works in overload condition, the electromagnetic parameters will change drastically and cause huge loss, which seriously affect the stable operation of motor. This paper investigates the influence of overload operation on the electromagnetic parameters and loss characteristics of asynchronous motor. The analyses are performed on change of current and magnetic density under the influence of skin effect and magnetic saturation. Moreover, the loss distribution of motor under overload operation is statistically processed by loss calculation models, both at copper and iron. The results show that the stator and rotor current will increase rapidly, when the load torque increases. The magnetic density of the yoke in the iron core changes less, and the magnetic density of the tooth changes more. Copper and iron loss will also increase, affecting the performance of the motor. The results of this research provide technical support for the optimization design of asynchronous motor overload capacity improvement.

articleTitle: Generalized VSG Control Strategy for Active Power Transient Characteristic Optimization of Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Both droop control and virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control can be widely seen used in voltage source inverter. Among them, the virtual inertia and damping characteristics VSG control has the ability to provide virtual inertia factors that droop control does not have, but its active power response speed is very slow, and there is a large overshoot. Aiming at the problem of poor active power transient characteristics of VSG control, a generalized VSG control strategy is proposed. First, the article analyzes the transient characteristics of the active power-frequency loop of droop control and VSG control, and derives the generalized VSG control strategy. Then, according to the system model, the influence of the pole-zero point of the main controller of generalized VSG control strategy on the frequency response speed, the response speed and overshoot of active power is analyzed. And on this basis, a parameter design parameter design method is given, which can eliminate active power overshoot and make the active power response as fast as possible while keeping the frequency response speed unchanged. Finally, an inverter grid-connected bench was built to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed generalized VSG control strategy.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Dual Three-Phase Winding PMSM for Integrated EMA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In modern aerospace electromechanical actuators (EMA), the integrated structure has brought many advantages, such as reducing system components and system volume, etc. In this paper, the design of dual three-phase winding permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) for an integrated EMA is addressed. The motor adopts slot pole combination of 12/10 because of a high winding factor and utilization. The motor is integrated with the EMA system, so the size of it is strictly restricted. Under the condition of limited size, the most suitable stator split ratio is found by analytical calculation and then verified through finite element simulation. Then through the analysis and comparison of three winding configurations, the double-layer winding phase shift 180 degree is selected. Finally, in the case of considering the eddy current loss on the rotor, the optimal design is carried out to obtain the optimal output torque and reduce the torque ripple.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Tolerance of DSEM Starting/Generating System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The faults of power devices and windings in the starting/generating system of doubly salient electro-magnetic machines pose a great threat to the reliability of the system. This paper presents fault tolerant methods for three-phase DSEM starting/generating system based on a bridge converter with bidirectional switching. The paper analyzes the starting /generation operating characteristics of doubly salient electro-magnetic machines and the system fault types firstly. On this basis, in order to improve the torque output capability of the starting operation after fault and the power output capability of the generation operation, fault-tolerant conduction loops of the starting/ generating system under various open circuit faults are analyzed. Finally, a Simulink simulation model is built, and the results verify that the proposed control strategy can increase the torque output and restrain the output power drop in the starting stage and power generation stage respectively.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Variable Leakage Flux PM Motors with Different Flux Barriers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the variable leakage flux (VLF) PM motors with three different distributions of flux barriers are designed, analyzed, and compared. First, a feasible approach of realizing leakage flux variation is discussed to emphasize rotor design of different flux barriers, where the variable magnetic resistance is purposely introduced. Then, the three VLF PM motors with different saliency ratio characteristics are investigated and compared comprehensively, including no-load back-EMF, flux density distributions, inductances characteristics, torque production and leakage flux ability. By comparison, a prototype motor with three layers of independent leakage flux bypasses is manufactured and tested, which possessing higher output torque, lower risk of demagnetization, and wider speed range. Finally, the effective design of the proposed motor is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transfer System Based on Focused and Shielding Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metamaterials (MM) can make a huge difference to the wireless power transfer (WPT) systems. As previously reported, the MM with negative relative permeability can improve the power transfer efficiency (PTE) and MM with near-zero relative permeability can shield the electromagnetic field (EMF). However, most of the works rely on small signal transmission without the consideration of the power supply. In this paper, the mid-range WPT system based on two types of the MM is proposed. The theoretical analysis of two types of MM, focused and shielding MM, has been put forward. The experiment setup has been built to verify the validation of the proposed system. The strategy of impedance matching has been presented to enhance the system transmission performance. The results show the MM can enhance PTE above 30% and reduce the EM leakage below 20mA/m simultaneously. And the maximum power supply can reach about 100w at the transfer distance of 120cm. It can provide the guidance for wireless charging on-line monitoring equipment with small meter transfer distance.

articleTitle: Multi Objective Optimal Dispatching of Microgrid Considering Multiple Random Variables Based on Improved NSGA-III
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the face of the national requirements of carbon neutrality, how to effectively absorb renewable energy is the focus and challenge of microgrid optimization operation. The traditional optimization strategy with power generation cost as a single objective has been difficult to meet the current demand. Therefore, this paper takes the generation cost, environmental cost and system robustness as the optimization objectives. In this paper, firstly, the energy optimization model of microgrid is established with the objective of minimizing generation cost, minimizing environmental cost and maximizing system robustness. Secondly, an improved NSGA-III optimization strategy considering the operation constraints of microgrid is constructed based on NSGA-III and compromise fuzzy multi-attribute decision-making method. Finally, the calculation accuracy and superiority of the proposed algorithm are verified, and the algorithm is applied to the microgrid optimization proposed in this paper. At the same time, the effectiveness of the algorithm and model in improving the proportion of renewable energy consumption is verified.

articleTitle: An Energy Storage-type Power Quality Control System with Partial Compensation Strategy for Electrified Railway
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an energy storage-type railway power quality control system (ES-PQCS) is given to improve the power quality of traction power supply system (TPSS) and recover considerable braking energy generated by electric locomotive. First, the topological structure and mathematical model of the system are analyzed, revealing the relationship of compensation current with the primary power factor (PF) and the load current. Then, the partial compensation strategy (PCS) is proposed to optimize the compensation capacity of railway power conditioner (RPC). Besides, the active power flow and power compensation under system operation scenarios are analyzed, and the power-flow management scheme with 11 classic cases is listed. Furthermore, the capacity configuration of ESS is designed. Finally, based a substation’s data, typical scenarios, system design and simulation are carried out, which verify the effectiveness of compensation strategy and its ability of capacity decreasing and energy saving.

articleTitle: Plasma Real-time Diagnostics Based on Visual Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Real-time diagnostics has always been a key point of plasma research. Optical emission spectroscopy is the most commonly used method to obtain the plasma parameters through fitting of the emission curves. But the process is time-consuming, making it almost impossible to get the data in real-time. In this paper, we propose a method using image recognition for real-time diagnostics. The relationship between visual images and rotational and vibrational temperatures was established. A convolutional neural network model was used for image recognition. After training, the test accuracy was over 0.99. The model was proved to be able to predict the temperature of a new input image, indicating potential applications of image recognition in real-time plasma diagnostics.

articleTitle: Tie-line Power Smoothing Strategy of Integrated Energy System Using Separate Storage of Heat and Electricity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integrated energy system is an effective way to achieve efficient use of renewable energy and emission reduction. To solve the problem of large peak-valley difference and large instantaneous fluctuations of tie-line power connected with integrated energy system, this paper proposed a power smoothing strategy for the tie-line of the park’s integrated energy system. First, this paper proposed a power smoothing system combined with the of sensible heat storage and battery energy storage. Considering the difference in response speed and lifespan of heat storage equipment and battery energy storage system, an improved composite filtering method is proposed to realize the reasonable distribution of power smoothing components, which can avoid frequent charging and discharging of battery energy storage and improve power smoothing performance. Considering the change of user's heat demand, using fuzzy control to adjust the filter time constant in real time to ensure that the state of charge of the energy storage device is close to the initial value after the end of an operating cycle, which is helpful for the continuous operation of the system. Simulation analysis shows that the proposed strategy has a good tie-line power smoothing effect, which is beneficial to the efficient use of energy in the park's integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Collaborative Optimal Scheduling of Economy Energy Efficiency in Energy Internet Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the development direction of energy field in the future, energy Internet is helpful to realize the efficient utilization of energy, help to play potential of multi energy complementary advantages, achieve the purpose of energy saving and emission reduction, and meet the goal of building a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient new generation energy system. Under the background of the interaction between the park and the regional energy Internet, firstly, the basic framework of interaction between typical the park and the regional energy Internet is introduced, and the stratification phenomenon under the geographical factors, scheduling factors and energy management factors is explained. Secondly, on the basis of establishing typical the lower level park and the upper level regional energy Internet model, the day-ahead exergy efficiency optimization scheduling model of the lower level park energy Internet model, and the day-ahead economic optimization scheduling model of upper level regional energy Internet are proposed, and the energy efficiency and economic multi-objective collaborative optimization scheduling problem are mapped into the cooperative game strategy. Then, it introduces the solution process of hierarchical collaborative optimization scheduling based on cooperative game in detail, and expounds the effect and function of outer cooperative game and inner cooperative game. Finally, the rationality and superiority of the hierarchical collaborative optimization model and method based on cooperative game are verified by example analysis and comparison.

articleTitle: Research on Three-degree-of-freedom Control of Three-phase Dual Active Bridge to Minimize Current Stress
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The three-phase dual active bridge converter has the advantages of high-power-density and easy realization of soft switching, which is very suitable for bidirectional high-power transmission applications. In this paper, a three-degree-of-freedom duty cycle control method is proposed to reduce the current stress under light load and voltage mismatch conditions. Firstly, there are different working modes with this control method are classified and compared through time-domain analysis. Secondly, taking the current stress as the optimization objective, the optimal operating trajectory in each mode is solved by Lagrange multiplier method, and the global minimum current stress operating method in full power range is obtained. Finally, a 30kW prototype is built to verify the effectiveness of proposed control method.

articleTitle: An Optimized Control Strategy for Distributed Energy Storage System to Reduce the Peak-valley Difference of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accompanied by energy structure transformation and the depletion of fossil fuels, large-scale distributed power sources and electric vehicles are accessed to distribution network that result in the load peak-valley gap increasing. Energy storage system (ESS) possessed the characteristics such as quick response, precise control and energy bidirectional flow. Therefore, the configuration of ESS in grid is a feasible measure to reduce the difference between peak load and valley load. This paper presents a superior control strategy that uses distributed energy storage to smooth load fluctuation of grid. Set the time scale to one day, constraints such as energy storage capacity, power and state of charge are taken into account, and the calculation examples are designed based on the proposed the evaluation index compares the effect of optimized control strategy given in this paper with the current common constant power strategy, which proves the feasibility and effect of the presented method.

articleTitle: Research on Line Switch Statuses Identification in Distribution Networks Using TTU Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The intelligence level of distribution networks keeps improving in recent years. For example, in China, the distribution transformer supervisory terminal unit(TTU), which can intelligently monitor and manage the distribution transformer area, is being widely installed in distribution networks. These TTUs can provide real-time distribution transformer operation data. To increase the value of these data, this paper focuses on the line switch statuses identification technology in distribution networks using TTU measurement data. Firstly, based on the analysis of the TTU measurement data, an optimization equation of which the objective function is the residual error between measurements and estimations is formulated. Secondly, the nonlinear terms in the original optimization equation are eliminated, and it is converted into a mixed integer quadratic programming(MIQP) problem so that it can be solved using the standard method. Moreover, a voltage measurement correction algorithm using the solution of the objective function is proposed. Finally, case studies are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Forecasting Method in Rural Areas Based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the performance of rural power load forecasting, a new power load forecasting method is proposed. Firstly, basic and statistical features are extracted from historical power load data and numerical weather prediction (NWP) data. Then, t-SNE dimensionality reduction is used to extract main features, and K-means clustering is used to distinguish seasonal features. Secondly, the deep learning network CNN-LSTM (fusion of convolutional neural network and long short-term memory) is designed, and the load prediction models for spring and autumn, summer and winter are trained separately. Finally, use a rural power load in Wuxi, China to predict the power load in the next 24 hours and calculate the error. Experimental results show that the forecasting error of the proposed method is lower than that of LSTM, ARIMA and other prediction models.

articleTitle: Research on the Practice of Rural Electrification Improvement Project Focusing on Rural Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The comprehensive implementation of the rural electrification promotion project is a major strategic measure for the country to consolidate the agricultural foundation and help and guarantee the revitalization of the rural areas. State Grid Shandong Electric Power Company summarized the main practices and experiences of rural electrical upgrading projects, analyzed the increasingly diversified energy demand trends and characteristics of modernized rural areas, and combined with the world-leading energy Internet strategy with Chinese characteristics to build rural energy Internet. Through the promotion of "power supply + energy efficiency" services, new ideas and new technologies for rural electrification improvement projects were carried out, and a typical construction method was empirically studied using a village in Shouguang as an example.

articleTitle: Impact of Photovoltaic Grid-connected on Distribution of Power System Disturbed Oscillation Center
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected technology, the PV grid-connected capacity has increased sustainably. Due to the stochastic volatility and indirectness of PV power, the PV grid-connected technology has greatly influenced system instability mode and oscillation center distribution. The simulation is carried out under two conditions: the location of PV grid-connected; the relative position between fault point and PV power, which is based on the out-of-step oscillation criterion of the bus voltage frequency, the PV power supply model and its control strategy. The results show that the change of PV grid-connected location will change the system's equivalent external characteristics and cause the oscillation center to migrate between different lines. The frequency of oscillation center migration increases when the fault location is closer to the PV grid-connected location.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Impedance Modeling and Stability Analysis of BDFIG Tied into Weak Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Brushless doubly fed induction generator (BDFIG) is a potential alternative to the well-known DFIG in wind power generation field due to its high reliability and low maintenance cost in virtue of the elimination of brushes and slip rings. However, the stability issue of BDFIG-based wind power system under weak grid still leaves unknown. To settle such problem, this paper establishes the input admittance model of the BDFIG system in the generic vector synchronous frame, where the influence of current control loop and phase-locked loop (PLL) are considered. Then the interaction between the BDFIG system and the weak power grid is evaluated and discussed. To be specific, the effect of the control parameters on the system stability is analyzed in detail by applying the generalized Nyquist criterion (GNC). The correctness of the theoretical analysis is finally verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Overview of charging and discharging dispatching strategies for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The wide application of electric vehicles (EVs) is an important part of promoting traffic electrification, but how to solve the negative influence of EV charging behaviors needs researchers to strive. This paper gives an overview of charging and discharging dispatching strategies for EVs. First, the specific negative influence of the extensive access of EVs is analyzed. Then, the researches on charging loads of EVs are summarized. Finally, the content of EV dispatching is introduced, from the aspects of V2G technology of EV, demand response measures and dispatching modes. Based on that, this paper summarizes some shortcomings of the current research, and some possible research directions are reasonably speculated. To sum up, the EV dispatching technology is summarized, which provides suggestions for the promotion of EVs.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant Strategy of MMC with Hybrid Reserved Redundant Submodules
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters (MMC) are widely used in high-voltage DC transmission and medium-voltage DC distribution networks. In order to improve the reliability of MMC, the arms are usually equipped with redundant submodules (SM), which effectively reduces the risk that the MMC shuts down due to SM failure. Based on the redundant SMs, the fault-tolerant strategy of hybrid cold and hot SMs is improved. Compared with the redundant fault-tolerant strategy with single type of reserved SM, the complexity of the improved algorithm is reduced. On the basic of the improved fault-tolerant strategy, a control strategy for the charging of the cold reserved SM is proposed, which can effectively reduce the impact on the output performance of the MMC during the charging process of cold reserved SM. The validations of the conventional hybrid reserved fault-tolerant strategy and the proposed hybrid reserved fault-tolerant strategy are compared in a 19-level MMC model by the PSCAD/EMTDC platform. According to the simulation results, the proposed fault-torlerant control algorithm can reduce the impact of SMs fault on the performance of MMC.

articleTitle: Study on the Oscillation Center of DFIG-based Wind Farm Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of randomness, volatility and low inertia, the large-scale integration of new energy units has changed the original power flow distribution and deteriorated the transient stability of the system, resulting in the migration of the system oscillation center, which can even affect the accurate action of the splitting control. Aiming at the problem that the integration of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) affects the migration law of the oscillation center, firstly the Thevenin equivalent model of DFIG is constructed and the operating characteristics are analyzed. And then the equivalent admittance model of DFIG is constructed. Finally, based on the equivalent admittance model, the migration law of the oscillation center in the DFIG-based wind power system is analyzed. The results show that the out-of-step center (OOSC) moves away from the DFIG-based wind farm integration point when DFIG generates reactive power and moves close to the integration point when DFIG absorbs reactive power. While the migration range of the oscillation center extends to the entire line.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Configuration of C-C and C-V of WPT System Based on LCL-LCC Compensation Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the operation of WPT (Wireless Power Transmission) system, load changes will cause the system's operating voltage and current to become unstable, and further cause circuit equipment to malfunction. A LCL-LCC type compensation network applied in wireless power transmission system was proposed in this paper. The circuit model was established to derive the working conditions of the primary side C-C (constant current) and secondary side C-V (constant voltage). And the current expression of the primary side and load voltage expression of the secondary side was obtained. The relationship between voltage gain of the system and capacitors of the secondary side was analyzed. In order to keep the current of the primary side and the load voltage of the secondary side stable when the circuit load changes, a circuit parameter design method with adaptive parameter configuration features was proposed which no control strategy is needed. Finally, the rationality of the proposed parameter design method was proved by the results of software simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Characteristics of 10kV Power Cable Defects under Very Low Frequency Voltage and Oscillating Wave Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Both very low frequency voltage and oscillating wave voltage are applied to the partial discharge detection of power cable. In order to compare the partial discharge characteristics of power cable defects under very low frequency voltage and oscillating wave voltage, 10kV heat-shrinkable, cold-shrinkable power cable samples with axial and radial knife marks defects, with water-intake defect and with no defect were respectively tested under very low frequency and oscillating wave voltage. Partial discharge tests were carried out, and the partial discharge inception voltage, maximum partial discharge volume and partial discharge waveform were measured and recorded. The test results show that the partial discharge inception voltage of 10kV power cables under the oscillating wave voltage is lower than that of the very low frequency voltage. Under the same fixed voltage, the maximum partial discharge of the oscillating wave voltage is larger, the number of partial discharge pulses is more, and the partial discharge waveform is more dense than that of the very low frequency voltage.

articleTitle: Study on the optimization of CFPREV by adapative threshold
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Commutation failure is a common fault in HVDC transmission systems. In order to reduce the risk of commutation failure, commutation failure predictive control is often configured in engineering.After detecting the fault, the criterion is triggered by a given threshold, output trigger offset angle to increase commutation margin. Because the threshold is often given in the actual project, it can only meet part of the failure conditions. For most other fault conditions, the given threshold cannot suppress the commutation failure. This paper presents an adaptive threshold selection method. By analyzing the relationship between AC bus voltage and commutation failure, an adaptive criterion is established to reduce the probability of commutation failure. In PSCAD/EMTDC, based on CIGRE Benchmark model is used for calculation and analysis. The simulation shows that the optimized threshold can suppress the commutation failure in short-circuit fault.

articleTitle: Evaluation and optimization of safety performance state of grounding grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The grounding grid is an important part of ensuring the safety of power plants and substations, and its performance is directly related to the safety of people, equipment and power grids. After the grounding grid is running, due to the concealment of the project, it lacks sufficient technical means to evaluate it after it is put into operation, which has caused many difficulties for equipment operation, personnel safety and grounding grid maintenance. In order to solve the above problems, this paper uses CDEGS software to simplify the modeling of the grounding grid of a substation, and evaluates the performance of the grounding grid by analyzing the soil resistance layered model, touch voltage, step voltage and other parameters of the grounding grid, and give an optimization plan.

articleTitle: Topology and Control Strategy Research for a Novel Compact Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The medium voltage AC/DC converter is an essential equipment for formation of AC/DC hybrid distribution grid. This paper proposes a hybrid converter topology between the modular multilevel converter (MMC) and the two-level topology, named as compact modular multilevel converter topology, which is suitable for the application in AC/DC hybrid distribution grid. This topology adopts three-phase shared capacitor design to reduce the number of sub-modules and the required capacitance value. The modular multi-level design is applied to improve the power quality of the AC side. This paper will at first briefly introduce the proposed topology and the working principle. The power control, sub-module capacitor voltage balance and pre-charging control strategies required for the operation of the converter will be further respectively demonstrated. Compared with traditional MMC, only 1/6 sub-modules and 1/2 capacitance is required by the proposed topology, which can greatly reduce costs and improve system integration level. At last, performance of the compact MMC and the proposed control strategies are evaluated by simulation tests and conducted in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Stability of MMC Grid-Tied System under Two Typical Unbalanced Grid Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The AC transmission network of Modular Multilevel Converters (MMC) usually adapts the overhead line, so the single-phase grounding faults of the AC side are rather general. At this time, the protection system will cut off the fault line for the first time, so there are two unbalance grid conditions (UGCs), i.e. single-phase grounding (SGUGC) and disconnection (SDUGC) during this process. However, the comparative analysis of small-signal stability under two different UGCs has never been involved. Therefore, when ignoring the transient process of faults and protection actions, and considering the inherent properties of the MMC system, two small-signal models based on the linear time-periodic (LTP) theory are built under SGUGC and SDUGC, respectively. Then, the influence of control parameters on the system stability under the two UGCs is compared in detail, and the results provide theoretical support for the control parameters optimization after protection system action. Finally, the detailed nonlinear MMC grid-connected model verifies the analysis results.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of IGBT Power Module Electro-thermal Coupling Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power semiconductor devices play a key role in aerospace, electric vehicles, medical and so on. As the main force in power semiconductor devices, IGBT is currently the most advantageous power semiconductor device. Firstly, this paper proposes a power loss calculation model based on the average loss of the switching period. Secondly, an electrothermal simulation model of the IGBT module is established in MATLAB and PLECS combined with the thermal network model. Finally, the simulation results of the two models are compared to discuss the influence of different parameter changes on the junction temperature and power loss of the IGBT module. Form the simulation analysis, it can be seen that the electrothermal model proposed in this paper can accurately determine the trend of device junction temperature changes, and has a good application prospect in the life prediction of power devices in the future.

articleTitle: Detection of lithium plating based on the distribution of relaxation times
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium plating leads to severe capacity fading and possible safety problems in lithium-ion batteries (LiB). Therefore, it is necessary to provide an in-situ detection methodology of lithium plating evolution during battery cycling. Qualitative analysis of the Distribution of Relaxation Times (DRT), based on Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) deconvolution, shows a different degradation mechanism between lithium plating and normal aging batteries. A Support Vector Machine (SVM) detection algorithm based on the DRT is proposed. It only relies on the measured capacity and EIS data during battery aging, which is also easy to process and non-destructive to battery sample. The method has a significant advantage in battery safety management and echelon selection of retired batteries.

articleTitle: Loss Minimization Control for Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor in a Wide Speed Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To achieve the loss minimization control of the interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSMs) in a wide speed range, the loss model for IPMSMs is established considering the dynamic working conditions. The implicit expression of the direct-axis (d-axis) current that minimizes the loss is derived, and the numerical method is used to solve the optimal d-axis current. Furthermore, the equivalent iron loss resistance is estimated to update the loss model with an extended Kalman filter (EKF). The proposed strategy combined with the field-oriented control method is compared with the traditional control strategy where the maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) strategy is used below the rated speed and the flux weakening control (FW) or maximum torque per voltage (MTPV) strategy is adopted above the rated speed. The research results show that compared with the traditional strategy the proposed strategy can minimize the total electrical losses in the full speed range and obtain higher efficiency under both dynamic and steady state. Moreover, the dynamic response below the rated speed is faster. The proposed loss minimization control strategy achieves a unified solution in a wide speed range and has the advantages of fast and concise calculation, which is suitable for both the dynamic and steady working conditions and more efficient.

articleTitle: Electrical Breakdown Characteristics of Soil under Pulse High Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A number of studies have been carried out on the breakdown of soil under large impulse current in the grounding of power systems. In contrast, there is less research on the electrical discharges for soil remediation. These types of discharges are usually non-thermal. It’s necessary to have an in-depth understanding of the key physical and chemical mechanisms underlying electrical discharge process for soil remediation. This paper studies the corona discharge characteristics in soil produced by pulsed high voltage excitations. A new method is applied to obtain the images of electrical discharge in soil and the discharge phenomena are analyzed. The voltage and current waveforms are investigated. The effects of applied voltage and pulse width are studied through experiments. The mechanisms behind the experimental phenomena are discussed.

articleTitle: Brushless DC Motor Control Based on Perturbation Observer in Model Predictive Control Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the FOC control method is often used in Brushless DC Motor (BLDCM), however, the accuracy of the FOC depends heavily on complex vector modulation and PI parameter regulation. Model predictive control (MPC) can deal with discrete switching states directly without vector modulation and PI parameter regulation, and has faster current response. However, no matter FOC strategy or MPC strategy, the noise of measured current is unavoidable. Moreover, the control accuracy of MPC mainly depends on the accuracy of motor model. It has been proposed to use Kalman observer to filter the measured current to reduce the noise in the quadrature current. In practical application, the parameters of the motor vary with different working conditions, and there are some unknown disturbances. These factors will greatly reduce the accuracy and stability of current predictive control. Therefore, this paper proposes a model predictive control method with disturbance observer. In this paper, the disturbance term is added to the motor model, disturbance observation is added to the Kalman current observer, and the current is used to estimate the disturbance value online, which reduces the accuracy requirement of the motor model by MPC strategy. The current robustness and disturbance rejection performance of the proposed strategy are demonstrated in a simulation based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Overcurrent limiting and quench recovery characteristics of superconducting tapes utilized in SFCLT under AC impact
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The 2G superconducting tapes are widely applied in the field of electric power because of low-impedance current-carrying characteristics in the superconducting state and the overcurrent-limiting in the normal state, and Superconducting Fault Current-Limiting Transformer (SFCLT) is one of the most important applications of superconducting tapes in power equipment. In this paper, a simulation model of superconducting tape is established to analyze the overcurrent limiting ability of superconducting tape, and then AC impact experiments are carried out with different types of superconducting tapes to study the quench and recovery characteristics. The experimental results demonstrates the correctness of the simulation model. The results in this paper can be utilized to select the suitable superconducting tapes for SFCLT.

articleTitle: Influence of Synchronous Generator Excitation Parameters on Power System Transient Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The comprehensive influence of synchronous generator excitation parameters on power system transient voltage stability was studied and analyzed. Firstly, based on the principle of trajectory sensitivity analysis, a quantitative method was proposed to evaluate the influence of single excitation parameter of synchronous generator on transient voltage stability of power system. The influence degree of single excitation parameter of synchronous generator on transient voltage stability of power system was determined by this method. Furthermore, under the constraint of maintaining the transient voltage stability of power system, the optimal values of excitation parameters and the change trend of transient voltage stability caused by the different values of excitation parameters were determined. Finally, based on the influence degree of excitation parameters on the transient voltage stability and their optimal values under the constraint of transient voltage stability, a quantitative index which can comprehensively evaluate the transient voltage control performance of synchronous generator excitation system was proposed. Extensive simulation results of a large power grid show that the proposed method and index can effectively evaluate the influence of generator excitation parameters on the transient voltage stability of power system.

articleTitle: Dielectric Properties of Epoxy/Paper Composites in the High-low Temperature Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy resin impregnated paper (ERIP) composites are the main insulation material of capacitance core of the capacitance graded bushing. The insulating property of ERIP composites are relevant with the change of environmental temperature. Therefore, the influences of high-low temperature environment on the dielectric response properties of ERIP composites were studied in the paper. Firstly, the cycles test of ERIP samples is carried out by high-low temperature environment from 20°C to 120°C, and the frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy (FDS) test is performed on the ERIP sample at each cycle. Then, the dielectric loss factor (tanδ) and the real and imaginary parts of complex capacitance at different cycle numbers and frequencies are all analyzed in the paper. Finally, the features are extracted from the frequency domain of the tanδ, and the relationship with the features and the cycles is established. The test results and analysis indicated that as the number of cycles increases, the value of the tanδ and the imaginary part of the complex capacitance has an increase trend, while the value of the real part of the complex capacitance decreases with the increase of the number of cycles. As the number of cycles increases, the rate of change of the power tanδ, the imaginary and real parts of the power complex capacitance are 46.79%, 39.73% and 4.26% respectively. The tanδ at 1Hz, 0.46Hz and 0.22Hz are the selected features, all of which have linear relationship with the cycle times. The conclusion can provide a data basis for insulation state of the ERIP composites within the capacitance graded bushing.

articleTitle: Energy Optimal Management of Microgrid with High Photovoltaic Penetration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For microgrid with high photovoltaic penetration, the optimized energy management strategy can not only improve the microgrid benefits effectively, but also ensure the safety and stability of island microgrid. This paper establishes a multi-objective energy optimization model of the microgrid with high photovoltaic penetration based on the photovoltaic operation and maintenance costs, the energy storage system operating life loss, the thermal power environmental pollution and governance costs, the electricity trading from grid, and the fine for controllable load shedding. Then obtain energy optimal management strategy by particle swarm algorithm with inertial weight factor. Finally, the proposed energy optimal management system is verified on a typical microgrid by simulation.

articleTitle: Power Quality Disturbances Recognition Based on Deep Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Traditional power quality disturbances(PQDs) recognition methods are based on selecting features manually and then use classifiers to classify. For huge amounts of data, this method has the problem of insufficient features or redundant features, which leads to low recognition accuracy. With the development of deep learning technology, this paper proposes a PQDs identification method based on a deep residual network. This method links the two sets of convolutional layers in the traditional convolutional network into a residual block through short-cut. Then, it learns layer by layer through residual blocks, acquiring the deep features of data. Thus it realizes the identity mapping of the redundant layer by short-line connections to solve the network degradation problem of deep networks, and reduces the difficulty of network training. Finally, the softmax layer is used for classification. In order to test the anti-noise ability of the network, the deep residual network model is trained with the data added with Gaussian white noise. Simulation results show that, comparing with ordinary convolutional networks, the method proposed can accurately identify 7 types of single disturbances and 5 types of composite disturbances in different noise conditions. Furthermore, it has higher robustness and better network convergence speed.

articleTitle: Identification of Transformer Magnetizing Inrush Current Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the fact that the existing feature quantities cannot well identify the magnetizing inrush current during remanence and bias and the huge number of feature quantities, a new identification method using empirical mode decomposition energy index and artificial intelligence algorithm is proposed in 'this paper. Decomposition and denoising are realized through empirical mode decomposition, and then the corresponding energy index is obtained for the waveform of each inherent modal component and simplified by the mean impact value method. Finally, the accuracy of prediction using artificial intelligence algorithm is close to 100%. This reflects the practicality of the method proposed in 'this article.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Prediction of Spacecraft Cable Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The cable is a key component for spacecraft to transmit energy, power and signal. Because of its resistance, it will inevitably generate heat under the action of a long time current. Therefore, temperature is the main factor affecting the life of spacecraft cable. This paper proposes an intelligent algorithm model based on Back-Propagation (BP) neural network. The algorithm, which does not depend on the complex characteristic parameters of the spacecraft cable itself, realizes the temperature calculation through training the BP network. The simulation results show that the algorithm has the advantages of high accuracy and fast convergence speed. The calculated temperature can guide and improve the design of cable layout and direction. Further calculated cable life can provide a strong foundation for future spacecraft to distribute electrical energy intelligently and autonomously.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Amorphous Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Cogging Torque and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Because of its advantage of low core loss, amorphous alloy can replace traditional silicon steel as motor stator core, which can significantly improve motor efficiency. Based on the analysis of an 18kW amorphous permanent magnet synchronous motor, the structure of it is optimized by using optimized pole-slot combination, step skewing of rotor and multi-objective genetic algorithm for cogging torque and efficiency at low speed and high torque. Through finite element method and prototype experiment, it can be seen from the cogging torque waveform and efficiency MAP chart of the initial motor and the optimized motor, that the cogging torque is greatly dropped after optimization, and the efficiency at low speed and high torque is also improved. These prove the effectiveness of the optimal design.

articleTitle: Influence of Box-in Structure on Heat Dissipation Performance of UHV Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Box-in structure is a structure used to reduce the noise effect of the converter transformer, but it also brings about the problem of reduced heat dissipation performance of the converter transformer. To study influences of Box-in structure on the heat dissipation and temperature distribution of Ultra-High Voltage(UHV) converter transformers so as to guide the heat dissipation of converter transformer and ensure its safe and stable operation, the following workwas done in this paper: Based on the finite element principle, the commercial software COMSOL was used to establish the electromagnetic-thermal-flow field simulation model of the converter transformer and its surrounding environment. Then, the influence of the Box-in structure on the temperature rise of the converter transformer and its surrounding environment under different ambient wind speeds was analyzed. After the above work, the following conclusions were obtained: the existence of the box-in structure significant reduces the convection heat dissipation capacity of the converter transformer box wall, resulting in that when the converter transformer with Box-in structure is compared with the one without Box-in structure, its average box wall temperature is 3.7K higher, and the local temperature is 7.7-17.55K higher; the hot-spot temperature rise of the converter transformer box wall decreases with the increase of ambient wind speeds. The research results obtained in this paper can be used to guide the heat dissipation of the box-in structure UHV converter transformer to ensure its stable operation.

articleTitle: Non-uniformity Analysis of Parameter Distribution in a 7-channel Serpentine Flow Field Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is a competitive energy conversion device with the zero emission of greenhouse gas and high efficiency. However, cell inconsistency in stack and non-uniformity in single cell affect the performance and accelerate localized degradation. A 7-channel serpentine flow field PEMFC is modeled based on the practical one. In this paper, numerical simulation method based on computational fluid dynamics is applied to investigate the distribution of physical field in membrane. The accuracy of simulation results is verified by experimental polarization curve. The current density, temperature and water content distribution under two working states (0.7665 V and 0.5311 V) are selected for analysis, and the distribution non-uniformity is quantitatively described and compared. The results demonstrate that numerical simulation is a convenient and inexpensive method assisting to PEMFC analysis in engineering application.

articleTitle: Study on Partial Discharge of GIS Based on Optical Fiber EFPI Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to detect ultrasonic signals for partial discharges in GIS using a built-in optical fiber EFPI sensor. The finite element method is used to simulate the propagation characteristics of the ultrasonic signal in the SF6 in the GIS. It is found that the degree of attenuation of the ultrasonic signal reaches almost 90% after passing through the first partition type basin-type insulator. From the distance detection characteristics of the optical fiber EFPI sensor in the GIS, it is found that the amplitude of the partial discharge signal measured by the sensors at different distances attenuates from fast to slow, which is comparable to the signal attenuation law in the simulation. On comparison, it was found that the sensitivity of the optical fiber EFPI sensor is significantly higher than that of the piezoelectric sensor.

articleTitle: Optimal Partition for Power System Restoration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The reasonable and scientific partitions of power system is very helpful to speed up the black-start restoration by recovering each subsystem in parallel. A new partitioning model and effective solving algorithm for parallel restoration of power grids is proposed. Firstly, a new partitioning model is built according to the practical process of system restoration, which is a large mixed integer nonlinear programming(MINP) problems. Secondly, in order to overcome the difficulty of directly solving a large MINP issue, a step by step solving algorithm is designed: firstly, non-black-start-generators (NBSG) are divided into subsystem based on electrical distance and adjust it to make the total output of each subsystem as balanced as possible; secondly, load buses are divided into subsystems based on the results of power flow tracing calculation and adjust it to make the power mismatch between generation and load requirement in each subsystem as small as possible. The samples demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the model and algorithm proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of commutation failure propagation characteristics and influence factor of multi-infeed LCC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The multi-infeed DC system can effectively transmit power and ensure the flexibility of the system’s operation mode, but the strong coupling among the converter stations makes the analysis of the commutation failure (CF) problem complicated. To this end, this paper firstly studies the propagation characteristics of CF among multiple stations, and the influence of the coupling impedances among these stations and the fault location on the CF. Then a method based on the decoupling idea is used to change the CF analysis problem of a multi-infeed DC system into that of the weakest single-infeed system. Finally, using the simulation analysis, the influence of fault type/wiring mode on CF is analyzed considering the relationship between the extinction angle, i.e., the CF criterion, and the influence of various variables on this factor is studied.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of Transient Overvoltage after Large Disturbance Considering Dynamic Characteristic of Wind Turbine Generators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of centralized access of large-capacity high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission and high-ratio renewable energy (RE) generation, this paper studied the mechanism and impact factors of transient overvoltage under large disturbance considering dynamic characteristic of wind turbine generators (WTG). Firstly, the theoretical equations calculating the magnitude of transient overvoltage on the converter station (CS) side and the WTG side after AC/DC disturbance were derived. Then, the mechanism of transient overvoltage caused by AC/DC disturbance were analyzed. Finally, the impact of different factors such as WTG active/reactive power characteristics during low-voltage ride through (LVRT) on transient overvoltage was analyzed combined with simulation. All the conclusions were verified through simulation of practical case systems. The study results reflected that the LVRT characteristic makes the WTGs be another ‘reactive power source’ resulting in transient overvoltage besides the CS, the higher of the transient overvoltage is caused by the smaller of the WTG active output and the larger of the WTG reactive output.

articleTitle: Total Transfer Capability Evaluation of Power Systems Based on Stacking Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The total transfer capability (TTC) of flowgate is an important concern for operator during the power system operation. To provide fast and accurate TTC evaluation, this paper presents a TTC evaluation methods using the stacking ensemble learning method. Firstly, the repeated power flow is applied to calculate the TTC value under different scenarios. Then, the steady variables, including the active and reactive power, voltage and angle of generators, the active and reactive power of loads and the active power flow on transmission lines, are used as the input features. Finally, the stacking ensemble learning based on the XGBoost, RF, GBDT, MLP and SVM is used to obtain the final TTC evaluation model. The simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Protection of More Electric Aircraft DC power supply system based on solid-state circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of More Electric Aircraft, the protection of its DC power supply system is more important. DC solid-state circuit breaker (SSCB) has better performance in short-circuit fault protection of DC power supply system. Therefore, this paper mainly introduces the More Electric Aircraft DC power supply system protection based on a novel SSCB. The SSCB uses two transformers and two thyristors to realize the bidirectional protection of the system, and has a simple structure and low loss. This paper introduces the DC power supply system short-circuit fault principle at first, and then, introduces the working principle of the novel SSCB, and the SSCB is verified by simulation experiment at last.

articleTitle: Driving Switched Reluctance Motor by Full-bridge Converter with Ring Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A switched reluctance motor (SRM) always uses asymmetric H-bridge as its power converter, this type of circuit makes the cost of the SRM driving system higher than the cost of the conventional motor drives. The full-bridge inverter is a good alternative topology for the power converter for SRMs, this type of circuit has tower costs and more driving methods for SRMs than the asymmetric H-bridge. A new driving topology that can drive SRM by full-bridge converter is proposed in this paper, based on an existing ring structure, the improved driving topology can make the circulating current controllable, then the unnecessary power loss is avoided. The proposed topology is also tested with simulation and validation, the results show that the new structure works well for the SRM.

articleTitle: Evolution of the Stem During the Dark Period in Long Air Gaps
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The stem is an essential object of the streamer to leader transition and leader propagation processes. While it is not well observed especially during the dark period. The Schlieren technique was chosen to obtain the stem evolution process during the dark period in this paper. Experiments were carried out under positive switching impulses, and the Schlieren images of the stem were recorded. The results show that the structure of the first corona stem can be classified into the cylinder type and conical frustum one; the evolutions of the two types during the dark period are of different characteristics: the thermal diameter of the cylindrical type is smaller than that of the conical frustum one, while the channel length is opposite. Besides, the variation of the thermal diameter and channel length of the cylindrical stem can be divided into two stages, but they change linearly for the conical frustum type; the different types of stems have a great effect on the initiated path of the second corona stem.

articleTitle: Coupling Mechanism of Electricity Market and Water Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There is a strong coupling relationship between electricity and water. The development of the power industry requires a large amount of investment in water resources. How to balance power and water resources has become a difficult problem facing the economic and social development of water-scarce areas. This paper builds China's electricity-water coupling market, using a system dynamics model to simulate its coupling effect, and uses Shaanxi Province as an example to conduct empirical research. The results show that the introduction of water rights trading in the power market can achieve two effects. The first is to control the water consumption of the power industry while ensuring power demand, thereby effectively alleviating the problem of water shortage. Second, it is possible to promote the consumption of renewable energy through market methods and optimize the power supply structure.

articleTitle: Characterization of a Compact High-amplitude Electromagnetic field Pulse Generator with tunable parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A compact high-amplitude electromagnetic field pulse generator with tunable parameters, such a pulse wide, rising time, amplitude, is developed between a transmission stripline. The rising time can be tuned down to 8.2 ns, and the half pulse width up to 1730.8 ns, and the peak electromagnetic field up to 270 kV/m. By using a step motorina gas-fill vessel to move the electrodes, the discharge process can be controlled automatically by using a computer. The stability of the electromagnetic field between the impedance-matched transmission stripline then is characterized systematically in this paper.

articleTitle: A Novel Symmetrical Phase Dual CLLC Resonant DC-DC Converter for the Hybrid AC-DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a symmetrical dual phase CLLC resonant DC-DC converter with hybrid pulse frequency modulation and phase-shift control scheme for the hybrid DC-AC microgrid. The presented converter consists of two six-switch full bridges and dual phase CLLC (DPCLLC) resonant tanks. This dual phase converter can achieve softswitching on the both sides. The topology, average model, operating principle and power transmission characteristics are analyzed in detail. The control scheme of the proposed dual phase converter is to regulate the switching frequency of MOSFETs gate signal and the duty cycle of the resonant tank input voltage. In order to reduce the overshoot of the DPCLLC converter, a soft-start strategy is adopted, which increases the switching frequency and reduces duty cycle during the start-up state. The simulation results in PLECS can verify the feasibility of the dual phase CLLC converter and the control method.

articleTitle: A Two-Layer Trip Chain Model for Commuting Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the requirements of future sustainable transportation, the number of electric vehicles is increasing rapidly in recent years. The increased electric vehicle charging requirements have put pressure on local distribution networks, but also provide opportunities for the utilization of those flexible energy storage resources. And modeling electric vehicle driving and charging behavior is the key to estimate the charging load and further explore the potential of providing grid services. Therefore, the modeling of driving and charging behavior of electric vehicles is widely focused and different trip chain models have been proposed. However, the lack of sufficient real-world data is often the greatest barrier to the implementation of these models. In this paper, a two-layer trip chain model for commuting electric vehicles is proposed, where the bottom-layer model is similar to conventional trip chain models, but its parameters are generated from top-layer model. By introducing structured distributions of the bottom-layer model parameters to top layer model, only simple survey data are required for the model calibration; therefore, the data requirements of trip chain model are largely reduced. The driving and charging behaviors of commuting electric vehicles related to an office building are simulated, and the results show the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Transition Resistance Characteristics on the Waveform of Fault Current Travelling Wave in Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Travelling wave locating technology has become more and more mature. For operation and maintenance, it is also hoped to further determine the specific causes of faults, especially the causes of non-lightning faults. Various non-lightning faults are essentially different in the characteristics of the transition resistance, which leads to huge differences in the waveform of the travelling waves. In this paper, the generation principle of travelling waves is analyzed, a simplified equation that can describe the characteristics of current travelling waves is proposed, and the simulation and measured waveform are analyzed.
