The analysis results show that, for non-arcing nonlightning faults, the rising edge of the current travelling waves act as a step signal; for arcing non-lightning faults, since the development of arc requires a certain time, the rising edge of the current travelling waves will slow down. The rising edge is mainly affected by the arc gap length and the arc generation speed, and the rising time ranges from a few microseconds to tens of microseconds. The above analysis and conclusions can provide theoretical support for the identification of non-lightning faults based on current travelling waves.

articleTitle: Analysis and Test Method on Transient Step Response Character of High Voltage DC Electronic Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High voltage DC electronic current transformer is the key equipment in HVDC system, and its transient step response is one of the most important indicators for the control and protection, which is significant to power quality and power supply reliability of the power network. This paper introduces the structure of DC electronic current transformer and the corresponding transient step response character and related influence factors. A closed-loop test method on transient step response for DC electronic current transformer is proposed. Polynomial fitting is used to calculate the delay time of the step response, the rise time error of the field testing results and other key indicators. The validity of the test method is proved at a HVDC converter station testing system.

articleTitle: Stator Phase Resistance Trade-off Between Output Torque and Braking Torque of PMSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the braking torque of the surface mounted permanent magnet (SPM) motor for the electric sliding plug door (ESPD) system of the rail transport is studied. When the three-phase armature coils are short- circuited, the braking torque should be small to ensure passengers can open the door by themselves. The relationship between the impedance of the three-phase armature coils and the braking torque is deduced. The variation law of motor stator phase resistance and braking torque is obtained. The output torque and braking torque of motor with different stator phase resistance is compared. The model of the motor is built. A prototype of 12-slot/10-pole surface mounted permanent magnet synchronous (SPM) motor is designed and manufactured. The results of the experiment agree well with the theoretical and FE-simulation results.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Control for Islanded Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid Involving Multi-terminal AC and DC Subgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To realize the power dispatch in hybrid AC/DC microgrid involving multi-terminal AC and DC subgrids (HMG-MADS) and enhance the system inertia, a comprehensive control is proposed in this paper. Based on the principle of virtual synchronous generator (VSG) and virtual DC capacitor (VDC), the interrelationships of the bi-directional AC/DC converter (BAC) and bi-directional DC/DC converter (BDC) are analyzed. Then the demand of the virtual inertia is defined for BAC and BDC to enhance the system inertia while the reasonable power exchange law is determined for them to realize power support among the subgrids. Meanwhile, the AC subgrids voltage/frequency and DC subgrids voltage are well controlled by comprehensive control. With the defined demand of the virtual inertia and reasonable power exchange rule, a new P/V droop principle for BAC and a new P/V droop principle for BDC is established which can realize a proper assignment of subgrids supportive power and improve the system dynamic response. Finally, simulation results are demonstrated to show the effectiveness and feasibility of the comprehensive control algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of High Voltage Vacuum Circuit Breaker with Electromagnetic Repulsion Mechanism Based on Wavelet Packet Decomposition and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, high voltage vacuum circuit breakers (HVVCBs) based on electromagnetic repulsion mechanism (ERM) have been more and more used in power system. However, the mechanical parts of HVVCBs are easy to be damaged because of the short opening time, high speed and large impact of ERM. Therefore, a method based on wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) and random forest (RF) is proposed to diagnose the fault occurred in HVVCB with ERM. Firstly, the opening vibration signals of ERM at two positions and six different conditions are obtained. Then, WPD is used to analyze the time-frequency characteristics of the vibration signal and the normalized energy vector of each frequency band of the vibration signal is calculated. Finally, the fault diagnosis and classification are carried out based on random forest. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can quickly and effectively identify the mechanical and electrical circuit faults in HVVCB with ERM.

articleTitle: Research on magnetic bias characteristics of power grid transformer based on GIC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the exact effect of geomagnetic storms induced current (GIC) on transformer excitation characteristics, the Montreal observatory in Anhui Province in China was carried out in terms of magnetic wave data an soil resistivity parameters, consequently the area communication network frame model is established, followed by the calculation of earth magnetic field and geomagnetic storms induced current during (GIC) by using plane wave method. Further, based on UMEC transformer model, effect of GIC and geomagnetic field on transformer excitation characteristics in the interested areas are carried out by using CDEGS software to simulate the electric power system network and transformer nodes. eventually GIC calculations and risk assessments during geomagnetic storms are figured out. The results show that under the influence of strong solar storms, geomagnetic storms have a strong impact on the AC power grid in the interested area, GIC induced in the grid is much higher than that in the DC power transmission, results in an increased e peak value of the transformer excitation current. The proposed method can provide a reference for GIC calculation in the power system and its influence on the magnetic bias characteristics of the transformer.

articleTitle: Missing Data Completion Based on Nonlinear Feature Space Mapping for the Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power grid is a non-linear, highly-coupled, multi-dimensional mathematical-physical system, and its informatization is mostly dependent on empirical data. Nonetheless, this data is occasionally misplaced because of signal transmission malfunctions, sensor faults, or human errors. Retrieving these missing data is indispensable for the power system digitization, informatization, and intellectualization. This paper proposes a missing data completion method by a non-linear feature space mapping algorithm that maps nonlinearly related variables to linear space to obtain data linearly coupled with the variable, including missing data. Comparative experiments based on actual multi-dimensional grid data show that compared with multi-dimensional linear interpolation, the proposed algorithm can reduce the root mean squared error by 87.95% and the mean absolute error by 88.20% on average. And R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is more significant than 0.99. Besides, for all dimensional variables in the data set, the proposed algorithms have relatively high accuracy. Experiments prove that this algorithm is sufficient for the application of the power grid.

articleTitle: Real-time Power Angle Measurement based on Second-Order Generalized Integrator with Frequency-Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power angle of the synchronous generator is a key indicator that reflects the transient stability of the power system. The accurate measurement of the power angle is thus important to ensure the stable operation of the power system. In this paper, a real-time power angle measurement of synchronous generator is proposed, which is based on the second-order generalized integrator with frequency-locked loop (SOGI-FLL). Firstly, the terminal voltage and current of synchronous generator (SG) are collected in real-time. Secondly, the fundamental-frequency positive sequence signal is extracted from the instantaneous sampling data by using the SOGI-FLL. Then the generator vector equation is used to calculate the power angle. Meanwhile, the power angle error existing in the transient process is compensated by using the generator swing equation. The one machine infinite bus (OMIB) system is considered when building the power angle monitoring model of SG. Two scenarios under both steady state and transient state are respectively simulated with the MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results indicate that the proposed method can enable a better real-time calculation with high accuracy for both scenarios.

articleTitle: Simulation study of electric field strength of circular hole-like traps in GIS equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: GIS equipment is widely used in electric power production because of its many advantages, and metal particles are the main cause of insulation breakdown of GIS equipment in recent years. Particle traps are an important research value as a suppression measure. In this paper, the shielding average electric field strength and the maximum distortion electric field strength of five traps are compared by electric field simulation with different trap thicknesses, different slot widths and different slot spacings using a fully closed and semi-open coaxial cylindrical simulation platform with a circular hole-shaped trap as the object of study, so as to provide guidance for the subsequent dynamic process of particles and the trap design and layout strategy for final application.

articleTitle: Distributed Collaborative Optimization of Active Power Allocation for MMC-MTDC with Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the frequent power fluctuations of MMC-MTDC system caused by the randomness and fluctuation of renewable energy output, a distributed cooperative optimization control strategy for active power allocation is proposed in this paper. In this control strategy, when the power fluctuation of the system is small and the DC voltage deviation is less than the set value, the unbalanced power is borne by the main converter station to avoid sagging. Frequent adjustment of the coefficients; when the main converter station is not able to bear the power, the converter station using DC voltage sag control can allocate the remaining unbalanced power in proportion to its own capacity. Aiming at the deviation of active power distribution in DC voltage sag control caused by DC line resistance, a distributed cooperative optimization control method is used to optimize the active power distribution. Finally, the PSCAD and Matlab co-simulation platform is used for simulation verification. The proposed strategy improves the accuracy of active power allocation between converter stations and has strong robustness on the basis of ensuring DC voltage stability.

articleTitle: Short-term Peak-shaving Strategy for Coordinated Cascade Hydro and Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The uncertainty and fluctuation characteristics of photovoltaic power pose great challenges to the safe operation and the peak-shaving process of power systems. Since cascade hydropower plants have flexible and rapid regulating capacity, a short-term peak-shaving model for coordinated cascade hydro and photovoltaic system (CHPVS) is proposed. Then, the proposed peak-shaving model is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem, and the solution process is presented. Finally, a case study demonstrates the effective peak- shaving characteristics of CHPVS, and the feasibility and practicability of the proposed model are also validated.

Author Keywords: coordinated cascade hydro and photovoltaic system

articleTitle: Stepwise Impedance Analysis Method for Stability Assessment of Multi-Bus DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy generation technology, the DC power distribution system (DPSs) commonly contains various buses with different voltage levels. Under this circumstance, it is much more challenging to carry out stability analysis for such multi-voltage level DPSs. According to the mainstream methods, the multi-voltage level DPSs are directly equivalent to the source subsystem and load subsystem. However, this kind of impedance equivalence and stability analysis hide each voltage-level DC bus's impedance characteristic. When the impedance instability occurs, it will be challenging to identify the instability DC bus in DPSs. In this paper, a stepwise impedance analysis method for multi-level DPSs is proposed. The impedance stability is firstly implemented in the lowest voltage level of DPSs with the stability criterion. If the lowest voltage level of DPSs is stable, then the voltage level's impedance is converted to the upper voltage level through an interface converter. With the step-by-step stability analysis and equivalent impedance calculation, the multi-voltage level DPSs can be guaranteed if all of the voltage levels are derived stable. Lastly, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by simulations in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Structure and Performance Analysis of a Novel Bottom-excitation Eddy Current Retarder
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the most common auxiliary braking devices, eddy current retarder can greatly improve the safety and comfort of driving. Eddy current retarder is extensively applied due to its simple control and low cost. This paper presents a novel structure of eddy current retarder in which the coils are wound at the bottom between the salient poles of the stator of the retarder. Compared with traditional hub-type eddy current retarder, coils and stator salient poles have higher space utilization. The novel eddy current retarder is preliminarily analyzed based on the electromagnetic theory, and the finite element method is used to analyze the performance of the novel eddy current retarder. The novel eddy current retarder with the same design space and weight was compared with the traditional hub-type eddy current retarder. According to the analysis results, the braking torque performance of the novel eddy current retarder are better than that of the traditional hub-type eddy current retarder at the low speed and large coil current.

articleTitle: Verification Method of Power System Application Specific Processor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the verification method of power system application specific processor and the power system application specific function modules in the processor. The verification is done from the application view in designing the power system specific processor. By tracing the signal stream and the data stream, the signal data path method is used to segregate the problem by segmentation. The function verification of the processor is done by using test equipment such as an oscilloscope and a function generator commonly used in the laboratory. In the case that the processor, the power specific function module and the operating system may need to be modified, the method is used to shorten the verification process of the processor. And the method also simplifies the verification. For the performance of the FPGA emulation processor is very low, the frequency-down method is introduced to verify the application functions. These two methods speed up the whole verification of the processor.

articleTitle: Method of Power-Frequency Interval-Wave for Measurement of Large Grounding Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The measurement of grounding impedance has a high requirement for the instrument. In this paper, a method of measuring the power frequency interval wave of large-scale grounding device is proposed, which is studied from three aspects: principle, implementation and field application. The interval wave method outputs the interval voltage signal of power frequency through synchronous high-speed acquisition and power electronic switch, and then removes the influence of field noise by forward and backward difference of adjacent cycle signal. The noise of different types of strong interference is measured in the field, and the denoise performance of the interval wave method is analyzed by simulation. The application of the interval wave method in the measurement of the grounding impedance of a 500kV substation is realized, and the effectiveness of the method is proved by comparing with the different frequency method. The research results of this paper provide a reference for the lightening and intelligence of grounding impedance measurement equipment.

articleTitle: Capacity Clearing Method Based on Reliability Pricing Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a method for clearing power capacity. The method is based on the profits of the generators in the past years, the risk preference of investors and the value of capacity. It simulates the bidding of the supply and demand parties for auction clearing, and forecasts the auction results of the system in the future. This article verifies the model based on the operation data of the PJM market in the past few years, and adjusts the demand curve according to the actual operating results of the market.

articleTitle: An Improved Integrator Discretization Method for Multiple Second-Order Generalized Integrators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multiple second-order generalized integrators (MSOGI) can extract fundamental waves, harmonics and their orthogonal components in real time, which plays a vital role in power quality assessment, grid synchronization, harmonic compensation and other aspects. Different discretization methods of MSOGI determine the complexity of its implementation and the accuracy of its extraction. The discretization methods of MSOGI can be divided into three categories: the whole transfer function discretization of MSOGI, the transfer function discretization of second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) and the traditional integrator discretization. Among them, the first method is not easy to implement because of the order of transfer function. The latter two methods have some errors in phase angle and orthogonality. In order to pursue better performance, this paper proposes an improved discretization method based on MSOGI integrator discretization. This method has the advantages of small phase angle error, good output orthogonality and so on. It can better meet the discretization requirements of MSOGI with less computation, and is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Cost Estimation of Voltage Sag Mitigation Based on Improved Severity Index
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The voltage sag mitigation is a non-standardized, due to the lack of customer side details, treatment capacity estimation difficulties, easy to cause excessive or inadequate treatment. This paper studies the identification of the tolerance and capacity of the mitigated devices, and proposes an improved severity index that considers the severity of voltage sag’s residual voltage and duration. And the treatment capacity identification method based on the improved sag severity index and object capacity ratio is put forward and then estimates the required treatment costs. Based on the actual monitoring data of a city power grid, the empirical analysis results show that the proposed method is effective and reasonable.

articleTitle: Influence on Safe Operation in Active Distribution Network with Small Current Grounding Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When a large number of distributed generators access to the traditional distribution network, they will cause new risk problems on the safe operation of the power system. In order to analyse the impact of these problems, the simulation models of 10 kV distribution network, photovoltaic and wind turbine were established to explore the influence on safe operation in active distribution network (ADN) with small current grounding mode in this paper. The results show that, compared with neutral non-earthing mode, the neutral point grounding via the arc suppression coil can suppress the capacitive fault current, but increase the maximum value of earth potential rise of the earth connection grounding point. When the traditional power grid is connected with distributed generation, the fault voltage level of small current grounding mode is still within the safe range. If the safety of safe operation needs to be further enhanced technically, the low resistivity process of earth connection need to be improved.

articleTitle: Study on Fretting Wear and Electrical Contact for Single PP-IEGT Chip Module under Power Cycling Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The press pack IEGTs (Injection Enhanced Gate Transistors) modules have been widely used in numerous energy transportation systems, however the unpredictable reliability of devices is a critical concern. During operation condition, the chip is rated as the most fragile component within the package, and the fretting wear of on the aluminum chip surface is the initial step of chip failure. As wear intensifies, the chip surface is reconstructed and easily forms large cracks and intergranular scratches, which will further increase the contact resistance and result heat accumulation. Therefore, this paper focuses on quantitative analysis the fretting wear of chip surface under accelerated aging through experimental and numerical approaches. In terms of the micro perspective, the microstructural of aluminum metallization on the chip surface is observed by the electron microscope in this research, and the surface roughness is calculated to characterize the metallization degradation under power cycling. The results show that the fritting wear is a major micro-defect on the aluminum chip surface. With the number of power cycles increased, the cracks caused by fritting wear become denser, and they initially appear at the edge region and then extend to the center of the chip surface. Moreover, finite element simulations indicate that the thermal stresses are the key factors for electrical contact degeneration, which are affected by the friction coefficient and temperature variation.

articleTitle: System Energy Efficiency Comparison of AC and DC Buildings Based on Lagrange Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the penetration of renewable energy increases a lot, the needs for novel grid topology and control strategy attracts researches. The breakthrough of power electronics makes the power transformation between multiple voltage levels or different current forms easier and cost lower. As for typical commercial building with on-site generation, this paper proposed a novel optimization method for power flow assigned to parallel- connected converters between two voltage levels for DC distribution. By the utilization of Lagrange Multiplier Method, the energy management system for those converters are corrected. In addition, several popular energy efficiency definitions are compared and analysed for choosing the most accurate one to carry on system evaluation. By combining normalized value of economic and efficiency index, the weighting factor based metric is used to compare the conventional AC distribution and DC distribution. Based on the time sequential simulation, the results show that under such novel optimization strategy, the energy efficiency is increased by 3.83% while the grid electricity saving is about 75.53 MWh accounting for 5% of the total annual load consumption.

articleTitle: Influence of Silicon Steel Materials on Performance of PMSM with V-Shape PMs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the performance and structure of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with V-shape PMs used for electric vehicles (EVs) are designed. Then, the finite-element method (FEM) is used to analyze the basic performance of electromagnetic field, temperature field and stress field of the motor, as well as the multi-physics performance under different silicon steel materials. By comparing the motor performance under different materials, the influence law of silicon steel (SS) materials on motor performance is investigated, and the selection principle of SS materials for the driving motor of EVs is proposed.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Simulation of Photovoltaic-Hydropower Combined Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To alleviate the energy crisis and environmental pollution problem, more and more renewable energy generations are integrated into the power grid. Since the output power of the renewable energy generations fluctuates randomly, the integration of the renewable generation brings significant impact on the operation of the power system. It is well known that the hydropower generation has good feature of quickly power regulation, and the solar energy source is abundant near the hydro-power station in the West of China. Hence, a photovoltaic- hydropower combined generation system is proposed, and it is integrated into the power grid via a ±800kV ultra-high voltage direct current transmission line. The simulations are carried out on PSCAD, and the frequency regulation characteristic is also studied. The results demonstrate good dynamic characteristic of the combined energy generation system.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a New Symmetrical Three-phase Doubly Salient Electro-magnetic Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the asymmetry of each phase of the conventional doubly salient electro-magnetic generator (DSEG), this paper proposes a symmetrical design method. A 24/16-pole three-phase DSEG with long pitch excitation winding is designed. Each excitation element is wound across four stator poles so as to make the magnetic flux path of each phase consistent. And the number of each phase rotor pole obtuse angles sliding in (out) and that sharp angles sliding in (out) are the same. While realizing the three-phase symmetry of DSEG, the adoption of the pole shoes design to avoid the asymmetric contact becomes unnecessary. Then the electromagnetic characteristics of the traditional and the proposed symmetrical DSEG are simulated and compared by finite element method (FEM). The results show that each phase of the proposed DSEG is symmetrical and has good power generation performance, which solves the problems of large voltage fluctuation and phase current asymmetry in the operation of traditional DSEG power generation, and verifies the correctness of the design method and theoretical analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Ride Through Strategy of Power Unit of Cascaded H-Bridge Medium Voltage UPS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cascaded H-bridge medium-voltage UPS is widely used in medium-voltage distribution networks. Because it uses a large number of power switching devices, its reliability cannot be ignored. Given the H-bridge's short-term failure, the traditional bypass method will cause the failed unit's permanent isolation and reduce the UPS's operating efficiency. In order to solve the above problems, for short-term full-bridge lock-up, this paper proposes an adaptive fault ride-through strategy based on fault voltage feedforward calculation. For short-term single component failure, this paper proposes a complementary electrical level fault ride-through strategy. It can prevent the faulted unit from being irreversibly isolated. Simultaneously, it optimizes the UPS output voltage and current during the fault period to achieve fault ride-through. The simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC show that the proposed fault ride-through strategy has good feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Incremental Distribution Network Pricing Mechanism in China Based on LASSO Regression and Synthetic User Allocation Factor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Incremental distribution network (IDN) is unique in China. It is a newly sprouted transition product in electric power system reform period. As IDN is huge in number and lacks in regulation, the pricing is a difficult problem needed to be solved. Chinese government has issued a regulation to set IDN price, however, which is widely considered unreasonable. This paper proposes a new IDN pricing mechanism based on allowed revenue method, and LASSO regression is applied to determine synthetic user allocation factor (SUAF), which is used to allocate the allowed revenue fairly and reasonably between different types of users. The study concludes that: IDN pricing mechanism proposed in this paper is consistent with pricing principle, and the pricing result is objective and reasonable which can be popularized and applied to all IDNs in China.

articleTitle: Fast Bacteria Inactivation of Waste Water by Gas-liquid Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The experimental investigations of bacteria inactivation of waste water were carried out in a gas-liquid discharge reactor. Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) were selected as the typical Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria to study the sterilization efficiency of the device. The experimental results showed that pulsed discharges had a great effect of fast inactivation on microorganisms in waste water. After only 3 minutes of plasma treatment, the sterilization rates of both E. coli and S. aureus could reach to 99.99%. To investigate the sterilization mechanism of plasma, observations of scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and measurements of protein leakage were made. After plasma treatment, structures and morphologies of both two bacteria cells had undergone significant variations. With the increment of the discharge treatment time, protein leakage of the two bacteria kept increasing. The active radicals, high electric field and shock waves may work together to cause the severe damage of bacteria by interacting with cell walls. This may provide technical guide for the further application of microbial inactivation by gas-liquid plasma in waste water.

articleTitle: Comparative Study for High-Speed Permanent Magnet Motors with Solid and Ring Type Rotors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, two high-speed permanent magnet motors (HSPMMs) with solid and ring type permanent magnet rotors are designed and analyzed. The two HSPMMs with different rotor structures are compared comprehensively at the same speed, loss and output power. The electromagnetic performances for the two motors are analyzed in this study by Finite Element Method (FEM) Moreover, the thermal performances of the two motors are also estimated at the same cooling condition by the lumped parameter thermal network (LPTN) method. It is found the ring type permanent magnet rotor structure is with lower operational temperature for the HSPMM in this application.

articleTitle: Short Term Power Load Forecasting Based on Clustering and Long Short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and reliability of load forecasting, this paper proposes a load forecasting method based on clustering and LSTM(long short term memory network). Firstly, the K-means clustering method is used to learn the regional power consumption model. Then the support vector machine algorithm is used to find the relationship between the climate conditions and the power consumption model. According to the climate conditions, the trained model is used to predict the power consumption model. Finally, the LSTM neural network is used to predict the total power consumption of the day to be forecasted, and the predicted load curve of the power consumption pattern is combined with the predicted total power consumption to obtain the predicted load at each time point of the day to be predicted. Matlab platform was used to verify the prediction. Six days were randomly selected for prediction. The MAPE (mean absolute percentage error) of this model kept between 1.6% and 2.5%, which is higher in prediction accuracy than traditional prediction methods.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Modeling of the Dual Flux Modulator Magnetic-Geared Machine Based on Dual d-q Coordination System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A nonlinear mathematical model based on variable inductance and dual d-q coordination system of dual flux modulator magnetic-geared machine (DFM-MGM) was proposed in this paper. The closed-loop speed control performance based on the d-q coordinate system is investigated, and i<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf>=0 control is employed to analyze the static and dynamic performance of the DFM-MGM. Finally, the correctness of the proposed model is verified by experiment, the proposed model can predict the steady and transient process of DFM-MGM as a magnetic gear and electric machine.

articleTitle: Line Loss Rate Calculation Method for Low-voltage distribution network with HPLC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the difficulty in calculating the line loss rate due to the complex operation status and the large number of nodes of the low-voltage distribution network(LVDN), In this paper, the algorithm combining principal component analysis and k-means is used to carry out linear loss rate classification modeling calculation. The characteristic index of line loss rate is firstly established based on the inherent feature, climate feature and operation feature of the LVDN. Then, based on principal component analysis(PCA), the dimension reduction of the characteristic index of the line loss rate of the LVDN was carried out, and the clustering was carried out based on K-means algorithm. Finally, the line loss rate of LVDN is calculated based on multiple linear regression algorithm. The example is given to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm by calculating 204 data from a certain city.

articleTitle: Research on MMC control strategy based on Linear Active Disturbances Rejection Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been widely used in HVDC transmission projects because of its large- scale and cascaded topology. However, there are many problems in the control of internal circulating current and sub module capacitor voltage. As an effective method to solve the control problem of uncertain nonlinear systems, Active Disturbances Rejection Controller (ADRC) has been widely studied. Based on the existing control system, this paper introduces the idea of active disturbance rejection control, and designs a controller with faster response speed and stronger robustness, instead of the energy outer loop controller. Furthermore, PI + LESO controller is proposed to replace part of PI controller, and the control results are compared and analyzed. Real Time Digital Simulator (RTDS) is used to simulate the proposed control system. The results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid MMC DC Fault Ride-Through Control Strategy Based On Virtual DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aim at the lack of dc fault handling capability for modular multilevel converter(MMC), A novel dc fault ride- through (FRT) control strategy based on virtual dc motor (VDCM) for hybrid MMC, whose arm adopts the mixture of full- bridge sub-module (FBSM) and HBSM, is proposed in this paper. This proposed strategy adapts adopts AC and DC independent control which ensures that reactive power and voltage support can be provided for the dc system during dc fault. Besides, the proposed strategy can not only suppress the dc fault current under the pole-to-pole (PTP) fault, enahnces the stability of dc voltage for the dc system to improves the dc voltage stability when the dc grid operates normally by the power feedforward controller. Based on the analysis of the novel FRT strategy, The FRT capability is further optimized, three examples are established in PSCAD / EMTDC to verify its fault handling capability and steady-state anti-disturbance capability.

articleTitle: Distributed Control Method for User-level Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the proportion of distributed generation grows in power system, microgrid becomes an important role in consumption. As the number of facilities in radiating distributed power grid is great, the application of traditional centralized control or decentralized control methods are difficult to solve problems such as high control pressure, weak connection between the microgrid and main grid, or single point failure. Aiming at low-voltage user-level microgrid, this paper proposes a P2P control structure based on MAS to realize distributed control and ensure that operation standards can be met in both grid-connected and off-grid operations of microgrids. Through such method, rapid response to changes, control pressure lowered and single point failure avoided could also be fulfilled. By building user-level microgrid system in PSCAD/EMTDC, the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed control method are verified.

articleTitle: Thrust Force Ripple Optimization of MEMS Permanent Magnet Linear Motor Based on Harmonic Current Injection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a method optimizing the thrust force of a Micro Electro Mechanical System (MEMS) Permanent Magnet Linear Motor, based on harmonic current injection. Fourier decomposition is implemented to the air gap flux density of the motor to derive the fitting expression of the thrust force dependent to exciting current. Through analyzing the thrust force ripple of sinusoidal current excitement, the paper comes up with the strategy of harmonic current injection to eliminate the ripple component in the thrust force waveform. Mathematical demonstration is given that injecting harmonic current can totally eliminate the ripple caused by odd component of vertical air gap magnetic induction intensity. Simulation verification is implemented based on the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> and 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic injection control strategy, proving that the method is feasible for the thrust ripple is reduced to 4.3% of the value before optimazation. Experimental results lead to the consistent conclusion that the strategy shows good steady-state and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Additivity of Partial Discharge Signals form PDcheck Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, non-invasive detection and diagnosis technology of electrical equipment has developed rapidly. Pulse current method with PDcheck is one of the common methods to detect the partial discharge of electrical appliances. However, the PDcheck device not only detects the expected defect discharge, but also other types of discharge, especially the discharge of insulating bushing. And few efforts have been made to identify these two types of discharges. The purpose of this paper is to distinguish them with a simple and easy method. An experimental platform is designed, which is relatively easy to discharge. Then the needle plate defect on the disc insulator is set as artificial defect, and the defect is placed in the sealing chamber. The discharge threshold voltage of the defect can be controlled by adjusting the proportion of N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> in the environment. Two types of discharge can be identified by analyzing PRPD spectrum and time-frequency relationship. However, it is found that PDcheck results with different defects do not have superposition, which conflicts with previous experimental results. A possible explanation is put forward, i.e. when the intensity of partial discharge in the casing is close to or greater than the intensity of partial discharge in the defect, the partial discharge in the casing will produce electromagnetic interference to the defect. A more accurate explanation of this phenomenon needs further study.

articleTitle: Grid-based Spatial Load Forecasting Method Based on POI Information Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Spatial load forecasting (SLF) is the basis of grid planning for distribution networks. The development of the Internet makes it possible to apply big data technology to spatial load forecasting. Based on open source big data, this paper proposes a grid-based spatial load forecasting method based on point of information (POI) mining. Firstly, the application programming interface (API) of the network map platform is invoked based on Python programming language, the open source user data is obtained, and the ray method and regular matching method are used to carry out information mining, so as to obtain the basic data for grid-based spatial load forecasting. Secondly, by referring to the distribution network planning standards, the recommended power density per unit area of the planning area is decided, and the basic data are normalized to reflect the load distribution of each grid. Then, based on the specific situation of the planning area, three total load forecasting methods are integrated for total load forecasting. Finally, combined with the total load forecasting results and load distribution, grid-based spatial load forecasting was carried out based on the total load forecasting results and grid load normalized proportion, and the forecasting results were verified by fitting the load development characteristic curve. Applying the method described in this paper according to the actual situation of the planning area can provide a basis for grid planning of the distribution network. At the end of this paper, the practicality of the method is verified in combination with the actual area.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Transient of the Resonant Oscillation Wave Field Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: XPLE power cable has widely used in urban power transmission network, and its insulation condition evaluation is usually carried out by power supply company after commissioning to ensure the safety and reliability of XPLE power cable transmission line. there are many off-line insulation condition test technology of XPLE power cable, but the resonant oscillation wave field test is prefered method due to its convenience and flexibility for field test. However, the resonant oscillation wave high voltage generator uses high-speed bidirectional solid-state switch to interrupt the primary current of the excitation transformer, which will produce large amplitude transient switching overvoltage and overcurrent on the excitation transformer. This paper illustrates the transient switching voltage and current overshoot phenomenon by electromagnetic transient simulaiton, and proposes a optimization method for the switching control method of the resonant oscillation wave high voltage generator. The results of the electromagnetic transient simulaiton has shown that the transient switching overvoltage on the excitation transformer windings can be effectively suppressed.

articleTitle: Transformer Load Capacity Assessment and Optimized Control Strategy of Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power transformer is the core of energy conversion and transmission, and its load capacity is an important assessment index of power grid's load capacity and safety reliability. With the growth of social power consumption, the overload phenomenon is becoming more and more prominent. In order to improve the load management level, this paper carries out the research work related to transformer load capacity assessment and optimized control strategy of cooling system. Firstly, the transformer load type and load capacity constraints are introduced. Then the load capacity is assessed by taking the top-oil temperature, hot-spot temperature (HST), capacity of auxiliary equipment and relative life loss as constraints. Finally, the optimized control strategy of cooling system is proposed. The results show that the main constraints of the normal periodic load capacity and the long-term emergency load capacity are the relative life loss and the capacity of auxiliary equipment respectively. Short-term emergency load capacity is not only limited by the temperature of top-oil and hot-spot, but also affected by the initial load rate. The sliding interval method is used to optimize the control strategy of cooling system, which can avoid the frequent switching caused by fluctuating load or environment.

articleTitle: Simulation and Design of Pulse Gas Injection in HFRC Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In FRC experimental studies, it is found that the parameters of the plasma formed after the collision merging greatly depend on the plasma parameters of the formation zone. The design and optimization of the pulsed gas injection device will help the ionization of neutral gas and thereby improving the plasma parameters of the formation zone. In this paper, studies are focused mainly on the change process of gas distribution of pulse gas injection stage, and design of the pulse gas injection device. The research takes the control of gas distribution as the goal and ANSYS FLUENT as a simulation platform to carry out the study. First, in this paper, we introduce several gas injection schemes that can be used in the pulse gas injection device, and ANSYS Fluent is used for simulation comparison. Through the analysis of simulation results, we have determined the most suitable scheme for gas injection. Then, we analyze in detail the axial and radial distribution of neutral gas at different time under the optimal scheme. And the results show the advantages of multi-valve gas injection. Finally, we predict the appropriate time duration of gas injection and ionization time when the pressure source is 2 × 10^5 Pa.

articleTitle: Stray Current Leakage Analysis of Rail Transit Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The low resistance characteristic of urban power grid makes it a good flow path for subway stray current. The distribution characteristics of stray current at transformer neutral point in AC power grid are closely related to the leakage characteristics of stray current on subway track. As far as possible, the subway system will monitor the stray current, but it cannot give a more in-depth analysis and treatment plan of the stray current invading the urban power grid. In this paper, a simplified calculation model of stray current distribution in urban AC power grid is proposed. Based on Monte Carlo method, the distribution law of stray current in power grid and the relationship between rail transit stray current leakage are given from the perspective of random analysis. Based on the results of the analysis, the paper further puts forward the optimization of rail transit stray current monitoring point selection scheme, by selecting fewer substations with wider coverage and more sensitive to stray current changes as current monitoring points. The results of calculation and analysis show that the optimization of stray current leakage monitoring of rail transit by using Monte Carlo simulation can improve the economy and effectiveness of leakage point location.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Homopolar Inductor Machines with Different Rotor Structures for Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, several novel homopolar inductor machine (HIM) topologies, such as rotors with the rectangular, arc-shaped, sinusoidal and triangle rotor slots, are developed. However, the influence of different rotor slots on the performance of HIM is not clear, and there is no basis for selecting rotor slots. Addressing this issue, a comprehensively comparative studies of these topologies with different rotor slot shapes are implemented. Firstly, the topology and operation principle of the HIM are illustrated. Then, the influences of rotor slot shape on the performance including the no-load air gap flux density, back electromotive force, inductance, torque, torque ripple and losses are systematically studied. Moreover, the stress distribution, modal and rotary inertia of rotor with four different rotor slots are analyzed. Based on the above analyses, the HIM with arc-shaped rotor slots is selected and its prototype is developed. Some electromagnetic performance indexes are tested to verify the rationality of analyses. This work clearly points out the advantages and disadvantages of HIMs with different rotor structures, which could be good reference for the selection of rotor slot shape.

articleTitle: Research on Key Geographic Factors Affecting Lightning Tripping Based on Association Rules and Entropy Weight
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lightning is one of the important causes of transmission line tripping. In order to improve the effectiveness of transmission line risk assessment and provide reference for lightning protection design, it is necessary to study the key geographical factors affecting lightning tripping. In this paper, firstly, the geographical features such as altitude, slope, slope aspect, slope position and land type of the tower are extracted by using ArcGIS geographic software, and then the association rules are used to study the relationship between various geographical factors and lightning tripping. Finally, the entropy method is used to calculate the weight of various geographical factors on lightning tripping and determine the key factors. After calculation, the influence weight of slope on lightning tripping is 0.49, which accounts for the largest weight among geographical factors, so the influence of slope on lightning tripping should be considered in lightning protection design.

articleTitle: A Measuring Method for Grounding Leakage Resistance of Distribution Network Based on Zero Sequence Voltage Regulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since most of the technologies for measuring distribution network’s ground parameters are mainly aimed at accuracy of the grounding capacitance, the grounding leakage resistance measurement is not accurate. In addition, the inaccuracy caused by the internal resistance of voltage transformer (VT) and the resonance elimination resistance is hard to avoid during the measurement, which results in a large error. Furthermore, traditional measurement methods cannot be applied to a variety of different system grounding methods, which are not conducive to practical applications. For this reason, this paper proposes a method to measure grounding leakage resistance of distribution network (DN) through zero-sequence voltage regulation. It selects the appropriate tap of the Y/ ∆ -connected grounding transformer external to the distribution network connected to ground to obtain a smaller zero-sequence voltage, and measures the zero-sequence current of the system at this time, and then substitutes the obtained voltage and current values into the calculation to get system grounding leakage resistance. The PSCAD/EMTDC simulation is run to prove the proposed method. The measurement results obtained have small errors and are suitable for different system wiring methods. It shows that the measurement method is of high accuracy, wide applicability, safety and economy to use.

Author Keywords: grounding leakage resistance of distribution network

articleTitle: A Configuration Strategy of Photovoltaic and cold Storage for Refrigeration System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing energy consumption in the refrigeration system, the environmental problems such as global warming and ozone depletion are becoming more and more serious. On this background, it is practical significant to provide options for energy-saving renovation in the refrigeration field. The paper takes a low-temperature cold storage as the research object. Firstly, according to the refrigeration system of the cold storage, two schemes of combining photovoltaic (PV) with lead acid battery and combining photovoltaic with ice thermal storage are proposed. Secondly, an optimal configuration method of the PV and energy storage system is proposed aiming at minimizing economy, as well as carbon dioxide emission. Detailed power balance and equipment operation constraints are established. The proposed optimization model is formulated a mixed-integer linear programming. A case study on a cold storage project in China with typical data of cold storage in summer, winter and transitional seasons is conducted. Case study demonstrates that the scheme with photovoltaic collaborating lead acid battery is the best solution. Meanwhile, it also shows that the energy storage equipment can reduce the total cost of the system, improve the utilization rate of photovoltaic, and promote economic and environmental benefits of the system.

articleTitle: Trans-provincial and trans-regional transmission pricing mechanism under regional unified spot market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transmission cost is an important part of the total cost of power end users, and its cost allocation and pricing mode will affect the behavior of market subjects including power generation and load in electricity transaction, and further affect the transaction situation, market efficiency and social welfare. Especially for trans-provincial and trans-regional power transmission projects, the unmatched transmission pricing method may affect the efficiency of large-scale resource optimal allocation and reduce the market dividend. Based on the three-node system, this paper discusses the construction of China's current regional power spot market and the pricing policy of trans-provincial and trans-regional power transmission, and analyzes the market clearing result, generation cost and transmission cost under the single-load ring network. The results show that if the trans-provincial and trans-regional transmission pricing method based on transmission volume is adopted in the trans-provincial and trans-regional energy transaction, the following problems will arise: 1) The efficiency of optimal allocation of resources and the social welfare will be reduced, the cost of power generation will be increased; 2) The establishment of the market clearing model of electricity energy with embedded transmission charges will greatly increase the optimization variables and clearing complexity.

articleTitle: Single-ended Protection Scheme of MMC-HVDC Transmission Line Based on Bridge Arm Inductor Voltage of Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Relay protection of transmission lines is one of the key issues facing the development of MMC-HVDC systems. This paper analyzes the fault equivalent circuit during the faults of the DC line in the different fault location in MMC-HVDC systems, and obtains the relationship between fault current components of upper and lower bridge arms, and analyzes differences of fault voltage components of both bridge arms inductors of converters on this basis. A protection scheme for MMC-HVDC transmission lines using the correlation coefficient of MMC upper and lower bridge arm inductors fault voltage components is proposed. The simulation results in PSACD show that the proposed scheme can effectively identify the fault location and has strong resistance to transition resistance.

articleTitle: Feature Selection for Electrical Demand Forecasting and Analysis of Pearson Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Demand forecasting contributes to the stable operation of the electrical grid. Increasing computational complexity with the emerging big data in the interconnected electricity grid poses a challenge on the effective electrical demand forecasting. The emerging machine learning algorithms are capable of handling this big data, but their performance depends on the quality of the input features in the dataset. Feature selection filters relevant and informative attributes, improving the quality of the input dataset hence facilitating better prediction. In this article, the feature selection for electrical demand forecasting is presented. The relationship of input features with the electrical demand and relation between the input features are analysed. Correlation coefficient, variance inflation factor (VIF) and analysis of variance (ANOVA) based techniques are examined to identify the relevant attributes. Performance of ANOVA is analysed via sum of squares (SS), mean square (MS) and degree of freedom (df). A brief discussion on the key issues concerning multicollinearity and the application of Pearson coefficient is also presented. Challenges that require further attention in feature selection research are discussed at the end.

articleTitle: Impacts of Solar Penetration on Short-Term Net Load Forecasting at the Distribution Level
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Motivated by the environmental concerns and a desire to reduce electricity bills, the number of residential and commercial customers with solar panels has increased significantly. Since the installation of solar panels is "Behind-The-Meter", utilities can only see the net load (load minus solar generation) of each customer. Distribution-level net load thus represents the net demand of a substation, a feeder, a transformer or a customer at the distribution side. Reliable forecasts of the distribution-level net load provide valuable decision support information for utilities, however, forecasting distribution-level net load is difficult since the net load is determined by complex interactions between customer energy usage patterns and weather conditions. This paper analyzes the impacts of different levels of solar penetration on short-term net load, identifies the key solar relevant factors, and provides a framework for distribution-level net load forecasting. Numerical testing demonstrates the high forecasting accuracy based on the synthesized load data and scaled solar generation. Our method has potential applications in forecasting peak load and time, substation/feeder with batteries, and distribution-level net load with wind or other dispatchable renewable resources.

articleTitle: Analysis and Countermeasures of Harmonic Instability in a Practical HVDC System with Fixed Series Compensation and STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In a practical ±500 kV/3000 MW line commutated converter based high voltage DC (LCC-HVDC) transmission system, a sustained 5.5/105.5 Hz harmonic was observed in the voltage of the AC bus of inverter station. HVDC power limit function was triggered because of the action of AC filter resistance harmonic overload protection caused by the harmonic. To study the phenomenon, the real-time digital and physical closed-loop simulation platform based on real time digital simulator (RTDS) is first built and the harmonic instability phenomenon is reproduced. Then, its mechanism and impact factors are analyzed based on real-time simulation. Analyses results show that series resonance and core saturation are the main reasons of harmonic. AC/DC harmonic transfer characteristic through converter leads to the interaction of AC and DC network, and inappropriate AC/DC impedance results in the sustained harmonic. Bypassing the series capacitor is proposed as a temporary countermeasure and verified by on-site test. To solve the problem thoroughly, supplementary harmonic controller (SHDC) based on STATCOM is designed, whose validity is verified by simulation tests.

articleTitle: A Vehicle-to-Grid Frequency Regulation Framework for Fast Charging Infrastructures Considering Power Performances of Lithium-ion Batteries and Chargers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the rapid development of renewable energy and electrification of transport, the stability and efficiency of power system will encounter inevitable challenges. A decentralized Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) framework for fast charging infrastructures joining in the primacy frequency regulation is proposed in this paper to cope the fluctuation of renewable energies. Two interaction modes are transferred according to the state of charge (SOC) of PEVs (Plug-in electric vehicles) in order to meet the fast-charging demand of drivers primarily. Based on the engineering system of vehicle battery pack, we fabricate detailed interaction logics among fast charger, V2G controller, battery pack and battery management system (BMS). The effective V2G control strategies need to consider the power limitations and charging effects. As a consequence, an equivalent circuit battery model (ECM) with high accuracy for dynamic and fluctuation working conditions is employed to obtain power limitations of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs). Furthermore, fast-charging-oriented droop control strategies are designed to participate regulation of power grid with negligible impact on fast charging. An alternative current (AC) power system with high penetration of renewable resources is constructed to verify the effects. The results of case study reveal that the proposed method with bidirectional chargers can reduce the fluctuation from renewables, loads and PEVs by 21.22%, accompanied by PEVs’ SOC changes lower than 0.5%. Interestingly, a high renewable penetration system can eliminate frequency derivation by adding PEVs with proposed regulation.

articleTitle: Research on Wind-storage Joint Frequency Modulation Control Strategy Based on DFIG Frequency Modulation Capability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the problem that DFIG's excessive participation in frequency modulation is not conducive to the safe and stable operation of the unit and insufficient inertia, firstly, by analyzing the frequency modulation process of DFIG in different states, using the LOGISTIC function, introducing the frequency modulation coefficient that characterizes the DFIG frequency modulation ability, and adjusting the active power of DFIG participating in frequency regulation in real time. On this basis, based on multi-input fuzzy control, a control strategy for inertia compensation for DFIG using energy storage is proposed. A four- machine two-area simulation model was built on the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed control strategy can effectively avoid DFIG participating in frequency modulation excessively, maintain the safe and stability of the unit, and suppress the secondary frequency drop, which improves performance of DFIG frequency response capability.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Load Transfer Controller for Uninterrupted Operation of Low-Voltage Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, the uninterrupted operation of low-voltage distribution grids has been paid great attention to. The load transfer technique during equipment maintenance, peak load period, and grid construction becomes a determinant factor to realize uninterrupted operation. This paper designs and analyzes a load transfer controller (LTC), which can be connected to two adjacent substations to carry out load transfer operation. Additionally, the power flow and the power rating analysis of an LTC are discussed in detail. In the topology of an LTC, one series voltage source converter (VSC) and one shunt VSC share the common DC bus. The shunt VSC which acts as a unity power factor rectifier is used to keep the DC bus voltage constant. The series VSC acting as a series voltage compensator is responsible for the connection and disconnection of the device and the load transfer. Extensive simulations on a two-bus system equipped with an LTC under the conditions of different voltage differences and phase-angle differences confirm the theoretical studies of an LTC.

articleTitle: An Integrated Energy System Evaluation Method Based on FAHP-EWM-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES) of the park integrates multiple types of energy such as electricity, heat, cooling, and gas, and objective and accurate evaluation of them is the basis for subsequent dispatch management and energy structure adjustment As the current IES evaluation method lacks indicators in terms of multi-energy complementation and system energy consumption, a new park IES evaluation method is proposed for this. First, a comprehensive IES evaluation index system is established. And through fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method (FAHP)-entropy weight method (EWM) combination of subjective and objective weighting method to weight indicators, combined with technique for order performance by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) for program evaluation. Finally, a case study is carried out based on IES to verify the rationality of the proposed evaluation index system and the effectiveness of the evaluation method.

Author Keywords: technique for order performance by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: Transient Stability Assessment Method for Power System Based on SVM with Adaptive Parameters Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nowadays machine learning and deep learning methods have been widely used in transient stability assessment for power system. Some simple machine learning models have strong applicability for transient stability evaluation due to their high efficiency, but these methods often suffer from insufficient accuracy. Although the deep learning models can achieve higher precision, the offline training usually costs a lot of time. In order to improve the evaluation accuracy of the model and shorten its time of searching parameters. This paper proposes a parameter searching method based on Bayesian optimization that integrates verification curves and RFE (recursive feature elimination) to optimize the SVM (support vector machine). The global search is replaced by the directed local search strategy, which can reduce the model training time and achieve the global optimum. On the one hand, we combine the verification curve with the RFE based on random forest. By this method, we can determine the Bayesian optimized area. Then we can achieve the optimal parameters. On the other hand, the prior function in Bayesian optimization is used to simulate the distribution of hyperparameters. At the same time, the acquisition function is used to determine the best search point, thereby greatly reducing the time cost of offline training. The simulation results on New England 10-machine 39-bus system show that the offline training time of the SVM based on the improved Bayesian optimization is significantly shortened and its evaluation accuracy can be upgraded to a large extend.

articleTitle: Motor Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Wavelet Packet Analysis and Sparse Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence industry, it is more and more popular to combine deep learning technology with machine fault diagnosis recent years. The process of fault diagnosis includes two main steps: extracting fault features from signals and classify the health conditions based on the features. In traditional diagnosis methods, features extraction depends on human labor and prior knowledge so much, which makes the processes of fault diagnosis not only time-consuming and laborious, but also subjective and limited. According to the theory of unsupervised learning, a method for intelligent diagnosis of motor bearing is proposed in this paper. Firstly, wavelet packet analysis(WPA) is used to reduce noise by decomposing and reconstructing the original signal. Then, sparse filtering network is used to extract features from decomposed signals. Finally, according to the extracted features, support vector machine is used to classify the health conditions. The results show that the proposed method is more accurate than other related methods. Because of unsupervised learning, the proposed method depends on human labor and prior knowledge rarely.

articleTitle: Development of Hydrogen Energy Storage Industry and Research Progress of Hydrogen Production Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydrogen energy storage is considered as a promising technology for large-scale energy storage technology with far-reaching application prospects due to its low operating cost, high energy density, clean and pollution-free advantages. It has attracted intensive attention of government, industry and scholars. This article reviews the development and policy support of the domestic hydrogen energy industry in recent years in China, summarizes the technology development process and progress of hydrogen production from electrolysis of water. It briefly describes the principle of hydrogen production from electrolysis of water, and analyzes the cost and efficiency of catalytic materials and electrode structures electrode structures and forecast the development trend of hydrogen production technology from electrolysis of water.

articleTitle: A Semi-Decentralized Control Strategy of a PV-based Microgrid with Battery Energy Storage Systems for Electric Vehicle Charging and Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a DC microgrid semi-decentralized control strategy for electric vehicle fast charging and hydrogen production. The equivalent circuit models of the photovoltaics (PV), battery energy storage system and the proton exchange membrane water electrolyzer (PEMWE) are built and integrated into an equivalent bus capacity model of the microgrid, where both model accuracy and computation efficiency are promised. The microgrid, excepted for the PEMWE, is always maintained under the decentralized mode, which is based on the Virtual battery model and Bus-signaling control. The control of the PEMWE is divided into the decentralized mode and power-based mode, the mode choice of which is determined by the PEMWE controller according to time period when the price of the grid is the lowest of the day. The PEMWE could utilize the extra energy generated by the PV array to stabilize the bus voltage, the daily production target could also be satisfied. The proposed semi- empirical approach is verified in the MATLAB/Simulink environment and the feasibility and priority of which is proved.

articleTitle: The Cruising Range Analysis of Heavy-duty Fuel Cell Vehicles with Liquid Hydrogen Storage and Supply Systems Based on Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Liquid hydrogen provides a prospective solution for the on-board hydrogen storage and supply system of heavy-duty fuel cell vehicles to carry more hydrogen in a smaller volume. The research group develops 32-ton and 49-ton heavy-duty vehicles equipped with fuel cell systems, batteries, liquid hydrogen storage and supply systems, and independent-drive electric wheels. In this study, the two heavy-duty vehicles’ powertrain dynamic model based on experimental data is established. The maximum cruising ranges of two vehicles under constant-speed conditions and China-worldwide transient vehicle cycles (C-WTVCs) are then analyzed, respectively. The dynamic programming algorithm is adopted to find the optimal power distribution between the fuel cell system and the battery. Simulation results show that the 40-km/h cruising range of the 32-ton and 49-ton vehicles can be up to 1283 km and 1717 km with 62.0 kg and 112.2 kg hydrogen depleted completely and battery state of charge sustained. Dynamic programming results show that two vehicles’ cruising range can be 615.3 km and 768.7 km under consecutive C-WTVCs.

articleTitle: Design of universal edge IOT agent device for comprehensive monitoring of distribution room
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Smart monitoring of distribution room is an important means to improve the lean management level of low-voltage distribution network. Aiming at the problems of diversity of bottom terminal interface, difference of communication protocol and poor real-time of business processing in current comprehensive monitoring of distribution room, based on the research of key technologies such as plug and play interface design, localized edge computing and virtual container deployment, a general edge IOT agent device for comprehensive monitoring of distribution room is designed, and the module of edge IOT agent device is given Based on cloud edge collaboration, the architecture and function design of the comprehensive monitoring system for the distribution room are proposed. The accuracy, reliability and real-time performance of the data monitoring for the distribution room are effectively improved, which is a good example Typical experience accumulation of smart IOT system in application scenarios of distribution station area.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis and Visual Simulation Platform Construction of Distributed Energy Storage on Load Peak-shaving and Valley-filling in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an economic analysis method for distributed energy storage applications in distribution networks, and constructs a visual simulation platform. Firstly, the influence of photovoltaic / wind power fluctuation on load peak-valley difference in distribution network under different permeability is analyzed, and the technical and economic characteristics of different distributed energy storage systems are compared. Secondly, in order to facilitate the analysis and display the analysis results, a visual simulation platform is constructed based on MATLAB / Simulink software. The simulation results of IEEE 33-Bus System show that the method described in this paper can effectively analyze the economy of load peak-shaving and valley-filling by different energy storage configuration methods, and the visualization platform can clearly and intuitively show the results of the above analysis method.

articleTitle: Sizing and Locating Planning of EV Centralized-Battery-Charging-Station considering Battery Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Characteristics of two types swapping electric vehicles (EVs) are considered, which include private EVs and electric taxis. Then, a time-space load forecasting method for these swapping EVs is proposed. After that, the forecasting results are taken as the load basis for sizing and locating planning of centralized-battery-charging-stations (CBCSs). In addition, based on the life cycle cost (LCC) theory, a double-layer planning model is established. It takes into account the CBCSs’ planning economy and the optimization for battery logistics system. That is, the planning LCC of CBCSs is conducted by the upper layer optimization. And the lower layer planning optimizes the annual transportation cost of the battery logistics company. The calculation example shows that the proposed planning method for CBCSs is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Seamless Closed-Loop Load Transfer of Low Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel seamless closed-loop load transfer device (SCLTD) of low voltage distribution network, which is capable of realizing three seamless operations: 1) loop closing, 2) load transfer, and 3) disconnection from the grid. In the proposed circuit configuration, an injected voltage source is connected to two low voltage bus bars.
