Therefore, closed-loop current can be controlled flexibly by regulating this voltage source. The system can be applied to adjacent substations to carry out closed-loop load transfer operations. In the proposed configuration, the voltage source is paralleled with the contact switch and thus can be bypassed to realize the disconnection of the SCLTD from the grid. Furthermore, this paper presents an advanced control strategy for seamless transfer among three operating modes, which eliminates the voltage oscillation and current impact due to the switching of operating modes. The proposed configuration and the designed control strategy are validated in a simple two-bus system via MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Overview of DC transmission line fault analytical methods and single-ended protection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC transmission technology, which plays an important role in connecting AC grids, can transmit power asynchronously under long-distance and large-capacity conditions. Protection devices and control system of the DC transmission system are quickly put into use after the information of the first traveling wave caused by faults of DC lines having been detected. Therefore, the current HVDC transmission line mainly adopts single-ended protection based on first traveling wave information as main protection for DC lines and such protection is not affected by the control strategy. But in the fault transient stage, changes of electrical quantities of DC transmission lines will show nonlinear characteristics because of the control strategy. At present, the analytical method of fault characteristics in the transient stage is not perfect and the rapid coordination of control and protection has not been realized. This paper presents an overall introduction to the research statuses of fault analytical methods and single-ended protection principles of DC transmission lines. First, the fault characteristics of LCC- based DC transmission lines and VSC-based DC transmission lines are compared. Second, the current research statuses of HVDC transmission line analytical models and fault transient analytical methods are analyzed and the shortcomings of current analytical methods are listed. Third, the current single-ended protection principles of DC transmission lines are classified, and then the problems and valuable research directions in the process of studying single-ended protection principles based on the coordination of control and protection are listed. Finally, the outlook for the rapid coordination of control and protection of DC transmission lines is determined.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Configuration Scheme of Offshore Wind Power Transmission System by 220UVAC Submarine Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the offshore wind power transmission system(WPTS) through the AC submarine cable(SC), as the scale of the offshore wind farm(WF) gradually increases, the transmission distance of the AC SC continues to increase. Due to the large charging power of the SC, there are many problems in the actual offshore WF connection project, such as excessive reactive power injection at the point of common connection(PCC) of offshore WFs, over voltage and over current carrying capacity along the SC, and over voltage on the high voltage side of the offshore substation. In response to the above problems, this paper establishes a mathematical model for the WPTS by the 220kV AC SCs, and analyses the WPTS based on the principle of layered division of reactive power compensation. Under the condition of voltage and current limitation along the cable, the offshore high voltage reactor(HVR) value of compensation is determined. Onshore high voltage reactor and SVG are installed on land to make the reactive power exchange between the WPTS and the land AC network zero. When the SVG capacity is minimum, onshore HVR value connected to the system is given. Combined with a specific project in China, the recommended reactive power configuration plan is calculated.

articleTitle: Review on the Coordinated Voltage Control Methods in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing penetration of distributed generation (DG), electrical vehicles (EV), and flexible loads have led to many voltage issues in the active distribution networks (ADN), such as voltage fluctuations, overvoltage, voltage drop, harmonics, voltage unbalance, etc. The existing literature has presented and implemented various voltage control methods to address these challenges. This paper investigated and summarized the state-of-art of voltage coordination control from the aspects of time-level, components, objectives, areas, control schemes, and the algorithms/models. Finally, we present the conclusive comments and suggest future work for voltage coordination control in the ADN.

articleTitle: A Power Market Nodal Price Forecasting Based on Historical Electricity Price and Unified Dispatch Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the progress of the reform in the electricity power system, all 8 electricity spot market pilot provinces have initiated trial runs of electricity spot market settlement and the staged progress has been achieved. As the major clearing pricing mechanism in current domestic power spot market, the forecasting of nodalprice plays an instructive role for mastering the law of nodal price fluctuations and generating bidding and offering strategies. This paper proceeds the day-ahead nodal price forecast for sampling 40 nodes of a certain province by applying and comparing 6 forecasting algorithms like LASSO regression, rigid regression, KNN, SVR, random forests, LSTM, with the historical power price and power load data generated during its real trial operation. The result of the nodal price forecasting shows that, in the case of taking historical nodal price as the only forecasting input, SVR performed the best forecasting accuracy and preferable generalization ability as well, while the LASSO regression performed the worst of which. While load data added in, the forecasting results run by SVR and LASSO regression reflected a significant improvement comparing -with other methods. In addition, SVR is also the most effective method of all. The improvement of the nodal price forecasting by adding load data partially depends on the forecasting model applied and the correlation of nodal price and the load data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Ultra-low Frequency Oscillation in Hydro-Dominant Power System and Turbine Governor Side Suppression Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: After asynchronous operation, the Southwest Power Grid has the risk of ultra-low frequency oscillation, which seriously threatens the stable operation of the power grid. Based on the hydropower single-unit with load system, the extend Philips-Heffron model is built considering PSS/GPSS. Then, the damping torque analysis is carried out in the both prime mover and excitation side. The negative damping in the prime mover side is prominent in the ultra-low frequency band, then the effect of damping increase by PSS and GPSS is compared. After that, the small signal analysis of the whole system is conducted and the participation factors of the ULFO mode shows the high participation and controllability of GPSS channel. At last, the proper GPSS parameters configured by small signal analysis are equipped in the hydro unit of asynchronous four-machine two-zone system which reveals an obvious ULFO suppression effect.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Augmentation and Swift Optimal Sizing Framework for PV-based EV Charging Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Optimizing the size of photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage system (ESS) is a key issue to ensure reliable, resilient and economic operation of the microgrid (MG). However, multiplicity of electric vehicle (EV) load profiles and computational complexity of the optimizing models limit the application of existing methods upon restricted scenarios. In this paper, a novel framework combining physical-economical model (PEM) and data-driven model (DDM) is established. First, a data augmentation approach based on reversed Monte Carlo (RMC) is proposed to generate comprehensive synthetic EV load datasets for big data training. Subsequently, a PEM is given to determine the capacity configuration of PV and ESS under each load condition, with the objective to obtain the best financial profitability. The model takes into consideration battery degradation and optimal power dispatch. Finally, a DDM is trained with machine learning techniques to relate optimal sizes with input of EV profiles and MG features. Testing results illustrate that in the test sets, the neural network could predict the optimal configuration within 15% and 20% relative error, respectively, enormously narrowing design space of PEM, and thus produces over 88% runtime savings while maintaining high fidelity and optimality.

articleTitle: Discussion on business flow of active distribution network for multi flow integration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes the concept of service flow innovatively, analyzes the interaction of multi flow fusion of "energy flow information flow control flow service flow" in active distribution network under the background of energy Internet, designs the structure of multi flow fusion active distribution network, and analyzes the key technology of service flow from the perspective of service flow modeling technology, analysis method and simulation platform Two typical business scenarios of optimization and risk analysis are taken as examples to illustrate the typical business applications of multi flow fusion active distribution network, which provides the basis for the next step to carry out the research of other business functions.

Author Keywords: Multi current fusion active distribution network

articleTitle: Wildfire Risk Assessment of Transmission-Line Corridors Based on Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wildfires, occurred in transmission line corridors, seriously affect the security and stability of power grids. In order to reduce the effects of wildfire on power grids, a logistic regression (LR) model was employed to assess the risk distribution of wildfire occurrences in transmission line corridors. Guizhou Province which locates at south-west of China was taken as the study region. An inventory dataset of Guizhou Province including 14 wildfire-related variables and historical wildfire occurrences were assembled. After the multicollinearity analysis of wildfire-related variables, the occurrence probability of wildfires in the study region was calculated by the LR model. And a wildfire risk distribution map was drawn in a resolution of 1 km × 1 km for visualization. The wildfires happened from January to May 2020 was applied to the validity of wildfire risk distribution map. The results shows that 82.65% of fire points were happened in the area with the third and fourth risk level. It indicates that the proposed method can be used to provide technical support for the maintenance staffs to carry out differentiation technology and strategy for wildfire protections.

articleTitle: A Review of Integrated Modular Motor Drive for Medium-Voltage Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With increased requirements for high reliability, high power density and fault tolerance in medium voltage motor drive, integrated modular motor drive (IMMD) offers an effective option. However, appropriate topologies and control methods should be considered according to different application requirements. This paper reviews existing IMMD topologies for medium voltage motors and summarizes their features. Hardware design of IMMD which includes the selection of capacitors, thermal design and integration categories is provided. The power devices and sensors fault tolerance methods are also investigated.

articleTitle: Improved Spot Market Clearing model based on DC Power Flow Model Based With PTDF Corrections
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electricity spot market reform has always been the forefront of the development of the electrical industry. On the basis of the relatively mature development abroad, China has also begun to gradually experiment in 8 provinces. However, in the real-time market scheduling, the line power flow using the DC method often has the deviation from the actual situations, which leads to problems such as the power flow exceeding the limit. Therefore, in order to improve the problem, this paper proposes an improved DC power flow model based on Power Transfer Distribution Factors (PTDF) with correction. We also using the 'case39' system in matpower to verify the validity of the model. The results show that the overall accuracy and variance are improved, thereby achieving a more accurate DC dispatching, which enhances the safety and economy of grid dispatching in the electricity spot market.

articleTitle: A Multi-Source Dispatching Model with Considering the Nuclear Power Plants Dispatching and Wind Power Accommodation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large number of volatile renewable energy sources such as wind power being connected to the grid, the traditional power operation scheduling method has been unable to meet the consumption demand of renewable energy. Firstly the paper comprehensively considers the traditional nuclear power operation mode and wind power output characteristics, adopts the fixed peak depth, uses the Pearson correlation coefficient to match the nuclear power and wind power output during the pre-dispatch period and determine the optimal nuclear power operation mode. Secondly, on the basis of not changing the base load characteristics of nuclear power and considering its safety and economy, a nuclear power peak shaving operation model suitable for coordinating wind power consumption has been established, and the particle swarm algorithm is used to realize the coordinated and optimized dispatch of multi-source. The paper selects data from northern China to verify that the proposed optimized operation method can increase the proportion of wind power consumption, improve economy and ease the pressure of peak shaving.

articleTitle: System Strength Challenges:An Overview of Energy Transition in Australia’s National Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Australia is at the forefront on energy transitions globally. The national electricity market is currently undergoing world’s fastest renewable penetration in forms of capacity additions per capita. With the profound change, the power system is experiencing novel challenges. As conventional synchronous generators are operating less or being decommissioned, system strength has emerged to be the prominent challenge and constraint to the power system stability and ongoing renewable project development, respectively. To facilitate the decarbonization pathways, Australia is the first country that evolved the system strength and inertia frameworks to accommodate transition barriers. This paper reviews the recent research in renewable integration of the NEM in Australia. It proposes and analyses a comprehensive overview on the challenges of system strength in the NEM from the technical approaches, regulatory requirement, and industrial feasibility perspective.

articleTitle: Comprehensive design of high-speed and high-power motor rotor considering dynamic characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A high-performance low-loss high-power high-speed motor used in flywheel energy storage system is studied in this paper, where the dynamic characteristics of high-speed motor rotor system are studied and comprehensively designed. The influence of electromagnetic force and damping force on the rotor system has been analyzed. The critical speed of the rotor system has been calculated, and the modal characteristics of the rotor system have been studied by simulation. Finally, the steady and transient response characteristics of the rotor are obtained. Based on these analysis results, the sheath of flywheel rotor shaft is designed comprehensively to realize the safe and stable operation of high-speed motor.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Correlation-Concerned Measurement Manipulation Detection Based on Gramian Angular Summation Field and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The growing integration of information and communication technology exposes more exploitable cyber-attack vectors to electric power systems. Measurement manipulation is an impactive type of cyber-attacks that can be launched to cause massive damages by interfering decision-making of control centers. Existing data-driven measurement manipulation detection models often bear criticisms due to the deficient mining of spatial-temporal correlations. In this paper, based on the Gramian Angular Summation Field (GASF) algorithm, various types of phasor time-series measured at different locations are transformed into a series of generalized multichannel images. From these generalized images, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are trained to discover suspicious patterns. GASF can visualize the temporal features of a single time-series and facilitate collaborative CNNs to figure out spatial-temporal correlations between different measurements. The improvements of the proposed framework in the detection performance are demonstrated through case studies.

articleTitle: Cross-areal Scheduling Strategy of Electric Taxi Clusters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with other electric vehicles, electric taxis charge more frequently due to public service. The charging behavior and mobility characteristics of electric taxi clusters will make them one of the flexible resources available for power grid operation and scheduling, and bring more scheduling possibilities. The behavior characteristics of the electric taxis is analyzed based on the empty-loading ratio, and the traffic energy system model considering the interaction of vehicle, road, and power grid is established to fully reflect the potential of the interaction between the electric taxis and power grid. Considering the mobile characteristics of electric taxis and the participation of renewable energy a cross-areal scheduling strategy of electric taxi clusters is proposed to minimize the areal net load fluctuation of power grid. The example results show that the optimal scheduling method can absorb renewable energy, stabilize load fluctuations, and effectively alleviate the traffic pressure caused by charging, which verifies the effectiveness of the model and strategy.

articleTitle: Capacity Configuration Model of Biogas-based Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The effective use of energy is becoming increasingly crucial nowadays due to the acceleration of rural economy construction. In order to build a rural energy Internet with a multiple energy supply of cooling, heating, and power, it is necessary to configure the integrated energy system's reasonable capacity. Therefore, this paper establishes a biogas-based integrated energy system's capacity configuration model, which considers annual total cost, annual carbon emissions, and exergy efficiency as the model's optimization objectives. The paper uses an augmented ε-constraint method for multi-objective optimization to obtain the Pareto curve. Afterward, the optimal solution is determined by comparing and analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of different schemes. The result indicates that the model proposed in this paper can realize the optimal configuration of the rural integrated energy system construction.

articleTitle: Research on Maximum Power Tracking Control Method of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Wind Power Generation in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the wind speed sensor and rotor-speed position sensor problems, this paper proposes a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control method without mechanical sensor. On the basis of studying the maximum power tracking control method of permanent magnet synchronous wind turbine, establishes a optimal torque control method model which effectively avoided the systematic error caused by wind speed acquisition and speed estimation. Through studying the mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous generator, the sliding mode observation model of two-phase rotating coordinate system was established to derive the velocity and position of rotor. Aiming at salient pole effect of synchronous motor, this paper used phase-locked loop technology to improve system ability of tracking and estimating rotor position information in real time. The simulation and experiment verified that the method could realize the maximum power point tracking quickly and accurately without mechanical sensor, and improve the system working efficiency.

articleTitle: Progressively Detect Faults in a Large Power System: A Visual Analytics Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With rapid expanding in power system equipment, enormous attention is now paid on developing methods to detect and reason faults in large power system data set. Existing techniques mainly focus on data analyzing methods, while little work studies visual analytics approaches. In this paper, we propose a progressively visual analytics procedure (i.e., overview, detecting candidate faulted buses, locating buses and check reasons) to detect fault origins and check possible reasons. In particular, an efficient clustering algorithm associated with a novel visualization for time-varying multivariate as well as multiple and coordinated views are developed to locate faulted buses easily and quickly. Case studies have indicated that our approach is much beneficial to real-life applications.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Technology of Less-Oil Immersed Electric Equipment Based on Pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an effective defect detection technology for low-oil power equipment (oil-immersed CT, PT, high-pressure casing, etc.), pressure detection is attracting more and more researchers' attention. However, the current research on pressure detection is mainly focused on the experimental research of pressure threshold, and there is no research on the fault diagnosis technology of low-oil equipment based on pressure. This paper proposes a kind of based on membership degree of less oil pressure equipment fault diagnosis method. In the proposed approach, the pressure variation characteristics of low-oil equipment with different defects are compared and analyzed and the pressure is selected as the characteristic quantity. Fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is used to classify the fault degree. According to the actual situation of oil pressure detection, the fault degree can be divided into four categories: no fault, light fault, moderate fault and severe fault, and the membership calculation formula based on pressure parameters under four types of fault is established in this paper. Finally, an example is given to prove the validity of the diagnostic method. The results of this paper have a certain engineering significance for the pressure-based state evaluation of low-oil equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Differential Protection of Generator Stator Winding Based on Field-circuit Coupling Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper is focused on the problem that the phase-to-phase coupling affects the reliability of the protection in the differential protection of the traditional generator model, a field-circuit coupling method based on generator stator winding differential protection application is proposed. At first, the finite element calculation of the generator electromagnetic field is combined with the multi-loop method to build a mathematical model of the field-circuit coupling of the stator internal short- circuit faults. Moreover, the mathematic model is applied to the generator differential protection, which uses the principle of longitudinal impedance to convert the triangular balance relationship between the fault voltage, current and winding impedance reasonably. Finally, simulation results show that the field-circuit coupling mathematic model proposed in this paper can better simulate the internal operating conditions of the generator, and the longitudinal impedance triangular balance relationship can distinguish between internal and external short- circuit faults effectively, and improve the reliability of generator protection and fault identification sensitivity. So, it has a good prospect for engineering promotion.

articleTitle: Research on the Variation of Lightning Activity Parameters with Land Types Based on Lightning Location System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The statistics of lightning activity parameters is the basis to guide the lightning protection design, transformation and study of lightning characteristics of transmission lines. The lightning activity parameters are closely related to the land type. Based on the ground lightning data of lightning location system in Hainan Island, combined with the land type data from resource and environmental science and data center, this paper uses ArcGIS geographic software to supplement the land type data of ground flash point, and studies the law of lightning activity parameters and land types, such as mean value of lightning current amplitude, ground lightning density, cumulative probability distribution of lightning current amplitude, positive lightning ratio and so on. The study shows that the average amplitude of total lightning current in paddy field is the largest; due to the heat island effect, the total land flash density, negative ground flash density and positive ground flash density of urban land are much higher than those of other land types, and more attention should be paid to the transformation of forest land lightning protection measures; the median current of cultivated land is the largest, and the probability of larger amplitude lightning current is the largest. The proportion of positive flashover in lakes is the largest, so the influence of positive lightning on lightning shielding of transmission lines should be properly considered.

articleTitle: Probability Prediction of Short-term Wind Power Based on Quantile Regression Forest and Variable Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is important to predict the probability interval of wind power with uncertainty, which is usually applied to optimize the capacity of spinning reserve in electric power system. In order to quantify the confidence interval of the wind power prediction, a kind of probability prediction method called the quantile regression forests model(QRF) has been proposed to construct the non-linear mapping relations between multi-inputs and double-outputs, in which the clustering effect of different forecasting results is estimated by nonlinear regression analysis to obtain the lower-upper bounds of confidence interval under different confidence levels. Instead of the fixed bandwidth, an index of variable bandwidth based on the instantaneous mean value and standard deviation is proposed, in order to acquire the higher coverage rate and the narrower bandwidth. Case study suggests that it has a better application effect on probability interval prediction of wind power by the proposed method in the paper, compared with the BP neural network & Bayesian network & Support Vector Machines model.

articleTitle: Optimization Calculation of AGC Coordination Factor of Photovoltaic-Thermal-Hydro Unit Based on Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With more and more renewable energy is being connected to the power system, the traditional synchronous units will be replaced, and the system inertia and frequency regulation capability will decline, which will bring unsafe factors to the power system. To ensure the stability and economy of the power system, it is necessary to coordinate the renewable energy system which does not participate in the frequency regulation with the traditional synchronous units to control system frequency accurately. This paper considers the characteristics of the photovoltaic, thermal, hydro unit of the secondary frequency regulation's process, then builds the objective functions of the system economy and stability, and through improved multi-objective optimization of particle swarm algorithm (MOPSO) for the output of the photovoltaic, thermal, hydro unit. Getting different strategy of frequency regulation in the Pareto frontier according to the Pareto theory. Finally, an IEEE 9-node simulation system including the photovoltaic-thermal-hydro unit is constructed in DIgSILENT software. The simulation indicates the effectiveness of the strategy and provides the guiding significance for renewable energy to participate in the frequency regulation of the power system.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term Forecasting Method of Wind Power Based on W-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Effective and accurate forecasting of wind power is critical to maintain the security and reliability of power grid operation, which can promote the accommodation of wind power. In view of the fact that the existing ultra-short-term forecasting method of wind power is difficult to effectively mine and analyse the inherent variation law of data, a forecasting method of wind power based on wavelet decomposition combined with bi- directional long-short term memory neural network (W-BiLSTM) is proposed. Firstly, wavelet decomposition is used to extract the time domain information and frequency domain information of the input time series. Then, considering the bi-directional information flow, BiLSTM network is adopted for wind power forecasting to coordinate the history data and future forecasting. Finally, the experiment is carried out by actual data, and the simulation results show that the proposed forecasting model and method of wind power have a better forecasting performance compared with other comparison methods.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Field Ionization and Pre-breakdown Processes in Liquid Nitrogen under Pulsed Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Simulation concerning the field ionization and streamer propagation processes in liquid nitrogen under pulsed voltage is performed to investigate the discharging characteristics and the factors that may influence the discharging process. In order to have a better description of field ionization in liquid nitrogen, a computational quantum chemistry method is utilized for obtaining the relations between the ionization potential of nitrogen molecule and the electric field. Results indicate that the pre-breakdown process could be divided into four stages which are initiation, propagation, re-ignition and annealing. In addition, the temperature in liquid nitrogen during the discharging process is investigated which shows that the temperature of liquid nitrogen in a small region near the needle electrode would reach the global maximum close to 120 K whereas along the discharge path there exists an area where the temperature of liquid nitrogen would exceed 85 K after 250 ns under 200 kV pulsed voltage with a 2 mm needle-sphere gap. Finally, several factors that would impact the streamer propagation are discussed.

articleTitle: Enabling Terminal-Side Intelligence for Smart Meters: Design and Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for electrical data analysis, close proximity of computational resources to the terminal side has become a priority in modern power systems considering extant weaknesses with regard to operational efficiency, data security and the increasing burden of the cloud. Nevertheless, smart meters lacks local resources as modern terminals of smart grids. On the other hand, the alternative solutions based on edge computing may be inadequate in flexibility. To this end, a device aiming to enable terminal-side intelligence for smart meters is proposed in this work. First the functional design of the device is elaborated and a prototype of it is then introduced. Finally, two typical applications of this device are illustrated respectively. In addition to the traditional functions of smart meters, the proposed device is endowed with the capability of local computing whereby it has broad application prospects in the future.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Integrated Power and Oil Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the optimal operation of integrated power and oil transmission systems where pumps along the oil pipeline have huge electricity consumption. Considering the contradiction between calculation speed and accuracy, a variable step mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model is established. Additionally, to describe the diffusion effect of drag reducers on the hydraulic loss, the description based on long short-term memory recurrent neural network (RNN-LSTM) is proposed which can perform sequence-to-sequence nonlinear regression. Case studies show that the model in this paper outperforms the classical model in saving more energy and cost, and the RNN-LSTM can calculate the hydraulic loss with high accuracy. The solution is intuitive for the pipeline dispatcher and the established model is capable of industrial use, meeting the goal of energy conservation and emission reduction to relieve the energy crisis.

Author Keywords: integrated power and oil transmission systems
long short-term memory recurrent neural network

articleTitle: Research on The Construction of Hangzhou Power Economic Climate Index Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There is a certain correlation between power consumption and economic development. Taking into account the timeliness of power data releases and the accuracy of the data, this study builds a power economic climate index model that can reflect the economic operation of Hangzhou based on indicators for electric power and economic indicators. And macroeconomic characterization variables are used to verify the index model constructed. The result shows that the power economic climate index model is consistent with the macroeconomic operation, in a sense, the power economic climate index model is effective. Moreover, the power economic climate index model will help to evaluate the development level of industries and regions from the perspective of the economy more comprehensively, and is of great significance of discovering uneven development and power planning.

articleTitle: Research on Time Domain Protection of AC Line in AC/DC Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Affected by the access of the DC system, when the AC line fault on the inverter side causes the commutation failure of the DC system, the AC side has the characteristics of frequency offset and high low frequency content. In the traditional protection scheme, the pilot protection is the main protection, and the distance protection is the backup protection. They are all based on the protection of the power frequency, and there are unstable operations. From the perspective of time domain, combined with the method of parameter identification, a time-domain pilot protection scheme suitable for AC/DC hybrid system is proposed, which solves the problems caused by frequency offset in principle and a protection criteria is provided; When a line fault occurs in the AC transmission line of the hybrid system, the proposed time-domain distance protection scheme all adopts the time-domain full amount of fault information, and is also solves the problems caused by frequency offset. The simulation results show that the time-domain pilot protection and time-domain distance in the protection scheme can accurately and quickly identify faults, effectively solving the problem of unstable protection action when commutation failure occurs.

articleTitle: A Voltage Control of Energy Storage Mobile Shelter Under Multi Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of high reliability power supply for important loads in the emergency field, this paper proposes a topology and voltage control of energy storage mobile shelter under multi energy access, which can promote the collection and utilization of various in-field energy, and realize the voltage stability control of AC and DC bus. Paralleled AC bus is adopted to prevent the power supply interruption of important loads, and the detailed topology and parameter design is presented. The DC bus adopts the segmented droop control, which cancels the static error of droop control under steady-state operation and mobilizes external energy to prevent over charge or discharge when energy storage battery near the limit. The automatically updated reference of energy storage converter can be to realize the AC bus frequency correction and the priority power supply of external renewable power and internal energy storage battery. SOC balance function is added to avoid circuit reorganization of emergency support system. Diesel generator is only used as hot standby, which can improve the reliability of power supply for important loads and reduce the burden of fuel transportation. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: A Guiding Learning Model For Transformer Fault Diagnosis Combining Rule-Based Domain Knowledge And Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms based on data mining have been continuously developed for half a century and have achieved good application effects in many fields including transformer fault diagnosis. However, mining rules only by data and using empirical risks to fit structural risks will have a certain negative impact on the generalization performance of the model and the security of the output results. When it is applied to transformer fault diagnosis, it is easy to diagnose serious fault as non-serious fault. In this paper, we introduce the characteristics of the domain experiential knowledge based approach and the machine learning model based approach, then a concept called guiding learning is introduced. On the basis of using Receiver operating characteristics curve (ROC) to verify and mine the relevant experience knowledge in transformer fault diagnosis field, combined with the extreme learning machine (ELM) model, a guiding learning model for transformer fault diagnosis is established. After that, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the model, and in this process, the trust degree that changes with the number of iterations is introduced to better adapt to the training process of the model. By comparing with the ELM fault diagnosis model optimized by particle swarm optimization, it is proved that the established guiding learning model is superior to the traditional model in generalization performance and safety of output results. At the same time, the probability of serious diagnostic errors is dramatically reduced.

articleTitle: Capacity Planning and Economic Benefit Analysis of Multi-station Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multi-station integration is the integration of various stations such as substation, energy storage station, data center, photovoltaic station, and 5G base station. In order to solve the problem of optimal design and coordinated operation of multi-station under the constraints of station conditions, load demand and economic benefits, this paper presented the capacity planning method and economic analysis of each station in multi-station. Firstly, the integration relationship between stations in multi-station was analyzed. Then, the capacity of each station was planned with the goal of maximizing the utilization rate of existing substation site and meeting the demand of surrounding load. Finally, the economic benefit of the configured capacity was analyzed with a case to provide reference for multi-station project.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Corona Discharge Characteristics and Heat Transfer Enhancement Application at Atmospheric Pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The mechanism of the electric field for heat transfer enhancement with needle-to-ring corona discharges is studied by experiment. Results show that discharge is easier to occur when negative voltage is applied and the electrical characteristics still obey Townsend's equation. The time-averaged velocity field results demonstrate that positive corona produces ionic wind more effectively than negative corona. In addition, it is found that ionic wind can dramatically enhance heat transfer. The enhancement effect of positive discharge is more significant than that of negative one.

articleTitle: Inverter dynamic disturbance compensation strategy based on current model predictive control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to enhance the inverter island operation to nonlinear load, harmonic, and voltage fluctuation resistance. This paper proposes an improved dynamic compensation strategy based on the residual generator for voltage inverter in distributed grid. Firstly, in the dq coordinate system, the state space equation of the LC filter after the separation of fundamental disturbance and non-fundamental disturbance is established. According to the dynamic compensation structure and the principle of disturbance cancellation, the controller Q(s) is designed to compensate the non-fundamental disturbance in reverse. Secondly, the traditional double closed-loop control structure is improved, and the model predictive control algorithm is used to replace the traditional current loop, which improves the response speed and accuracy of current control. Dynamic current compensation directly affects the predictive control algorithm, changes the value function, and outputs the optimal vector. The advantage of this method is that the concept of optimal control is introduced to further improve the transient characteristics of the inverter. Finally, the switching experiments of the inverter controlled by this method for different types of loads are designed in Matlab/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Voltage Differential Control of Multi-terminal DC Distribution Network Based on Active Power Balance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rise of renewable energy and the development of power electronics, the DC distribution network will play an increasingly important role. Firstly, this paper described the typical topology and operation mode of multi- terminal flexible DC distribution network. Secondly, in order to solve the problems of voltage control deviation and strong communication dependence in the traditional control strategy of multi-terminal flexible DC distribution network, an adaptive voltage differential control (AVDC) was proposed, which enabled the converter stations to adjust voltage and maintain power balance instead of the master station. By detecting the bus voltage signal, the converter station can switch mode independent of the communication system. Finally, a simulation model was built based on PSCAD / EMTDC platform, and the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy were verified by simulating the master station exit and load removal conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Current Waveform in Impulse Aging Experiment of ZnO Arresters in 500kV AC Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impulse aging experiment of the ZnO arrester is an important way to study its electrical aging characteristics, and the 8/20 μs current waveform is usually used in the impulse aging experiment. However, the tested current waveform of the arresters in the 500kV AC filter is different because it is caused by the breaker switching not by the lightning. This paper mainly studies on the surge current waveform and its influencing factors of the AC filter arresters in a ±800 kV converter station by simulation and actual test verification. Firstly, based on the PSCAD electromagnetic simulation program, a simulation model of the ±800 kV UHVDC project is established to simulate the transient over-current of the 500kV AC filter arresters in the inverter station under the filter breaker closing condition. Secondly, the influencing factors and the parameter range of the current waveform in the AC filter arresters are analyzed and compared, and a 15/35 μs current waveform is proposed to be used in the surge aging experiment. At last, considering the amplitude and the current waveform range of the AC filter arrester, a group of the impulse current for the aging experiment is proposed depending on the repetitive charge transfer rating method.

articleTitle: Motif-Assisted Load Classification: Time Series Analysis Using Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the great growth of power consumption, the scale of load data becomes extremely larger and complex, making the problem of load classification harder than ever before. This paper explores the issue of load classification from the perspective of complex network theory and network tetradic motif. Through transforming a set of load time series into data networks based on the method of Horizontal Visibility Graphs, 60 samples of load time series from nine sectors are divided into four categories. Principally, the basic topological properties of complex networks such as Average Clustering Coefficient (ACC), Average Path Length (APL), and degree distribution are taken into account as macroscopic measurement indexes to roughly classify the loads into three categories. To attain better results, the tetradic motif occurrence frequency is introduced as a mesoscopic measurement index to explore the inherent structure of load time series. Experimental results show that the proposed method manages to classify the 60 samples of load time series into 4 categories dependably and efficiently.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Operation of Community Integrated Energy Systems Based on NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The operation of community integrated energy systems (CIES) usually involves several optimal objectives and decision variables. Traditional evolutionary methods are difficult to solve the multi-objective optimization with large number of variables to be optimized. In this paper, an optimal CIES dispatching method based on NSGA-II is proposed for the multiple-objective operation. Objective functions are selected as decision variables and NSGA-II is used to obtain the objective values of Pareto optimal points. The Branch and Bound (BB) algorithm is adopted to determine the corresponding feasible solutions. The final operation strategy is chosen from the Pareto optimal points according to a typical principle with the minimum Euclidean distance. The proposed method can effectively address the multi-objective optimization of CIES with large number of variables. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by case studies.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-Wideband Sierpinski fractal Antenna for Partial Discharge Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a broadband antenna used for partial discharge (PD) detection and location in high-voltage equipment, the developed antenna can detect electromagnetic wave signals. To capture the discharge electromagnetic signals, the sensors frequency range should include the frequency range from 0.3-3GHz. We design a Sierpinski fractal antenna which has ultra-wideband characteristics that can be used in high-voltage equipment PD detection, the parameters of antenna are optimized for the frequency bandwidth and gain enhancement, the resonance frequency and bandwidth of the antenna is selected by resize the dimension and by changing different flare angles of the antenna, its fractal structure controls the multiband frequency feature with no significant changes on the radiation electromagnetic parameters. The antenna key radiation characteristics including antenna gain, radiation pattern, radiation impedance and return loss and are presented and the self-similar property is demonstrated, the computational results with several antenna dimensional and fractal stage parameters were performed and verified. The experiment is carried out in a high-voltage simulated discharge arrangement that is composed of a point-to-plane platform. The developed antenna has the matched characteristics and meet the required frequency band of the radiated electromagnetic wave. The experimental results of the application case show that this fractal antenna meet the requirements of the PD electromagnetic wave detection and location in the power system high-voltage apparatus.

articleTitle: Research on Variable Gap Simultaneous Wireless Power and Information Transmission Method Based on Nonlinear PT Symmetry Principle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The variable gap simultaneous of wireless information and power transmission (SWIPT) is a hotspot of wireless power transmission system. Based on the single coil and dual band resonant structure, an energy transmission method is proposed by using the nonlinear gain saturation mechanism of voltage amplifier with variable transmission gap. The accurate analytical solutions of system transmission efficiency and harmonic frequency are deduced by analyzing the circuit model of the system, and the correctness of the theoretical model is verified by using a simulation method.

articleTitle: Acquisition Strategy of GIS Partial Discharge Signal Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Reliability of gas insulated switch gear (GIS) is closely related to the safety and stable operation of power system. It is necessary to monitor and collect the partial discharge signal to judge whether the fault or defect occurs. The traditional sampling theorem (Nyquist sampling theorem) will produce a large number of invalid signals and waste storage space, resulting in a large amount of stored data. Hence a new partial discharge acquisition method called integral ignition circuit acquisition based on compressed sensing is proposed in this paper. The simulation result is analyzed and compared to the reconstruction of the traditional sampling theorem. It is concluded that the integral fire circuit is more suitable for application in the detection of partial discharge signals.

articleTitle: Research on Power Balance Control between Low Voltage Buses in Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the low voltage bus interconnection system of substation, the load fluctuation will lead to the imbalance of feeder transmission power and unequal load rate of substation. In order to solve the mentioned problem, a power balance control strategy of flexible interconnection device (FID) with energy storage is proposed. The control strategy can modulate the active power output of FID port in real time, realize the transmission power balance between feeders, and keep the load rate of substation consistent. Considering the capacity limit of the substation, when the total load exceeds the allowable range of the substation, the corresponding power difference is compensated by controlling the discharge of the energy storage device to avoid the overload operation of the transformer. Finally, a simulation model is built in DIgSILENT/PowerFactory and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: High-speed Video Observations of an Upward Negative Leader Intitated from Canton Tower
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Upward negative leaders are lack of observations due to the scarce upward positive lightning flashes. This paper reports an upward negative leader started from the Canton Tower in Guangzhou. The evolution of the upward negative leader, which lasted for about 30 ms, was imaged by a high-speed camera. Images recorded in the first 12 ms was concerned, during which three different stages are distinguished based on the main direction of leader propagation, namely, upward propagation, horizontal development and downward evolution. The downward elongation of one upward leader branch is the first time to be observed. Based on the high-speed frames, velocities of the main leader channel and other two branches are estimated during different stages, and also compared with each other, as well as the existing results from the triggered lighting. The observations will help us to have a deeper understanding of lightning discharge behavior.

articleTitle: Two-level Day-ahead Optimal Scheduling of Distributed Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Stochastic characteristics of wind and photovoltaic (PV) power causes great challenge for power system operations. Distributed energy storage system (DESS) can mediate the intermittent renewable energy. This paper proposes a two-level optimization method for DESS scheduling. Firstly, DESSs are aggregated in a virtual power plan (VPP) and participates the power scheduling as a whole, the power schedules of DESSs are obtained with the proposed two-level optimization method. Secondly, in the upper-level optimization model, a two-stage stochastic unit commitment model is established with considering power uncertainties, and thermal units as well as VPP of DESS are optimized to maximize the power generation of renewable energy. And then, in the lower-level optimization model, an optimization model is proposed to schedule each DESS in order to minimize the total life loss cost of DESSs. Case studies are inducted based on actual data of a provincial power grid. The effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method is verified by the testing results.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Strategy for Concerntrating Solar Power Plant to Suppress Output Power Fluctuation of Wind-photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Concentrating solar power plant (CSP) generation is a latest approach of utilizing solar resources to generate electricity in recent years, which has a considerable development prospect. The CSP with thermal energy storage (TES) system has features of good dispatchability and operation flexibility, which is beneficial for reducing fluctuation of output power of renewable power generation. The operation mechanism of CSP is analyzed, and the dispatching model of CSP with TES is also formulated. CSP is integrated with the photovoltaic and wind energy generation to improve the multi-energy system operation schedulability, and an optimal dispatching strategy based on multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to suppress the wind-photovoltaic output power fluctuation. The equivalent load and operation cost of systems are calculated, and the practicability of CSP with TES in reducing output fluctuation and operation cost is successfully verified in the results.

articleTitle: Resilience-Oriented Security-Constrained Unit Commitment with Quick-Start Units
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an enhanced security- constrained unit commitment (SCUC) strategy to ensure the resilience of power system operations under extreme weather events by considering the role of quick-start units. First, a stochastic optimization model with a selection of extreme weather scenarios is formulated as a mixed-integer programming problem for the SCUC decision-making. Then, an enhanced Benders decomposition is employed to partition the optimization model into a master problem along with a set of feasibility check subproblems. Last, numerical experiments are conducted on the six-bus system and IEEE 118-bus system. The results have verified the computational performance of the proposed model and the practical validity of quick-start units toward the resilience goal.

articleTitle: Study on the Location of Energy Meter Distribution Center based on Immune Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To optimize the location and distribution network of energy meter distribution center, this paper proposes an optimization model based on the Gaussian-Projection algorithm and Immune algorithm to make a more scientific location and distribution plan. Firstly, the Gaussian-Projection algorithm is introduced in detail, and then the Gaussian-Projection algorithm is applied to obtain the coordinates of the first quadrant. Secondly, Immune algorithm is used to solve the optimization model. Finally, the location of the distribution center and the distribution plan for users is formulated.

articleTitle: Privacy protection method of power metering data in clustering based on differential privacy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power companies can use the power grid big data platform to cluster analysis of power metering data, which can improve the personalized service quality of power grid companies for different users and discover the power stealing behavior of users to protect the interests of power grid companies. However, in the cluster analysis of power measurement data, the privacy information of power users may also be disclosed. To defend the privacy information of power users, the article applies differential privacy technology to cluster analysis of power metering data to avoid power users’ privacy leakage. First, the article presents the attack model that exists in the cluster analysis of power metering data. Then, the article add Laplacian noise to the power metering data to defend against attacks in the cluster analysis of attackers. Next, to enhance the data availability of noise-added power measurement data in cluster analysis, the article limits noise distance based on the results of the cluster analysis. Experiments show that method proposed in article can guarantee the privacy information of power data during the cluster analysis of power metering data, and ensure the data quality of the power metering data after privacy protection.

articleTitle: Study of Welding Joint Resistance of REBCO Wires for High Temperature Superconducting Magnet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A high-temperature superconducting (HTS) motor was designed, which employs the HTS wires in the rotor field windings. To reduce the welding joint resistance of the wires, a simple and efficient welding method is developed, and the welding process suitable for 2G and 1G HTS wires is summarized as follows. First, the welding process was obtained by the tests, the results show that the welding temperature is chosen to be 220°C, the lap length is chosen to be 160mm, and the resistance of the joint can reach 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>Ω. Second, the resistance influenced by the radius was analyzed by the finite element method. The results show that there might be little decrease in the critical current of the joints. Last, a 2G HTS magnet was manufactured to verify whether the joints made by the method can meet the requirements of bending deformation in the HTS magnet winding process. The results show that the welding process can satisfy the requirements, and provide an important reference for subsequent work.

articleTitle: Accurate Forecasting of Electric Load Demand via Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Method With Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the electrical load is significantly affected by many factors, such as the economic policy, the human behaviors, the political environment, etc., it is of great difficult to achieve the accurate forecasting. In order to solve such problem, an electric load demand prediction model is proposed in this paper firstly, by utilizing the interval type-2 fuzzy logic (IT2FL) method. Then, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied to obtain the best parameters of the model, including the antecedents and consequents of the designed fuzzy rules, aiming at further improving the forecasting performance. Finally, experimental and comparison are conducted. And, both of them demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed forecasting model.

articleTitle: The robust-optimization operation strategy of the electro-thermal integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) takes multi-energy complementation and energy ladder utilization as the core, emphasize the ’ubiquitous interconnection’ between different energy systems and the interaction of information & energy flow. This article aims to build a new type of robust-optimization operation strategy of electro-thermal IES, where the robust coefficient for expressing the uncertainty of wind turbine output characteristic. The proposed IES taking into account the conversion of natural gas and electric power, the user-side demand response and the real-time transaction in the energy market, and the simulated objective are obtained from the combined objective of economy, environmental, energy efficiency utilizing the entropy weight method. The results express that the proposed IES is reasonable and practical, suggesting an IES scheduling plan while providing a reference to market pricing and related policies.

articleTitle: Characterizing Surface Profiles of Tungsten-based Electrodes Under Intense Pulsed Arcs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presented the detailed results of surface profiles of tungsten-based electrodes (W-Ni-Fe and W-Cu) under 100-kA level repetitive pulsed arcs for 10,000 times. Focusing on the surface morphology, a series of statistical parameters (surface roughness, etc.) were adopted to quantitatively characterize the features of electrode surface. Meanwhile, the evolution of those parameters in the aging process was summarized and analyzed systematically. The results indicated that the contour of the electrode changed in both general shape and micro-structure. For the macroscopic contour, the characteristic diameter of the electrode tip decayed from ~21 mm to less than 18 mm after the test. As for the micro-fluctuations (μm level), various erosion patterns were found in anode and cathode, or in W-Ni-Fe and W-Cu electrodes. Then, possible mechanisms of those phenomena were discussed. Finally, the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) method was adopted to study the spatial pseudo-periodicity of the electrode profiles. The four materials had a rank on erosion resistance, namely, 97WNiFe>93WNiFe&90WNiFe>90WCu.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Subsynchronous Oscillation of Grid-Tied VSC Under Different Grid Strengths
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, with the development of renewable energy, the proportion of power electronic equipment in the power system has gradually increased, which makes the stability and subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) of power system more complicated. In this paper, based on the sixth-order state space model of the grid-tied voltage source converter (VSC) in the time domain, we discuss the stability domain of the system when the parameters of different controllers change under different power grid intensities. These stable regions can provide guidance for the adjustment of controller parameters. Then we further research the dynamic process of the eigenvalues when the system leaves the stable region, and verify that the situation where a single eigenvalue crosses the virtual axis only occurs when the controller parameter is negative. Finally, in the area where the system is unstable, we find that the main factor causing SSO is phase-locked loop (PLL) by comparing the bandwidth of the controller. The results are also consistent with the time domain simulation in Matlab / Simulink.

articleTitle: Mitigating Cascading Failure in Large-scale Power Systems based on Soft Isolation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to mitigate the propagation of inter-area cascading failures, this paper proposed a novel soft isolation method. Based on the recently developed Interaction Graph (IG) approach, a novel KICs-based OPF model, which considered the status of KICs, is proposed to realizing soft isolation. By intentionally limiting the disturbance on the tie lines between sub-grids, the proposed soft isolation control strategy can significantly mitigate the propagation of inter-area cascading failures and give special protection of the main grid. The Numerical results verified the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Distributed Control Framework for Improving the Transient Response Speed of Cluster Grid-Connected Battery Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Grid-connected battery energy storage system (BESS) is an important form of energy storage application. It generally adopts PQ control to provide power support. However, existing control methods cannot achieve dynamic power allocation resulting in a slow transient response speed. To address this problem, this paper presents a distributed control scheme for the actual grid-connected BESSs. Based on the transient analysis, two regulation parts are designed separately to realize the transient fast response and the steady-state proportional power allocation. Compared with the traditional control, the proposed control has a remarkable advantage in improving the transient response speed. Several simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method in a cluster grid-connected BESSs.

articleTitle: Research on Moisture Assessment of Oil-Paper Insulated Bushing Based on Polarization and Depolarization Current
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage bushing is an important part of the operation of transformer equipment. In order to accurately and effectively evaluate the moisture condition of the bushing, this paper uses the polarization and depolarization current (PDC) non-destructive measurement method to do it. In the current research, the characteristics of loss peaks and curve fluctuations of tanδ-f curve can judge whether the bushing is evenly damp, but it lacks the judgment of the high moisture position of the internal damp. This paper uses oil-paper samples of different moisture content to make a preliminary qualitative exploration of PDC measurement methods. Then the polarity reversal method is used to judge the bushings with different moisture conditions, Combined with the migration characteristics of hydrolyzed ions in the oil-paper insulation, it is analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Lifetme Estimation for Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitor in Active Power Quality Controllers considering Load Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Active power quality controllers have been widely used in distribution network to improve power quality. Aluminum electrolytic capacitor is extensively adopted as the DC bus of the device due to its volume and cost, but it also brings reliability issues to the whole device. This paper presents a calculation method for the spectrum of the DC current considering the load’s reactive power and unbalanced active power and conducts the lifetime estimation of the aluminum electrolytic capacitor combining with its characteristics. Thus, the DC bus design of the device can be optimized with the estimation result. The theoretical analysis is verified in a 0.4kV distribution network.

articleTitle: Common Mode Frequency Analysis Modeling and Quantification Method for Power System with High Penetration of Renewable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of the permeability of renewable energy generation in the power system, the frequency regulation capability of the system constantly deteriorates. Domestic and foreign scholars have proposed some control strategies for renewable energy generation such as wind turbines to actively participate in frequency regulation. However, current research on how to accurately evaluate the contribution of wind turbines to grid frequency regulation is insufficient. Therefore, a unified structural model is proposed to approximate the power response of various generating equipment in the grid under disturbance. Then, based on the unified structure, the common mode frequency trajectory of the system is analyzed and the frequency characteristics, including average rate of change of frequency and frequency nadir, are quantified, based on which the supporting effect of various equipment such as wind turbines on the frequency is evaluated. Finally, the effectiveness of the unified structure model and the proposed method for quantifying frequency characteristics is verified by simulation.

Author Keywords: average rate of change of frequency

articleTitle: Electric Field Analysis of 35kV Measuring Voltage Transformer with Insulation Defects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metering voltage transformers of 35kV and below commonly adopt solid insulation structure. During the pouring process of insulation structure, defects such as bubbles and metal particles may be introduced to the solid insulation, which will cause partial discharges, and then affect the insulation and metering performance of the transformer. This paper mainly aims at the influence of the above defects on the insulation electric field of the transformer. A three-dimensional simulation model of a 35kV voltage transformer is established, and the influence of the defect type, defect location, defect size, and voltage waveform on the electric field distribution near the insulation defect are analyzed. The results show that: the electric field distortion caused by metal particles is slightly larger than that of bubbles; the insulation defect near the high voltage side of high voltage winding causes the most serious electric field distortion; smaller bubble defect causes stronger electricfield distortion, while larger metal particles cause stronger electricfield distortion. The electric field distortion laws of defects under power frequency voltage and impulse overvoltage are similar. The research of this paper can provide guidance to the production and maintenance of metering voltage transformers.

articleTitle: Dielectric Tests on Cable Testing Circuits of Medium Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dielectric test of power cable is a most important inspection operation in its whole life cycle. Generally, dielectric tests on cable testing circuit are carried out through available electric connection points in medium voltage (MV) switchgear. in consideration of that some parts and switch fracture of the switchgear also bear the effect of cable test voltage stress during cable testing, new requirements for the insulation level of the above components to withstand various types of combined voltage are put forwarded. This paper analyze the test conditions of cables in switchgear situation, give the cable dielectric test circuit in line with IEC62271- 200:2011, discuss the rated cable test voltage, summarize and give the recommended values according to relevant standards or specifications. Finally, combined with engineering practice, the advantages, disadvantages and application of DC withstand voltage, AC withstand voltage, ultra-low frequency and oscillating pulse voltage methods are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of battery diagnostic methodologies considering parameter learning process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuously growing number of electric vehicles, the safety of electric vehicle battery systems has received wide attention. The threshold parameter learning of the data-based battery diagnosis methods highly affects the algorithm performance but is seldom discussed. In this paper, two commonly used fault diagnosis methods, 3σ multi-level screening method and LOF algorithm are compared to evaluate the fault detection performance, and the learning of the threshold parameters are particularly discussed. The results further address the importance of threshold parameter learning for the performance evaluation of battery diagnosis methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Marine Grounding Electrode and its Influence on the Surrounding Area
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the gradual transformation of the world energy structure to low-carbon green environmental energy, wind energy—as a renewable clean energy, has been widely used due to its clean and safe characteristics. At present, the technology of VSC-HVDC is the best choice for the far sea wind power transmission. In addition, with the large-scale and far-reaching characteristics of offshore wind power, the VSC-HVDC project of bipolar topology is a possible future model. This paper studies and discusses the design of sea electrodes and it’s safety evaluation. The calculation results show that the method can meet the safety requirements of electromagnetic effect and thermal effect.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Virtual Inertia Control Strategy Based on an Improved SOGI-FLL Scheme for Energy Storage Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A frequency derivative-based virtual inertia method for energy storage converters (ESCs) using a second order generalized integrator-frequency locked loop (SOGI-FLL) is used to address the lack of inertia concern. However, the existence of the dc component in the input of the SOGI-FLL leads to fundamental frequency oscillations in its measured results. An enhanced virtual inertia control strategy with a complex bandpass filter based improved SOGI-FLL (CBF- ISOGI-FLL) is proposed to deal with this problem in this paper. In addition, the small-signal modeling and tuning procedure of the SOGI-FLL as well as the CBF-ISOGI-FLL are carried out to validate their feasibility. Furthermore, the estimated quantities of frequency derivative signal for the SOGI-FLL and CBF-ISOGI- FLL, in the presence of the dc offset, are used to display the performance comparisons. Finally, simulation and experimental platforms are established, simulation and experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: An Integrated Power Supply Design for Motor Encoder Utilizing Common-Mode Voltage with Phase Shifted SPWM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Motor encoder is a rotational speed and position measuring device in high performance servo motor. It needs an additional 5V or 12V power cable connected with the inverter for power supply. In order to seek simplicity in engineering, this paper proposes a common mode voltage-fed method to supply power for the motor encoder, eliminating the need for the additional DC power cable. Furthermore, compared with the conventional SPWM technology, the Phase Shifted-SPWM (PS-SPWM) technology is adopted to improve the common-mode voltage and finally reduces the output DC voltage ripples. Experimental results validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed design.

articleTitle: Research on Output Voltage Waveform Control of Three Level Inverter under Unbalanced Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the condition of unbalanced load, the three-phase output voltage of three-level inverter is asymmetric. The traditional double closed-loop PI control has a good control effect on the output voltage waveform when the load is balanced, but in the case of unbalanced load, the output voltage waveform contains a negative sequence component, and the control effect on the negative sequence component is limited.
