In order to improve the output voltage waveform under unbalanced conditions, the 90° symmetric component method is used to separate the positive and negative sequence components, and then PI control is applied to the positive and negative sequence components separately in the dual synchronous rotating coordinate system. Simulations and experiments have verified the correctness of the control strategy, which has a strong harmonic suppression capability and high output voltage quality under unbalanced load conditions.

articleTitle: Research of Inertial Control Strategy of Wind turbines under Low Frequency Situation of Hydro-dominated System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper we present here a strategy about wind turbines participating in primary frequency regulation (PFR) to improve low frequency conditions of Yunnan Power Grid in China. We first establish a system frequency response (SFR) model including multiple power sources and frequency limit controller (FLC) of DC system. Then, we propose a process to optimize parameters of wind turbines PFR from the perspective of improving the action of FLC. Simulation results show that the wind turbines participating in FPR with using inertia control, which can quickly suppress the frequency peak of the system, effectively reduce the number of actions of Frequency Limit Controller, and avoid the frequency secondary drop in hydro-dominated system with Frequency limit controller.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Internal Model PI Control Design for Grid Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the structure and working mode of the new dual full bridge topology are analyzed, and the following work is carried out to improve the system performance. The dynamic small signal mathematical model of dual full bridge converter is established. Aiming at the main circuit structure of grid power supply system and the problem of complex parameter adjustment of traditional PID controller, a double closed-loop control method is proposed, in which PI controller is used in current inner loop and IMC controller is used in voltage outer loop, so as to reduce the number of adjustable parameters and the complexity of parameter adjustment The fuzzy internal model PI controller is used to give consideration to the dynamic performance and robust performance of the controller. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Research on Ferromagnetic Resonance of Isolated Distribution Networks with Neutral Point Ungrounded
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the operational reliability of the neutral point ungrounded medium-voltage isolated distribution system and reduce the risk of ferromagnetic resonance, this paper establishes a simulation model for reproducing the accident of a 6.6kV neutral-point ungrounded isolated grid distribution system in a power station. In this system, the characteristics of the distribution system's ferromagnetic resonance and the elimination effect of various common protective measures are explored and the influence of the fault phase on single-phase fault clearance and single-phase arc grounding to excite ferromagnetic resonance are separately studied. The research conclusions of this paper have important reference value for the reasonable determination of elimination methods for the neutral point ungrounded isolated grid distribution system.

articleTitle: Optimization of Geometry and Electrode Coverage of Trapezoidal Piezoelectric Energy Harvester for Specific Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, to get a high energy storage capacity, the geometry and electrode coverage of cantilevered trapezoidal piezoelectric energy harvester (PEH) with proof mass was designed and optimized for 50 Hz vibration environment, and it was verified by COMSOL simulations and experiments. The synchronous charge extraction circuit (SECE) is used to isolate the effect of the load on the recovered power in experiments. Under the same excitation of constant acceleration of 3 m/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, trapezoidal and rectangular PEHs with the same volume are compared on the power generation capacity, the result shows that the output power of trapezoidal piezoelectric energy harvester is 31.6% higher than that of rectangular.

articleTitle: Differential protection of distribution network with adaptive braking coefficient based on transient direction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Traditional differential protection is widely used in protected transmission lines because of its simple principle and high reliability. However, due to the inconsistency of the communication paths at both ends during the synchronous acquisition phase, the collected currents have differential, which reduces the reliability of the differential protection to a certain extent. Therefore, under the background of 5G communication technology, an adaptive differential protection based on transient direction suggests in this paper. The method improves the reliability of differential protection by changing the braking coefficient according to the transient direction on both sides of the line. The simulation experiment is performed by MATLAB / Simulink. When the external fault occurs, the differential protection device successfully identifies the differential current caused when the synchronous path is inconsistent, and ensures the reliability of the internal and external fault action mode.

articleTitle: Optimal Day-ahead Scheduling of Electric Vehicles and Hydrogen Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the shifting of global energy production away from fossil fuels, the usage of electric vehicles (EV) and renewable energy generation has increased rapidly. To solve the problem of grid-connected fluctuations of renewable energy and EV charging load, an optimal day-ahead scheduling of EVs and hydrogen storage is proposed in this paper. The trip characteristics of EVs are analyzed to calculate the charging load and the model of hydrogen storage station is established at first. The main focus of the second step is dispatching the hydrogen storage station and photovoltaic power plant to maximize the revenue of electricity retailers over a 24-h time horizon. The constraints include electricity selling price constraints, power limitations, and voltage stability within the network. The proposed scheduling model is applied on IEEE 33-node network to prove that it satisfies the consumption requirements of abundant photovoitaic power generation with significant economic benefits.

articleTitle: Data-Driven based Tap Positions Optimization of Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to make full use of the voltage regulation capability of a distribution transformer with off-circuit tap-changer, we proposed a strategy for adjusting the tap positions of distribution transformers to solve the problem of voltage quality of the distribution network caused by frequent voltage violation. Taking the user-side voltage qualified rate and the action times of the switching equipment as the objective function, we establish a multi-objective optimization model to optimize the tap positions of the distribution transformer. And then we use genetic algorithm based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to solve the proposed optimization model and obtain the optimal distribution transformer tap position. Finally, case study based on the practical data shows that this method can effectively reduce the voltage deviation and improve the voltage qualification rate.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Aggregation Modeling Algorithm of Smart Park in Load-intensive City
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper takes the load-intensive city demand aggregation modeling method as the research object, analyzes the raw data of the energy management platform of the smart park, extracts the energy consumption data that needs to be mined and processed, and processes the data from bad sources to improve the data usage efficiency. Based on the analysis of the data sources of the smart park energy management platform, energy consumption data is extracted and processed, and bad data is corrected. According to the cluster analysis method, the demand aggregation model of the park is established, and the results are used for the optimal energy dispatch of the park, which can improve the energy efficiency of the park.

articleTitle: A Closed-Loop Starting Method of Sensorless Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The sensorless brushless DC motor has broad application prospects, but the sensorless control method of commutation by detecting the motor back electromotive force (EMF) is not suitable for low speed conditions, making it difficult to start stably and reliably. This paper analyzes the change of DC bus current when the control system delays switching sectors, and obtains the motor commutation timing by detecting the current change rate. A closed-loop speed control system for the starting process of sensorless brushless DC motor is designed, and the three stages of the starting process is analyzed. Finally, the designed control system has been experimentally verified that the brushless DC motor can be started reliably.

articleTitle: Research on Increasing Test Voltage to Suppress Influence of Electromagnetic Interference in Dielectric Frequency Response Test of High Voltage AC Oil-paper Insulated Bushing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduced the field test of dielectric frequency response of 110kV and above high voltage AC oil-paper insulated bushings, and explained the mechanism of electromagnetic interference and proposed measures, such as increasing the test voltage, to suppress electromagnetic interference. And voltage dependence of dielectric frequency response of high-voltage AC bushings werestudied as well. The method of increasing test voltage was proved to be effectively in suppress the electromagnetic interference and improve the accuracy of the test result during field test in the converter stations and substations.

articleTitle: Modeling Of Micro-grid With Power Electronic Transformer & Its Effects On AC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Different devices are used to connect the micro-grid with the main network. As of their performance difference, the effect on main-network may not be the same, so it is necessary to carry out relevant research. Firstly, based on the structure of PET, one of the advanced access device, a steady-state analysis model is constructed in ETAP. Secondly, according to the composition of the discussed micro-grid, its operational analysis is done when the supply and demand vary. Finally, the variation of power loss, voltage deviation, harmonic components in the main grid, which reflect the influence of micro-grid with PET are shown. Meanwhile, the corresponding control strategy of PET is also given.

articleTitle: Interruption Performance of a 40.5kV Vacuum Circuit Breaker Used for the Fault Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vacuum circuit breakers(VCBs) are commonly used in the medium and lower voltage power systems. With the requirements of current limiters, the interruption characteristics of the vacuum circuit breaker need to be improved. As to obtain the relationships between interruption characteristics and arcing extinguishing chamber key structures, tests are adopted to a 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker in this paper, and lots of calculations are carried out for optimization of electromagnetic field. It is shown that for the application in current limiters, contact structures and coil must be designed and optimized for obtaining larger magnetic force so as to interrupt the arc under the conditions of higher DC component and shorter arcing time. Testing results reveals that the interruption behaviors are affected by the polarity of the vacuum circuit breaker, it is harder for interrupting when polarity is positive, and the interruption performance of the VCB is decreasing because of the electrical inductance existing in the current limiter.

articleTitle: Regression method based fault detection of the VRF system for energy saving
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A refrigerant charge fault detection strategy was proposed using regression method. First, characteristic variable parameters that are sensitive to the refrigerant charge level of variable refrigerant flow (VRF) system were select. Then, regression models of refrigerant charge amount fault detection were established by using multiple linear regression and support vector regression respectively. The training process of the regression model only needs the normal refrigerant charge operation data, which does not need the complete refrigerant charge level experimental data. Refrigerant charge fault experimental data which contains refrigerant undercharge, overcharge and leakage were used to test the developed fault detection models. Results show that the detection performance of the support vector regression model is better than the multiple linear regression model. In addition, for the refrigerant leakage fault, the support vector regression model can detect the leakage fault after 3 minutes of refrigerant leakage.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristics Analysis and Suppression Method of Short Circuit Fault of Coaxial Cable in Electromagnetic Launch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In electromagnetic launch systems, coaxial cables are used for energy transmission from the power supply to the launcher. Once the cable has a short-circuit fault, it will cause the cable to over-current or even explode, causing the launch to fail. This paper first established the dynamic launch model of the capacitive energy storage electromagnetic launch system, and analyzed in detail the influence of the coaxial cable short-circuit fault location on the load current, projectile exit speed, and coaxial cable current. The results show that the closer the short-circuit fault location is to the load side, The larger the cable fault current, the smaller the projectile exit velocity.At 1m the cable fault current reached 1.9 times the normal current, resulting in a 76% drop in exit speed.Secondly,an electromagnetic launch system model with a high-temperature superconducting current limiter was established,and the installation position of the current limiter was optimized. The fault current before and after the installation of the current limiter was simulated and compared. The results showed that: after the current limiter was added, the cable short-circuit current The peak value dropped by 29%, and the projectile exit speed was reduced by 61 % compared to normal conditions, which can effectively reduce the impact of short-circuit current on the cable, increase the projectile exit speed, and provide guidance for the safety design of the electromagnetic launch system.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Container Security Framework Adapted to the Power Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, due to the elastic container technical characteristics and active open source community support, container technology has become an important basic technology for the new digital infrastructure of power. Now, the container technology is very popular and widely used in power cloud platform, but the problem of power system security risk caused by container can’t be ignored. Aiming at the problem of container security, this paper proposes a lightweight container security enhancement framework. Based on the methods of lightweight hardware virtualization isolation, cloud trust, and transparent encryption and decryption of container data, we implemented the container framework in the power cloud platform. Experiments show that the mechanism has played a practical role and has little impact on the business in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Optimization and Solution Method for Electric Vehicle Charging and Discharging Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of Vehicle-to-grid(V2G) technology can help electric vehicles (EVs) better assist the grid operation, and this paper proposes an electric vehicle load optimization model and solution method. The EV load optimization model regulates the charging and discharging power of EVs at different time of the day, with the aim of minimizing peak-to-valley difference of network and network loss, while considering the charging demands of EV users, the battery charging and discharging cycle range. The paper uses second-order conic algorithm to relax the power flow balance constraint, and then convexify the "nonconvex" part of the EV model to eliminate integer variables. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by cases analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of the User Side Energy Storage With Multiple Values Considering Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy storage has the ability of fast and flexible bi-directional power regulation, which can change the traditional power system's attribute of instant balance. At present, the energy storage application is still in an initial stage, so it is necessary to study how to get the best out of the multiple values of energy storage in the power system to improve its economy. This paper studies an optimal configuration method of the user-side energy storage with multiple values considering frequency regulation. Firstly, the load characteristics are introduced, and the feasibility of energy storage to play multiple values is illustrated. Secondly, according to the frequency regulation market mechanism, the role of the thermal generating unit and the energy storage in the process of frequency regulation is quantified, and the revenue distribution mechanism is designed. Then, the optimal configuration model of the user side energy storage with multiple values is established. Finally, a case study shows that the method proposed in this paper can improve the economy of the energy storage configuration.

articleTitle: A New Method for Single-phase Grounding Fault Line Selection Based on Waveform Similarity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of fault line selection, a fault feeder detection method based on zero sequence current waveform similarity is proposed. First of all, the transient zero-sequence current is decomposed by variational mode decomposition combined with fast Fourier transform, the power frequency component and noise signal are removed, and the transient non-power frequency component is obtained. Secondly, the correlation analysis of non-power frequency components is carried out, and the comprehensive correlation coefficient is obtained. Finally, the maximum difference between the threshold and the comprehensive correlation coefficient of non-power frequency components is compared to detect the fault feeder. Theoretical calculation and simulation results show that the proposed method is not affected by various fault conditions, and can select fault feeder accurately, which further improves the accuracy of fault line selection.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the impulse aging of varistors in the arrester of 500kV AC filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impulse current of the 500 kV AC filter arresters is very high when the AC filter bank circuit breaker is switched and the closing phase angle is large in some ±800 kV and ±500 kV converter stations. The frequent high current will accelerate aging of the arresters and then threaten the safe operation of converter stations.In this paper, based on the measured impulse current waveform of the arresters during the switching on process of AC filter bank, the impulse aging experiments of ZnO varistors of AC filter arrester under the negative polarity 15/35 µs impulse current with an amplitude of 15 kA was carried out. Firstly, in order to shorten the experiments cycle, each group of the impulse aging experiments consists of 50 times impulses. Secondly, combined with the experiments results and calculation analysis, the variation of electrical characteristic parameters such as DC reference voltage (U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.01mA</inf>, U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1mA</inf> and U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1mA</inf>), capacitance C, residual voltage ratio β and nonlinear coefficient α<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> of ZnO varistors during the experiments process were obtained. Finally, the variation regularities of electrical characteristic parameters of ZnO varistors obtained by a large number of single impulse aging experiments in other papers were compared and analyzed. The results show that the overall variation trend of electrical characteristic parameters of ZnO varistors obtained by each group of the impulse aging experiments with 50 times impulses is almost the same as that obtained by the single impulse aging experiments.

articleTitle: Research and Engineering Application of DC Frequency Limit Control in DXB DC Project
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The frequency limit controller, or FLC, is an important measure for grid frequency stability control, and has been widely used in DC projects. DXB UHVDC project is faced with the problems of increasing frequency instability of the Yunnan power grid, as it runs asynchronously from the main grid, and the shortage of the opening unit in the initial stage of production. The configuration of FLC is very important. It analyzes two kinds of FLC control logic used in current DC project of China Southern Power Grid and compares the results of two kinds of control logic response through simulation test. The FLC configuration and parameter selection of DXB UHVDC are explained, and the response characteristics of FLC under the typical fault under the isolated islanding system are verified through simulation. And verify its function in DXB R TDS simulation platform as well as field test.

articleTitle: Development of High Voltage DC Power Supply at High Potential for Aging Test of HVDC Converter Arresters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC arrester is the key protection equipment of HVDC converter (converter valve). It is necessary to test the aging performance of valve disc of arrester according to the standard waveforms. In order to generate the voltage waveforms of valve and bridge arresters in HVDC converter, aging test power supply for converter arresters was developed by DC superimposed ripple. Aging test power supply implementation approach has been introduced in this paper. According to the parameters of the current DC arresters in the market, the parameters of high voltage DC power supply at high potential are analyzed, and the output current should be up to 15mA when the out voltage is 8kV. According to the voltage waveforms characteristics of various parts in the operation of HVDC project, the design principle of the aging power supply is introduced and the insulation level of the high voltage DC power supply to the ground is calculated. The topological structure and implementation of high voltage DC power at high potential are described. The output waveforms of pure DC voltage, the valve voltage and 6 pulse bridge voltage are presented, which are generated by the aging power supply composed of DC and ripple. The experimental results show that high voltage DC power supply at high potential can output 30mA at 8kV, which can also be used in series with the ripple power supply to generate required special waveforms.

articleTitle: Study on The Paschen Curve of Air Discharge under Repetitive Pulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Paschen curves of air plate-to-plate discharge under repetitive pulse voltage is experimentally investigated in this work. It is interesting to find that, when the pulse repetitive frequency is 100 Hz, A "U" shape of the Paschen curve of the air discharge is observed. The breakdown voltage of air discharge for pulse voltage is significantly higher than that for DC and AC voltage, and both the left branch and right branch of the Paschen curve are more precipitous than that for DC and AC voltage. However, as the pulse repetitive frequency increases up to 100 kHz, the Paschen curve of the air discharge under pulse voltage is almost the same as that under DC and AC voltage. In addition, a one-dimensional plasma simulation of the air discharge is implemented to understand the effects of the pulse repetitive frequency on the breakdown process.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control method of electrochemical energy storage system based on source-load interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the absorption capacity for large-scale new energy, a fuzzy control method for electrochemical energy storage system based on source-charge interaction is presented in this paper. According to the principle of source-charge interaction control, the optimization model of source-charge interaction electrochemical energy storage system is established. The minimum difference of source-charge interaction power is as the objective function, and the grid constraints are considered comprehensively. Combined with the technology of power prediction, the fuzzy control principle is introduced into the energy storage control strategy to improve the dynamic regulation accuracy of the control system. The effective response to the power fluctuations of the power grid is realized. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by the optimization results on the regional power system of North China.

articleTitle: An activation energy-based method for assessing the aging state of cellulose insulating paper under the synergistic effect of mechanical stress and heat
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Oil-paper insulation is an important component of the oil-immersed power transformer, and its insulation life is directly related to the operating life of the transformer. Therefore, it is particularly important to accurately assess the life of the oil-paper insulation system. In this paper, aging insulation paper samples with different mechanical stresses were prepared in an aging vibration chamber under laboratory conditions, and the activation energy under the synergistic machine-thermal action was obtained using the translation factor. The Arrhenius equation was then combined with the Ekenstam equation to derive an equation that can accurately determine the degree of polymerization of the oil-paper insulation system. It is proved that this equation can predict the degree of polymerization of the paper under the synergistic action of machine and heat, and can provide theoretical support for the evaluation of paper life.

articleTitle: Influence of parasitic parameters on electrical stress of high frequency transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power electronic transformer (PET) or solid state transformer (SST) is regarded as "energy routers" for the application in new energy power transmission, distributed power energy and electric vehicle It has gradually become a research hotspot due to its high efficiency and flexibility for power control. Among them, the high frequency transformer (HFT) used as a key component in DC-DC converter can generate parasitic parameters to affect the HFT electrical stress. The increase in working frequency can effectively reduce the volume of transformer However; the influence of parasitic parameters closely related to structure, material and layout of HFT become more and more seriously on DC-DC converter performance at high frequency, such as several tens of kHz. This paper provides a simulation study about the influence of parasitic parameters on the electrical stress of HFT under different working conditions. A typical HFT with the rated power of 10 kW was used for obtaining the possible parasitic parameters. The DC-DC converter includes the 20 kHz HFT was simulated considering the parasitic parameters. They can affect the voltage and current waveforms of the windings, especially for the dV/dt and dI/dt regions, which are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Breakdown location method for on-site impulse withstand voltage test based on distributed HF current
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impact withstand voltage test has been successfully applied to the handover test of GIS equipment, but there is a lack of targeted breakdown location methods. This paper proposes a breakdown location technique based on the distributed high-frequency current method, explains the principle of the technique, the composition of the location system, the specific implementation steps under different working conditions, and carries out simulation analysis according to the field conditions of the impact withstand voltage test, and conducts tests in the field. The results show that the breakdown location technology based on the distributed current method can be applied to the GIS field impact withstand voltage test, which is easy to install and effectively reduces the location time of the breakdown accident on site; in the specific implementation of the breakdown location of the distributed current method, the rising edge and transient amplitude of the grounding current waveform are related to the distance of the occurring grounding gas chamber, and the steady state amplitude is not related to the distance of the breakdown point; the location potential can be an effective trigger for the breakdown system signal.

articleTitle: Research on Stability of Multiple Photovoltaic Virtual Synchronous Generators System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The existing researches of virtual synchronous generator (VSG) stability was applied for microgrid or one machine infinite bus system. There is few study on VSG stability in multiple machines system. The small signal model of grid-connected VSGs system is given in this paper. By solving the steady-state and the sensitivity analysis of the parameters, the effect of control variables and s parameters (line impedance ratio, line length, etc.) on the small signal model eigenvalues were studied. On the other hand, the comparison about the differences between multiple grid-connected VSGs stability and single VSG stability is conducted. The results of mathematic model show that if the control variables of different VSGs are basically identical, the damping characteristic of the multiple VSGs system can be equivalent to a one VSG system.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Automotive Fuel Cell during Activation Period
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fuel cell has a broad application prospect, whereas the durability, cost and performance need optimization for further commercialization. Fuel cell activation procedure is an important way to effectively improve fuel cell performance, but has received little attention, especially during automotive operation. In this paper, we focus on the performance characteristics of the on-board fuel cell activation stage and introduce two online performance analysis methods suitable for vehicle conditions. It is found that during the activation phase, the voltage degradation caused by vehicle operating conditions and the performance optimization introduced by hydration occur simultaneously. Due to the effect of operating current on hydration, fuel cells exhibit different performance characteristics at different currents. The analysis provides a basis for the control strategy design in the activation phase of automotive PEMFC, so that the fuel cell can quickly achieve the best performance.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on the Partial Discharge Characteristics of Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The converter transformer sustained the combined voltage of AC and DC at the same time, so the operation condition is quite complex. The oil paper insulation defects of converter transformer will directly affect the operation safety of converter transformer. In the course of long-term operation of converter transformer, the working temperature of converter transformer oil will change due to its internal insulation fault, load change, heat dissipation device fault and environmental temperature. Therefore, this paper analyzes the distribution of electric field and temperature when partial discharge occurs in the operation of converter transformer based on fluid dynamics theory and heat transfer theory. It is of great significance to ensure the normal operation of the transmission system

articleTitle: A Data-Based HALL Sensor Position Deviation Compensation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Brushless DC motors (BLDC) that use Hall sensors to obtain the rotor position have been widely used in various applications. However, the rotor position is difficult to obtain accurately due to the deviation of the installation position of the Hall sensor in actual engineering, which will cause torque fluctuations and weaken the control performance. Further more, the analysis and experiments in this article have found that under certain circumstances, for example the back-EMF is not the ideal trapezoidal wave but closer to a sine wave and the DC bus filter capacitor will generate more heat. This leads to a substantial increase in temperature and reduces the reliability of the drive. Therefore, this paper proposes a new method of Hall deviation correction based on online data collection and offline analysis to obtain the actual angle of the motor Hall deviation, and gives a control algorithm based on the angle compensation. Finally, physical experiments are given to verify that the method can effectively eliminate the bus current pulsation caused by Hall deviation and reduce the temperature rise of the bus filter capacitor.

articleTitle: Power Network Modeling Method Based on the Combination of Physical Characteristics and Structure Characteristics in Mvar Control Space
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the substantial increase in the penetration rate of new energy, energy storage and flexible loads, the random volatility of grid operation has increased, and the control capabilities of traditional grid reactive power solutions have been limited. Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional reactive power network topology modeling method in the process of matching the dual characteristics of source and load, this paper proposes a new power network modeling method in Mvar control space that integrates the physical characteristics of the power system and the structure characteristics of the grid. The method combines the different characteristics of the electrical distance in the voltage control zone and the shortest path and the edge betweenness in the complex network theory by defining an edge weight called "hybrid edge weight" to provide a scale for grid structure division. The article analyzes the characteristics of the hybrid edge weight parameters by taking the IEEE 9-node system as an example, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed modeling method.

articleTitle: A Cicuit and Artificial Neural Network Mixed Battery Model for Test Normalization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Battery is the energy source of many power equipment, the quality and reliability of battery is directly related to the reliability of all kinds of equipment, so it needs to be tested reasonably. However, different enterprises or research institutions have different battery quality indicators and testing methods, resulting in various test results cannot be compared and referenced. Eventually, the workload is increased and the waste of testing resources is wasted. In this paper, a battery model mixed with circuit and artificial neural network is proposed to realize data exchange and test data normalization.

articleTitle: The design of a low-inductance folding MOV structure for the generation of high voltage microsecond quasi-square pulses
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metal-oxide varistors (MOVs) have been applied to the pulsed power field for the generation of quasi-square pulses due to their nonlinear voltage-current characteristics. The varistor voltage of a single MOV is limited. Multiple MOVs in series are promising to be used to stabilize high voltage pulses and therefore to produce quasi-square pulses. A low-inductance folding MOV structure for the generation of high voltage microsecond quasi-square pulses is designed and numerically studied in this paper. Circuit simulations have been carried out to verify the shaping characteristics of MOVs and the influence of the MOV column inductance on the output waveforms is analyzed. A coaxial evolute structure of MOV in series has been designed and optimized to increase the insulation level of the MOV column while minimizing its inductance through simulations in CST. Furthermore, a 500kV-level microsecond pulse generator based on the multiple MOVs with coaxial evolute structure has been designed and verified with simulation. The results indicate that a high voltage pulse with amplitude of 500 kV and pulse width of 1 μs can be obtained on the load of about 50 Ω. Without pulse forming lines, this MOV based generator has the advantages of simple design and compact construction, which is promising to be used as a compact long pulse driving source in many fields, such as corona plasma generation, industrial dedusting, and medical disinfection.

articleTitle: Cost-Based Application Placement Optimization for Integrated Energy System using Docker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the integrated energy system (IES), distributed energy, flexible load and electric vehicle are widely involved in the energy production, consumption and other aspects of the power system, which makes it an important issue to optimize the deployment of energy management application. Therefore, this paper proposes cost-based application placement method using computing resource containers based on Docker technology, which can effectively reduce the deployment cost of application placement in IES. We first characterize the task components and their connections in energy management application. According to the architecture of physical machine using Docker, we construct the operation model including computation model and communication model Besides, to evaluate the application placement schemes, we propose a cost-based evaluation metrics considering the cost caused by task execution and data transmission. Simulation verifies the rationality and effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Corona-type (Non-thermal) Leader in the Point Head Rod-Plane Short Gap
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a numerical simulation is presented to study corona-type (non-thermal) leader observed previously in the point head rod-plane short gap. A 2D axisymmetric model of streamer discharge is established to simulate the positive streamer discharge in the rod-plane short gap at atmospheric pressure. The streamer discharge parameters such as movement of major charged particles, shape of the streamer and distribution of electric field are obtained. Then we set a plasma channel composed of positive and negative ions near the anode and find two sections in the current pulse, which is consistent with the previous experiment. The existence of corona-type (non-thermal) leader in the point head rod-plane short gap is conformed through the numerical simulation. It is widely accepted that residual charge can be ignored under power frequency voltage. However, the experiment result and simulation result illustrate the effect of residual charge on the subsequent discharge. And a theoretical demonstration is given that the residual charge from the previous discharge (a plasma channel) is the key to the formation of the “stem” structure. The research in this paper can not only expand the understanding of the corona discharge process, but also help to judge the intensity of corona discharge.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Engine Cooling System Based on Self-adjusting Fuzzy Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A simplified mathematical model of the vehicle engine electronic control cooling system is established by using the lumped parameter method, and non-linear control strategy and fuzzy control strategy are introduced to simulate the cooling system. Taking the optimal coolant temperature of the vehicle engine outlet as the research objective, non-linear controller, fuzzy controller and self-adjusting fuzzy controller are designed to control the engine coolant temperature and to study the energy consumption optimization of the cooling system. Experiments show that compared with non-linear control, self-adjusting fuzzy control, and fuzzy control strategy, When the engine is in the maximum heat load and the electronic valve is fully open, the energy consumption of the cooling system can be reduced by 33% by using self-adjusting fuzzy control strategy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Judgment Method of the Measurement and Control Device Crash of Transmission Line Based on SCADA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to check the measurement and control device crash of transmission line in time, an intelligent discrimination method is proposed. This method makes full use of the data storage and data processing functions of SCADA. According to the actual work experience of power grid monitoring and the characteristics of the measured data after the measurement and control device crash, the intelligent judgment process and criterion conditions for quickly identifying the measurement and control device crash are established, which greatly improves the troubleshooting efficiency of the monitoring and control device crash. Taking the actual power grid as an example, the test results show that the method can reliably and quickly identify the measurement and control device crash of transmission line.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of dielectric characteristics on plasma jet characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dielectric barrier discharge is the most common way of generating plasma jets used in biomedicine. Most of the existing literature uses quartz glass as the dielectric and seldom researchers use ceramics. This paper studies the difference in the characteristics of plasma jets generated by dielectric barrier discharge when quartz glass and ceramics are taken as the dielectric. The differences in optical characteristics, temperature characteristics, discharge power and discharge current of plasma jets generated by the two dielectrics were studied, and the causes of the differences in characteristics were explored through thermally stimulated current experiment, laying the foundation for the further research on the differences in the biomedical application of plasma jet when using different dielectric.

articleTitle: A Temporal-spatial Distribution Characteristics Based HVDC Transmission Line Model and Its Influence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the reverse geographical distribution between the main power consumption areas and energy production bases in China, several HVDC transmission lines have been built. Different from AC system, resistance parameter is the main factor affecting the electrical quantity of DC system. In order to consider the influence of DC resistance on system analysis, the thermal balance process of transmission line is analyzed in detail in this paper. By considering the temporal-spatial distribution of meteorological environment, the HVDC transmission line is modeled finely, and a DC transmission line modeling method is proposed. On the basis, the corresponding power flow calculation method for AC/DC hybrid systems is presented. Finally, to verify the impact of the proposed model, an AC/DC hybrid model is built based on PSASP simulation software. By calculating the DC line resistance under different temporal-spatial environment influences, the influence of the model on the operating state of AC/DC hybrid system is analyzed. The simulation results show that calculating the resistance under different temporal-spatial conditions is helpful to improve the accuracy of power system analysis.

articleTitle: Static Mechanical Characteristics Study of Cap and Pin Insulator at Low Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There have been lots of failure accidents of cap and pin insulator when it is at extremely cold environment. The research object of this paper is cap and pin insulators of porcelain and glass with different rated mechanical damage road. And the experiments to test their static mechanical characteristics are carried out at low temperatures. The results show that with the decrease of temperature, the mechanical strength of insulator metal fittings, insulation parts and cement adhesive are improved in varying degrees. However, with the decrease of temperature, the size of metal accessories and insulators does not change much. The results show that the shrinkage degree of cement adhesive volume with the decrease of temperature is higher than that of other connecting parts. According to the analysis, the cavity between the insulator and the iron cap caused by the shrinkage of cement adhesive is the main reason for the failure of mechanical characteristics. For the sake of operation safety, it is suggested that insulators with mechanical strength higher than the design value should be used to reduce the probability of mechanical failure of insulators caused by adhesive cavities.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Operation Optimization Method of Steam Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The steam power system consumes many energies, which lays a foundation for the long cycle operation of petrochemical enterprises. However, most optimized operation scheduling schemes only considered the savings in energy quantity, disregarding the difference in energy quality. In this paper, exergy analysis method in thermodynamics is used to evaluate the quality of various energy sources, and exergy objective function is established. Moreover, combined with economic objective function, a mixed-integer nonlinear multi-objective model of SPS is established. Finally, the ε constraint method is used to obtain the Pareto front of multi-objective problems, and the fuzzy decision is used to determine the optimal strategy of the system. By introducing the multi-objective optimization of SPS model considering the economic and exergy objective, an optimal scheduling scheme weighing economic and exergy objectives is obtained. Compared with single objective optimization results, the results indicate the feasibility and effectiveness of the model and the solution method.

articleTitle: Motor-Generator Pair to Improve the Operation Stability of Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the stability problems caused by low inertia, weak damping and low short circuit capacity of photovoltaic (PV) systems, this paper puts forward the motorgenerator pair (MGP) as a new way for grid-connection. Firstly, the control method and structure of PV connected to the grid via MGP are described. Then, the moments of inertia of PV with or without MGP under the same capacity are compared. The second- order small signal model of MGP is built to analyze the damping characteristics of MGP. And the short-circuit ratio is used to analyze the effect of MGP on the grid strength. Finally, the simulation model is built by PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the improvement effect of MGP on low inertia, weak damping and abundant harmonics of PV systems.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Grid Connected Offshore Wind Farm Considering the Influence of Typhoon
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the Batts model and key characteristics of typhoon, the influence of typhoon on the wind speed is evaluated. Besides, the influence of typhoon on failure rate of wind turbines based on wind speed is considered to establish the reliability model of offshore wind farm. In addition, the reliability models of the collection system and VSC-HVDC system are established by state space method. The reliability indexes are calculated by the system state transition sampling approach. This reliability evaluation method increases the accuracy of reliability evaluation. At the same time, it enhances the practicability of the reliability model and can better provide guidance and references for the construction of offshore wind farm. Finally, the IEEE RTS-79 is studied to access the reliability. From the results, it can be summarized that the reliability indexes of grid are directly influenced by typhoon.

articleTitle: Life prediction of pulse capacitor based on BP neural network method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the core component of pulse power supply, the life and reliability of pulse capacitor is one of the most important characteristics. Due to many factors that affect the life of the capacitor and the complex state equation, the life model of pulse capacitor is established based on the BP neural network method. Firstly, a life test platform for pulsed power capacitors was established, and life tests were performed on 5 capacitors; Secondly, a BP neural network model was established, using the experimental data of capacitor 1 as training data, after training the neural network model, the life of remaining 4 capacitors was predicted. Finally, the predicted results are compared with the actual experimental results, and the life of capacitor is obtained from the variation of the capacitance value. The error between the predicted data and the experimental data is within 5%, which verifies the accuracy of the life prediction model. This method can be used to predict the life of the capacitor, evaluate the performance and status of capacitor, and improve the stability and reliability of pulse power system.

articleTitle: A Distributed Data Center for Full-view Synchronous Measurement System Based on OpenPDC/ OpenHistorian
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing degree of power electronics in the power system, the full-view measurement system (SYMS) realizes real-time measurement and data collection. However, the existing SYMS data center cannot adapt to the development of the next few years. To solve this problem, a distributed SYMS data center in combination with the open-source real-time phasor big data platform OpenPDC/OpenHistorian is proposed. The new-generation SYMS data center will consist of a front-end OpenPDC cluster, message-oriented middleware (MOM), OpenHistorian storage cluster and application cluster. The system has the characteristics of high availability, robust scalability and low coupling.

articleTitle: A Micro-plasma Device for Neuroprotection and Its Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this study, a bayonet dispensing mental slim tube-ring structure based on dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) was adopted to generate micro-plasma jet at atmospheric pressure. The micro-plasma jet has a diameter of 500 μm and can propagate into the open air. The electrical and optical diagnoses revealed that this device is of good repeatability and controllability, which is essential for precision plasma medicine applications. A detailed analysis on the touchability of the jet suggests that this device is safe enough to operate. It will be applied in our further research on the neuroprotective effects of plasma treatment.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of a Novel Single-stage Electromagnetic Needle Selector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Needle selector is an executive component of computerized flat knitting machine used to implement needle selection control. It is found that there are problems of missed and wrong selection in the actual working process. In this paper, a novel single-stage electromagnetic needle selector with E-type structure was designed by using ANSYS Maxwell. And PWM control technology was applied to the excitation driving circuit of this needle selector. The analysis and experiment show that the new needle selector can effectively reduce the occurrence of wrong and missed needle selection, and also save the material cost. This research can provide theoretical guidance for the improvement of the product process and driving module of the needle selector, and better practical application value.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of An Outer-Rotor Magnetic-Gear-Integrated Brushless Motor under Two Magnetization Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel magnetic-gear-integrated motor employing Halbach array is presented in this paper. This proposed motor skillfully combines the magnetic gear with the permanent magnet brushless motor. As a result, they could use the same permanent magnet rotor, which makes the motor have higher torque density. Hence, the proposed motor could meet the requirements of low-speed and large-torque in the meantime. Besides, Halbach array and conventional radial structure are respectively used in the PMs of this proposed motor. Meanwhile, the main performance comparison of the two structures is studied through finite element analysis.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Market Decision of Load Aggregator Considering Response Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that load aggregator (LA) faces greater risk when participating in day-ahead market demand response(DR) due to uncertainty of user response, a day-ahead market decision model of LA considering the uncertainty of response is proposed in this paper. The basic process of LA participating in the day-ahead DR is described in this paper. A DR model considering the uncertainty of response is constructed. Conditional value at risk (CVaR) is used as measurement indexes of decision risk. A benefit-risk portfolio decision model of LA is constructed, and the adaptive particle swarm optimization embedded in Latin hypercube sampling is used to solve the model. The effects of risk preference and response reliability on the benefits and risk losses of LA are discussed. The validity and rationality of the model are verified by an example, which provides a theoretical reference for LA to participate in the operational decision-making of the day-ahead market DR.

articleTitle: Design of a chopper system in a compact THz-FEL facility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An independently tunable cell gun of Huazhong University of Science and Technology Free Electron Laser Terahertz facility has an imperfect performance in longitudinal bunching. The long beam tail not only wastes microwave power and leads to the deterioration of beam quality, but also be a serious threat to the security and stability of the facility. A chopper system based on rectangular deflector is designed to solve these problems. This paper analyzes the principle of chopper system to eliminate tail particles. The beam dynamics simulation was carried out by particle tracking software Parmela, the particles whose phase is after 48° are cut off, and the correctness of the theoretical results was verified. Last but not least, the cavity is manufactured and the measurement of bead perturbation is investigated. The deflecting field distribution on the central axis of the cavity obtained by bead perturbation is compared with the CST simulation result.

articleTitle: Study of a 40.5kV/50kA Vacuum Interrupter Used for the Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vacuum circuit breakers are widely used in medium and low voltage power system. This article is based on the national key R&D project "Development of economical high-voltage AC current limiter for voltage levels of 500kV and above", which mainly studies a 40.5kV/50kA vacuum interrupter(VI). The special VI was used for the current limiter to interrupt the arc under the conditions of higher DC component and shorter arcing time. In order to obtain the structures of the contacts and the repulsion mechanism, lots of magnetic simulating calculations were carried out. A 2/3 coil-type contact structure was used in this paper. Then, a 40.5kV/50kA VI with the 2/3 coil-type contact structure was designed by electric field simulating calculations. A fast repulsion mechanism was used as the driving component to carry out the rated symmetric short-circuit current breaking test (T100s) and the rated asymmetric short-circuit current breaking test (T100a) under the parameters described in the paper. At present, the VI designed in this paper could successfully break the rated short circuit current of 50kA, and the DC component of T100a was 78%.

articleTitle: Robust Control Strategy of Speed Loop with Variable Inertia
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a robust control strategy based on model reference control is proposed to achieve the high-performance speed control when the moment of inertia is variable. This strategy consists of a model reference controller and a robust compensator. The model reference controller is proposed to achieve the ideal dynamic response and the robust compensator is proposed to compensate the effect of inertia mismatch. The two controllers are proportion-integral (PI) controller, which parameters are designed and discussed. The tunning parameters are reduced to two adjustable parameters, which are expected response angular frequency and maximum inertia ratio. Although the inertia is variable, the maximum ratio of inertia can be known. The effectiveness of this strategy is verified by simulation results and experiment results.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Analysis of Variable-stage Compression and Variable-stage Expansion Advanced Adiabatic Compressed Air Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this research, a new type of variable-stage compression and variable-stage expansion advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage system is proposed. The compressors and turbines enable to change the running stages by adding bypasses and valves. In order to study the performance of the system, three different operation modes, conventional mode, rated pressure ratio mode, and variable pressure ratio mode, are presented. Thermodynamic performance of different modes is compared and analyzed by means of numerical simulation. To further enhance the system performance, the influence of the operating pressure of the air storage tank and the number of compressor and turbine stages are studied. The research results show that the new system can effectively improve the energy storage density. When the stages of compressor and turbine is greater than 3, the charging and discharging efficiency of the variable pressure ratio mode is the highest. The research results provide an effective way to improve the performance of advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage system.

articleTitle: Transient Response Analysis of Short-Circuit Electromagnetic Force on the Rotor Teeth of a High-Speed Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A high-speed (HS) synchronous generator with the hidden pole was explored in this study. To obtain the mechanical properties on the rotor tooth of the HS generator under the dual action of centrifugal force and electromagnetic (EM) force, the transient response of the rotor was analyzed based on a process that could be summarized as follows. First, the mathematical models of the energy method, the LIVENS and Maxwell stress tensor methods were compared and a simple finite element model was analyzed. The results show that the LIVENS stress tensor method has more general applicability and is more suitable for solving the local EM force of ferromagnetic materials. Second, the EM force of the rotor teeth of the generator was calculated by the LIVENS stress tensor method. The results show that the EM torque of the generator is mainly distributed in the rotor tooth. Third, the transient response of the rotor under short-circuit was calculated by the FEA, the results show that the short-circuit EM force has a small effect on the structural stress of the rotor and can be almost ignored, which meet the design requirements of the HS generator.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Uniformity Parameters under DC and Impulse Excitations for MOV Banks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a correlation analysis between the uniformity parameters under DC-voltage and impulsecurrent excitations for MOV banks based on the z-score transform and the Pearson correlation coefficient. After a series of tests on 120 disks, the MOV banks parallel-connected by 18 disks in 3 groups are formed, and the following tests are carried in normal, abnormal and unbalance temperature states, respectively. The z-score normalized results imply a linear proportional relation between the parameters in low and high current ranges, for the single disk and the formed bank used in this paper. Furthermore, the Pearson correlation coefficient provides a related quantitative index to support the data relevance, to classify the abnormal states and to avoid the affect of unbalance temperature on the monitoring. The analysis results can be useful in the further study on the selecting and coordinating of the disks in the high-energy MOV banks.

articleTitle: Effect of Phase-Locked Loop on Transient Characteristics of Wind Turbine Generator under Abnormal Frequency Offset
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With increasing penetration of wind power generation, influence of transient Characteristics of wind turbine generator (WTG) on safety and stability of power grid is becoming more and more important. The doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) is connected to the power grid through the back-to-back inverter. The vector control method based on phase-locked synchronization is adopted. The phase-locked loop (PLL) drives the internal potential phase change to realize the synchronous operation with the power grid. PLL is core of back-to-back inverter, which connects DFIG with grid. Therefore, it has great influence on transient characteristics of DFIG. Dynamic model of PLL is built in this paper. Frequency and phase tracking performance of PLL under abnormal frequency deviation is studied by changing its parameters. And its effect on transient characteristics of DFIG is analyzed. Simulation models are built, the influence of frequency and phase tracking performance of PLL on transient characteristics of DFIG under abnormal frequency deviation is simulated.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Optimization of Square Wave Response Characteristics of Resistance Capacitance Voltage Divider
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The square wave response test is of great significance for the dynamic performance verification of voltage divider. In order to improve the measurement dynamic characteristics of the divider and further guide the development of the resistance capacitance divider and measuring equipment, based on the principle of adjusting the parameters of the divider, the parameters of the low-voltage arm are fine tuned, and the influence of other test factors is considered. The results show that the optimization study can effectively reduce the square wave response overshoot and the stability time of the resistance capacitance divider.

articleTitle: Contour Tracking of Direct Drive H-type Platform Based on Multi-axis Global Task Coordinate Frame
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low contour accuracy of direct drive H-type platform which consists of three permanent magnet linear synchronous motors (PMLSM) in trajectory tracking with large curvature, a contour control method is proposed to establish a rigid-flexible coupling model in multi-axis global task coordinate frame (MGTCF) combined with the sliding mode controller (SMC). Firstly, in order to clarify the rotation mode of the crossbeam and establish the complete dynamic constraint relationship between the servo axes, a three- degree-of-freedom rigid-flexible coupling dynamic model of direct drive H-type platform is built. Secondly, in order to regulate the non-orthogonality between the contouring error coordinates and the tracking path coordinates in the task coordinate frame, a multi-axis global task coordinate frame is presented. Then the sliding mode controller compensates the uncertain nonlinear disturbance effectively of the system. Finally, the simulation results show that the modeling method and contour controller advanced in this paper can fully improve the contour tracking performance of the platform.

articleTitle: Effects of Different Control Methods on the Buck-Buck Cascaded System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Control methods often play important roles in the converters to improve characteristics. This paper takes the buck-buck cascaded system as an example to study the influence of different control methods on the system’s performance especially for stability and dynamic response. Different from the stability evaluation method of the cascaded system discussed in the previous literature, this paper studies a more complex situation, when the front stage converter operates with the sub harmonic oscillation and connected with a buck converter. Besides, to evaluate the transient performance with different control methods, four transfer functions are proposed. Finally simulations verify the above analysis. It indicates that three basic control methods which are voltage control, peak current mode control and V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> control perform similarly in term of the stability, and as for the transient performance, when V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> control is adopted to the both converters of the studied system, the cascaded system has a better transient performance compared to the other two basic control methods.

articleTitle: Research on Discharge Characteristics of Porcelain Insulators Considering Air Humidity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the actual operating circuit, the surface discharge of the insulator will be affected by air humidity. In order to study the influence of air humidity on the surface discharge characteristics of insulators, this paper firstly obtains the reduced electron mobility by assuming the electron energy distribution function (EEDF), and then builds a two-dimensional ceramic based on the fluid-chemical reaction insulator discharge mixed model which includes 41 kinds of reactions andl9 kinds of particles. According to the above model, the air composition is combined with the air humidity, and the distribution characteristics of the surface electron density, potential and ion density of the insulator under different air humidity are given. Finally, the discharge parameters of the insulators under different air humidity are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Effects of Varying Ionic Mobility on Calculated DC Ionized Field with the Presence of Atmospheric Particles by Upstream-BEM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Ionic mobility describes motion characteristics of ions in the electric field, and is also one of vitally significant parameters utilized in the calculation and prediction of ionized field strength of high voltage direct current (HVDC) power transmission. Atmospheric particulate matters make the ionized field problem more complex. This paper investigated the effects of varying ionic mobility on DC ionized field with the presence of atmospheric particles. Ionized field distribution, ionic current density, and space charge density were calculated by upstream-boundary element method. Calculation results illustrated that under certain applied voltages and corona inception field strength of the HV conductors, ionic current density changed proportionally with the varying ionic mobility. Impacts of particles’ mass concentration on the distributions of ionized field and current density were also calculated. The results can be of suggestive value to the design and operation of HVDC projects.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of DC Microgrid Based on Residual Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fault characteristic analysis is the theoretical basis and important premise of protection system design. Most of the existing DC protection researches are aimed at high-voltage DC transmission and other applications, while low-voltage DC microgrids lack corresponding fault characteristics research and fault diagnosis solutions. Based on this, this article first takes the low-voltage DC microgrid as the research object, analyzes the process and characteristics of typical faults, and then proposes a novel fault diagnosis method based on the principle and function of the residual generator. By evaluating the residual error of each line and designing the threshold, when multiple converters in the DC microgrid are connected in parallel, the fault detection and location of the decoupling of each line can be realized. Finally, taking the line to line fault as an example, the test was carried out using MATLAB/Simulink to verify the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Master-slave Control Based Microgrid via Vector Fitting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important supplement to the traditional power grid, microgrid plays an important role in improving the reliability and quality of local power grid. However, the high permeability of new energy generation and power electronic equipment significantly changed the dynamic characteristics of the microgrid, which brings a great threat to the safe operation of power system. Therefore, several stability analysis methods have been proposed. However, these researches mainly focused on droop-controlled microgrids, and there is still a lack of in-depth research on master-slave controlled microgrid. Furthermore, these methods need to obtain the detailed parameters of each distributed energy resource(DER), it is difficult to carry out in practical engineering application. To address the abovementioned problems, this work analyzed the stability of master-slave based microgrid without detailed DER parameter. To this end, the frequency-dependent impedance of DER was measured and a frequency-domain fitting technique known as vector fitting was adopted. The robustness and efficiency of the proposed approach was validated under both grid-connected and isolated modes with time-domain simulation and state-space model.

articleTitle: Experimental study on synergistic coupling between pulsating heat pipe to enhance heat transfer characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The single pulsating heat pipe and the main pulsating heat pipe are structurally coordinated with each other , So as to form a coupled pulsating heat pipe heat exchanger, using a constant temperature water bath as heat resource and the air as cooling resource.High purity distilled water and anhydrous ethanol were used as working fluids of main pulsating heat pipe and cooperating pulsating heat pipe respectively. By changing the constant temperature water bath temperature, the wall temperature characteristics and heat transfer performance of the pulsating heat pipe were studied experimentally, and compared with the heat transfer characteristics of the pulsating heat pipe without working medium under the same conditions. The results show that the pulsating heat pipe with ethanol as working fluid can operate stably under the action of multi heat source and multi cold source, which is established by cooperating with the main pulsating heat pipe structure, and further enhances the heat transfer performance of the main pulsating heat pipe. At the same time, the mechanism of heat transfer enhancement and mutual excitation between coupled pulsating heat pipes is proposed and qualitatively analyzed under the effect of external field of mutual variable load, so as to maximize the heat transfer performance of coupled pulsating heat pipe heat exchanger. In order to provide reference experience, methods and means for strengthening the phase change heat transfer process in the tube by using pulsating heat pipe as load external field.

articleTitle: Multiband PD location method based on the Granndo propagation model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is a great challenge to locate the partial discharge in power cables induced by different types of insulation defects. To overcome the challenge, a new method based on the Granndo model is developed in this paper. The incident and reflected waveforms are obtained through the cable partial discharge calibration experiment, and then the attenuation constant and dispersion constant of Granndo model are determined. The frequency spectrum of reflected wave and the wave velocity under corresponding frequency are determined through the simulation of cable propagation characteristics. Finally, the frequency band of frequency component concentration is selected for positioning calculation, which reduces the positioning error caused by waveform distortion and velocity uncertainty. Meanwhile, the calculation speed is faster than others.

articleTitle: Common Mode Decoupling Control Strategy for A Three-phase Transformerless AC-DC Converter with Independently Controlled Neutral Module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the popularity of various types of loads based on DC power supply, low-voltage AC and DC hybrid distribution networks have become an efficient solution for future distribution systems. The bidirectional interface converter is a key device. When the AC and DC sides of the distribution network are grounded, the AC and DC coupling of the converter will cause common mode voltage and leakage current, endanger personal safety, and reduce power quality. This paper proposes a new three-phase non-isolated AC-DC converter common ground topology, which can eliminate the common-mode voltage of traditional converters due to AC-DC coupling. However, common ground will cause neutral current, and this paper also proposes a control strategy for neutral current suppression. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by detailed simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Flux Weakening Control of Single Q-axis Current Regulator Scheme for Long Stator Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The long stator permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (LS-PMLSM) used for the maglev vehicle needs to adopt flux weakening (FW) control to increase its speed due to the limitation of the traction inverter output voltage. In this paper, it is proved that the speed of LS-PMLSM with the feeder cable can be increased by FW control, and an FW control scheme based on the single q-axis current regulator (SQCR) is proposed. Compared with the conventional FW control, the proposed SQCR-FW control scheme can eliminate the coupling between the two current regulators. The hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) experiment shows that LS-PMLSM can achieve the highest target speed and complete the full speed operation. It can reduce current and traction fluctuation and the actual speed of the motor can follow the reference speed curve better when compared with the double current regulator (DCR) method.
