Author Keywords: Long stator permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (LS-PMLSM)

articleTitle: Performance Improvement by Pattern Optimization of PCB Winding in Coreless Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Coreless Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Motor (AFPM) is expanding its application more widely for its multiple advantages, in which Printed Circuit Board (PCB) winding is applied in coreless stator for better process control and flexible modulation design. There are variable layout patterns to design a PCB coil. To achieve better performance, non-overlap concentrated coil is studied in this article. And to minimum MMF unbalance, torque harmonics and rotor pull force, outer bridge connection among coils in one phase is mainly recommended. However, under different restrict with compromise among performance, process and structure, inner bridge can also be applied with optimized pattern. Simulation and calculation result is confirmed by actual test with prototype.

articleTitle: Operation Mode Recognition of Surface Microdischarge Based on Digital Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Surface microdischarge (SMD) has various application potential in biomedicine, agriculture and industry. An important issue for practical use is to develop an online monitoring method for operation mode recognition of SMD. In this paper, we proposed a operation mode recognition method for SMD based on digital image processing technique. The visible light digital images of SMD were shot and the RGB chromaticity index of the discharge images were extracted. It was found that the sum of all pixel values in the SMD discharge gray scale image and in the R, G, and B monochromatic images increased with the applied voltage monotonically, which can reflect the change of the discharge intensity. The difference between the proportions of the B component and the G component ( Δ (B-G)%) showed a trend of first increasing and then decreasing as the applied voltage increased. The Δ (B-G)% reached the maximum value of 46.93% at V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-p</inf> of 5kV and was corresponding to the mode transition point measured by Fourier transform infrared spectrometer (FTIR). Finally, a SMD operation mode recognition method, based on the Δ (B-G)% and the applied voltage was proposed.

articleTitle: Simulation for the Partial Discharge of Wedge-Shaped Oil-paper Insulated under DC Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The converter transformer is a kernel equipment in ultra-high voltage direct current(UHVDC), and some partial discharge(PD) occurs under wedge-shaped electrode of the converter transformer. For researching PD mechanism of oilpaper insulation at wedged electrode, a model based on the fluid dynamics theory and the bipolar charge transport theory was built. Microscopic images including PD and charge distribution obtained by this simulation were analyzed. Besides, the influence of parameters such as voltage amplitude and charge mobility on PD characteristics were discussed. Through the simulation, we can get the conclusion that the partial discharge process under DC stress at the wedged electrode can be broadly classified into the following parts: ionization and polarization in oil, the surface discharge at the oil-paper interface, the deep discharge in pressboard, and surface flashover. During the discharge process, the voltage plays a facilitating role in the discharge. And the effect of charge mobility especially of pressboard on discharge is twofold, the flashover voltage reaches the maximum when the electron and hole mobility is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, when the longitudinal trend of discharge is the strongest. The longitudinal trend inhibits the development of transverse discharge and increases the flashover voltage. The results of this paper have theoretical value for studying the partial discharge mechanism of converter transformer.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of PEV Fast Charging Stations Considering Transportation-Power Network Couplings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fast charging stations of plug-in electric vehicle (PEV) will play an important role to support future low-carbon transportation network, which could also bring challenges to future power distribution network. To this end, this paper proposes a coordinated planning approach to optimize the location and capacity of PEV fast charging stations considering transportation-power distribution network couplings. The total profits of PEV fast charging stations are maximized through the optimization of the locations as well as the number of chargers and waiting spaces. The effectiveness of the proposed solution has been further confirmed through a series of simulation results.

articleTitle: Voltage/Reactive Power Coordination Control Between Energy Storage Power Station and Clean Energy Plant Connected toAC/DC Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper studies voltage/reactive power coordination control between energy storage system and clean energy plant connected to AC/DC hybrid system. As energy storage power stations are widely integrated to grid, they pose larger influence on clean energy. It occurs that voltage/reactive power characteristic of energy storage plant and clean energy plant becomes complicated to control and analyze. For the sake of studying the energy storage system and clean energy plant’s voltage/reactive power characteristics, a model of energy storage and clean energy plant connected to AC/DC hybrid system is proposed, with a proper coordination control strategy of PCC voltage/reactive power. Then, the coordination control strategy is conducted under different conditions in time domain simulation to analyze voltage/reactive power dynamics of system. Lastly, the experiment on hardware-in-the-loop(HIL) system is finished to validate proposed voltage/reactive power coordination control above.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Power Distribution Architecture for Edge Interoperability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart power distribution network, the overall distribution network presents a distributed feature. The architecture of the traditional centralized distribution network has been unable to meet the massive distribution data access and real-time computing needs generated by these scenarios. In this paper, an intelligent distribution architecture for edge interoperability is designed. The distribution network is decomposed into a network composed of a backbone network and multiple edges. The architecture includes four parts: physical architecture, information architecture, edge object model, and edge intelligent mode. The proposed architecture replaces the original centralized distribution network architecture by edge division, which reduces the pressure of centralized storage, calculation, and transmission. Edge interoperability can be realized by the edge object model and information architecture corresponding to the physical architecture.

articleTitle: A Capacitive Energy Transfer DC/DC Converter for HVDC Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage large-power DC/DC converter will be one of the pivotal equipment in the future direct-current power grid, and has become the hot topic of research in recent years. In this paper, a novel capacitive energy transfer (CET) DC/DC converter topology which applies to high voltage direct current (HVDC) is proposed. This topology is based on diodes in series, series-connected thyristors, and cascaded full-bridge submodules. The proposed converter has several merits such as simplicity, high efficiency, and low cost. Moreover, the bidirectional power transmission can be achieved by the coordinated control of fast mechanical disconnectors. The circuit structure, operation principle, parameter design, and control schemes of the topology are analyzed and proved by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Catenary Power Supply System of Electric Heavy Truck
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the power supply capacity of electric heavy trucks, reduce battery capacity and costs, the catenary power supply system of electric truck was proposed. The load parameters were calculated; the intermediate single-point power supply system was designed and simulated; the influence of power supply mode, contact line diameter and rectifier substation voltage on power supply capacity were compared and analyzed. The results showed that the power supply capacity and line loss of the intermediate single-point power supply system were better than the single-ended power supply system; increasing the wire diameter or increasing the voltage of the rectifier substation could effectively reduce the line loss, improve the system efficiency and the power supply capacity; when the pantograph voltage was equal to the battery voltage, the output power of rectifier substation would be limited and then the battery needed to provide electrical energy. The research was of great significance to the application and promotion of electric heavy truck.

articleTitle: FCM based Demand Response Baseline Load Estimation Using Smart Meter Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Customer baseline load estimation is the basis of Demand Response(DR) for it decides the DR performance evaluation and financial settlement of customer participation. The accurate estimation of baseline load is hard because of complexity and uncertainty of customer behavior. Besides, baseline load is an ideal load which cannot be metered in reality. This paper proposed a data driven Fuzzy C Means(FCM) based baseline load estimation method. The fuzzy characteristics of customer electricity consumption behavior is adequately considered and the complex factors of customer behavior are implicitly considered. The proposed method has high accuracy compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Transients Simulation and Analysis of the DFIG-based Wind Power Generation System Using Back-to-back Three-level NPC Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power generation and multilevel converter are two of the most rapidly developing and promising technologies in recent years. This paper concentrates on the multi-scale transients modeling methods of the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind power generation system using back-to-back three-level neutral point clamped (NPC) converter. The averaged model and switching function model of the NPC converter are proposed to deal with the large-scale simulation of the wind power system. In addition, the overall control strategies is proposed to drive these models. The simulation results show the good accuracy and efficiency of the proposed average model and switching function model compared with the detailed model, and verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies.

articleTitle: Research On Parallel Connection Of Energy Storage Inverters Based On CAN Bus With Democratic Master-Slave Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In distributed energy storage systems, inverters are indispensable. Parallel connection is one of the effective ways to expand the capacity of the inverter. However, there are many problems such as current unevenness in the inverter cascade system, especially when the inverter module is in different working conditions, such as module switching, inverter load/reduction or even the module exits operation due to failure, the system will become unstable. When the transformer is added or removed, even if the module fails and exits, the system will become unstable. In this paper, the experimental platform of two inverters running in parallel is taken as the research object. The democratic master-slave control mode based on CAN bus strategy is proposed, and the superiority of the democratic master-slave control mode is clarified from the perspective of system stability. In the experiment, the output voltage quality is increased by using fewer interconnection lines, ensuring high reliability operation of the system.

articleTitle: Design of the Filament Power Supply for the High-voltage Electron Accelerator with Insulated Core Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high-voltage electron accelerator with insulated core transformer (ICT) has competitive advantages in the irradiation processing industry due to its high efficiency and reliability. The filament power supply (F-PS) is a key component in the accelerator, which provides the filament heating power and make the filament emit an electron beam. To control the beam current of the accelerator more flexibly, instead of using a traditional regulating transformer, it is a better solution for such applications to adopt power electronic converters as the F-PS. This paper proposes an optimized power electronics scheme for the F-PS based on the LLC resonant converter with integrated magnetics. A novel integrated structure that applies magnetic integration technology is used so that the number and size of the magnetic components are reduced. Modelling air-gap magnetic field accurately is also demonstrated to guide design for integrated magnetics, ensuring the stable operation of the converter. The designs are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Seamless Handover Technology of Flexible Interconnected Distribution Network Based on DC Distribution Center
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the power supply reliability of the closed loop operation of the distribution network, the flexible interconnected distribution network should have the ability of grid connection operation and island operation mode stable switching. Based on DC distribution center, the seamless switching technology of flexible interconnection distribution network is studied in this paper. Firstly, the topological structure of DC distribution center and the mechanism of power mutual support between multiple AC feeders are analyzed. Secondly, the technology of virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control is applied in two control strategies of PQ/VSG and E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dc</inf>Q/VSG for the seamless switching of flexible interconnected distribution network. Finally, an AC-DC flexible interconnection distribution system with a DDC consisted of four-terminal the hybrid submodule multi-level converter(H-MMC) was constructed for simulation verification. The results show that the control strategy can realize the seamless switching of the grid-on/grid-off operation mode of the flexible interconnected distribution network.

articleTitle: Route Optimization Battery Equalization for Series Connected Liquid Metal Battery Strings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the inconsistency problem of series connected liquid metal battery (LMB) strings, a route optimization equalization scheme is proposed in this paper. In terms of balancing topology, a modular double-layer cell-to-cell balancing topology based on inductor and flyback multi-winding transformer is designed, which can transfer energy between any two batteries within or among modules. For control strategy, an equalization strategy based on graph theory and ant colony optimization (ACO) is proposed, which has been compared with the traditional maximum/minimum equalization control strategy. The simulation results show that compared with traditional equalization strategy, the balancing speed of the route optimization control strategy is improved by 88.62%, and the balancing efficiency is increased by 19.43%. Therefore, the proposed strategy can not only effectively improve the consistency of the battery strings, but also optimize the balancing effect.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Compensation Methods to Improve Stability for DC Microgrid with Constant Power Loads
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the system instability issue caused by a large number of constant power loads in DC microgrid, two compensation methods, active damping compensation and virtual negative inductor compensation, are introduced to improve the stability of DC microgrid in this paper. The small-signal mathematical model of the DC microgrid can be established by designing the Boost converter with voltage and current double closed-loop and the DC-DC converter, which can be regarded as a constant power load. Based on the principle of system dominant pole distribution, the Lyapunov eigenvalue method is used to estimate the power boundary of the DC microgrid. To improve the system stability, active damping compensation method is adopted directly in the control loop of source, and in contrast, a virtual negative inductor method is adopted on the source converter by droop control method, the principle and realization of two compensation methods are right after studied in detail. The power boundary values obtained before and after different compensation methods are compared. Finally, the effectiveness of the active damping compensation and virtual negative inductor compensation methods to improve the stability of DC microgrid is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Design Homopolar Inductor Alternator for Capacitor Charging Power Supply Based on Voltage-Behind-Reactance Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Homopolar inductor alternator (HIA) has obvious advantages to achieve fast charging and repetition frequency output, and it has been used in the capacitor charging power supply (CCPS) system. However, for the capacitor charging power supply with homopolar inductor alternator (HIA-CCPS), the influence on parameters of alternators and systems on charging has not been studied quantitatively. Also, there is still no proper method on how to combine these parameters with the alternator design for the existing HIA design methods. The application of voltage-behind-reactance (VBR) model in HIA-CCPS system greatly simplifies the analysis of parameters on the capacitor charging system. In this paper, based on the VBR-model, the influence of various parameters in the charging process on the performance of the charging system will be quantitatively studied, and according to the research results, the alternator design process based on the above analysis will be presented, at the same time, a prototype of HIA-CCPS system is designed to verify the above analysis.

articleTitle: Fast Calculation of Saddle-Node Bifurcation Point in Islanded Microgrid Based on Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes two fast calculation algorithms for the determination of the saddle-node bifurcation point of islanded microgrids, which use bisection search and parabolic approximation respectively. The Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm is applied to obtain the least-squares solution in the infeasible region of power flow equations. The bisection search algorithm uses the least-squares solution to determine whether the current trial step reaches the power flow infeasible region, and finally approaches the saddle-node bifurcation point. The parabolic approximation algorithm performs a parabolic approximation to ‘the least-squares value’ – ‘load margin’ curve in the infeasible region, and the zero point of the curve is corresponding to the required saddle-node bifurcation point. The case analysis shows that the two algorithms proposed in this paper have the advantages of high accuracy, high computational efficiency, and strong robustness.

articleTitle: A New Rotor Position Observer of Brushless Doubly-Fed Induction Generators Based on Control-Winding High-Frequency Signal Injection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the main target is to propose a novel detection methodology for sensorless position observer with the injection approach of high-frequency signal (HFS) for voltage regulation of the brushless doubly-fed induction generators (BDFIGs). The new suggested observer relies on the injection of HFS into the control winding (CW) side, (CW-HFS), while the resulted induced signal detected from the power winding (PW) side can be processed for observing the position signal of generator. The proposed new sensorless control method neither need any saliencies in the rotor side nor require any process for computing the flux, which can assure the superiority of the new algorithm. Comprehensive analysis is realized with a BDFIG of wound-rotor type. The effective observation of the novel algorithm for detecting the mechanical position of BDFIGs has been confirmed through the obtained results with a better dynamic performance under various states of operation.

articleTitle: A Distributed Robust Optimization Method with MC Dropout and Wasserstein Ambiguity Set Applied in Day-head Dispatch of Microgird
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Day-ahead load forecasting is the key part in day-ahead scheduling of power system. Considering the uncertainty of load forecasting can improve the robustness of the system and reduce the risk cost. This paper proposes a distributed robust optimization (DRO) method for units dispatch with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout and Wasserstein ambiguity set. The model uncertainty is obtained by introduce MC dropout into deep learning model. The ambiguity set is obtained by taking the prediction results as the prior data of Wasserstein ambiguity set method. Finally, the optimal dispatch problem is solved by the Robust Stochastic Optimization Made Easy (RSOME) toolbox in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Experimental study of XLPE power cable insulation detection based on the electrical capacitance tomography sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The XLPE cables are a vital part of power transportation. Defects in the insulation of the cable body and its accessories may lead to economic losses or safety hazards, and the current installation quality of cable terminal joints lacks effective detection methods. Since the permittivity of the cable insulation will change accordingly when there is a defect in the cable insulation, Electrical capacitance tomography (ECT) is a technique that can display the spatial distribution of permittivity of different media. In this work ECT is applied to the detection of insulation defects in XLPE cables. An eight-electrode array sensor is manufactured, and the cable capacitance is detected with an impedance meter. The cable sample sheath layer was cut into a defect area with a length of 20 mm, a width of 10 mm, and a thickness of 1 mm to simulate an air gap defect. The capacitance value of the intact cable and the defective cable is measured by the sensor and impedance analyzer, and the image of the internal structure of the cable is established using the linear back-projection algorithm. Experimental results show that ECT algorithm can detect the air gap defect in the XLPE cable insulation, but the imaging accuracy still needs to be improved.

articleTitle: Modeling for Analyzing Practical Oscillation Event of AC/DC Distribution Networks with Power Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In an AC/DC distribution network test of an integrated energy service center in Jiangsu Province, it is found that there is an oscillation phenomenon on the DC side with unclear mechanisms. In order to analyze the practical oscillation phenomenon, this paper proposes detailed models of the AC/DC distribution network, which considers a power electronic transformer (PET), two three-phase voltage-source converters (VSCs), and a buck converter. First, the basic structure and simplified model of the AC/DC distribution network are introduced according to the practical power grid. Then, the topological structure and control method of each equipment is presented in detail, so as to establish the mathematical model of each equipment and the whole AC/DC distribution system. Finally, a simulation model is built on the MATLAB platform to reproduce the oscillation event and further qualitatively analyze the factors affecting the oscillation. These qualitative analysis results provide reasonable suggestions for system operators to ensure the safe and stable operation of AC/DC distribution networks. Moreover, the practical oscillation occurred at AC/DC distribution networks is little reported previously, and thus the practical recording data and detailed models of the AC/DC distribution networks provided in this paper are valuable for academic researchers to in-depth study the oscillation mechanism.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of a Pyro-breaker Utilized in Superconducting Fusion Facility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pyro-breaker is a fast-responding and high-reliable explosive-driven circuit breaker, which has been applied in several quench protection systems, such as ITER and Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST). The choice of the detonator and the dosage of the explosive is a significant part of the development of a new pyro-breaker. The presented pyro-breaker has two units, both driven by explosives, but the specific driving structures are different from each other. The numerical modeling of these two units includes the coupling of multiple materials, and the model is complex due to the cooperative action of each other. The numerical models of the explosion on the conductors are built respectively for the two units, and the simulation is carried out in ANSYS / LS-DYNA. The conductor structure, explosive dosage, and driving mechanism are checked and calculated. Based on the results of numerical simulation, several explosion tests were conducted to verify the accuracy of the model. The breaking processes of the conductors under different dosages and shaped explosives were analyzed. The mechanical structure of the conductor was optimized and the forming problem after the explosion was solved. The model will be the theoretical basis for the designing of the pyro-breaker in the quench protection system of China Fusion Engineering Experimental Reactor (CFETR).

articleTitle: Extension of Space Vector Signal Injection MTPA Control for IPMSM Into Deep Flux-Weakening Region
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To guarantee the minimum copper loss of interior permanent magnet synchronous motors in a wide operating range, space vector signal injection (SVSI) control combining with flux-weakening control scheme is presented in this paper. The SVSI control can track the maximum torque per ampere points, but due to voltage saturation, it is invalid in the deep flux-weakening region. A new strategy is proposed to select the optimal current commend to minimize copper loss in wide speed range. The presented strategy is based on the difference between a proper limit value and the amplitude of voltage vector. The difference is utilized to adjust the angle of current vector when voltage saturation by SVSI control is detected. The proposed strategy is parameter independent. The simulation results demonstrate the feasibility of the presented method.

articleTitle: A Strategy for Eliminating Harmonics in Three-phae System with Harmonic Generators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A strategy for eliminating harmonics from the output of three-phase inverters is proposed with an idea of a special harmonic generator, which is characteristic in structure with a multi-phase round-shaped transformer for synthesizing the desired harmonics electromagnetically. To control the harmonics in magnitude and ingredient that mainly depended on auxiliary inverters, space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is improved with special consideration of the round-shaped transformer. Power consumption of the harmonic generator is much less than that of the total system as it is mainly used for producing harmonics rather than the transfer of electrical power.

articleTitle: Research on lightning overvoltage in Ecuador 230kV GIS substation based on EMTP-RV
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The simulation model of a new 230 kV GIS substation in Ecuador was established by EMTP-RV. The lightning overvoltage levels of the main equipment in the substation under different modes of thunder wave invasion, different tower and substation operation are calculated, and the insulation coordination of each equipment is checked. The results show that the closer the lightning strike location is to the substation, the higher the lightning overvoltage is. Generally, the lightning overvoltage is the highest in the operation of a single transformer, double busbar, and double-circuit transmission line. Under different lightning striking points and operation modes, the lightning overvoltage on the main equipment does not exceed its lightning withstand voltage level, and has a certain insulation margin, which meets the requirements of safe operation.

articleTitle: Influence of Magnetic Hall Sensors on Slotless Permanent Magnet BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates influences of Hall sensor magnetism on the torque performance of a slotless permanent magnet (PM) brushless dc (BLDC) motor through two-dimensional finite-element method (2-D FEM). The model and specification of the slotless PM BLDC motor equipped with the Hall sensor are illustrated. Then, the influences of magnetic Hall sensors on the magnetic field distribution, cogging torque and electromagnetic load torque performance of the slotless PM BLDC motor are presented. The results show that the magnetism of Hall sensor in the stator have great influence on the torque performance. Two prototypes of slotless BLDC motor with magnetic Hall sensors and weak-magnetic Hall sensors are manufactured and tested to validate the theoretical and FEM results.

articleTitle: Performance of Neighborhood-Watch-Based Resilient Distributed Energy Management Algorithm Under Different Types of Cyberattacks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the intelligence and interconnection of power systems, distributed generation (DGs) and distributed control algorithm have been developed rapidly. Virtual power plant (VPP), formed by the aggregation of multiple distributed generation agents, can perform distributed economic dispatch (EP) based on the consensus algorithm. In order to protect the distributed economic dispatch process from communication failure or cyberattack, a resilient distributed energy management algorithm called neighborhood watch mechanism has been proposed. However, the attacker who wants to endanger the stability of the system or obtain the economic benefits, carefully designed stealthy attacks or collusion attacks may destroy the current defense strategy. This paper analyzes the performance of the resilient distributed energy management algorithm of neighborhood watch mechanism under different types of cyberattacks, and tests the specific performance through numerical examples.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Force Harmonics Compensation Control Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Multiple Proportional Resonance Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the driving comfort of range extender, a 13kW, 6-pole, 36-slot permanent magnet synchronous motor is used as a prototype model to analyze the characteristics of electromagnetic force harmonics and to summarize the regularity of harmonics frequency and orders. Using modal analysis, the nature frequency of the prototype which may causes vibration is obtained. A multiple proportional resonance (PR) controller is proposed, which can compensate the harmonics at a specific frequency, thereby reducing the radial electromagnetic force harmonics generated by the stator armature current, and effectively suppressing the electromagnetic vibration at the natural frequency of the motor.

articleTitle: A novel identification and location method for transient power quality disturbance sources
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of power electronics and high penetration of new energy generation have brought great economic and social benefits. Meanwhile, new power quality phenomena and new issues have come into existence, such as three-phase unbalance, harmonic and low-frequency resonance, etc. In order to solve power quality problems fundamentally. The paper proposes a novel identifying and locating method utilizing transient power quality data. Based on the operational big data of power system, spatio-temporal data model of power quality is established. Then, based on big data, by adopting random forest algorithm, the data is analyzed to identify and locate transient power quality problem disturbance sources. This paper simulates in IEEE 30 bus system, and the results indicate the accuracy in identifying and locating short circuit disturbance sources.

articleTitle: A High-frequency High-power Transformer Based on Split Planar Coils for High-isolation Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the power electronic transformer (PET), the high-isolation high-frequency high-power transformer is the key equipment. In this paper, a high-frequency high-power transformer based on split planar coils for PETs is presented. The structure and characteristics of the proposed transformer are presented in detail. Magnetic and electric simulation model is built in ANSYS/MAXWELL 3D to investigate the magnetic core flux density distribution and the electric field intensity distribution. A 37kW transformer prototype is designed and an experimental setup is built in order to evaluate the performance of the transformer prototype. The transformer prototype is tested at 37.7kW full power and a peak efficiency of 98.567% is achieved including the loss of the inverter and rectifier.

articleTitle: Dynamic Inspection Method of Motor Winding Defects Based on Scanning Inductive Thermography and Image Registration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this manuscript, a new dynamic inspection method using the scanning inductive thermography (SIT) and an advanced image registration algorithm is proposed. This detection scheme is applied for multiply motor winding defects detection. An SIT-based experiment system is conducted to simulate the industrial assembly line and realizes the constant acquisition of thermal images. However, the raw images are time-space misalignment which is unusable for further processing. Thus, we developed an image registration algorithm to calibrate and align the data. The classical contrast enhancement methods, including independent component analysis (ICA) and non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), are employed to process the calibrated data. The experimental results indicate that the dynamic detection method could provide a rapid and reliable scheme for the manufacturing and operation of motors.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Circuit of HVDC Control and Protection System and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the characteristics that network and optical fiber are widely used in the secondary system of HVDC control and protection system, referring to the virtual circuit of intelligent substation, a layered architecture for virtual circuit of HVDC control and protection system is proposed. The virtual circuit model is described by a series of description files: physical topology network description file, logical topology network description file, mapping relationship description file and LogicalLink description file. Based on virtual circuit, the visualization, online monitoring and other practical functions of secondary system can be realized, which can effectively support the on-site operation and maintenance personnel to quickly locate and troubleshoot the faults, and can also improve the reliability of the HVDC transmission system.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PI Control Strategy of Permanent Magnet Assisted External Rotor Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Torque Sharing Function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new type of permanent magnet assisted external rotor switched reluctance motor (PMa-ERSRM) is proposed, which has the advantages of mixed excitation, segmented stator and external rotor. A new type of motor structure, mathematical model and Matlab modeling are introduced. According to the characteristics of the motor, the torque sharing function (TSF) is applied to the motor control, and the fuzzy PID control is introduced into the speed loop to improve the adaptability and robustness of the nonlinear system. Compared with the traditional control mode, the control strategy can significantly reduce torque ripple.

articleTitle: Radio Interference Performances of Large Section AC Conductors at High Altitude Location
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At high altitude location, the corona discharge around conductor surface of AC power lines are severe, and the generated radio interference levels are serious. It has become an important factor in restricting the conductor selection of AC power lines. Large section conductor is a good choice to meet the limit of RI threshold for ultra-high-voltage (UHV) power lines. However, there are few RI data of large section bundled conductor at high altitude, which cannot provide reference for the selection of suitable conductors for power utility companies. In order to investigate the RI characteristics of bundled conductors with large cross section at high altitude, an UHV corona cage (8m × 8m × 35m, altitude: 2261m) was employed and three bundled conductors (8 × LGJ 720, 8 × LGJ 900 and 10 × LGJ 720) were tested. The RI performances of three types of bundled conductors were measured in fair weather and different rainy conditions (1.5~18 mm/h). Then the influence of conductor electric field and rain rate on RI characteristics was analyzed. The results concluded in this paper can provide important reference data for high-altitude power lines construction.

articleTitle: Capacity Configuration Approach of Park-Level Integrated Energy System Considering Multi-Area Power Exchange
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An equipment capacity configuration method for park-level integrated energy system (PIES) is given in this paper. The power exchange among subsystems is considered in this method when multiple subsystems are operating jointly. Firstly, the structure and model of multi-area PIES is established, respectively. Then, the capacity configuration optimization model of multi-area PIES is established, which can minimize the cost of the system. Finally, the given method’s validity is shown by a case study and shows in this paper.

articleTitle: Charging characteristic of free metallic particles in transformer oil when the electrodes covered with insulation paper
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The charging characteristics of free metallic particles in transformer oil will change when the electrode is covered with solid insulation dielectrics. In this paper, the motion behavior of the particles was recorded by the motion observation platform. The result showed that particles would temporarily settle on the electrode after touching the paper-covered surface, which would not occur after contacting the bare electrode. As applied voltages increased, the settling time decreased. Subsequently, a calculation method of the charge quantity was proposed based on the kinetic equilibrium equation and the charge quantity of metallic particles was solved. It was shown that the charge quantity after contacting the paper-covered electrode was about half of that for the bare electrode, which increased linearly with the rise of the applied voltage. Finally, it was qualitatively inferred that the particles were mainly charged through the conduction of insulation paper.

articleTitle: Conductivity of Bulk Zinc Oxide Varistors under Dc and Pulsed Bias
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Zinc oxide (ZnO) varistors is widely used in over voltage protection of various circuits for its advantages of excellent nonlinear, fast response time and low power consumption. Commercial ZnO varistors was selected and its dc and pulse conductivity was tested. Based on ZnO grain boundary barrier model, the dc conductivity was analyzed in the Breakdown and Pre-breakdown regions. At the pulsed bias, the capacitive current and conduction current of ZnO varistors was obtained. The growth ratio of conduction current is greater than that of the capacitive current. The tunneling electric field coefficient of ZnO grain boundary barrier, the permittivity of boundary and the proportion of boundary thickness were calculated.

articleTitle: Robust Current Predicted Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Based on Novel Sliding Model Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) speed control system, having a rapidly and steady current control internal loop is the sticking point to guaranteeing that the motor has good output torque performance. The deadbeat predictive current control (DPCC) strategy has rapidly current response, but it depends heavily on the precise mathematical model of the machine. When the motor parameter in the current loop controller has a mismatch with real system, the steady error of the output current of motor will appear, and even lead to system oscillations. Therefore, a robust predicted current control of PMSM based on novel sliding model observer is proposed in this article. First, the performance of the traditional DPCC when the machine mathematical model mismatch is analyzed, and then a sliding mode observer based on an exponential-based bi-power reaching law is proposed, which can predict stator current and estimate the current transient at same time. Compared with the traditional DPCC, the scheme of this paper can remove stator current static error caused by parameter mismatch. The validity and effectiveness of method are proved by experiment.

articleTitle: Comparison of Unipolar and Bipolar HVDC Transmission Modes: Experimental and Simulation Research
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper compares and evaluates unipolar and bipolar conductor in HVDC transmission mode. In the experiment, the distance between the bipolar conductors is 330mm, and the corona starting voltage is 50kV, while the unipolar corona voltage is 70kV. By comparing the change of ion current density after corona onset, it can be seen that the increasing rate of unipolar ion current is faster, which is 5.5 times of bipolar ion current. The results show that bipolar conductors can suppress ion current better than unipolar transmission, and the suppression around the positive conductor is more obvious. Further study on the synthetic field strength of unipolar and bipolar conductors before corona onset shows that the maximum electric field strength under unipolar conductors is 36.38 kV/m, while the maximum electric field strength of bipolar conductors is 25.93 kV/m, and the field strength around bipolar conductors is generally smaller than that of unipolar conductors.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Power Flow Calculation of Power System with HVDC and Photovoltaic Power Source
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The grid-connected operation of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) and PV (Photovoltaic Power Source) bring more stochastic factors to the power system, which makes the power flow more uncertain. Thus, the probabilistic power flow calculation for power system, which includes HVDC and PV, is proposed. Firstly, the probabilistic power flow model of the whole power system is established. In the established model, the probabilistic characteristics of loads and PVs are considered. The correlations between PVs and loads are taken into account. After that, the stochastic response surface method, which can deal with the correlations of random variables, is used to solve the model. Finally, the numerical characteristics of power flow responses are achieved. Taking the IEEE 14-bus system with HVDC and PV as the test system, the results of the simulation verify that the method provided by this paper is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulation of Lithium Dendrite Growth in Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium plating is the key safety and capacity fade issue in lithium-ion battery. Here, we report a method using kinetic Monte Carlo simulation to simulate the dendrite growth process during lithium plating under over-charging, fast charging and low-temperature charging conditions. The morphology of lithium dendrite is tree-like, showing obvious tip attraction. The lithium plating number, average dendrite length, dendrite distribution coefficient, dendrite height and dendrite density are proposed to describe the lithium dendrite quantitatively. Finally, it is proved that pulse charging can effectively inhibit the lithium plating and dendrite growth.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Source-Storage-Load in Wind Power Heating System Considering Integrated Demand Response of Power and Thermal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of wind curtailment caused by the limited flexibility capacity of thermal power units, an optimal dispatching strategy of combined wind power-regenerative electric heating (REH) system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the integrated demand response (IDR) under price-based response scheme is analyzed to analyze the schedulable value of power and heat DR resources, including the power demand response (PDR) model and the thermal load demand response (TDR) model. On this basis, a joint optimal dispatch model of the REH system with IDR and the heat storage electrical boils is formulated, which takes minimizing the total thermal generation cost as the objective function. Case study on a wind power heating system in China is conducted. Case study results show that the proposed optimal operation strategy of the combined wind-thermal heating system considering IDR is more effective in promoting wind power utilization and reducing the total operation cost.

articleTitle: Unified traveling wave ranging scheme for asymmetrical parameter double-circuit and four-circuit lines on the same tower
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional traveling wave ranging research is mainly focused on single-circuit line, symmetrical parameters on the same tower and double-circuit transmission line. In order to realize the traveling wave distance measurement of asymmetrical parameter double-circuit and four-circuit transmission lines on the same tower, this paper starts with phase mode conversion, by constructing a new fault traveling wave selection criterion and improved traveling wave that is not affected by wave speed and sag. The unified traveling wave distance measurement scheme for asymmetrical double-circuit and four-circuit transmission lines on the same tower with actual project is proposed. The ranging scheme can select the only current modulus traveling wave under different fault types, and the ranging results are not affected by wave speed and sag. A large number of PSCAD/EMTDC experimental simulation data verify the accuracy and feasibility of the theoretical scheme .

Author Keywords: multi-circuit lines on the same tower with asymmetry parameters

articleTitle: Exploring the Influence of the Evolution of Discharge Plasma Channel on the Characteristics of Electric Explosion Products
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric explosion of wires (EEW) is a complex physical process involved multiple phase transitions. The EEW production of ultrafine powders is influenced by numerous elements. Previous researches indicated that the plasma process would have critical impact on the produced nanoparticles. This paper investigated the nanoparticles morphology of Cu and W explosion which represent two typical non-refractory and refractory metals. Electrical characteristics and self-emission images were used to clear the discharge process. The radius of the nanoparticles produced by the silk explosion technology is between a few nanometers and a hundred microns. Experiments indicated that the evolution of discharge channels were obviously different as well as the exploded products. The distribution of nanopowders, geometric mean, and the geometric standard deviation were calculated, and the influence of the plasma process was analyzed based on above parameters.

articleTitle: Refined load forecasting of distribution network based on ARIMA model with multi-factor combination analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize accurate planning and refined management requirements of distribution network, under the condition of comprehensive consideration of multiple influencing factors, it has become a new development trend to carry out fine-grained load forecasting for distribution network. First, the pilot areas are divided according to the distribution network grid division method. Then, taking meteorology, economy, electricity price policy, electricity consumption of large users and other factors into comprehensive consideration, load forecasting is carried out for each unit based on ARIMA model. Finally, the overall data of the region is obtained by summing up the load data of each unit. The case shows that the precision of load prediction can be improved effectively and the spatial distribution of load can be obtained by using the refined grid prediction method under the combination of multiple factors, which has guiding significance for the planning and expansion of distribution network.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of radiated magnetic field based on time frequency method for primary/secondary fusion distribution switch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to various electromagnetic interference, the primary/secondary fusion power distribution switch often has various faults, but the type of interference and evaluation methods considered in the current study are relatively single, which cannot completely simulate the interference intensity and action time in actual operation. This paper firstly describes the electromagnetic interference principle of the primary/secondary fusion distribution switch, selects to build a simulated transient harassment generation device, considers a model 10kV outdoor primary/secondary fusion distribution switch with the stable interference signal, and focuses on the collection of the spatial magnetic field signal near the switch. The magnetic field distribution around the secondary circuit. The results show that under the proposed interference, the instantaneous magnetic field strength on the side of the distribution switch transformer can reach 11000A/m and the characteristic frequency distribution of the interference signal is around 1.3MHz, 12MHz and 20MHz.

articleTitle: A New Speed Controller for Hybridly Excited Asymmetric Stator Pole Doubly Salient Machine in Full-speed Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hybridly Excited Asymmetric Stator Pole Doubly Salient Machine (HEASPDSM) is a new type of hybrid excitation motor. It is with a simple structure and suitable for high-speed operation, so that it has wonderful prospects in electric vehicle drives. In order to enhance the output torque at low speed and extend the speed range, the speed-torque characteristic curve of HEASPDSM and the constraints of flux weakening are analyzed, and an improved full-speed range driving control scheme based on mathematical model is proposed. Finally, the method was successfully verified by simulation.

Author Keywords: Hybridly Excited Asymmetric Stator Pole Doubly Salient Machine (HEASPDSM)

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Control Strategy of Parallel Systems in Switched Reluctance Generators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To enhance generating capacity and reliability of multi-machine parallel power generation, implement the efficiency optimization, a current distribution control method based on differential evolution (DE) algorithm is proposed for the switched reluctance generator (SRG) in parallel. The load current is stabilized by the maximum value current sharing control (CSC) firstly. Then, the current distribution control method is adopted, which can adjust the reference current of each parallel generator in the current distribution part, so as to change the working point of each generator and implement the optimization of parallel system efficiency. The performances of the proposed control method are evaluated in detail by the simulation, and comparison with traditional current sharing control is carried out as well.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Method of Edge Computing Device Resource for Power Distribution Service
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fast evolving cities emerge new power distribution services and will create a new distribution service ecology. Edge computing is the vital technique to provide data processing capability and support the new distribution services. The Edge Computing Device (ECD) has limited data processing capability and under certain situations ECD cannot satisfy the demand of each distribution service. Therefore, the scheduling method that can effectively utilize ECD resource and improve the performance of distribution services is worth studying. The distribution services supported by ECD are analyzed and distribution service model is built considering service latency, importance and computing workload. Based on the proposed service model, two optimal ECD resource scheduling methods are presented. Case study results show that the methods can decrease the latency while satisfying the real-time requirement of crucial service, which proves that the methods are effective.

articleTitle: Distributed Cooperative Control Strategy of Thermostatically Controlled Loads Considering Switch Life Loss
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale access of new clean power generation energy to the power grid and the rapid development of smart electricity technology, more and more electric equipment is involved in the demand response to calm the fluctuation of new energy. However, the incremental cost and switch life loss of electrical equipment are usually not taken into account in the traditional optimal scheduling scheme. This paper presents a TCLs distributed cooperative control strategy based on multi-agent consistency. This strategy adopts the control cost model which takes into account the life loss of switches and can reflect the thermodynamic characteristics of TCLs, and realizes the control cost optimization through distributed collaborative control.

articleTitle: An Improved Half-and-full-bridge MMC with DC Fault Blocking Capability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) is a promising topology in the field of DC distribution system. However, MMCs are vulnerable to the DC-line short-circuit faults. In this paper, an improved half-and-full-bridge MMC (IHF-MMC) topology is proposed. The transferring path of fault current in bridge arm is composed of a thyristor branch and current-transferring branch; on the other hand, the upper arm of phase C adopts unipolar-voltage full-bridge submodules instead of half-bridge submodules to absorb fault energy. After the DC fault occurs, the fault current is transferred to the upper arm of phase C, and then interrupted by the submodules through sequential coordination of two additional branches. The operation principle in different fault stages is analyzed in detail in this paper, and a ± 10kV/2.5MW simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Design and Mechanical Property Analysis of Permanent Magnet Spring with Attractive Force used in PMSM with a Conical Rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To balance the axial force of a permanent magnet synchronous motor with a conical rotor (CR-PMSM) between the stator and the rotor, a permanent magnet (PM) spring with attractive force is designed. The magnetic circuit method is adopted to calculate the effective air-gap permeance, flux linkage and flux density. Then the magnetic force in axial direction is calculated by the virtual displacement method. The theoretical model of magnetic force – deformation is established to reveal the impact of different configurations adjustments on magnetic field distribution and stiffness coefficient. The static performance of the PM spring are analyzed by theoretical model and 2-D axial symmetry model of finite element method (FEM). A prototype of the PM spring is designed and manufactured together with the CR-PMSM. The simulation and experimental results show that the designed PM spring can meet the technical specification of axial force requirement of the CR-PMSM.

articleTitle: Energy Recovery of Air-Core Pulsed Alternators After Discharge Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The air-core pulsed alternator with miniaturization and light-weight is the preferred pulsed power supply for mobile combat platforms which have strict restrictions on volume and weight. After the air-core machine discharges to the load, massive magnetic energy remains in the alternator and the railgun due to the high residual currents. Usually, this magnetic energy is consumed by resistors in the circuit, but it leads to a low system efficiency. In this paper, two methods are put forward to get the magnetic energy reclaimed and thereby reused in the next projectile launching. One is to control the triggering signal of the rectifier circuit so that it can work as an inverter and the magnetic energy in field windings can be recovered into the kinetic energy in rotor. The optimum triggering angle is selected based on its value range calculated. The other is to design a resistance-capacitance absorption circuit installed on the muzzle to absorb the residual discharge current and realize the conversion of the magnetic energy in rails into the electric energy in absorption capacitor, which can be reused as an ignition capacitor.

articleTitle: Power Supply Control Strategy for Storage-converter-less Source-optical-storage System at the Edge of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power supply system reliability at the edge of the power grid is often difficult to meet the needs of users. These main problems include low voltage and line failure. This paper proposes a source-optical-storage power supply system without an energy storage converter, which is composed of a photovoltaic converter, inverter, and energy storage battery. Compared with the traditional energy storage power supply system, it is without the storage converter. The system without a energy storage converter between the bus and the flow side reduces the number of system transformation stages and makes the system transformation efficiency higher. The proposed power supply control strategy for this structure considers the battery storage capacity, photovoltaic generation power, and load demand. The strategy realizes the reasonable utilization of photovoltaic and energy storage batteries. The experimental results show the proposed system structure and power supply control strategy are reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: A Novel Intermittent High-Frequency Square-Wave Injection of IPMSM Sensorless Drive for Eliminating Inverter Dead time Nonlinear Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-frequency (HF) square-wave signal injection has been widely applied in the sensorless control system of interior permanent magnet synchronous machine, increasing the bandwidth of speed and position control loop. However, the injected high-frequency square-wave voltage may be distorted by the inverter nonlinearity effects, especially by the nonlinear effects of the dead time. This paper analyzes the effects of inverter nonlinearity on injection voltage, induced current ripple, and position estimation performance. A novel intermittent high- frequency square-wave injection method is proposed to minimize the effect of the dead time, which also improves the efficiency of injection voltage. Experimental results conform the advantages of proposed method. The mechanical position estimation errors are lower than 0.0314rad (1.8°).

Author Keywords: nonlinear effect of inverter dead time

articleTitle: Measurement Accuracy Evaluation of Power Quality Online Monitoring Device Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, most power quality online monitoring devices do not carry out accuracy test, and the measurement data may not be accurate due to the degraded performance of software and hardware and environmental impact after a certain number of years of operation. In this paper, a measurement accuracy evaluation method based on LSTM in proposed. Referring to the regulation that the precision inspection cycle of power secondary equipment is more than one year and the power quality online monitoring device must pass the accuracy test before putting into operation, it is considered that the measurement data of the device in the first year is accurate and reliable. Firstly, box plot is used to clean the data. Aiming at the coexistence section of reliable data and abnormal data interval in box plot, the slope law of abnormal data is used to complete the data cleaning. Then, the standard voltage and current value is given by the voltage and current prediction model based on LSTM. Finally, DTW cumulative distance is used to evaluate the accuracy, so as to avoid the problem that the timing of standard value and measured value does not correspond. By using the PQTS automatic test system, the feasibility of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Transient Model of DFIG-WT-dominated System for Nonlinear Oscillation Characteristic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since doubly fed induction generator-based wind turbines (DFIG-WTs) has more complex structure than synchronous generator (SG), the DFIG-WTs has strong nonlinearity inherently. It leads the oscillation responses of DFIG-WT-dominated system to be significantly changed, especially after large disturbance. The oscillation characteristics could not be reflected by linear results any more. More seriously, the stability conclusion would also be contrary. However, there does not exist general mathematic method to solve the nonlinear problem in DFIG-based WT, thus an approximate model that balances accuracy and universality is needed. This paper proposes a novel model of DFIG-WT- dominated system, in which the nonlinear effects are appropriately reflected by the higher-order terms of Taylor series expansion. Firstly, the original nonlinear model and its Taylor series expansion forms are developed. Then, the nonlinear oscillation characteristics under different fault degrees are analyzed and the approximate degrees of model with different higher-order terms are evaluated. Finally, model application in multi-machine system is discussed. The proposed model could provide a model basis for modal series analysis, which is a common method for nonlinear oscillation characteristic analysis.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Suppressing Electromechanical Torsional Vibration of Large-power AC Drive System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A method based on virtual inertia for suppressing electromechanical torsional vibration of a large-power AC drive system is presented in this paper. The main drive system of the rolling mill is the research object, and a two-inertia elastic model is established to study the mechanism of electromechanical torsional vibration. The improvement is made based on the control of the load observer. The virtual inertia control method combines the advantages of the positive and negative feedback control of the load observer, can achieve the purpose of controlling the moment of inertia of the motor from the perspective of electrical control, and effectively suppress oscillation.

articleTitle: Multi Level Integrated Energy Management and Control Method for AC / DC Hybrid Flexible Substation Area Based on Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of DC source loads such as photovoltaic power generation and electric vehicles, AC/DC hybrid distribution network technology has developed rapidly. In order to improve the regional energy management capabilities, a control method for integrated energy in AC/DC hybrid flexible stations is proposed. Based on the basic structure of traditional power internet of things (PIoT), combined with the characteristics of multiple energy sources in AC/DC flexible stations, the overall architecture of multi-level energy in AC/DC flexible stations is proposed, and the top-level architecture of "Cloud, Tube, Edge and End" is optimized. On this basis, according to the system operation mode and functional requirements, a multi-level operation control method for AC/DC flexible station area is proposed to meet the requirements of distributed energy access and diversified load control.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Stochastic Dynamic Microgrid Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based algorithm for the stochastic dynamic microgrid energy management. First, we consider AC power flow constraints which makes the problem non-convex and uncertainties in load, renewable generation and real-time electricity price which makes the problem stochastic. Then, the original multi-period optimization problem, which was difficult to deal with, is decomposed into several single-period optimization problems by the proposed deep reinforcement learning based method. Our method can obtain an approximate optimal policy for the original multi-period problem without long-term forecast and optimization or distribution knowledge of the uncertainty by learning from the results of single-period problems. Last, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed method are demonstrated through several case studies.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of fuel economy of a fuel cell/battery passive hybrid power system for commercial vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fuel cell/battery passive hybrid power systems have the potential of saving energy due to the avoidance of DC/DC power loss. However, their energy-saving effect has not been investigated in previous research. This paper studies the fuel economy of a fuel cell/battery passive hybrid system for commercial vehicles through simulation. The energy consumption of the passive hybrid configuration is compared to that of a conventional active configuration under high-speed static conditions. The results show that the passive configuration can save energy by 3%-12% under the selected condition and energy management strategy (EMS). The energy-saving percentage increases as the efficiency of the fuel cell engine increases. When the initial SOC is lower than the sustaining target of the EMS, the energy-saving effect becomes more significant. This study confirms the energy-saving effect of the fuel cell passive hybrid system.

articleTitle: A method of power distribution network fault voltage restoration based on grid reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The distribution network serves as the last link directly connected to users. The power quality directly affects the user's power experience. Therefore, it is particularly necessary to keep the distribution network safe. This paper mainly studies in the case of a disconnection fault, when the reactive power optimization cannot make the voltage meet the requirements, based on the reactive power compensation, with the minimum deviation of the monitored central node voltage as the goal, a network reconstruction method is proposed. The distribution network is reconstructed, and the actual topology of a certain area is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Arc Dynamic Characteristics in DC Disconnecting Switch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a control and protection device of photovoltaic power generation system, the DC disconnecting switches are used extensively. The interruption capacity is an important index of DC disconnecting switch. The interruption capacity is effected by dynamic characteristics of arc. Therefore, the dynamic characteristics of arc is analyzed by MHD simulation. The 2-D MHD model of disconnecting switch is built and the motion process of moving contact is considered. The temperature, pressure distribution, arc voltage and arc current curves are obtained by simulation. The results show that the velocity of arc motion is slowly and the utilization rate of the splitter plate is lower. It leads to the arcing time is longer. Therefore, the permanent magnet and gassing material can be added to improve the arc extinguishing ability.

articleTitle: Mixed-Type Open-Circuit Fault Diagnosis for NPC Inverters Using a Dual-Input CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The different open-circuit fault causes (i.e. terminal block damage, bonding wire fracture, driver circuit failure, et al.) lead to both one-way open-circuit and two-way open-circuit in neutral-point-clamped (NPC) inverters, namely the mixed-type open-circuit fault. In order to achieve a high diagnosis accuracy, the two types of open-circuit manifestations are simulated with two simulation ways to acquire mixed monitoring signal samples, on this basis, a diagnosis method using a dual-input convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed. The method uses the three-phase currents as the main monitoring signals, and the six midpoint voltages of the upper and down half bridge arms as the auxiliary monitoring signals for the open-circuit fault diagnosis. The effectiveness of the method is validated by simulation, and the effects of different sample durations and training sample numbers on the network training and diagnosis results are analyzed quantitatively.

articleTitle: Optimal Siting and Sizing of Distributed Generation Considering Voltage Stability Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fluctuation of voltage stability is considered in the distributed generation (DG) planning of this paper. Taking the mean value and standard deviation of the voltage stability index and the comprehensive investment cost of the distribution network as the goal, a model for optimal siting and sizing of DG is established. An improved multi-objective particle swarm algorithm is proposed to obtain optimal Parato solution set, in which adaptive inertia weight is used to improve convergence, cross mutation is used to avoid falling into local optima, and particle density is used to filter non-inferior solution sets. Taking the IEEE33 node system as an example, the location and capacity of wind turbines and photovoltaics are selected and the results prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Considering Restriking Arc Model 1000kV GIS Very Fast Transient Overvoltage Characteristics and the Influence of Disconnector Speed
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the research of Very Fast Transient Overvoltage(VFTO), the accuracy of arc model of disconnector largely influences the VFTO calculation results. How to accurately simulate the striking and extinguishing process of the arc during the action of the disconnector is the key issue of studying arc model. In this paper, the ATP-EMTP electromagnetic transient program was used to simulate the arc damping by series connection of constant resistance and time-varying inductance, and the built-in MODELS module was used for programming to simulate the restriking process of the arc. The model was applied to a 1000kV GIS test circuit. The voltage and current waveforms were analyzed under the opening and closing operations of the model, and the results were compared with the single breakdown arc model. At the same time, combined with the restriking arc model, the influence of opening speed of disconnector on VFTO was analyzed. The present study suggests that the restriking arc model can better reflect the VFTO characteristics during the breakdown process of disconnector. When the opening speed is less than 0.7m/s, the maximum VFTO of the test circuit increases with the increase of opening speed. When the VFTO amplitude reaches the maximum, it will decrease with the further increase of opening speed.

Author Keywords: arc striking and arc extinguishing criterion

articleTitle: Influence of Electrical Tree Aging on the Dielectric and Trap Properties of XLPE Insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dielectric and charge properties of XLPE insulation with different service periods are important to estimate the aging state of high voltage cables. The accelerated aging experiment was carried out to obtain the aged XLPE samples with the needle-plate electrodes using power frequency AC source. The surface composition and dielectric parameters of XLPE samples were measured and analyzed with the Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) and impedance analyzer. The surface potential and trap distribution of XLPE samples were measured by the isothermal surface potential decay (ISPD) method. The tested objects include the new XLPE sample, the samples with different electrical tree lengths, and the one with electrical tree breakdown. The results show that the aging of the electrical tree changes the dielectric parameters and trap distribution of XLPE samples. The dielectric constant increases with the length of electrical tree. The deeper and shallower traps appear simultaneously in the surface layer of XLPE insulation after electrical tree aging, and the trap density increases with the length of electrical tree. The trap energy level is the lowest and the trap density is the largest in the sample with electrical tree breakdown. The FTIR result shows that the absorption peaks of XLPE backbone structure decline obviously after electrical tree aging. The fracture of molecular chain and formation of low density area in XLPE sample are the main reasons for the change of dielectric and trap after electrical tree aging.

articleTitle: Positive sequence current differential protection based on least square method for distribution network with distribution generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A positive-sequence current differential protection scheme based on the least square method for the distribution network with distribution generation connected is proposed in the paper. By comparing the similarity of the positive-sequence current waveforms at both ends of the line, it is judged whether there is a fault or not. Firstly, the fault characteristics of the distribution network with inverter interfaced distributed generator (IIDG) are analyzed, and the fault characteristics of the distribution network are obtained when a metallic short circuit and fault with high resistance occur. According to these fault characteristics, a differential protection scheme based on the least square method is proposed. The instantaneous sampling value of the positive sequence component of the current is used in the criterion.
