And the residual square sum of each instantaneous value of the positive sequence current at both ends is calculated. The sum of squares of residuals in the half of the cycle is integrated, and the integrated value is used as the criterion. The simulation results show that the differential protection can operate under the situation of common fault types, transition resistance, and normal load levels etc. This scheme can adapt to the distribution network with poor communication conditions, and quickly and accurately remove faults.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of A Feedforward Current Based Active Common-Mode EMI Filter For Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) is becoming more and more popular in High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system recently since it can achieve high efficiency power conversion. However, numerous switching devices in MMC system generate severe Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) during its operation. Common-Mode (CM) EMI is generated by the high frequency fluctuation of voltage on the power devices and the parasitic capacitance in the system which may threaten the reliable operation of the system. EMI filters are commonly used for EMI suppression. To suppress the DC side CM EMI in MMC system, this paper proposed a feedforward current based active EMI filter. A 5-level MMC simulation platform is built in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The feasibility of this method is verified by simulation results and the CM EMI reduction could approach 20dB within several MHz with the proposed active EMI filter.

articleTitle: Feedforward Compensation Control for Variable Voltage and Variable Frequency Voltage Source Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The variable voltage and variable frequency voltage source converter (VVVF-VSC) has recently received wide attention for its capability to offer continuously adjustable frequency and amplitude. However, it is a challenge to design the controller for providing the precise tracking of the voltage references, since the voltage reference of VVVF-VSC is variable in a wide frequency band, and the existing controllers usually rely on a specific control frequency or frequency band. To cope with the issue, a new feedforward compensation control is proposed for VVVF-VSC, which is based on inversion-based feedforward theory. With the method, the controller can achieve the zero steady-state error control for the variable voltage reference in a wide frequency range. And, the proposed method is simple in implementation. Finally, the experimental results are presented to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Impedance Shaping of Grid-Connected Converter Based on Gershgorin Disc Theorem and Return Ratio Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale grid connection of renewable energy, a series of oscillation problems have been aroused. Especially when the power grid is weak, the renewable energy controller is easy to interact with the grid. The common solution is to shape the converter impedance. The existing research often increases the margin of renewable energy devices to cope with the change of grid impedance. However, the regulation ability is limited and the verification of shaping results is not intuitive enough. According to the stability criterion based on Gershgorin disc theorem and the system return ratio matrix, this paper proposes a new index of impedance shaping, and the specific correction target of the converter impedance element is determined. Then the shaping is realized according to voltage feedforward at the point of common coupling. With this proposed method, the system stability is significantly improved, the influence of the grid is fully considered, and the measurement results can be directly used for analysis. Finally, simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On-Load Tap-Changer Mechanical Fault Diagnosis Method Based on CEEMDAN Sample Entropy and Improved Ensemble Probabilistic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vibration signals of on-load tap-changer (OLTC) contain a rich of operating status information and will effectively diagnose the mechanical fault of OLTC. For the purpose of improving the level of OLTC diagnosis in mechanical condition, this study used the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) sample entropy (SampEn) combined with K-L divergence as a vibration signal. Meanwhile, an improved ensemble probabilistic neural network was used for mechanical condition. Then the OLTC mechanical vibration signals under different conditions were measured by experiments. The original vibration signals were decomposed into IMF components with different frequency distributions by CEEMDAN, and then calculate K-L divergence between them. Next, calculate the sample entropy of selected IMF component as the vibration signal feature vector. At the same time, construct a probabilistic neural network (PNN) and optimize the smooth factor. Then the optimized PNN and other weak classifiers were combined as the base classifier of bootstrap aggregating (bagging) algorithm, which greatly improves the classification accuracy of PNN. The final experimental results prove that the improved model can exhibit a high diagnostic efficiency and accuracy rate, which can effectively extract mechanical characteristics and generate some meaningful help for the research of other mechanical fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Defect Analysis and Preventive Measures of Main Transformer Bushing Based on Frequency Domain Dielectric Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The health status of main transformer bushing is directly related to the safe and stable operation of power grid. This paper introduces an abnormal dielectric loss factor of glass fiber reinforced plastic dry bushing of 220 kV main transformer. Firstly, the casing defects were determined based on the frequency domain dielectric spectrum. Then, the causes of the casing defects were analyzed by the partial discharge test, the casing disintegration inspection, the final screen dielectric loss test and the electromagnetic field simulation calculation. Finally, the diagnosis method and the preventive measures of the glass fiber reinforced dry casing defects were proposed. The research results of this paper have certain reference and guiding significance for the safe operation of this type of main transformer bushing.

articleTitle: Research on cable fault location based on eliminating the limitation of wave velocity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem that the traditional cable fault location method is limited by the traveling wave velocity, a new cable fault location method is proposed. Firstly, based on the traveling wave model of fault cable, the traveling wave is divided into four types according to the traveling wave propagation position and the number of refraction and reflection. Secondly, the cable line is divided into three sections according to the time when the refraction and reflection waves at the fault point and the reflection waves at the opposite end reach the detection bus and the polarity combination of each traveling wave head, and the corresponding location algorithm of removing wave velocity limitation for each section is derived. The fault distance is calculated by using the new algorithm on the Matlab/Simulink. Compared with the existing methods, the results show that the method has high accuracy and strong stability. Meanwhile, a cable fault location system is designed based on the new algorithm, and the cable fault location experiment is carried out. The experimental results show that the error of the positioning system is less than 1 % when different faults occur in the cable, which can effectively realize the cable fault location.

articleTitle: Multi-mode Coordination Strategy of Building Microgrid Considering Demand-side Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the effective combination of building microgrid and demand-side response, improve the ability of new energy consumption, build the functional structure of building microgrid load demand coordination management system, put forward the multi-mode coordination strategy of building microgrid that considers demand-side response. The calculation examples prove that the proposed coordination strategy is feasible and effective, and at the same time it has a certain degree of economy, which is conducive to assisting large power grids in "peak shaving and valley filling" and bringing economic benefits to users.

articleTitle: Thermal aging property and breakdown property of submarine cable materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important high voltage transmission equipment, XLPE cable plays an important role in submarine transmission engineering. In the long run, the performance of cable material is directly related to the overall insulation performance of the cable. In the work, the aging property and breakdown property of submarine cable insulation material and semi-conductive material are studied. Firstly, the semi- conductive layer, insulation layer, and composite structure specimen of the semi-conductive and insulation (S-I) layer were prepared by the plate vulcanizing press. Secondly, specimens were treated in a vacuum aging chamber at 135°C for 600 h. The morphology and groups of the samples before and after thermal aging were studied by SEM and FTIR. Finally, the breakdown strength of the insulation sample and composite sample before and after thermal aging were measured. The experimental results show the chemical bonds and functional groups in insulation samples after aging has little change. By contrast, the C-O bond in the methyl and ester carbonyl group decrease after semi- conductive layer aging. The breakdown strength of insulation samples after thermal aging decreases by 23.66%. The breakdown strength of the composite sample after thermal aging decreases by 26.50%.

articleTitle: Laboratory Calibration of HFCT Partial Discharge Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the advantages of high sensitivity and non-intrusiveness, HFCT PD detection systems are implemented in order to monitor incipient faults of power cables. This paper introduces a laboratory calibration method for HFCT PD detection systems based on a Gauss pulse signal. In order to modify practical PD signal at 1MHz~30MHz frequency band, equivalent Gauss pulse signal with certain rise time is applied. The method overcomes the drawback of sensitivity verification method recommended by IEC 62478 in traceability. All the standard equipment applied is frequently-used device in electrical laboratory. Parameters of the calibration work include frequency band, amplitude linearity, transfer impedance and detection sensitivity. By analyzing the data of four systems, the calibration provides reasonable criteria in quality verification of HFCT PD detection systems.

articleTitle: Joint Equilibrium Analysis of Electricity and Natural Gas Markets Considering Wind Power/Power-to-gas Equipment/Natural Gas Generating Unit/ Gas Storage Device Bidding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A joint operation of renewable energy with energy storage devices and the development of multi-energy market transactions are effective ways to accommodate renewable energy such as wind power. This paper addresses issues of joint equilibrium analysis of the wholesale electricity market (WEM) and the gas market (GM) in which wind power producers (WPPs), power-to-gas (P2G) equipment, natural gas generating unit (NGGU) and gas storage device (GSD) constitute a joint operator (JO) to participate in bidding competition. First, a new coupled electricity and gas markets trading framework is presented, in which WPP can use P2G equipment, NGGU and GSD to tackle the surplus and deficit of its actual output. In addition, P2G equipment and NGGU have arbitrage behavior in the multi-energy market. Second, based on this framework, a multi-period stochastic game equilibrium model in which the JO, conventional generators (CGs) and gas companies participate in the multi-energy market bidding competition is established, and the equilibrium model is solved by the nonlinear complementarity method. Finally, simulation results show that the presented multi-energy trading framework can tackle the deviation of the WPP participating in the multi-period WEM competition, reduce the market power of CGs, and improve the market competitiveness of WPP and the social welfare.

articleTitle: Predicting Method for number of power load users based on multi-dimensional grey model and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of high-tech industries such as medical treatment, transportation and biology, the analysis and prediction of large power load users becomes very critical, which can not only make the power distribution and the system operation more reasonable in the distribution network planning, but also optimize the user's power consumption experience to a great extent. In this paper, a combined prediction method based on the improved multi-dimensional grey prediction and support vector machine is proposed, which overcomes the shortcoming that grey prediction is only applicable to small sample short-term prediction and has no selectivity to specific data, realizes the complementary advantages of different models and avoids the limitations of a single model. Given the differences in the critical demand for electricity in different industries, this paper selects four typical large users in the high-tech industry as examples to predict the change of the number of these four large users.

articleTitle: The Low-Carbon Combined Heat-Electric-Gas Scheduling Model with Electric Boiler and Electric-to-Gas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of wind power consumption limitation in winter heating and the environmental issues of carbon emission from thermal power units, a low-carbon integrated electricity-heat-gas system model is proposed with electric boilers and electric-to-gas equipment. Aiming at carbon dioxide emissions, carbon capture devices, electric boilers, and electric-to-gas equipment are installed in the area with severe wind curtailment. The proposed model is to minimize system operation costs considering unit power constraints, equipment constraints, carbon capture constraints, and system constraints. Finally, simulation results on a serious wind curtailment system show that the model proposed in this paper can reduce the system cost effective and carbon tax of the system and enhance wind power integration, which has significant economic and environmental significance.

articleTitle: A Self-adapting Control Strategy to Improve Performance of AGC with Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Battery energy storage system (BESS) is a kind of flexible and reliable new source, an increasingly important part in frequency modulation (FM) service. In this paper, a self-adapting control strategy is proposed for multiple BESSs in power system combined with traditional generators working to improve the performance of automation generation control (AGC). In details, different control objectives are taken into consideration to ensure the comprehensiveness of strategy including smaller frequency deviation, higher economic performance and better status of BESS. Furthermore, the factors of grid and the information of BESS are designed as key elements affecting the weighting factors of different control objectives, which results in self-adapting change of the strategy according to the changes in power grid. Two cases of the AGC with proposed strategy are conducted in Matlab/Simulink and the results of the simulation and calculation indicate superiority of self-adapting strategy compared with common control strategy.

articleTitle: The Application of Corona Discharge Plasma Technology in Flue Gas Desulfurization and Denitrification of Cremator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the low temperature and complex composition of the flue gas of the cremators, there is no effective denitration process for cremators flue gas in the industry, combining the advantages of high voltage narrow pulse discharge technology, plasma generation technology and spray absorption technology, the experiments were carried out on a cremator. The results show that the corona discharge plasma technology can purify the flue gas of the cremator very well. Under the conditions of 26KW injection power, 0.1% NaOH and 7L/m3 spray gas ratio, the desulfurization rate is over 85% and the denitration rate is above 60%. With the gradual improvement of environmental emission standards, the process can be optimized by adding reductants or accelerators, and the ultra-low emission of cremator can be gradually realized.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Terrain Curved-Surface on Lightning Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lightning parameters are indispensable key parameters in lightning protection design. Based on the ground lightning data from the Hainan lightning location system in 2009, the relationships between lightning parameters (the average lightning current amplitude of total ground flashover, the proportion of positive and the negative flashover, and total ground flashover density) and terrain curved-surface parameters (slope, slope aspect, and slope position) are studied by means of GIS spatial analysis and mathematical statistics. Firstly, it is concluded that there is a cubic function relationship between the average lightning current amplitude of total ground flashover and slope. The proportion of positive flashover decreases with the increase of slope, and the distribution of total ground flashover density features U-shape with the increase of slope. The lightning protection should be strengthened for the transmission lines built on the mountain with the slope below 10° or above 48°. In addition, when the slope aspect is in the southwest direction, the average lightning current amplitude of total ground flashover and total ground flashover density are the lowest, while the proportion of positive flashover is the largest among all slope aspects. So some anti-backflashover measures should be taken for transmission lines built in the southwest slope aspect. Besides, the average lightning current amplitudes of total ground flashover are the largest and the total ground flashover densities are the highest in ridge and valley among all slope position. Some special lightning protection measures should be considered to be taken in ridge and valley.

articleTitle: Gaussian Process Regression for Quantitative DP Analysis of Oil-paper Insulation by NIRS Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Oil-paper insulation is the key insulation structure of the transformers, whose aging condition is closely related to the operations of the equipment. The degree of polymerization (DP) is the direct parameter characterizing the aging condition of oil-paper insulation. Recently, the near infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) measurement powered by quantitative analysis is used to evaluate DP of the insulating papers mainly. While the applications of NIRS for DP evaluation is constrained because the present spectral quantitative analysis method is not accurate and stable enough, especially for onsite tests. In this paper, we propose a Gaussian process regression (GPR) method to predict DP of the oil- paper insulation in laboratory as well as in field. Firstly, the basic principles of GPR algorithm are illustrated. A GPR model for DP prediction is established based on the spectra of differently aged insulating paper samples which are prepared in laboratory. The GPR model show a high prediction accuracy both for training set and testing set. The established GPR model is finally applied on the DP prediction of insulating papers originating from a de-tanked transformer. The accurate predicted DP and the reliable aging assessment results indicate that the established model can be implemented on site.

articleTitle: Enhanced Thermal and Electrical Properties of Functionalized h-BN/Epoxy Resin Composites
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride nanosheet (h-BN) is widely applied to polymer-based nanocomposites due to its good thermal and insulation properties. Moreover, surface modification can contribute to improving dispersity and compatibility of nanofillers in polymer-based nanocomposites. Epoxy resin (EP) nanocomposites filled with functionalized h-BN can further improve its thermal and insulating properties. In this work, a novel surface modification method of grafting dopamine (DA) at the end of 3-glycidoxypropyl-trimethoxysilane (KH560) is proposed to modify h-BN (DKB) as well as DKB and its corresponding EP nanocomposites are prepared successfully. The dispersibility of EP composites filled with h-BN is firstly discussed. Besides, the thermal performance and breakdown field strength of EP nanocomposites filled with modified h-BN are mainly investigated. The results show that surface modification method of DKB can effectively enhance the dispersity and compatibility of h-BN in the EP polymer. The thermal stability and thermal conductivity of DKB/EP nanocomposites has significant improvement. Meanwhile, breakdown field strength of DKB/EP nanocomposites is also superior to that of other h-BN/EP nanocomposites.

articleTitle: Impedance Modeling and Interaction Stability Analysis of Grid-Connected Voltage Source Converter Considering Multiple Frequency Coupling Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the renewable energy with a voltage source converter (VSC) as the interface circuit is connected to a weak grid, the power system is more likely to become unstable. The common method to analyze the interaction stability is the impedance-based stability analysis method. However, the traditional impedance model only considers the same frequency response as the perturbation frequency, but ignores the frequency coupling characteristic, so the stability analyses based on the traditional impedance model is inaccurate in some frequency ranges. Hence, considering multiple frequency coupling factors, the frequency coupling impedance model for a VSC based on the dual second order generalized integrator phase-locked loop (DSOGI-PLL) is established which can be more accurate, and the proposed impedance model is verified by simulation in MATLAB/Simulink. Furthermore, the influences of frequency coupling characteristic, short-circuit ratio (SCR) and outer-loop bandwidth on the stability of the grid-converter interconnected system has been analyzed by the generalized Nyquist criterion (GNC). Finally, the time-domain simulation results proved that the GNC can accurately forecast the resonance frequencies of the grid-converter interconnected system.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis for Power Substation Load Data based on Spectral Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the quick development of smart cities, data mining, feature extraction, identification and classification of different energy user groups are widely used to adjust the construction of distribution networks and power supply service strategies. This paper studies the principles and steps of the spectral clustering algorithm, considering the similarity measurement of load based on the load numerical characteristics, load curves volatility and trend characteristics. Then, the spectral clustering based on the proposed similarity measurement is performed on the substation-level power load data, and some typical load curves are categorized and analyzed. The results show that the composition of typical load curves of different substations can describe the composition of energy users in each substation. Besides, the spectral clustering method shows better performance in calculation speed, effectiveness and stability compared with k-means clustering,

articleTitle: Modeling and Solving of IGBT Switching Transient Based on Finite State Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To accurately obtain the switching characteristics of IGBT, a modeling and solving method of IGBT analysis model based on finite state machine is proposed. The switching process of the IGBT is analyzed, and the conditions for switching between the states are clarified; the nonlinear parameters of the device and the parasitic parameters of the circuit are considered, and the analytical model is established based on the state space theory; the finite state machine is implemented in Matlab/Simulink. Solve and verify with experiment. The results show that analytical model can accurately reflect the characteristics of the IGBT in the actual switching process.

articleTitle: Fixed-frequency hysteresis controller for fault-tolerant control of six-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The theory, design and implementation of fixed- frequency hysteresis current control of six-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is presented. Based on the difference between the given current and the actual current value with the loop width, and the algorithm calculates the duty cycle of the turn-on and turn-off states in real-time, The shortcomings of indeterminate switching frequency and large current distortion in traditional hysteresis control was solved by the proposed technique, the fault-tolerant operation of the motor under open- circuit fault can also be guaranteed. Simulation and experimental results are included to show the effectiveness of the proposed current controller.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of controllable leakage flux reverse-salient PMSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a controllable leakage flux reverse- salient permanent magnet synchronous motor (CLF-RSPMSM) is studied, which improves the flux-weakening capacity and speed range. Firstly, the design idea and working principle of the proposed motor are analyzed. Then sensitivity and response surface optimization methods are used to optimize the electromagnetic torque, torque ripple and reverse saliency ratio. The regulating flux characteristics and electromagnetic performance of the CLF-RSPMSM are simulated and compared with the initial IPM motor. Finally, the mechanical strength of the rotor of the CLF-RSPMSM is simulated. Both theoretical analysis and simulation results verify the characteristics of the proposed CLF-RSPMSM and the effectiveness of the optimization method in CLF-RSPMSM motor design.

articleTitle: An Automatic Verification Method of Intelligent Substation Operation Order Based on Chinese Semantic Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Verifying the intelligent substation Chinese operation order is an important step to ensure the accuracy of substation operations. The current manual verification method based on experience has strong subjectivity, low efficiency and low reliability. In view of this, this paper proposes an automatic verification method of operation order based on the Chinese semantic deep learning model: Global vectors for word representation-convolution Recurrent Neural Network (Glove-RCNN). By combining the text vectorization model Glove and text mining model RCNN, this method is feasible in realizing the semantic discrimination and automatic verification of correctness and error of the operation order texts. The experimental result shows that the MicroF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">score</inf> and MacroF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">score</inf> of the operation order verification model is 93.98% and 94.19%, which can accurately judge the correctness of the operation order, so as to effectively improve the verification efficiency.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Method Based on Copula Correlation Measurement Combined With Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate short-term load forecasting is of great significance to ensure the security and economic operation of power grid. Long and short term memory (LSTM) based predictive model in machine learning is a typical method for short-term load forecasting, but it is difficult to extract the weight of entering feature. This paper proposes a combined forecast model based on bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) based on attention mechanism. Firstly, the K-SVD algorithm is used to train the historical load data samples, and an over complete dictionary with the characteristics of data classification and sample sparsity is obtained. Then, the similarity matrix of sparse representation is used to cluster the load data. In the next step, the correlation analysis of Copula function is used to quantitatively calculate the correlation between weather, electricity price and load. Finally, Bi-LSTM-Attention is used to establish the prediction model. Taking the data set of a certain region in Australia as practical example, the prediction accuracy of the method reaches 95.84%. Comparing with support vector regression (SVR), back propagation (BP) and LSTM, the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy for short-term power load.

articleTitle: Control Strategy and Stability Analysis of Impedance Isolated Medium Voltage UPS in Off-grid Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impedance isolated medium voltage UPS proposed by ABB has superior performance, but the load power will be switched on and off at the megawatt level in off-grid operation, which will adversely affect the output power quality and stability of the system. At present, the above issue has not been discussed in relevant papers. In this paper, considering the voltage change of the leakage inductance of the step-up transformer caused by the load switching, a mathematical model of impedance isolated medium voltage UPS in off-grid operation is established, and its double closed-loop control strategy is proposed. The output impedance and input impedance of the system are deduced in detail. Moreover, based on the impedance ratio criterion method, the influence of the controller parameters and the equivalent leakage inductance of the step-up transformer on the system stability is analyzed. Finally, a simulation model of medium-voltage UPS in off-grid operation was built on PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the studied control strategy and stability analysis.

articleTitle: Sequential Distribution System Restoration With Inverter-Based Distributed Generations Considering Dynamic Frequency Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When extreme events cause large-scale outages, local power sources, such as distributed generations (DGs), can be coordinated to restore critical loads in distribution systems (DSs). However, the inertia of an isolated system formed by inverter-based DGs is relatively low, so the dynamic frequency during the restoration is essential as it may trigger the protection and cause restoration failure. Therefore, the dynamic frequency constraints should be considered when making decisions on the restorative actions. This paper proposes a dynamic frequency constrained service restoration method for the DS. First, according to the frequency response of inverter-based DGs, the analytical formulation of the system frequency nadir is derived and piecewise linearized. By incorporating the linear frequency constraints, a mixed-integer linear program is proposed for the restoration problem, by solving which the optimal restorative sequence and system operation state after each restorative action can be determined. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a modified IEEE 13-node test feeder.

articleTitle: Application of Gas Spark Switch in Plasma Pulse Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the application of gas spark switch as a microsecond pulse source in plasma pulse technology is studied. The overall structure of the plasma pulse device is introduced, and the mechanism of each module is analyzed. The breakdown process of the gas spark switch is simulated numerically, and the distribution of plasma density at different times is analyzed. A preliminary discharge experiment was carried out in the laboratory, and the relevant current and voltage data were measured. The results show that the gas spark switch as a microsecond pulse source may have a good application prospect in plasma pulse technology.

articleTitle: A Novel Clustered Voltage Balance for Cascaded H-Bridge STATCOM with CCS-MPC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In addition to the poor transient response, the traditional clustered voltage equalization scheme of the cascaded H-bridge STATCOM also causes some problems, such as harmonic pollution to the power grid. To solve the above problems, this paper improves the traditional scheme: Combining with the continuous control state set model predictive control (CCS-MPC) algorithm, a new clustered voltage equalization scheme is proposed. The proposed scheme can improve the dynamic performance of the cascaded H-bridge STATCOM clustered voltage equalization by dynamically adjusting the injected zero-sequence voltage, and suppress the DC side capacitor voltage fluctuation to a certain extent. Furthermore, the scheme of zero-sequence voltage injection prevents the system from overmodulation under inductive or capacitive conditions, using residual voltage modulation of the system. Finally, a MATLAB/Simulink simulation model is built to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Novel Finite-Control-Set Model Predictive Voltage Control for Dynamic Improvement of Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to mitigate the impact of load changes and external interferences on the stability of wireless power transfer (WPT) systems, the control strategy with excellent dynamic performance and disturbance rejection capability should be used. Therefore, a novel finite-control-set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) is proposed for the voltage control of WPT systems in this paper. This method is implemented on the basis of a discrete dynamic voltage model, and its operation mechanism is given detailly and intuitively. Moreover, the tradeoff between computational burden and dynamic performance is removed by introducing an adaptive step-size. An improved cost function also is presented to accelerate the convergence rate and improve the disturbance rejection capability. Finally, simulation results are given to validate the capability of the novel FCS-MPC.

articleTitle: Modeling of Large-scale Offshore Wind Farm Based on Vector Modeling Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the scale of wind farm continues to increase, the internal stability of wind farms and the distribution control strategy of wind turbines need to be further studied. Modeling is the basis of stability analysis. In order to solve the modeling problem, this paper proposes a wind farm modeling method based on vector variables. The core idea is to convert the complex model that contains plenty of wind generation units to a model consisting of one typical submodule, by constructing the block vector formed variables. In this way, the model has good scalability and high simulation efficiency, and can be realized by the vector simulation function of MATLAB/Simulink. In addition, linearization results can be easily and directly obtained by using Linearization Toolbox in Simulink, thus avoiding the complexity of writing programs for linearization calculations when studying the stability of large systems. Then, the simulation results are compared with the electromagnetic transient model to verify the correctness of the model. Time-domain simulation and linearization results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation Method of Distribution Network Considering Differential Reliability Requirements of End Users
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important part of the entire electricity market system, the needs of users should be given priority However, the existing reliability evaluation methods of distribution system fail to fully reflect the impact of end users' differentiated reliability requirements on the evaluation. Therefore, A method for reliability evaluation of distribution system considering the differentiated reliability requirements of end users is proposed. First, the reliability indicators are classified and counted. Then based on the entropy weight-analytic hierarchy process and the coefficient of variation-analytic hierarchy process to solve the established distribution network reliability loss model and contribution model, and the comprehensive weight of the reliability index is obtained. At the same time, according to the power consumption information of end users, the industrial, commercial, and residential operation modes of the distribution network to be evaluated are distinguished. The participation degree of different types of reliability indicators is calculated, and finally the comprehensive scores of the distribution network evaluation for different types of end-user reliability requirements are obtained. The calculation example analysis shows that, the proposed method can reasonably consider the influence of different types of users' reliability requirements on power supply reliability evaluation. The accuracy of distribution system reliability assessment is further improved.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of Jiles-Atherton Hysteresis Model Based on Variable Time-Step Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To efficiently and accurately model the waveform characteristics of the magnetizing inrush current, an improved hysteresis model based on the Jiles-Atherton theory is proposed, which mainly improves the simulation efficiency. Based on classical theory, considering the characteristics of the large slope of the linear region of the hysteresis loop and many high-frequency components, interpolation and heuristics are introduced to solve the problem of low simulation efficiency in small time steps. Finally, an improved transformer model is established on the CloudPSS simulation platform, and the accuracy and efficiency of the model were verified by comparing the running time and waveform matching degree.

articleTitle: Research on Aging Characteristics of Operating Composite Insulator in Inner Mongolia Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of composite insulators in Inner Mongolia Power Grid was introduced. A batch of composite insulators with different voltage levels, different operating years and different manufacturers were selected, and their appearance, electrical, mechanical and material properties were tested. Based on the test results, the effectiveness of each test item was obtained, the characteristics of operating composite insulator in Inner Mongolia Power Grid was analyzed, and the operation and maintenance recommendations of the composite insulator were put forward.

articleTitle: Effect of Cryogenic Temperature on DC Electrical Tree Initiation Characteristics of Epoxy Nanocomposites
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The widely used epoxy resin for high temperature superconducting (HTS) HVDC transmission system suffers the issue of electrical tree aging under high electrical field. Improving the DC electrical performance of epoxy resin at cryogenic temperature is the key to the safe and stable operation of HTS transmission. In this paper, electrical tree initiation characteristics at room and cryogenic temperature are tested. Moreover, thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) characterization of nanoparticles is carried out. The results show that the thermogravimetric process of nanoparticles modified with KH560 can be divided into physical and chemical thermogravimetric process, which indicates KH560 can effectively modify the surface of nano-alumina. With the increase of applied voltage cycles, the probability of tree initiation increases until all samples are triggered. At room temperature, it is found that the higher content of nano-alumina has the lower the tree initiation probability. In addition, the probability of DC tree initiation at cryogenic temperature is lower than that at room temperature. Furthermore, the tree initiation probability at 1 kV/s is much higher than that at 0.1 kV/s at both room and cryogenic temperatures.

articleTitle: Restart Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor in Flux-weakening Filed
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A new method is proposed to estimate the rotor position and speed in restart of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) sensorless control system in flux-weakening filed. The method judges the relationship between the magnitude of the electromotive force and the DC bus voltage according to the amplitude of the three-phase current composited current. All bridge arms are kept closed if the magnitude of the back EMF is higher than the bus voltage. Then we detect the peak point of the composited current vector, and obtain the rotor position and speed according to the magnitude relationship of the three-phase current at the peak point of composited current vector. And the selection method of the rotor position and speed detection time is given. The experimental results show that the proposed method can realize the restart of permanent magnet synchronous motor in flux-weakening filed.

articleTitle: A Fundamental-Harmonic Hybrid Power Transfer Strategy for Bidirectional Inductive Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For bidirectional inductive power transfer (BIPT) system, transmission efficiency optimization and widen zero voltage switching (ZVS) is important. In the BIPT system, to optimize the above issues, the dual-phase-shift (DPS) and triple- phase-shift (TPS) with the fundamental component are adopted. However, as the load power required of the system is decreased, the realization of ZVS is difficult, which is necessary to reduce the phase shift angle (PSA). And the system transmission power factor and efficiency will decrease. In this paper, fundamental- harmonic-hybrid (FHH) power transfer strategy is proposed for the optimization of the ZVS and system efficiency. Firstly, the relationship of the ZVS and efficiency with the transfer power of the BIPT is analyzed. Secondly, the implementation of strategy FHH is obtained, including the application condition, the realization of ZVS and the efficiency improvement. Finally, the simulations are performed. Compared with TPS strategy with the fundamental component, the transmission efficiency and power factor with FHH is improved under light load condition.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Day-Ahead Optimal Dispatching of Grid-Connected Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a day-ahead optimal dispatching method considering both the economy and the environment for the grid-connected microgrid is proposed. It aims at reducing the comprehensive cost (CPC) that combines power generation cost with environmental equivalent cost during the power production. The algorithm presented, which takes the CPC as the consistent variable, not only simultaneously satisfies multiple related constraints of power balance, power generation and energy storage, but also achieves a balance between the economy and the environment. The simulation is performed on a simplified grid-connected microgrid. It compares the proposed method with the traditional, which adopts a single-objective optimization function considering only economic benefits or only environmental benefits. CPC, distributed energy consumption rate and distributed energy penetration rate are used as indexes to quantify the evaluation results, which finally verifies the supremacy of the proposed approach in terms of its comprehensiveness.

articleTitle: A Two-Leg Converter and Control Strategy to Compensate the Three-Phase Imbalanced and Harmonic Currents
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the number of switches in the three-phase current compensation converter, a compensation scheme of two single-phase half-bridge back-to-back converters is proposed in this paper. In the traditional control, the active current is imbalanced and the reactive power cannot be fully compensated because the angle difference between line voltage and phase current is not considered. In order to solve this problem, a two-phase cross-decoupling control strategy of active and reactive currents is proposed. Firstly, the relation between active and reactive reference compensation currents and load currents is deduced based on the phase angle difference. According to this relation, the active and reactive currents of the single-phase converter are controlled respectively. To suppress the influence of load harmonic current on grid currents, a specific order harmonic control method is proposed. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional control strategy, the proposed control strategy can reduce the imbalance of three-phase current from 25% to 0.5%, increase the PF from 0.962 to 0.999, and compensate the grid harmonic currents.

articleTitle: An Active Gate Driver Design for Dynamic Voltage Balancing in Series-Connected SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of silicon carbide devices, the use of low-voltage Silicon Carbide (SiC) Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor (MOSFET) in series has become an option in medium/high voltage applications, but it introduces voltage imbalance problem and SiC MOSFETs suffer the great voltage peak stresses as well as the extremely high dv/dts. This brings great challenges to the insulation design of the gate driver circuit. In this study, based on the strategy of adjusting the driving signal time delay, an active gate driver is designed, it can not only reduce the design of sampling isolation through the ‘floating ground’ but also reduce the requirement for the coupling capacitance of the isolated power supply. Finally, the proposed active gate driver circuit is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Space Charges Dynamic Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The space charges effect affects the distortion of the electric field inside the insulating medium. It can affect the aging and breakdown characteristics of the material in insulating materials. The space charges dynamics will greatly shorten this process. This paper presents a numerical simulation of space charges dynamics in insulating materials. We study space charge dynamics by COMSOL simulation software. We use the software to simulate the space charges transient distribution and dynamics measurement. In this paper, the density variation of space charges under nanosecond variation is obtained using numerical simulations with a bipolar charges transport model. Simulation of the dynamic measurement for the density of space charges under nanosecond variations is performed based on the electro acoustic pulse method model simulation.

articleTitle: Characteristics and Mechanism of Line-Line Gap Breakdowns Induced by Wood Crib Fires
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The 30 kVA/50 kV power frequency discharge system was used to trigger the trips (flashover processes) of Aluminum Conductor Steel Reinforced (ACSR) powerline segments (LGJ-400/35) in a 10.0 cm air gap under a wood crib fire (comprehensive fire source), and the characteristics and mechanisms of such line-line air gap (conductor gap) were discussed. The results show that under the wood crib fire, the breakdown voltage of conductor gap is obviously lower than that under pure air. Under the same fire source power, the breakdown voltages of different flame zones are ordered as: pure air (70.0 kV) > intermittent flame zone (top, 32.0 kV-52.4 kV) > continuous flame zone 2 (upper, 21.0 kV-28.0 kV) > continuous flame zone 1 (bottom, 14.4 kV-24.4 kV). In the same flame zone, the breakdown voltage decreases from 52.4 kV to 14.4 kV (25.1 %-79.4% reductions to those in pure air) with the increase of fire source powers (1-3 wood cribs, 121.87 kW-323.66 kW). For the single wood crib fire source, the maximum leakage currents (within the period before the conductor gap breakdown) in the flame intermittent zone, the flame continuous zones 1 and 2 are less than 1.00 mA and 2.54 mA, respectively. Many soot particles and ashes will be generated when wood crib and other ground surface vegetation fire sources burn. They will fill the gaps between power lines and be polarized by the in-service line inducing electric field. Then distorted electric field will be formed between the two polarization ends and the lines. The opposite movements and interactive convections of a large number of electrons, ions and smoke particles in fire plumes are driven to form a discharge streamer channel and cause line-line gap breakdown at proper moments.

articleTitle: Stochastic Stability Analysis of New Energy Power System Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power system as an open dynamic system, on the one hand, it must always ensure the quality of power; On the other hand, it suffers from constant interference, and its location, type and severity are quite uncertain. With the development of new energy generation, the traditional power system model and the analysis method of entropy criterion can not reflect the stochastic problem of power system with new energy generation, and is no longer suitable for the actual system. Taking wind power generation as the representative of new energy power system, this paper summarizes the entropy stability criteria of stochastic power system by using differential equation and combining with the existing stability discrimination methods such as mean stability and mean square stability, analyzes the application scope of various kinds of stability, and carries out simulation analysis with specific examples.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Two-Stage Rectifier Based on Linear Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a model predictive control (MPC) method of two-stage rectifier based on linear extended state observer (LESO). The control performance of conventional MPC is easy to be affected under parameter mismatches and external perturbation condition. To solve this problem, the LESOs are designed to observe the system lumped disturbances. Then, predictive model would be compensated by the observed values to improve the accuracy in one period. The cost function of MPC is evaluated by the method of deadbeat control. Furthermore, to reduce the current ripple, the carrier phase shifting pulse width modulation (CPS-PWM) is applied. The simulation results validate the strong robustness and better dynamic performance in two-stage rectifier compared with conventional method.

articleTitle: Design and Control of the Double Side Variable Frequency Based Brushless Doubly-Fed Generator System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Brushless doubly-fed machine (BDFM) is widely used in wind power, hydraulic power, marine shaft and other variable-speed constant-frequency power generation fields due to its reliable structure and flexible excitation regulation. This paper presents a double side variable frequency (DSVF) based brushless doubly-fed generator (BDFG) system with specific control strategy. Compared with the traditional brushless doubly-fed generator system, this system has the advantages of simple topology, good dynamic response and strong robustness. Moreover, the power winding frequency and control winding frequency of the BDFM are flexibly adjustable. Finally, experimental results from a 30 kW BDFM prototype verify the feasibility and reliability of the proposed system topology and control strategy.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power System Leakage Current Reduction by Paralleled Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the modulation method for paralleled inverters to reduce the leakage current through achieving zero Common-Mode (CM) voltage of the transformerless Photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected systems. PV arrays are tied to paralleled inverters, which are interconnected to the grid via coupling inductors. The reference Voltage Vector (VV) and the paralleled VV are combined based on VV in each inverter. Zero-CM voltage is attained by distributing the action time to each inverter. The proposed Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) approach guarantees that the voltages for both inverters are in equilibrium during every switching cycle; the circulating current between the paralleled inverters is limited by a small value of coupling inductance. The PWM method has the benefit of reducing CM leakage current, and output current ripples. Simulation and experimental results of the proposed method are provided, validating its ability to eliminate CM voltage and suppress the CM leakage current.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Wind Power Consumption Limitation in Power System with High Proportion of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the reasonable capacity of power grid to absorb wind power, a new calculation method is proposed for the combined system of thermal power and wind power. In this paper, the probability and statistics method is used to analyze the output characteristics of wind farm, and the influence of characteristic index on wind farm is studied. A new calculation method of wind power limit is proposed, and the influence of seasonal factors is introduced to study the situation of wind power limit in summer and winter. Through the actual example, the idea and method are provided to formulate the control principle of wind power output, and the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Research on power decoupling of parallel virtual synchronous machine based on feedforward control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When photovoltaic inverters operate in parallel, the output of each inverter’s impedance and the line impedance of aren’t consistent, resulting in the instantaneous voltage of each inverter at the common parallel point is not equal, so in the parallel inverters system, the circulating current is easy to form between each inverter, which affects the distribution of active power together with reactive power. In this paper, feedforward compensation is leaded-in active and reactive power control channels, and dynamic virtual complex impedance method for dynamic improvement of response performance of parallel virtual synchronous machine, so as to increase the degree of freedom of dynamic characteristic control and heighten the feedback speed. The parameters of D (damping drop coefficients) and K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> (excitation coefficient) to make the inductive component of virtual impedance increase and counteract the resistive component, so as to the oscillation of output power is suppressed; Improving the stability of active power and reactive power and speed up the response speed of the system. The simulation display that parallel VSG in Matlab / Simulink make clear that the proposed control strategy is valid and practicable.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Signal of Transformer On- load Tap Changer Based on Kurtosis and Tunable Q-factor Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vibration signal of transformer on-load tap changer during switching can reflect the mechanical property of on-load tap changer. A new analysis method for vibration signal of transformer on-load tap changer based on kurtosis and tunable Q-factor wavelet transform is proposed. The vibration signal is divided into two segments: the rotating segment and the switching segment. For rotating segment, the kurtosis of vibration signal is calculated to diagnose the jam defect of on-load tap changer shaft. For switching segment, the intraclass correlation coefficient of different tap positions based on the results of tunable Q-factor wavelet transform are compared. The intraclass correlation coefficient can characterize whether mechanical defect is existing in on-load tap changer. The investigation results show that analysis of vibration signal based on kurtosis and tunable Q-factor wavelet transform can effectively evaluate the status of on-load tap changer, which provides important means for monitoring the mechanical condition of on-load tap changer.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Operating Principle of Fault Current Limiter Based on High Coupled Split Reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fault current limiter is one of the important means to solve this problem of excessive short-circuit current. The use of high coupled spilt reactor (HCSR) to achieve limit and interruption of fault circuit current (FCL) is a new technique in recent years. The distributions of fault current on current-sharing state and voltage inside the FCL on current-limiting state are verified through the small prototype test in this article. The test results show that the input of the arc resistance will cause the current difference of the two parallel branches of the FCL. After analysis, it is found that this difference is proportional to the single-arm inductance of HCSR, so it will be small when applied to high current, and will not affect the current sharing of the two branches. Besides, the difference of the voltages of two vacuum breakers and the appearance of DC voltage between the branches at the end of the HCSR are related to the value of current-chopping, which can be ignored in the high-current situation. The phenomenon different from the ideal simulation during the test is analyzed to verify the feasibility of the FCL topology based on HCSR in actual operation.

articleTitle: An ANN-INC MPPT Strategy for Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) technology is widely used to achieve high-efficiency output of photovoltaic system under the changing irradiation and temperature conditions. To improve the efficiency of the photovoltaic system, a MPPT control strategy based on neural network and incremental conductance (ANN-INC) is proposed in this paper. In ANN-INC, the output of the trained neural network is transferred to the INC part as the initial duty cycle, which makes the initial duty cycle have a small gap with the duty cycle when the photovoltaic system works at MPP, then the INC part can select a small step size to make the output of the photovoltaic system closer to expected output. The strategy has simple structure, fast dynamic response speed, small steady-state power oscillations and high efficiency. The strategy also performs well when the irradiation changes rapidly. The superiority of the strategy is verified in Matlab / Simulink.

articleTitle: An Improved Space Vector Modulation Method for the Reduction of Common-Mode Voltages in PMSM Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to suppress the negative effects of the common-mode voltage (CMV) generated in the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) control system, an improved space vector modulation method for CMV reduction is proposed in this paper. Compared with traditional space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM), it has same modulation range and has great dynamic and steady-state performance when used in the PMSM control system. In addition, it can reduce the amplitude of CMV from V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC</inf>/2 to V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC</inf>/6. Comparisons with existing modulation methods, as well as, experimental results are provided to verify feasibility and stability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on UHV GIS Bus Fault Location Method Based on Protection Action Behavior and Ultra-high Frequency Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To study the GIS fault location method with no obvious fault characteristics, this paper firstly studies the propagation characteristics of electromagnetic waves in GIS equipment, and then proposes a fault location method and system of GIS equipment based on protection action behavior and ultra-high frequency online monitoring. Finally, the effectiveness of this method is verified by an UHV GIS fault example.

articleTitle: Analysis of Measuring Distribution Electrical Parameters of Current Transformer Using Impedance Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Basic electrical parameters directly affect the performance of the current transformer while some distribution parameters are difficult to calculate and measure. This paper establishes the general equivalent circuit model and series equivalent impedance expression of the current transformer. A prototype is made and tested with an impedance analyzer to obtain the series equivalent impedance. Combining the impedance expression and the measurement results, through calculation and fitting, the distribution parameters of the current transformer are determined.

articleTitle: Operation optimization of integrated energy system based on variable efficiency characteristics of equipment and dynamic model of pipe network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, operation optimization of integrated energy system based on variable efficiency characteristics of equipment and dynamic characteristics of pipe network is studied. The equipment includes combined heating and power unit, electric boiler, and wind turbine, photovoltaic power generation. An energy hub model based on dynamic efficiency characteristics of equipment is established. At the same time, the dynamic model of thermal pipe network is considered in this paper, while the dynamic process of the pipe network under the change of mass flow is discussed. The operation optimization considering the variable efficiency of equipment and pipe network is studied with the objective of the minimum operating cost. The results show that proposed operation optimization model has better economy, the case shows that the total cost was reduced by about 8.88%. And the thermal dynamic process of the pipeline network is more obvious in the large integrated energy system, that the average time of dynamic process is increased by 31 minutes than that of the small system in the case.

articleTitle: Peak Shaving Potential of Residential Areas Considering Energy Consumption Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to formulate a reasonable time of use (TOU) power price to maximize the ability of users to participate in peak-shaking demand response projects, it is necessary to further study the impact of TOU price mechanism on residents' peak-shaking potential. Therefore, in this paper, first, the power load characteristics of urban residential areas is analyzed and a multi-period load model is established. Then, based on the concepts of self-elasticity and cross-elasticity coefficients of electricity demand for different time periods, corresponding load reduction and transfer models are constructed. Further, the demand response potential of users in each time period is analyzed and defined from the two perspectives of demand response capability and speed. A case study in a residential area in China is implemented. Case study results verified the effectiveness of the presented analysis method, and show that the peak-shaking potential of residential energy use behavior is greatly affected by different TOU power price peak-valley ratios.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics of Infrared Absorption Spectrum of SF6 Decomposition Component CO
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Infrared absorption characteristics of gases is a key basis for its qualitative measurement. In this paper, the temperature and pressure characteristics of the infrared absorption spectrum of CO were studied on the basis of HITRAN database. Because the peak value and linewidth of absorption line are two important parameters of the absorption line, in this paper, based on the line by line integration method, we have carried out the simulation on the characteristics of near infrared band 6350~6420 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The results show that the linewidth is mainly affected by the pressure, and with the increase of pressure, the linewidth also increases; while the absorption peak is mainly affected by the temperature, and with the increase of temperature, the peak will decrease. In contrast, although the pressure will also affect the peak, the influence is low. The results provide a reference for the selection of the CO laser and the temperature and pressure of the gas cell.

articleTitle: A Section Location Method in Active Distribution Networks Based on Multiple Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the flexible topology characteristics of active distribution network, the network topology is not described timely and accurately by adjacency matrix, where the matrix algorithm is not adaptive to the flexible network. Therefore, a novel matrix algorithm-based method is proposed to describe the spatial and temporal characteristics of active distribution network topology. Firstly, the relationship between network nodes and branches is described by the graph theory, which is combined with the real-time switch state matrix to obtain the dynamic adjacency matrix describing electrical connection states. Then, based on the network branch type classification, a partition and hierarchical traversal method is adopted, for fault location. Meanwhile, the reverse traversal is used to complement forward traversal to solve the problem of blind spot when multiple faults occurred in DG network. Case study results on an active distribution network show that, the proposed fault section location method has good adaptability to the flexible topology change and leads to accurate section location results.

articleTitle: A Ripple Suppression Method Applied to Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Flywheel energy storage system (FESS) is becoming more and more attractive due to its broad application prospects. The practical application of FESS faces the problem of rotor heating caused by high frequency harmonics of PWM inverter, especially in medium and high speed systems, which seriously restricts the performance of the system. In this paper, a suppression method of high frequency ripple based on capacitor isolated ripple compensation inverter is proposed. The operating principle of the circuit is analyzed and the control method based on this circuit is designed. Finally, simulations are built to demonstrate the validity of the analysis.

articleTitle: Intraday Rolling Optimal Dispatch Considering Wind Power and Load Demand Uncertainty for Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integrated energy system can effectively promote the complementary advantages among energy sources, which are usually-presented random-like properties. To cope with the uncertainty of wind power and load demand, scenario analysis method is used for analyzing the uncertainty for optimal dispatching. The model predictive control is used to establish a closed-loop dynamic rolling. The results of day-ahead optimal scheme are as reference value to refine and correct the output of core coupling equipment in the short-term intraday scheduling. Finally, the modified IEEE30-node power system with a 10-node natural gas system and a 7-node thermal system is tested as an electricity-gas-heat integrated energy system. The test results turn out the correctness and validity of the intraday rolling optimal dispatch.

articleTitle: An improved Fault Current Limiter for self-clearing MMC-based dc distribution network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Considering the investment cost and operation safety, an improved fault current limiter (FCL) for dc distributed network based on self-clearing converters is proposed in this paper. Before self-clearing converters being blocked, dc fault current can be automatically limited, which provides enough time for selective protection to identify fault lines and reduce the action speed requirements on mechanical switches. During normal operation, the proposed FCL does not deteriorate the transient response characteristics of dc system. The circuit design, control strategy and protection are simple. The threshold values on the voltage, current and capacity of power electronic devices are low, which greatly reduces the cost and conducting loss, because the power of dc reactor is divided from the dc cable.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of "Source-load" Time Series Changes on Voltage and Reactive Power Partitioning in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With large scale of distributed generations(DGs) access to the distribution network, the complexity of system optimization and control increases considering the random output of DGs and load fluctuation. In this paper, the influence of DGs connected to the distribution network on voltage and reactive power partitioning is analyzed based on the time series variation characteristics of power source and power load. Firstly, based on the principle of voltage and reactive power partitioning, four indexes containing inter-region coupling degree, intra-region coupling degree, regional reactive power balance degree and regional reactive power reserve are selected as the partitioning evaluation indicators. Secondly, typical scenarios of the "source-load" time series are divided with the comprehensively analysis of the time series characteristics of wind power and photovoltaic output and the typical daily load curve. Then, the influence of the four partition evaluation indicators in multiple "source-load" scenarios is analyzed. Finally, case studies based on modified IEEE33 test system are performed, and the result verifies the influence of the variation of "source-load" time series output on voltage reactive power partitioning.

articleTitle: Power Factor Improvement for a Magnetic-Geared Flat Linear Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Magnetic-geared Flat Linear Machine (MGFLM) has the advantage of low material costs for long stroke applications. However, the relative low power factor of the MGFLM need to be improved. Through the derivation of the power factor equation, it is found that reducing the q-axis inductance would help to improve the power factor. The Halbach permanent-magnet arrays is adopted to reduce the harmonic components and increase the fundamental magnetic flux density of the MGFLM. Based on the FEA, the effects of every possible slot-pole combination and key dimensional parameters on the power factor and average thrust of the MGFLM are discussed. Compared to the original MGFLM, the power factor was effectively increased from 0.537 to 0.807 with a merely 3.3% loss in the average thrust.

articleTitle: Analysis of variable-speed units for hydropower station to integrate renewable power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The consumption and abandonment problem has become an inescapable issue for the development of renewable energy industry. It's generally recognized that multi-energy complementary technology and energy storage technology are the noteworthy methods. The main purpose of this paper is to provide an analysis of using variable-speed generation units to improve the wind-solar-water complementary capability of hydropower stations, which combines the characteristics of the hydro-mechanical-electric system of a hydropower station with the advantages of variable-speed units, and it promised to expand the functions of hydropower stations and make the profit channels of hydropower stations more diversified. In order to realize the method, a complete mathematical description of variable-speed hydropower system was given, then it was verified with random fluctuations of wind power and photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reduced Order Model of VSC with Phase Lock Loop Based on Singular Perturbation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Phase lock loop (PLL), served as a dedicated synchronization unit, is a crucial component for voltage source converter (VSC). As a nonlinear unit, the dynamics of PLL raise the order of the overall VSC system model, which finally increases the analysis complexity. To overcome these, this paper proposed a dynamic reduced order model of VSC with PLL based on singular perturbation. The states of the VSC system can be divided into three parts by time scales, i.e. relatively fast states, relatively slow states, and states with medium time scale, and then can be reduced by singular perturbation method. Thanks to the method, the variables in the reduced model reserves their physical meaning. And the proposed model can greatly decrease the computational burden and analysis complexity with little compromise of accuracy. The effectiveness of the proposed reduced model has been fully validated in PSCAD/EMTDC compared with full detailed model under static, dynamic operation conditions, as well as under voltage sag event.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Consumer-Side Distributed Resources Based on IoT and Energy Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the popularization and rapid development of distributed generation and energy storage technology, many end users have changed from simple energy consumers to prosumers. However, consumer-side distributed resources, like PV generation and energy storage devices, have limited capacity and are not directly regulated by the electric power network dispatch system. In modern energy internet, these distributed resources are designed to receive dispatch instructions from new operation entities like load aggregators and virtual power plants. In this paper, an optimal dispatch platform of consumer-side distributed resources based on Internet of Things (IoT) and blockchain technology is proposed. Firstly, the operation framework considering participants, optimal operation scheme, data structure, value settlement is designed. Afterward, an energy blockchain structure for consumer-side distributed resources regulation is proposed. Then, the implementation of energy blockchain technology for distributed resources to participate optimal operation of distribution system is introduced. Finally, the availability of the proposed technologies is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Unbalanced Voltage Compensation Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Considering Spare Capacity of Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the photovoltaic (PV), making full use of the spare capacity of PV converters to remedy the unbalanced voltage problem is becoming a promising idea. In this paper, a dual-module based asymmetrical voltage compensation strategy is developed for PV converters to utilize the spare converter capacity as needed. By means of the positive/negative-sequence dual-module design, the proposed control strategy can mitigate the negative voltage and provide the reactive power to improve the overall PCC voltage.
