A power constraint factor based on the instantaneous power theory is introduced to flexibly adjust the converter power within the converter capacity. Effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulations on PSCAD/EMTDC platform.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Fault-Tolerant Switched Flux Permanent Magnet Machine with Modular Stator and Rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In many industrial applications, the high fault-tolerant capability of switched flux permanent magnet (SFPM) machine is required. The short-circuit fault between turns of the armature winding is one of the most common faults in SFPM machines. To prohibit the damage in this machine during the short-circuit fault, the amplitude of the short-circuit current should be limited. Thus, a modular stator and rotor SFPM (MSR-SFPM) machine with lower mutual inductance between armature windings is developed and compared with the conventional E-core SFPM machine in terms of short-circuit current and fault tolerant capability. The electromagnetic performance and short-circuit fault-tolerant capability of MSR-SFPM machine are investigated as well as the conventional SFPM machine. The results indicate that MSR-SFPM machine has lower torque ripple due to the lower short-circuit current during short-circuit fault compared with the conventional SFPM machine.

articleTitle: Technical scheme of autonomous controllable operating system for intelligent power distribution terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper firstly introduces the application status of all kinds of power terminals in State Grid Corporation of China, and analyzes the security and controllability of terminal operating system. This paper studies the Android operating system scheme of mobile terminal, and summarizes the independent and controllable scheme of current mainstream operating system. On this basis, the design objectives and technical solutions of the intelligent power distribution terminal operating system are put forward, and the functional boundaries of the terminal power business framework are deeply studied. Finally the technical evolution ideas are given, which provides a reference for the future in-depth study of the intelligent power distribution terminal operating system.

articleTitle: Active Negative Capacitor Based Second Harmonic Current Suppressing Methodfor DC Bus of Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In single-phase inversion system, pulsating power at twice of the line voltage frequency results in secondary harmonic current (SHC) on the DC side of voltage source inverter. To address the issue, this paper proposes a method based on active negative capacitors (ANC) to suppress SHC. Where, the secondary power will only circuit between the AC side of inverter and the proposed ripple suppression circuit. Meanwhile, the proposed circuit works in plug-in and plug-out and parallel on the DC side of inverter instead of the traditional large capacitor, increasing power density and reducing design cost. Finally, the simulation and experimental results of current ripple suppression are presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Genetic Neural Network for Tide Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The tide forecasting is an important task in the daily operation and optimal scheduling in tidal power station. Tidal level forecasting has its difficulty because the level is always effected by non-cyclical factors which are required for the prediction of tidal level. Traditional artificial neural network(ANN) model has been widely used in tide forecasting, however, the ANN model has some shortages, such as slow training, low precision or easy to fall into local optimum. Based on the ANN model, this paper presents a genetic neural network (GNN) model has been improved for forecasting the tidal level, which weights and thresholds are optimized by genetic algorithm. This GNN model can easily decide the nonlinear input-output relation and has a higher precision. Three models which adopt different algorithms will be used to test the performance of the proposed model. The result indicates the hourly tidal levels can be accurately predicted by the GNN model using a short-term hourly tidal records.

articleTitle: Density Functional Theory Study of Heptafluoroisobutyronitrile and its Decompositions Adsorption on γ-Al2O3

In this study, using the first-principles study with density functional theory, the adsorption performance of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>CN and its decomposition components on the surface of γ-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> was investigated. articleTitle: Clustering Effect Evaluation on Offshore Wind Power Based on Time-amplitude and Time-frequency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With large-scale offshore wind farms integrated to power systems, it becomes necessary to consider the clustering effect of wind power during planning and operation of power systems. Addition to traditional time-amplitude analysis, time-frequency analysis is also employed to evaluate the clustering effect of offshore wind power simultaneously and comprehensively. To evaluate the clustering effect quantitatively and accurately, an extensive index system is presented including normalized average output value, deviation coefficient, proportion of low output, peak-to-valley difference, smoothing coefficient, modal fluctuation rate, and frequency amplitude ratio. Consequently, in time-amplitude domain, the long-term and short-term output characteristics of single wind farm and long-term fluctuation correlation and short-term clustering complementarity of multiple wind farms are investigated. And, in time-frequency domain, variational mode decomposition (VMD) is used to decompose multiple wind power sequences to calculate the frequency range of wind power fluctuation. Finally, case study based on the practical data of offshore wind farms in Jiangsu province, China, is performed to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed evaluation scheme.

articleTitle: Effect of Al(OH)3 and thermal ageing on the dielectric performance of composite insulator shed based on THz-TDS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Composite insulator shed is easy to be affected by temperature, ultraviolet radiation, and other factors, resulting in the declining of insulation performance and threatening the safe operation. This paper aims at studying the terahertz frequency domain characteristics of high temperature vulcanized (HTV) silicone rubber (SIR) by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS). Besides, the effects of high temperature on HTV SIR and the ageing mechanism in terahertz frequency domain are explored. The results show that ATH (Al(OH)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) in HTV SIR has obvious characteristic peaks at 1.2THz and 1.33THz, which can also increase the refractive index and dielectric constant of HTV SIR. Moreover, thermal ageing increases the refractive index and dielectric constant of HTV SIR in terahertz frequency domain with ageing time. The results of Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) show that the intensity of -OH increases but the intensity of C-H, -CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Si-O-Si decrease with ageing time, which helps explain the results of THz-TDS. This study shows that THz-TDS is of great significance to the detection of polymers.

articleTitle: Security-Constrained Unit Commitment Considering Wind Power Uncertainty Subject to Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing penetration level of wind power will impose a huge barrier on how to effectively accommodate wind power use its predicted value. To address this issue, we propose an uncertain security-constrained unit commitment model considering the uncertainty of wind power subject to cyber attacks. First, two uncertainty sets of wind power are constructed based on the wind power forecast and its probability distribution, and are added into the traditional security-constrained unit commitment model. Then, under the premise of the slacked line power flow constraints and these uncertainty sets, the safe consumption interval of wind power the power system is obtained to solve this unit commitment problem. Additionally, the constrained wind power consumption interval by line power flow can not only ensure the safety of the power system, but also effectively restrain the attackable range of wind power forecast. The simulation results based on modified IEEE 6-bus, IEEE 30-bus and IEEE118-bus systems verify the effectiveness of the proposed model under different wind power scenarios.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of C4F7N and its Decomposed Products Adsorption on Gamma-Aluminum Oxide

The results show that the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>CN and its decomposed products which contain C=N exhibits obvious adsorption behavior, and γ-AI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> can be used for adsorbent toward compounds containing cyano-group in environmental insulation equipment using C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>CN as medium.

articleTitle: DC Line Single-ended Protection Scheme for Flexible HVDC grid Based on Traveling Wave
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fast and reliable DC line protection is one of the key techniques that limits the development of flexible high voltage direct current (HVDC) grid. Based on the analysis of characteristics of voltage traveling wave (TW) on DC line of flexible HVDC grid, a single-ended protection scheme is proposed in this paper. Firstly, high frequency wavelet singular value entropy is used to extract fault features of 1-mode voltage backward TW and to build fault identification criterion. Then, fault pole criterion is used based on the characteristics of 0-mode voltage backward TW. Furthermore, auxiliary criterion for lightning disturbance is proposed. Finally, the proposed protection scheme can identify fault area and type correctly without the influence of lightning disturbance, which is verified by simulation cases based on the PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Current Limiter Based on Highly Coupled Split Reactor on Main Circuit Breaker Overvoltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing short-circuit current levels in modern power grids, it is planned to install a current limiter based on a high-coupling split reactor in the 500kV power grid to limit the short-circuit current. However, the connection of the current limiter will cause the transient recovery voltage of the main circuit breaker to exceed the standard envelope, making the breaking conditions of the main circuit breaker very severe. This paper establishes a mathematical model and finds that the oscillating circuit formed by the current-limiting inductance and the stray capacitance of the system is the reason why the overvoltage rise rate of the main circuit breaker is greatly increased. Establish a single-phase equivalent circuit model for simulation. It is found that the rate of rise of the transient recovery voltage decreases with the increase of the stray capacitance of the system. When the stray capacitance takes the estimated value of the system parameters, the transient recovery voltage rise rate reaches its peak when the current-limiting inductance is 9mH.

articleTitle: Surface Charge Accumulation Characteristics in C4F7N Mixtures with Different Buffer Gases
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)

The total charges in C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture is most, followed by C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture, and SFr, is the least. The conclusions could provide appropriate suggestions for the practical engineering application of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N mixtures in DC GIL.

articleTitle: An experimental study of demand response effect of a multi-building portfolio
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Demand response (DR) can effectively balance the contradiction between power supply and demand and promote the integration of renewable energy into the grid by changing the end user's power demand curve through control strategies. Relevant research has begun to pay attention to the important role of building users in demand response. The current experimental research on building demand response is only focused on single building, because the experiment of simultaneous demand response for multiple buildings is restricted by various external factors. However, the load of a single building is relatively small compared to the entire power grid, so the building needs to be involved in the demand response project in the form of a building group. This paper reports on an experimental research on the demand response effect of a building group composed of 10 office buildings, based on the Shanghai demand response pilot experiment. Firstly, the basic information of each building of the building group is introduced, and the scheduling process of the demand response experiment of the buildings is demonstrated; Secondly, the demand response baseline method used in this paper is detailed; this is followed by analyzing the demand response effect of each building and the building group on the day of the demand response experiment. The experimental results revealed that the average load reduction rate of the entire building group during the demand response period was about 8.44%, and each building had a relatively obvious load reduction.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Demagnetization for Cylindrical Magnetic Shielding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Magnetic shielding is an important part in atomic clock’s physical system. The demagnetization of the assembled magnetic shielding system plays an important role in improving atomic clock’s performance. In terms of the drawbacks in traditional attenuated alternating-current demagnetizing method, this paper proposes a novel method — automatically attenuated alternating-current demagnetizing method. Which is implemented by controlling the demagnetization current waveform thorough the signal source’s modulation, so that these parameters such as demagnetizing current frequency, amplitude, transformation mode and demagnetizing period are precisely adjustable. At the same time, this demagnetization proceeds automatically, operates easily, and works steadily. We have the pulsed optically pumped (POP) rubidium atomic clock’s magnetic shielding system for the demagnetization experiment, the magnetic field value reached 1nT/7cm. Experiments show that novel method can effectively realize the demagnetization of the magnetic shielding system, and well meets the atomic clock’s working requirements.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Graphene Superhydrophobic Coating with Excellent Superhydrophobic/Electrothermal Synergistically Anti-icing Fuction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This research reported an effective de-icing method by combining the superhydrophobic and electrothermal functions. Due to the high specific surface area, the modified graphene powder exhibited superhydrophobic property. The coating was achieved by further partially embedding the graphene powders onto the substrate. The partiall-embeded structure offers the composite excellent mechanical robustness, which could retain superhydrophobicity after 10.00 m abrasion (5 kPa pressure). Furthermore, the excellent conductivity of the graphene offered the composite excellent electrothermal property. Therefore, this superhydrophobic composite could melt ice layer (2 mm thickness) within ~121 s after applying 20 V voltage.

articleTitle: Power Imbalance Mitigation by Grid Impedances under Multiple-Point Inertial Responses of Generations with Different Power Points
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates power imbalance mitigations by grid impedances under multiple-point inertial responses of non-synchronous generation (NSG) with positive and negative power points. Firstly, an inertial normalization method is put forward to unify inertia time constants at the same base of kinetic energy for all generators. Then, a network reduction method is applied to converter complex network topology to simpler radial form with one center point for the ease of grid impedance losses analysis. Next, a novel theory is established to analyze total grid impedance losses under multiple-point synthetic inertial responses of NSG with different power points when being subject to same rate of change of grid frequency, which implies that heavier total inertia in the generation with negative power points (importation) results in grid impedance losses variations to counteract overall grid imbalance. This conclusion is effectively validated verified in the model of IEEE 3 machine 9-bus system.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Technology of Opening and Closing Process of GW4 Disconnector in Normal and Jam Fault State
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper mainly selects the commonly used type of isolating switch-GW4 isolating switch, establishes its three-dimensional simulation model, simulates and analyzes the force of each component during the opening and closing actions, and simulates and analyzes the jamming fault on the motor current and output torque of the electric mechanism. And the influence of opening and closing action process. It provides an important reference basis for the installation, commissioning, overhaul and maintenance of the isolation switch, and reduces the defect rate of the isolation switch accident.

articleTitle: Research on Secondary Arc Characteristics of EHV Transmission Lines With Fault Current Limiter Based on High Coupled Split Reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To resolve the trouble of immoderate fault current with the improvement of the extra-high voltage (EHV) power system, additionally the voltage sags and power loss brought on by the traditional current-limiting ways, a innovative fault current limiter (FCL), which applies high coupled split reactor (HCSR) to current-limiting technology, has drawn severe interest due to its high reliability and superior current-limiting ability. In this paper, the secondary arc current characteristics of EHV lines with the FCL based on HCSR are investigated. Based on the simplified network and Laplace transform method, the variation of secondary arc current oscillation frequency and attenuation coefficient at different fault positions with and without the FCL based on HCSR is analyzed, and the transient characteristics are simulated and verified on the PSCAD platform. From the results, the application of the FCL based on HCSR will produce a high-frequency component of about 900 Hz during the fast decay period of the free component of the secondary arc current, which will cause its maximum value to larger. However, it will accelerate the decay rate of the secondary arc current and make it extinguish the arc faster.

articleTitle: The dynamic characteristics of dielectric barrier discharge patterns under Karman vortex on atmospheric airflow
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) has received more and more attention due to its wide application in many industrial applications, such as medical treatment, materials processing, and environment protection. The coupling of airflow and discharge is an important issue, such as the influence of flow velocities on discharge characteristics and the influence of discharge on airflow characteristics have been extensively studied. In this paper, the airflow of the periodic Karman vortex is constructed and the influence of the airflow on the discharge pattern is studied. Through measuring the discharge signal and relative light intensity under the Karman vortex, it is found that the discharges in the vortex areas are more vulnerable to breakdown and the relative light intensities of the discharges are stronger. In the front of the cylindrical section, the discharge pattern shows the discharge filament following the incoming flow direction. At the rear of the cylindrical section, the discharge pattern is presented as curved discharge wire configuring two rows of vortexes. The dynamic characteristics show that two rows of vortexes are generated and separated alternately, and each row of the vortex is also regularly generated and separated. The movement law of the discharge patterns is basically the same as the Karman vortex simulation. The variation characteristics of the airflow can be basically reflected in the discharge patterns. The dynamic characteristics of dielectric barrier discharge patterns are related to the changes of the spatial domains of the Karman vortex constructed in this paper.

articleTitle: Sloution of Voltage Violation for Rural Distribution Network with High Photovoltaic Penetration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of distributed power technology and the promotion of China's photovoltaic poverty alleviation policy, a large number of photovoltaic integrations to rural distribution network have caused serious problems of voltage overrun and line loss surge, which has aroused a great deal of attention for the operation of traditional rural power network. This paper proposes a revised planning optimization solution model for this application scenario and takes into account the use of the reactive power incentive and reward mechanism under the power market to promote the participation of user-side photovoltaic in reactive power regulation, so as to achieve significant cost reduction. A practical numerical sample of a rural distribution in inner mongolia is carried out to verify the proposed solution.

Author Keywords: reactive power incentive and reward mechanism

articleTitle: Bi-level programming method for integrated energy system considering thermal dynamic operation characteristics of pipelines and efficiency characteristics of devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the upper optimization, based on the dynamic model of heating network, solves the problem of pipe network failure caused by too low temperature, the lower layer optimizes the capacities of the devices at the heat sources with the objective of economy according to the results of upper layer. Through the case analysis, the result shows that after optimization, the difference between the pipeline temperature and standard temperature is reduced by 33%, the minimum temperature of the pipe is increased from 52.5 °C to 76.7 °C, and the problem of pipeline failure is effectively avoided. Compared to the traditional capacity optimization model, the capacity planning cost of the two heat sources is reduced by 3.37% and 4.14% respectively. The bi- level programming model proposed in this paper can effectively avoid the operation failure of pipe network, and has better economic benefits after considering the variable efficiency characteristics of energy device.

articleTitle: Harmonic mitigation and resonance damping of MMC-SAPF with low switching frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The shunt power capacitor will cause parallel resonance in the medium voltage (MV) power distribution system with nonlinear load. MMC-SAPF with low switching frequency is applied to handle this problem. Firstly, topology and control of device including modulation strategy is studied. Then, the parallel resonance mechanism in the MV power distribution system is analyzed. And then harmonic mitigation and resonance damping of MMC-SAPF is investigated. Finally, a large number of experimental results are tested to prove the utility of control strategy.

articleTitle: Exergy Analysis for Main Heat Transfer System of CEFR
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Many pieces of research on the high efficiency and energy saving for power plants mainly focus on thermal power plants or pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants. There are few studies on the efficiency of the sodium-cooled fast reactor (SFR). To determine the energy loss during the operation for the thermal system of the supercritical reactor and design a better construction scheme for the supercritical reactor, in this paper the neutron reactor and the important equipment of the main heat exchange loop in CEFR were modeled, and the exergy loss and exergy efficiency during the operation under rated conditions are also analyzed. The results show that the biggest exergy loss of the main heat transfer system is the reactor core during CEFR operation. In the main heat exchange system of CEFR, the exergy efficiency of the once-through steam generator is the lowest.

articleTitle: Power grid two-level dispatch strategy with participation of electric heating load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Existing heating methods mostly use coal or gas heating, which has high heating costs, environmental pollution and potential safety hazards. The use of electric energy for heating is the development trend of heating technology, but the electric heating load demand is random and fluctuating, and it is not easy to control. Therefore, this paper designs an implementation process of two-level optimal dispatch strategy with the participation of electric heating load: According to the heating conditions, the load is divided into controllable load and uncontrollable load; Predict the change trend of controllable load based on the generalized regression neural network (GRNN); Design a two-level dispatching strategy at the grid-user level, the grid layer optimizes its ordered heating strategy and time-of-use electricity price strategy in real time according to load types, load change trends and user satisfaction, and the user layer adjusts electricity consumption behavior according to the grid layer dispatching strategy and feeds back satisfaction indicators; According to the heating load satisfaction, the feasibility of strategy is evaluated. The strategy designed in this paper can effectively optimize load heating, reduce heating expenditure and improve user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-functional Controller of Bolt Tightening and Torque Value Detection of High Voltage Tower
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the electric-power industry, the safety of the high-voltage tower is of paramount importance, therefore, the bolts used to fix the tower must be applied with appropriate torque value. At present, most tools for fastening bolts use electric wrench with fixed torque. Although they can only tighten the bolts, they cannot recheck the tightening strength of the bolts. Aiming at this problem, a multi-function controller system is designed to realize bolt fastening and detection. Through the test platform for inspection, the experimental results show that the designed system can realize the function of bolt tightening and torque detection, and the error meets the industrial standard.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of DC-line Fault Recovery Squences Control on AC Power Grid at HVDC Sending-end and Corresponding Mitigation Measures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC-line fault recovery sequences (DFRS) are effective measures to improve the operational reliability of the HVDC transmission system, but these measures will also bring active power and reactive power impacts to the connected AC power grid. The paper first introduces the simulation model of the DC control system and the method to simulate the operation process of DFRS. Then combining with the DC control system model which is based on the actual project, the time domain simulation analysis is carried out to study the impact of the restart process on the AC power grid and the influence of the AC power grid strength and the initial firing angle of DFRS on the impact degree. On this basis, aiming at the risk that the low voltage ride through control function of nearby wind turbines may be triggered due to the low voltage on the sending-end power grid during the process of DFRS, an optimization strategy for DFRS is proposed. Finally, a simulation is performed based on the large-scale wind power grid connected Qishao UHVDC transmission system, and the effectiveness of the optimization strategy to improve the stable operation stability of the power grid is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Torque Harmonic Elimination for Dual Three-Phase PMSMs Based on CPS-SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional single three-phase two-level voltage source inverter introduces high-frequency current ripple due to pulse width modulation. It leads to high-frequency vibration and noise in motor control. To solve this problem, carrier phase-shift SVPWM (CPS-SVPWM) algorithm for a dual three-phase PMSM system is proposed in this paper. First, the reasons for the high-frequency torque ripple in the traditional three-phase PMSM system is analyzed. On this basis, a carrier phase shift algorithm is proposed for the dual three-phase PMSM system to reduce the motor torque ripple. Finally, finite element simulation verified the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Location and capacity determination of PET based on operation simulation of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the user power system is connected to the AC distribution network, the power system’s composition and operation characteristics, the access equipment, and their performance would influence the energy efficiency of the distribution network, which is needed to be considered in the design stage. For this reason, the power electronic transformer (PET) as access equipment is analyzed. According to the structure and operation characteristics of PET, the simulation model of PET in the ETAP is established, and the parameters of PET in power flow calculation are set. Then, the principle of PET location and capacity design and its steps are determined. Finally, the IEEE 33 bus distribution system is taken as our case study. The energy efficiency difference of distribution network between PET and traditional transformer is compared. And the capacity of PET as well as access point of PET is optimized based on maximizing energy efficient under different scenarios, the results is useful in access design for distribution network integrated by PET.

Author Keywords: Energy efficiency of AC distribution network

articleTitle: Interturn Short-Circuit Fault Diagnosis of PMSM for Small Hydropower
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There is a growing interest in small hydropower clean energy, and PMSM is the decisive service equipment in hydropower system, it is vital to ensure the stable and efficient operation of PMSM. However, there exist complex operating conditions make fault diagnosis difficult. Thus, in this paper, a diagnosis method for interturn short-circuit of PMSM for small hydropower is proposed. By analyzing the fault component, this method uses Extended State Observer (ESO) to estimate the fault signature of PMSM with interturn short-circuit. Then, the frequency tracking algorithm calculates the amplitude of faults signature and sets it as fault indicator. The method can be easily implemented in hydropower control system. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Effect of Void on Temperature Distribution in XLPE Power Cables by COMSOL Multiphysics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Cross-linked polyethylene cable (XLPE) is the most popular power cable in transmission and distribution. The electric cable has been working for many years. It has high importance on several factors and characteristics such as electrical, mechanical, temperature, humidity, void, and environmental stress, which could influence the cable insulation and contribute to the breakdown of the insulation. This paper major purpose is to evaluate and observe the effect of temperature distribution in the existence of void and without any void that has been located at the different locations within the cable insulation. The Finite Element Method (FEM) technique is utilized based on COMSOL Simulation software to check the temperature distribution behavior. First, the cable structure of 11kV XLPE was designed. Second, the cable structure and the void effect were introduced with different cable conductor, insulation, and semiconductor layers. Different parameter values, such as relative permittivity, thermal conductivity, and other parameter values, were inserted. Third, the simulation has been carried out with heat transfer in the solid module to determine the void effect. The result describes the temperature distribution effect within the cable insulation and the presence of the void placed in a different position.

articleTitle: Power Quality Monitoring and Load Protection System Based on Intelligent switch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of precise location and isolation of power quality disturbance in distribution system, a power quality monitoring and load protection system based on intelligent switch was designed. The electric energy information is collected and analyzed on the spot by the intelligent switch. Load protection is executed according to the analysis results. In the process of power quality analysis, windowed Fourier transform is used to detect harmonics. The average current is used to calculate the unbalanced degree of three-phase current. The transient power disturbance is identified by Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT). The accuracy of the above algorithm for each indicator monitoring is verified by the co-simulation system. Simulate the case where the index is out of limit, and the protective effect of the switch on the load is proved.

articleTitle: Study on High Voltage Pulse Driven Air Plasma Interaction with NH3 through Direct/Indirect Manner
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Removal or reuse of wasted NH3 by cold atmospheric plasma has great potential in industry and green agricultural and is benefit for energy saving and environment protection. This study investigated the interaction between pulse driven air plasma and gaseous NH3 through a direct and an indirect manner. A pin-pin discharge device was used. The gas phase products of direct reaction and indirect reaction of plasma and NH3 were compared and analyzed. It was found that double nitrogen fertilizer NH4NO3 could be formed during the indirect reaction manner while NH3 was decomposed by the direct reaction manner. Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy was used to measure the gas phase products. The concentration of NO, NO2 and NH3 vs. time was calculated to illustrate the chemical process inside the reaction chamber. The optical emission spectrum (OES) of discharging in different gas or gas mixture were recorded and the plasma temperature was fitted by using the spectrum of the N2 second positive system. The steady state temperature profile inside the reaction chamber during the discharge was also simulated. Finally, the possible reactions mechanisms during the direct and indirect reaction process were discussed.

articleTitle: Aqueous 1-naphthol Decomposition by DC Water Plasma at Atmospheric Pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Water thermal plasma is one of the effective methods to decompose persistent organic pollutants in waste liquid At present work, the decomposition of high concentration 1-naphthol in direct current (DC) water plasma was investigated. The experimental results showed that the major gaseous effluents were H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (42.1—50.4%), CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (11.7—15.2%), CO (3.9—76%), CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> (0.01—0.15%) and the content of the syngas was over 49.6%. The gas temperature was 5500 K under the condition of current at 7A and intial concentration at 500 mg/L. The decomposition efficiencies of 1-naphthol, COD and TOC were increased with the increase of the current (6A—SA). The maximum decomposition efficiency of 1-naphthol was over 99.5% at the current of 8 A. The higher initial concentration can lead to lower 1-naphthol degradation. This study provided an experimental analysis for the application of water vapor plasma technology in treatment of high concentration organic wastewater.

articleTitle: Virtual Synchronous Generator with Self-adaptive Power Regulation Ability in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The concept of virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is regarded to be a friendly grid-connected method for renewable energies. As the VSG can participate in grid power regulation automatically as conventional generators, a reserve capacity is needed when the VSG operates at rated power, and the stronger power regulation ability of the VSG, the larger reserve capacity is needed. However, a large reserve capacity will result in low hardware utilization because the VSGs used for renewable energies connection can only operate at rated power in few time. In this paper, a modified VSG with self-adaptive power regulation ability is proposed by adopting a variable unit power regulation coefficient based on fuzzy logical controller. The modified VSG can regulate its power regulation ability automatically according to its output power and the deviation value of the system frequency, thus, a small reserve capacity is needed when the VSG operates at rated power to improve its hardware utilization, meanwhile, the VSG will get a stronger power regulation ability when it operates on light-load to improve the transient characteristics of the microgrid. A microgrid model was built based on Matlab/Simulink and simulation results proved the modified VSG to be effective.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation of power cable based on combined weighting and adaptive gray clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the past quality evaluation process of power cables, inspection report data only provided two classification information of "qualified" or "unqualified", and a large amount of test data was wasted. Few researches evaluate the data of inspection reports and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of power cables based on test results. This paper proposes a method based on combined weighting and adaptive gray clustering. The clustering effect is measured by Silhouette Coefficient (SC) and the number of clusters is adjusted to achieve the best clustering effect. The cable quality is evaluated according to the clustering result. The effectiveness of the method is verified through comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Dielectric response micro-current measuring circuit with active error suppression function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dielectric response test is a non-destructive and highly sensitive tool for insulation characterization, it requires a high-precision micro-current measurement circuit, which can meet the requirements of field with complex electromagnetic interference and large temperature change. Ultra low bias current amplifiers are commonly used in micro-current measurements to complete I-V transformation. However, bias and offset currents are very susceptible to temperature. The test process is easily disturbed by external power frequency and electromagnetic noise in the form of radiation. In this paper, the principle of feedback resistance method in micro current test is analyses. At the same time, this paper analyses the effect of the error caused by the amplifier and temperature. On the basis of error analysis, a novel current test topology is proposed, which can effectively suppress the power frequency interference and temperature drift of chip. Through the introduction of differential architecture, the purpose of high accuracy current measurement under limited component accuracy is achieved. Experimental results show that test results of the proposed circuit having high linearity in the current range of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup>A to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup>A Additional current testing results using dielectric response test system which contains proposed circuit are also given, which reveals the stability of the designed micro-current measurement device.

articleTitle: Study on the Stability Control Strategy of Central-China Power Grid During Asynchronous Operation Test of Hubei and Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to construct the hydropower transmission base of Southwest Power Grid and block the transient energy transfer path when faults occur to the three UHVDC simultaneously, namely Fufeng, Jinsu and Binjin, the State Grid Corporation has built the Chongqing-Hubei VSC-HVDC project in 2019. In order to ensure the secure and stable operation of the power grid after the project’s completion, the asynchronous operation test of Hubei and Chongqing is carried out in advance, and the 500kV AC transmission lines between Hubei and Chongqing will break off to simulate the zero power operation mode of the Chongqing-Hubei VSC-HVDC. In this paper, the relevant calculation model is established in Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP), and the transient stability, dynamic stability and frequency stability characteristics of the Central-China Power Grid during the asynchronous operation test period is analyzed. On this basis, corresponding stable control measures are proposed, which can provide theoretical foundation for the secure and stable operation of Central-China Power Grid during the asynchronous operation period and after the completion of the VSC-HVDC project.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of new energy short-circuit current engineering calculation based on IEC standard and short-circuit capacity method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the expansion of power system interconnection scale, A higher proportion of new energy is connected to the power grid, which makes the calculation of the short-circuit current (SCC) of the power system complicated in the grid planning simulation. Aiming at the fault characteristics of new energy plants and stations, this paper firstly introduces International standard IEC 60909-0 (edition 2.0 ed.) and the short-circuit (SC) capacity method; Secondly, the calculation models of the above two methods considering the impact of new energy are compared; Finally, an example is given to compare the calculation values of the fault current of the new energy in the planning grid with the two methods. The case shows: Compared with the SC capacity method, the calculation method adopted by the IEC standard is more conservative and is suitable for the calculation of the fault current of new energy sources with variety classes of faults.

articleTitle: Starting Torque Improvement of a Permanent Magnet Starter Generator Based on Different Core Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Different stator materials correspond to different design requirements, and improving the material utilization ratio has always been a difficult design problem. In this paper, taking the core material as the entry point, different stator materials are applied to the same permanent magnet starter generator (PMSG), and the application characteristics of different materials are deeply analyzed. The PMSGs with different materials are optimized respectively to maximize the starting torque. The finite element results verify the effectiveness of the combination of PSO global optimization and step-by-step depth optimization. Meanwhile, the whole optimization process reflects the influence of stator materials on parameter sensitivity and relative relationship between efficiency and starting torque.

articleTitle: Improved Torque Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Flux Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to its quick response and strong robustness, direct torque control (DTC) system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is widely used in the field of higher response performance. However, the performance of conventional DTC still needs to be explored. Some factors have a great influence on the stability of the system such as: large torque ripple, stator resistance voltage drop, the disadvantage of integral method and nonlinear factors. In order to improve inhere problems above of conventional DTC, this paper uses the mathematical model in dq-frame to observe the flux linkage, and puts forward the definition of "stator flux line". Based on these, an improved torque control algorithm of high-speed motor based on flux decoupling is proposed. The simulation results on a 7.5kW/2400rpm PMSM verified the proposed control scheme has good performance in low speed-region and the algorithm can suppress the torque and flux ripple of the control system to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Weak Traveling Wave Location Based on VMD-WMM method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low position accuracy due to weak traveling wave signal in the case of high impendence earth fault in the distribution network, a method based on variational modal decomposition (VMD) and wavelet max modulus(WMM) method to realize the fault location under weak traveling waves. Firstly, using VMD on the component of fault current line to get multiple intrinsic mode function (IMF). Then, the mutation characteristics of the first IMF is received with the help of WMM to determine the arriving time of the weak traveling wavefront. Finally, PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results verify correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Numerical Study on the Interaction between High-Power Microwave and Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is known that plasma can absorb and reflect high- power microwave (HPM) energy through polarization and collision. In this study, influences of microwave frequency, initial electron density and different plasma structures on the protection performance against HPM are numerically investigated. The results show that under the effect of strong electric field of HPM, nonlinear effect in plasma is obvious and the gas breakdown makes the electron density increased, which leads to the attenuation enhancement of HPM and further weakens the energy of wave transmission. It can also be obtained that bi-layer plasma structure has a better attenuation performance than single-layer structure.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Dynamic Characteristics of Transformer Winding in Short-Circuit Fault by Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is of great significance for the stability of power system to research the electromagnetic and mechanical dynamic characteristics of transformer in short-circuit fault by numerical simulation. A 110kV/25000kVA power transformer model is established by the finite element method. In which Ogden model is adopted to conduct simulation analysis on winding spacer for considering its nonlinear mechanical characteristics. Some simulation results are obtained on the basis of modeling. Firstly, the magnitude and distribution of the axial and radial electromagnetic force of windings in short-circuit fault are calculated. Secondly, the dynamic change rule of displacement and stress of high voltage and low voltage windings in short- circuit fault is obtained. Thirdly, the distribution of maximum displacement and maximum stress on each coil disk are calculated. In addition, the difference of mechanical characteristics between HV winding and LV winding is analyzed. The above results can provide reference for transformer design.

articleTitle: Detection method and system design for bubble defects of glass insulator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bubble defect is a common defect of glass insulator, which needs to be detected and removed before putting into operation. In this paper, two kinds of defect detection methods base on uniform light and laser are studied, the characteristics of the two methods are compared and analyzed. Combine its advantages, a set of bubble defect detection scheme using uniform light source rapid screening and laser light source accurate verification is determined, and the defect detection system is designed. The system’s physical verification shows that the system can quickly and effectively complete the identification and location of bubble defects in glass insulators, has high accuracy and anti-interference ability, can meet the needs of automated detection, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: optimization of two-stage dynamic reactive power in the distribution network considering the photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For making use of photovoltaics (PVs) reactive power resources and reduce the number of capacitor switching times, a two-stage reactive power optimization method considering the PV systems is proposed. In the first stage, the grid voltage forecast model is established, and the time is divided by the range and standard deviation of the voltage forecast value. Solve the capacitor switching in each period. In the second stage, the day is divided into two parts: daytime and night. Establish the reactive power distribution strategy for daytime and night respectively: In the daytime, the PV solves the reactive power by using the Q(U) control mode, and then solves the static var compensator (SVC) reactive power; at night, PV systems and SVC solve reactive power in proportion to the reactive power margin. Finally, the above method is verified by the IEEE33 calculation example. The simulation calculation example shows that the proposed method can reduce capacitor switching numbers, make full use of PV reactive power and effectively improve quality of grid voltage.

articleTitle: Research on power frequency superimposed impulse voltage generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transient voltage measurement is not only the design basis of insulation coordination of power equipment, but also related to the safe and stable operation of power grid. The transient voltage waveform in the actual power system is often the superposition of overvoltage and power frequency voltage. In order to measure this kind of superposition waveform, it is necessary to develop the high voltage test equipment which can produce the superposition waveform. Therefore, based on the circuit theory, this paper puts forward a parallel superposition circuit, respectively carries out mathematical analysis and simulation verification of the circuit principle, and determines the specific structure and key parameters of the circuit. On this basis, a set of high-voltage test equipment is set up by designing and purchasing high-voltage components and the overall control system of the equipment. The voltage waveform is observed by using voltage divider and oscilloscope. The test results show that the superposed voltage generator can superpose 500 kV positive or negative impulse voltage at any phase of 120 kV AC voltage.

articleTitle: Simulation and Modeling Method of Permanent Magnet Contactor Based on Equivalent Current
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A new simulation and modeling method for permanent magnet (PM) contactor is proposed. The equivalent magnetic circuit model of PM contactor is established through magnetic field partition scheme, and the effect of PM is equivalent to coil current on the premise that the force on the moving core remains unchanged before and after the equivalent. The equivalent current at different air gaps is solved and fitted as a function of moving core displacement, and acts on the coil together with external excitation to achieve the purpose of substituting the equivalent current for the PM. On this basis, a co-simulation model of PM contactor integrated with control and body was established. Using the current closed-loop control technology to verify the effectiveness of the co-simulation model, which provides a new idea for the design of PM contactor intelligent control strategy.

articleTitle: Construction of influence factor database based on the accuracy of load forecasting results
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of the economy and the industrial structure regulation, the load characteristics of users and industries are affected by a growing number of factors. The accuracy of load forecasting methods that rely solely on historical data cannot meet the needs of the current power system. Therefore, it is necessary to incorporate factors such as economic and climatic factors into the load forecasting model (LFM) to improve forecasting accuracy. In this paper, a strategy of building influence factor database of users and industries using LFM based on support vector regression (SVR) is proposed to improve the accuracy of load forecasting. According to the accuracy of results, the related elements of users and the industries' load characteristics are screened to construct influence factor database, and then take the obtained related elements as the input layer variable of the LFM for training. Using the power consumption data of an enterprise in Shenzhen for calculation, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified. The accuracy of load forecasting results after taking the related factors screened by method as the input layer variable has been improved by 1.24%.

articleTitle: Steady-state Analysis of Cycloidal Magnetic Gear Based on Equivalent Motion Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cycloidal Magnetic Gear (CMG) has the advantages of high torque density, high transmission ratio, and steady-state performances are vital for its future industrial applications. CMG has two operation modes with high transmission ratio, namely, reducer mode and windlass mode, and the inner rotor needs to perform curve translation under both working modes. However, the existing commercial finite element software cannot set this complex motion form when using transient field simulator (TFS), which makes it difficult to obtain the steady-state electromagnetic characteristics of CMG in the design stage. This paper proposed a CMG steady-state electromagnetic performance analysis method based on equivalent motion modes (EMMs). Firstly, the operation modes of CMG with high transmission ratio is demonstrated. Then, the general mode is proposed, and the EMMs are derived through kinematic analysis of original two modes and general mode. Next, by using magnetostatic field simulator (MFS), the input and output torques also satisfy the transmission ratio, which verifies the correctness of the EMMs. Finally, based on EMMs, the magnetic field distributions under no-load and full-load show that the CMG pole coupling rate reaches 94%; through flux density FFT analysis, the modulation effect of non-uniform air gap is demonstrated. In addition, the steady-state torques simulation results show that the torque fluctuation is less than 2%. At last, the steady-state eddy current loss is calculated, it is found that the eddy current loss is independent of the load and proportional to the square of the output speed ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>.

articleTitle: Lightning Protection Performance of Long Span Section in ±1100kV UHVDC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the operation statistics of HVDC transmission lines in China, the blocking accidents caused by lightning strike on single and double poles of HVDC transmission lines occur from time to time. Lightning accidents have always been in the first place of all kinds of faults, and lightning damage has become a huge hidden danger affecting the safe operation of UHVDC transmission equipment. Lightning protection must be paid enough attention to in line construction and operation and maintenance work. For long span high tower of ± 1100kV UHVDC transmission line, due to its high tower height, long span, high lightning probability, and lightning accident is not easy to repair, its lightning protection performance is one of the key issues of transmission line lightning protection. Scientific evaluation of lightning protection characteristics of ± 1100kV UHVDC transmission line in long span section and improving the effectiveness of lightning protection design of transmission line have become the research hotspot and difficulty to be solved. In this paper, the lightning withstand performance of long span section in ± 1100kV UHVDC transmission line is studied, and the calculation method of lightning withstand performance of ± 1100kV long span section is proposed. The shielding failure flashover rate, strike back flashover rate and lightning withstand level of strike back are obtained. Because the span tower adopts the protection angle of -5.9° and the tower head gap is controlled by the working voltage gap, the actual gap of lightning flashover is larger, and the shielding lightning protection performance is better. The mean time between shielding failures of ± 1100kV UHVDC Yangtze River long span is greater than 64 years. The strike back lightning withstand level of each tower is above 260kA. The strike back lightning withstand level of each tower of ± 1100kV Yangtze River span is relatively high, and the average time without fault is long. The mean time between lightning stroke fault of ±1100kV UHVDC Yangtze River long span section is 52 years, equivalent to lightning flashover rate is 0.656 times/(100km•a), which is larger than the index of mean time between lightning stroke fault of 50 years. The tower design of ±1100kV UHVDC Yangtze River long span section meets the requirements of lightning protection.

Author Keywords: mean time between lightning stroke fault

articleTitle: Stator Temperature Analysis of Turbogenerator in Rotor Inter-Turn Short Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impact of rotor interturn short circuit (RISC) on the stator core loss and temperature is studied in this work. Different from existing research, this work is based on the variation analysis of the magnetic flux density (MFD) and the stator core loss calculation. Finite element analysis (FEA) is carried out on a MJF-6-30 prototype generator which has the same per-unit values as actual turbo-generator for practical reference purpose. It shows that RISC will increase stator core loss due to the exciting intensification of the automotive control system, which will increase the stator core temperature.

articleTitle: Research on BIT Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Brake system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To protect the safety of aircraft landing, this paper focus on the BIT technology for the aircraft brake system. Firstly, the types of faults in the aircraft brake system is analyzed. Secondly, in order to detect open and short circuit faults of sensors, the hardware circuit is designed. Finally, this paper used the neural network in Matlab simulation to distinguish the sensor signal drift faults. The simulation results prove that the BIT requirements of the aircraft brake system are satisfied.

articleTitle: Research on Variable Inertia Control Strategy of Electric Vehicle Based on Synchronverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the threat of high-penetration electric vehicles to the stability of traditional power grids increasing, synchronverter technology has received widespread attention due to its flexible grid-connection characteristics. Aiming at the frequency fluctuation problem of electric vehicles connected to the grid, this paper studies an electric vehicle smart charging station system to alleviate the instantaneous frequency impact caused by system power imbalance, and proposes a control strategy to change inertia adaptively so that the frequency dynamic response can be improved. The simulation results demonstrate that the charging station system can ensure the frequency of the grid connection point has a small overshoot and can quickly converge to the rated value in both the power command change and load switching conditions. The control strategy based on synchronverter proposed in this paper can effectively improve the ability of the grid to resist disturbance.

articleTitle: A Novel Superconducting Electromagnetic Catapult
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electromagnetic catapults have stimulate huge interest and are promising in the application such as the electromagnetic launch from the navy aircraft carriers, electromagnetic gun and other electromagnetic-directed energy weapons systems. Currently, most of the electromagnetic catapults are based on pulse power supply technology. But they have to face challenges such as complicated control circuit, low efficiency in energy transfer and long launching interval, which will limit the development of electromagnetic catapult. In this work, we have proposed a novel superconducting electromagnetic catapult, which is capable of avoiding complex pulse power supply system, improving the working performance and shortening launching interval. Besides, it can be used alone or in combination with the current electromagnetic catapult based on pulse power supply technology to improve the working performance. Experimental and simulation test have been carried out to verify the working principle of our proposed superconducting electromagnetic catapult.

articleTitle: Research on Circuit Topology and Control Method of ISOS Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the limitation of power device capacity and cost, the traditional single-channel wireless charging system (WCS) is difficult to meet the demand for high-power energy transmission. Though multiple sets of series or parallel magnetic couplers can reduce the voltage and current stresses of the device, the cross-coupling, low space utilization, poor stability of the compensation frequency, and the weak study of system circuit topology and control method need to be solved. To address the problems above, this paper proposes a circuit with the controllable rectifier circuit on the secondary side in multiple transfer channels based on the in-phase control method. The experimental results show that the controllable rectifier circuit based on in-phase control not only ensures that the imaginary part of the input impedance is 0 but also realizes the control of the charging current and voltage control.

articleTitle: Reserch on Multi-mode Operation of Distributed Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase in electricity demand and the common problems of centralized FACTS, such as high cost, large operating loss, and low reliability. The Distributed Power Flow Controller (DPFC) technology, which has the advantages of cost-effectiveness and reliability, is developing rapidly, but the DPFC in the current research only works in a single control mode. This paper introduces the basic principles of DPFC multi-mode operation based on typical systems, studies the control principles and control ability of DPFC under different control modes; proposes the multi-mode control strategy of DPFC and presents the electromagnetic transient model of DPFC based on PSCAD/EMTDC, the simulation verifies the validity and reliability of the DPFC multi-mode operation strategy.

articleTitle: The Influence of FDIAs on Integrated power flow of the Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As power, gas, and thermal systems are becoming tightly linked to each other in the integrated energy system (IES), the integrated power flow for regional integrated energy systems has received wide attention. In order to reflect the influence of false data injection attacks(FDIAs) on the integrated power flow of the IES, this paper is based on the FDIAs attack model and energy hub theory, considering the operation mode of the integrated energy system, and simulates FDIAs on the integrated energy system. The test results show that the FDIAs on the IES can affect the output of the energy supply units of each IES subsystem, the power and loss of each branch.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Maximum HVDC Infeed Power Based on Power System Minimum Inertia Constraint
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of the proportion of HVDC transmission, some synchronous generators are replaced by HVDC, which leads to the decrease of the inertia level of the receiving-end grid and threatens the frequency stability of the power grid. In order to study the maximum infeed power of HVDC, firstly this paper derives the dynamic response expression of the power grid frequency including the inertia response and the primary frequency response of the synchronous generator. Secondly, on the premise of avoiding under frequency load shedding (UFLS), the minimum inertia required in the case of N-1 is solved based on the frequency dynamic response expression. Thirdly, taking the minimum inertia as a constraint, the maximum infeed power of HVDC transmission is estimated. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified in the IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: CMPC-based Controller for Load Frequency Regulation of Interconnected Power System Integrated with BESS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A large number of frequency fluctuations may have a negative impact on the safe and stable operation of large-scale power systems, so the present work focuses on the design of a load frequency control (LFC) scheme based on centralized model predictive control (CMPC). Firstly, a frequency response model of a two-area interconnected power system, containing wind power, hydropower, thermal power, and battery energy storage system (BESS), is established. Next, on the basis of the system state-space model, the predictive model and optimization objective function are derived employing recursion. Finally, combined with physical constraints, the optimization problem is converted into a standard quadratic programming (QP) problem. Extensive simulations are executed to test and verify the availability of the proposed scheme. The results reveal that the mentioned system gives an active reaction to the CMPC controller regarding load disturbances and wind power grid connection.

articleTitle: Transformer winding deformation fault diagnosis method based on improved variational modal decomposition and optimized correlation vector machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The design of the transformer can withstand the mechanical shock during transportation and the large electromechanical power generated by short circuit and switching surge current. However, due to these forces, the windings may be slack, misaligned or deformed. The windings are the core component of the transformer, which directly affects the diagnosis of the transformer and even the entire power system. This paper proposes a feature extraction method for transformer winding vibration signals based on improved variational modal decomposition (IVMD). The improved variational modal decomposition is used to decompose the vibration signals under different states of transformer windings into a series of finite bandwidth eigenmode functions (IMF); on the basis of feature extraction, this paper also introduces the correlation vector machine (RVM), through the pattern recognition algorithm to establish the relationship between the weight divergence and the transformer winding operating conditions, and through the harmony search algorithm to optimize the option to the RVM kernel function. The algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively extract the characteristics of the mechanical vibration signal of the transformer winding and improve the classification accuracy of RVM.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle load forecasting in distribution transformer based on Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the private charging piles in distribution network have different characteristics from the charging piles installed in cities, a load forecasting method for electric vehicles in low voltage distribution network based feature engineering is proposed. First, a new feature set is formulated by taking the time characteristics for charging load of residents, the mechanism of charging piles, and the private property of some charging piles in distribution network into consideration. The original charging behavior data is used in feature engineering. Therefore, compared to the feature subset formulated by traditional methods, the charging behavior feature and time feature are considered in the new feature subset. Second, an LSTM neural network is constructed to forecast the 96-point load of electric vehicles for the 24 hours in the next day. Finally, the load forecasting is proceeding respectively based on both traditional feature subset and the new feature subset. The experiments results are measured by the statistics index and the ultra-short-term criterion of the grid. Also, some typical operation days are taken into consideration. Simulation results have shown that load forecasting based on the new feature subset has higher precision.

articleTitle: Study on Single Bus Separation Mode and In-out Line Arrangement Based on Short Circuit Current Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to limit the short circuit current (SCC) in the power system, bus separate operation is the most simple, effective and economical way. When limiting the SCC by using the method of bus separation, the specific switch of the bus is usually broken after the topology of the in-out lines of bus are fixed, but the influence of the arrangement of the bus in-out lines and the mode of bus separation on the effect of SCC limitation is not considered. Based on the virtual branch method, this paper studies the influence of the bus in-out line arrangement and mode of bus separation on the node SCC, and takes the SCC as the optimization target, so as to get the optimal scheme. From the node impedance matrix, this method illustrates the influence of bus separation mode and in-out line arrangement on the SCC. Finally, the effectiveness of this method is analyzed and verified in IEEE39 node standard network. The example shows that the result of the model is consistent with the conventional enumeration method, but the enumeration times are reduced by more than half.

articleTitle: Fault location and reclosing scheme of DC distribution network based on parallel module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the frequent occurrence of transient faults on overhead lines, the use of DC reclosing strategy can effectively improve its power supply reliability. However, when the DC grid coincides with a permanent fault, it will cause a secondary impact problem, endangering system operation and equipment safety. A fault location and reclosing scheme of DC distribution network based on parallel module is proposed. The parallel module consists of an energy absorption module and an energy storage module. The energy absorption module cooperates with the hybrid MMC to collect the residual energy of the current-limiting reactor and the line reactance. In addition, the energy storage module will also be connected to the absorption capacitor of the energy absorption module to charge it, so as to prevent the voltage traveling wave amplitude emitted by the absorption capacitor from being too low during the fault reclosing judgment, which will affect the judgment result. At the same time, using the principle of traveling wave ranging, the scheme also has the function of fault location. Finally, the simulation results prove that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Decoloration of Methylene Blue in a Surface/Volume Dielectric Barrier Discharge System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma system with a combing mode of surface/volume discharge was set up and applied for the decoloration of the methylene blue (MB) solution. The obtained experimental results show that the decoloration percentage increased with the applied voltage and the optimal energy utilization condition for the decoloration was the 5 kV discharge voltage. Analyzing of the solution pH conditions for the decoloration, the neutral solution with initial pH of 6.34 was more conducive to the MB decoloration. With the increase of the initial concentration of the solution, the decoloration percentage increased first and then decreased. The MB decoloration also showed a trend of increase and then decrease by enhancing the air bubbling rate under the condition of lower discharge voltage (4 kV). articleTitle: Effect of Charging Voltage of Energy Storage Capacitor on Performance of Ablative Pulsed Plasma Thruster
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Discharge energy of thruster is an important factor which can affect Ablative Pulsed Plasma Thruster system performance. The discharge characteristics, ablation characteristics of propellant and plasma movement characteristics of APPT at different initial voltages are systematically studied. By fitting and estimating APPT circuit parameters and system performance parameters under different initial voltages, the internal mechanism of influence of initial voltage change on thruster performance is obtained. The results show that with the increase of discharge voltage, the plasma velocity increases, the impulse bit, specific impulse and efficiency of the thruster all increase, and the system performance improves. But with the increase of voltage, efficiency of the system energy converse to discharge energy decreases, while the mass of the ablated propellant increases, the proportion of the ablated propellant which is effectively ionized and accelerated by Lorentz force decreases. This is not conducive to the performance improvement of thruster, it can be concluded that simply increasing the initial voltage of thruster has certain limitations on optimizing thruster performance.

articleTitle: Quantifying the Impact of Charging Strategy on Degradation of Battery Energy Storage System
