publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Battery energy storage system (BESS) plays a vital role in energy shifting, peak shaving, electricity saving, etc. However, the estimation of BESS operating costs has remained a challenge. This work presents a data-driven model utilizing historical data and real-time data from battery management system (BMS). The method employs elastic net and neural net to form a state of health (SOH) evaluation model and employs dynamic time warping (DTW) to estimate the real-time degradation rate. By studying a data set from real-world lithiumion batteries, we obtain a set of degradation curves of various charging strategies and different SOH, which indicates the influence of charging strategy on degradation.

articleTitle: Transfer Function Sensitivity Based DFIG Shedding Scheme to Mitigate Subsynchronous Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes transfer function sensitivity based index for doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) shedding scheme to mitigate subsynchronous oscillation. Firstly, the Phillips-Heffron model of the power system integrated with DFIG is built, and the transfer functions of DFIGs and other left part of the power system are derived. Then, the transfer function sensitivity of DFIG, which considers each DFIG as a whole part presented by a feedback transfer function, is obtained through calculating the logarithmic partial derivative of DFIG to the whole power system. Finally, the improved four-machine two-zone system with 4 DFIGs is used as the test system to verify the validity of transfer function sensitivity, the results of simulation prove that the transfer function sensitivity could quantize the influence of DFIG on subsynchronous oscillation and shedding DFIG with positive sensitivity could mitigate subsynchronous oscillation.

articleTitle: Exploring Methods for Short Circuit Testing of High Voltage Fault Current Limiter Based on High Coupling Split Reactors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Great progress has been achieved in the development of fault current limiters (FCL) in recent years. However, there has been no domestic or overseas standard basis directly in terms of experimental verification. Short circuit testing of high-voltage FCL requires tremendous system capacities. Hence equivalent synthetic methods of testing should be considered. Due to the particularity of component parts in FCL, synthetic testing methods for circuit breakers may induce insulation stress in abnormal conditions. Based on the working principles of high-voltage FCL with high coupling split reactors, equivalent testing methods should be considered firstly, the paper conducts research and analysis on relevant domestic and overseas standards as well as lab capacities, and puts forward equivalent methods of short circuit testing. Then, testtag plans are formulated with actual working status. Lastly, system simulations on the feasibility of plans are carried out.

articleTitle: Research on Household Energy Management System Considering Tou Price
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Home energy management system (HEMS) is an important part of smart grid terminal. Reasonable scheduling strategy of household load power consumption and energy storage operation can not only relieve the pressure of power grid, but also reduce the electricity costs of users. Therefore, this paper proposed a household energy management strategy based on time-of-use(TOU) electricity tariffs. Firstly, according to the characteristics of household load, it can be divided into three categories: basic load, transferable load(TL) and interruptible load(IL). Then, with the constraints of the dispatchable load and the working state of the energy storage battery, a load optimization scheduling strategy and an energy storage charging and discharging strategy have been formulated with the goal of minimizing the cost of household electricity purchase. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed optimal scheduling strategy can effectively reduce the peak load and household electricity cost.

articleTitle: A comparative study on electromagnetic vibration of Doubly Salient Electromagnetic Machine with concentrated and distributed field windings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Noise and vibration problems originated from the salient poles of the stator and rotor are the major shortcomings for the application of the Doubly Salient Electromagnetic Machine (DSEM). In this paper, two DSEMs with distributed field windings and concentrated field windings are comparatively studied in terms of not only basic electromagnetic (EM) performances but also in terms of EM force, vibration modes and electromagnetic vibration characteristics. Both analytical and numerical result shows that the spatial distribution of the EM force is strongly dependent on the stator/rotor pole combinations. The modal analysis result suggests that resonant fequencies of the stator can be increased when housing and bolt connections are considered. Finally, the harmonic response shows that the 12s/8r DSEM with concentrated field windings has better performance in terms of the vibration than the 12s/10r DSEM with distributed field windings due to the thicker yoke and the higher spatial orders EM force harmonics.

articleTitle: Torque Ripple Suppression Strategy of Doubly Salient Electro-magnetic Motor Based on Three-phase Six-state Torque Closed-loop Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of torque ripple of doubly salient electro-magnetic motor (DSEM), this paper proposes a torque ripple suppression strategy based on three-phase six-state (TPSS) torque closed-loop control. In order to make full use of the inductance variation region of DSEM to output torque, based on the standard angle control, the control strategy of conducting the next phase positive current in advance is adopted to realize the instantaneous torque closed-loop control of the motor. The variation characteristics of the current and output torque of each phase in the commutation process are quantitatively analyzed based on the linear inductance model. The analysis shows that the proposed control strategy can increase the electromagnetic torque in each mode. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed strategy can effectively suppress the torque ripple of DSEM.

articleTitle: A Generic Understanding of Damping Effect of Wind Power Generation with Inertial Response on Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The inertia control in wind power generation is becoming a necessary trend in the future power system. Thus, the system electromechanical oscillation will be responded by the wind power generation and in turn, it will significantly affect the system electromechanical damping. The different inertia control seemingly has different characteristics and different effect on system damping. In this paper, we use a simplified model to understand the generic damping effect of different inertia control. One typical inertia control method is illustrated to study. This paper aims at helping people to clearly understand and quickly judge the influence of inertia control on system damping.

articleTitle: Research on Protection Tripping Scheme of Multiple Criteria with High Reliability for HV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The abnormities occurring at any part of sampling process may cause the maloperation of dual-configured protection systems in smart substations. To cope with this problem, multiple differential protection criteria are formed, which use the currents acquired from the lines that connect to the busbars connecting to the double ends of the protected line. All the acquired information is shared in the substation area protection platform. Then, a novel protection tripping scheme of multiple criteria for high voltage (HV) transmission line is proposed. Theoretical analysis and simulation results indicate that compared with the existing 1-out-of-2 tripping scheme, the proposed protection tripping scheme is immune to the abnormities of current transformer (CT) such as saturation, interference and disconnection, which can effectively enhance the reliability of line protection.

articleTitle: Synchronous Optimal Pulse-Width Modulation Method for Three-Phase Five-Level NPC-H Bridge Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A synchronous optimized pulse width modulation method for a three-phase five-level NPC-H bridge inverter is proposed for the problem that the larger the inverter output common-mode voltage amplitude is, the larger the system conduction loss and the worse the electromagnetic compatibility. A mathematical model is constructed based on the inverter output current, weighted common-mode voltage, etc. as a whole. The optimal switching angle value is solved by minimizing a specific function, and the corresponding PWM signal is generated according to the NPC-H bridge inverter control. Simulations show that this method can effectively solve the problems of large harmonic current and high common mode voltage amplitude at low switching frequency of five-level NPC-H bridge inverter output while maintaining the self-balancing characteristic of voltage at the neutral-point of DC bus.

articleTitle: LCC-HVDC Small Signal Model Considering the Influence of Voltage Variation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) technology is developing rapidly in China due to long distance power transfer, large power handling capacity and low loss. In this paper, a small signal model considering the influence of voltage variation is proposed for fast and accurate simulation of AC/DC hybrid power grid. First, the LCC-HVDC state space model is developed where voltage and power are selected as the converter station interface to make the model generation easier. Later, the influence of dynamic voltage variation on the converter station model during the small disturbance is considered. The quasi-steady state model and the commutation angle formula were revised to improve the accuracy of the small signal model. The correctness of the small signal model of the HVDC transmission system established in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Harmonic Stability in Heavy-Haul Railways Based on Impedance Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electrical resonance instability (ERI) phenomenon has frequently occurred near the resonance frequency of the traction network in the heavy-duty railways system. Since the effective range of the small-signal average model is lower than the 1/2 switching frequency, to analyze ERI, this paper first analyzes the sampling and PWM process in detail. Then, a multi-frequency model of the locomotive rectifier that considers sampling sideband harmonics is derived. The passive criterion is used to analyze the stability of the system. Finally, the influence of the control delay on the input-admittance is revealed. The simulation and experiments verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Regional Distributed Photovoltaic Ultra-Short-Term Prediction Method Based on Multi-task Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate and fast photovoltaic prediction is of great significance to the economy and safety of smart grid. At present, the existing prediction methods do not consider the correlation between different photovoltaic power stations in the region. In this paper, a regionally distributed photovoltaic ultra-short-term prediction method based on multi-task learning is proposed. Firstly, the LSTM model for photovoltaic prediction is designed, and then the multitask learning is realized through the network parameter sharing mechanism. Due to the full consideration of the correlation between different tasks, the proposed method improves the prediction accuracy. At the same time, the structure of multi-input and multi- output improves training efficiency. An example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Winding Deformation Detection Based on Vibration Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vibration signal sent out during the operation of transformer can reflect the internal mechanical performance state. If the state of core, winding and other vibration sources changes, the vibration signal collected on the surface of transformer will also change abruptly. Therefore, vibration signal analysis can be used as transformer live detection, fault diagnosis and other methods to guide maintenance. In this paper, the vibration signal of a 110 kV transformer during the short- circuit test is analyzed, and the results are compared with the traditional winding deformation test methods. Combined with the inspection after the test, the effectiveness of the winding deformation detection method based on the vibration signal analysis is verified.

articleTitle: Design of Voltage Synchronous Signal Estimator under Grid Distortion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The grid voltage contains the positive sequence, negative sequence and harmonic component under the complex condition of voltage asymmetry, which can cause the great interference to the detection of synchronous sinusoidal signal of the power grid. Therefore, a detection method in a two-phase stationary reference frame is proposed based on extended kalman filter (EKF). Firstly, the Hilbert transform is combined with the Clark transform, and the positive sequence voltage signal is separated by eliminating the negative sequence component using the simple mathematical operation. Secondly, in order to extract the synchronous signal from the separate positive sequence signal, the positive sequence component in the two-phase stationary reference frame is used as the input signal of EKF. This method can not only estimate the positive sequence component of the fundamental wave, but also eliminate the Gaussian white noise of the system, which can more accurately solve the problem of actual working conditions. In this paper, EKF is used to estimate the amplitude and phase of grid voltage synchronization signal. The maximum error of voltage estimation is obviously reduced, compared with other optimized algorithms. Thus, EKF can better estimate the amplitude and phase of the grid voltage fundamental wave. Then, a closed-loop system is designed in this paper. Finally, the simulation and experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can extract grid sinusoidal signals under complex conditions accuracy, and have good frequency adaption characteristics.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Topology and Control Parameters of the Switched Reluctance Motor with 12/8 Poles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of torque ripple, a novel structure of switched reluctance motor (SRM) is proposed. Compared with the conventional SRM, the new SRM has a significant effect in suppressing torque ripple, reducing it by 53.5% with a slight increase in the average torque. In addition, as the proposed SRM has perfect symmetry in structure, consistent results in forward and reverse rotating conditions. Moreover, the switched reluctance driver (SRD) with the nonlinear models of optimized SRM inserted is built in MATLAB/Simulink. The control parameters of SRD are also optimized to further suppress the torque ripple. The simulation results verify that, on the basis of topology optimization, the SRD with optimized control parameters can generate 71.8% lower torque ripple and slightly higher torque.

articleTitle: Multi objective optimal operation of integrated electricity-gas system considering emission of pollutant gas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of power to gas (P2G), the optimal scheduling of integrated electricity-gas system ((IEGS) has been widely concerned. In order to ensure the operation economy of the system and achieve the best environmental benefits and optimal electricity purchase cost through flexible scheduling of P2G and Gas Fired Unit (GFU), this paper proposes a multi-objective optimal scheduling model of IEGS considering system operation cost, pollutant gas emission and electricity purchase cost. The normal boundary intersection (NBI) method is used to transform the multi-objective optimization problem into multiple single objective optimization problems, and the fuzzy clustering method combined with practical preferences is used to quickly screen the optimal solution. Finally, the modified IEGS system is used for case study, and multiple scenarios are set for comparative analysis to prove the superiority of the proposed model. The results show that the optimal scheduling model can realize the flexible scheduling of P2G and GFU, and achieve good environmental benefits while ensuring the system economy.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation Analysis of Active Heave Compensation Control System for Marine Winch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the control requirements for the active heave compensation system of marine winch, an analysis of the control mechanism based on active heave compensation system is proposed and a simulation model of the active heave compensation control system is constructed. According to the different water depths and sea conditions -where load locates, the corresponding parameters are set to calculate the compensation characteristics of the active heave compensation control system under above circumstances, obtaining the displacement response curve of the load and the motor speed response curve with compensation function, whilst yielding the displacement response curve of the load without compensation. The simulation results indicate the high compensation accuracy of the designed active heave compensation control system. Moreover, a trial based on marine winch applying active heave compensation has been implemented, the trial data obtained showing a sheer adaptability of the active heave compensation control system. The work provides a reference for the improvement of the active heave compensation control system based on marine winch.

articleTitle: Transient Rotor Angle and Voltage Stability Discrimination Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network with Multiple Inputs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence-based methods have been widely used in power system transient rotor angle or voltage stability analysis. In this study, the deep convolutional neural network with multiple inputs is utilized to train a model for transient rotor angle and voltage stability discrimination. Firstly, the rotor angle and voltage trajectories are placed into the convolutional layers, pooling layers and one fully connected layer respectively. Then, the outputs are combined and put into another fully connected layer to construct the discriminator. The case studies of the 8-machine 36-bus system illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Moreover, the visualized analysis of deep convolutional neural network is provided by the class activation mapping. Based on the visual analysis, the input regions which are important for discrimination can be visualized, which makes the convolutional neural network can be transparent for practical application.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Wind Power Fluctuation Suppression and Frequency Modulation Based on Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the wind power penetration continues to increase, the inherent volatility and weak frequency modulation capabilities of wind power have increasingly prominent influence on the power system. Thus, China has promulgated relevant standards for the power smoothing and frequency modulation capability of grid-connected wind power However technical ways achieving this standard have not yet mentioned in detail. This paper proposes a comprehensive control strategy based on the hybrid energy storage system that can simultaneously stabilize wind power fluctuations and participate in the primary frequency modulation. The control strategy includes two parts: the power fluctuation suppression control and the auxiliary frequency modulation control. Finally, through simulation analysis and comparison with other control strategies, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed strategy in suppressing power fluctuations and auxiliary frequency modulation are verified.

articleTitle: Development of a Self-integrating Rogowski Coil with Magnetic Core for High Impulse Current Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and construction of a self-integrating Rogowski coil with magnetic core for (4/10) μs and (8/20) μs lightning impulse current measurement. In order to improve the measurement accuracy, frequency spectrum of lightning current wave was analyzed. By optimizing the winding structure and parameters designing, the bandwidth of the Rogowski coil can be broadened and the response time is shortened. Compared with standard impulse current shunt, the peak value deviation under (4/10) μs and (8/20)μs impulse current waveforms are less than 0.5% and the time parameter error is less than 1%. It is very suitable for on-site calibration for current transducers with high measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Leakage Location of Stray Current in Rail Transit Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the acceleration of urban construction, the subway system and the urban power grid system are too close in the dense urban system. There is a big problem in the operation of subway system, that is, the load current will enter the ground from the weak insulation of the track and invade other public network systems, causing a series of adverse effects such as corrosion. For the power grid, the stray current leaking to the ground will be attracted by the AC power grid, which will make the neutral DC current of the grounding power transformer around the rail transit line change significantly. In order to obtain the intensity and location of stray current leakage point, this paper proposes the inverse location of current leakage point through the distribution of DC current in the neutral point of transformer in AC power grid. In this paper, the mathematical model of point leakage point is constructed to replace the line leakage section, the stray current leakage is monitored by the transmission network, and the actual situation of track insulation damage is reflected by analyzing the distribution characteristics of transformer neutral point DC current, which makes the maintenance and repair work of rail transit more targeted.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Bluetooth Miniature Circuit Breaker for Electric Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of the new generation electric energy meter to control electricity through Bluetooth, the existing research and application based on Bluetooth technology are comprehensively analyzed. The overall design scheme of the Bluetooth smart miniature circuit breaker is proposed, and the main functions of each functional module are specified. In order to realize the accurate pairing between the Bluetooth electric energy meter and the associated Bluetooth circuit breaker, an accurate pairing method based on current fingerprint technology is proposed, the current fingerprint characteristics are given, and the current fingerprint module and characteristic code encoding method are designed. The automatic pairing principle and process of the Bluetooth miniature circuit breaker for the electric energy meter are designed, and the accurate pairing between the Bluetooth electric energy meter and the Bluetooth circuit breaker is realized. The technology can effectively improve the pairing success rate of Bluetooth miniature circuit breakers and prevent false tripping caused by paring errors.

articleTitle: Development of non-contact detection system for energy storage materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Magnetically Mediated Thermoacoustic Detecting Method (MMTDM) is a non-contact conductivity detection method for energy storage materials of high resolution. In this paper, in order to verify the feasibility of MMTDM to detect the electrical conductivity of energy storage materials, firstly, the principle of MMTDM was studied. Secondly, a set of narrow pulse magnetic field excitation of the experimental system for MMTDM was designed and established. At last, the self-made graphene target was put into the detection area, which emitted the thermoacoustic signal. The signal was detected by the ultrasonic transducer after being amplified by 60dB. The experimental results demonstrate that the system can be used for non-contact detection of electrical conductivity of energy storage materials.

articleTitle: Design of Adjustable High Voltage Pulse Power Supply Driven by Photovoltaic Cells for Cold Plasma Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cold atmospheric plasmas (CAPs) driven by high voltage pulse power supply have various advantages in various applications, such as high reactivity, easy ignition and energy saving, etc. Design specific high voltage pulse power supply powered by renewable energy like photovoltaic cells (PV) could further enhance the application potential of CAPs. Here, a high voltage pulse power supply directly driven by PV was designed and the main parameters of 500Hz to 5kHz frequency, lμs to 10μs pulse width and over 10kV amplitude were obtained in this investigation. We analyzed the design process of the topological structure, which was mainly composed of boost circuit, Marx generator and transformer. The design of the overall topology, the Marx generator, the circuit parameters selection and the auxiliary circuit for IGBT were introduced and discussed in detail. The high voltage pulse power supply was developed and tested with three typical CAPs sources. This designed power supply exhibited excellent working performance with stable output of CAPs load. Further optimization of the power supply was also discussed in the end.

articleTitle: A Compact Self-Power Module Based on Electromagnetic Energy Harvester and Voltage Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A compact self-power module is proposed in this paper with the tubular integration of electromagnetic vibration energy harvester and voltage multiplier. The electromagnetic energy harvester is constructed with dual planar springs and cylindrical magnets. The optimal location and size of the coils are investigated. A single-stage voltage multiplier is used to rectifier and boost the harvested AC voltage, which is also followed by a LDO stage to further stabilize the output. The volume of the electromagnetic vibration energy harvester is 8 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The maximum output power is 19.1mW when the acceleration is 0.7 g and the resonance frequency is 116 Hz. The designed self-power module is able to provide stable voltage and sufficient power for the wireless temperature and humidity sensor.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Renewable Energy Resources Assessment Results in Argentina
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing development of renewable energy resources in South America, to analyze "the location", "the quantity" and "the quality" of wind and solar energy resources will, not only benefit for one country on efficient resource utilization, but also promote the realization of large- scale international resource utilization and complementation. Argentina, as a major country in South America, researches on its renewable energy development is of great significance. This paper completed the renewable resources assessment through modeling and estimating the theoretical reserves, technical potential installed capacity and development cost of wind and solar energy in Argentina. Then, a more precise quantitative evaluation of development potential is given through the calculated development cost and capacity factor of technical potential installed capacity. Finally, after compared the existing power stations with the assessment results, suggestions on how to development renewable energy resources in Argentina are given.

articleTitle: A Pilot Protection for HVDC Transmission Lines Based on Current Correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A new DC line protection is presented on the basis of current correlation of DC filter and DC line. Characteristic analysis on DC filter shows that it behaves like an inductor at high frequency. Based on this characteristic, fault analysis demonstrates for DC line faults, at high frequency, currents of DC filter and DC line are negatively correlated, their correlation coefficient is theoretically -1 for either end of line. Under external faults, near faulty end, the currents of DC filter and DC line are positively correlated, their correlation coefficient is theoretically 1, whereas at the distance faulty end, they are negatively correlated, their correlation coefficient is -1. Thus, current correlations are used to detect faults. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed protection can identify DC line faults accurately. Meanwhile, it has no requirement for two-terminal data synchronization and has low communication requirement. Besides, it is sensitive to high-impedance faults.

Index Terms: High Voltage Direct Current Transmission Lines

articleTitle: ReaxFF-Based Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Polymethylmethacrylate Surface Modification by ROS in Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) is widely applied in electronic and power equipment because of its excellent insulating properties. Studies have shown that surface modification of PMMA by plasma grafting can improve the surface antistatic performance of the material, reduce the surface charge accumulation and prevent surface flashover. The modification of materials by cold atmospheric plasma (CAP) involves the interaction of comprehensive physicochemical factors, among which reactive oxygen species (ROS) play an important role. In this paper, the reactive force field (ReaxFF) was applied to study the related mechanism of modification triggered by three ROS (O, OH, and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) at the atomic level. The results showed that PMMA molecule was oxidized and produced macromolecular radicals and oxygen-containing groups after ROS treatment. These products have active chemical properties because of their unpaired electrons, and other functional groups can be grafted on the surface of materials with these radicals and groups as active sites. The simulation study can provide reference for material modification by graft copolymerization to obtain functional surface according to the expected design.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of active distribution network resilience considering the power supply recovery and interaction of subareas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Extreme weather events lead to large-scale blackouts, resulting in huge economic losses, and a reasonable resilience evaluation system can direct effective methods to reduce these losses. In this paper, an evaluation index system of active distribution network (ADN) resilience is constructed based on analytic hierarchy process considering the supporting role of distributed resources in extreme conditions. Firstly, ADN is divided into several critical and uncritical subareas according to the load characteristics. Based on the fault recovery characteristics of subareas, the resilience indexes such as fault recovery time, outrage time and energy loss percentage are proposed. Secondly, the piecewise linear function is used to normalize the resilience indexes, weights are given to calculate the resilience score of each subarea due to the different load characteristics. Considering the interaction between subareas, the complex correlation coefficient method is used to determine the weight of them and calculate the resilience score of distribution network. Finally, Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the occurrence of extreme weather. The method based on IEEE33 bus example can quantitatively analyze the power supply recovery ability of each subarea and ADN under extreme conditions.

articleTitle: Threshold Voltage Monitoring Method for SiC MOSFET Based on Body Diode Voltage under Body Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Threshold voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TH</inf>) shift caused by bias temperature instability (BTI) has become the most serious reliability problems in silicon carbide (SiC) metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET). BTI-induced V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TH</inf> shift is divided into recoverable shift and permanent shift. The traditional V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TH</inf> shift measurement method for silicon (Si) devices is difficult to monitor the recoverable shift of SiC MOSFET. To solve this problem, firstly, based on the physical structure and working principle of SiC MOSFET, this paper establishes an analytical model of forward voltage of body diode (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SD</inf>) under body effect based on the reverse conduction resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SD-ON</inf>). Secondly, the influence mechanism of BTI on V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SD</inf> is studied. Finally, a method is proposed to monitor V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TH</inf> of SiC MOSFET utilizing the forward voltage of body diode under body effect at small current. The experimental results prove that this method can real-time extract V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TH</inf>, and the monitoring method is simple.

articleTitle: An Improved Crowbar Control Circuit of DFIG during LVRT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent decades, the installed capacity of wind power is increased greatly, and doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) occupies a dominant position among wind power generators due to its excellent characteristics. However, how to improve the low voltage ride through (LVRT) success rate of doubly fed induction generator during the grid fault especially unsymmetrical grid fault of great value. Based on an improved crowbar control strategy, this paper designs a new control circuit, optimizes the control process, and improves its control speed. Finally, the simulation of MATLAB/Simulink shows that the rationality of this control circuit.

articleTitle: Morphology and Radiation Characteristics of Blue Core in Argon Helicon Plasma Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Argon helicon plasma is typically associated with a blue core, namely a radially localized central area of strong ion light emission. An experimental study was carried out to study the morphology and radiation characteristics of blue core in argon helicon plasma discharge. Experiments were carried out with two technics including Local Optical Emission Spectroscopy (LOES) and time-integrated images with digital camera. In particular, the helicon mode, characterized by the intense blue core plasma, can be achieved by adjusting the input parameters such as RF power, magnetic field, and operating pressure. Analysis of a prominent characteristic line (ArII 481.0 nm) of blue core indicates that the intensity of ion line increases linearly with the RF power, magnetic field, or operating pressure in certain intervals (when 1000 W< P< 2000 W or 250 Gauss < B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> < 500 Gauss or 0.1 Pa< p< 1.0 Pa). Apart from this, blue core width increases with the power while decreases with an increase in magnetic field or operating pressure. In order to further understand the formation of the blue core, parameter regarding electron temperature is adopted to reveal that the increase of the intensity of ion line depends strongly on the increase of electron temperature.

articleTitle: Influence of Soil Structure On Coating Voltage of Buried Pipeline When Lightning Strikes Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transmission lines and buried oil and gas pipelines are very similar in the principle of selecting paths, the situation that transmission lines and buried oil and gas pipelines are parallel for a long distance or intersected occurs constantly. When the transmission line is struck by lightning, the safety of buried oil and gas pipelines will be threatened. In this paper, CDEGS is used to study the influence of uniform soil, horizontal stratified soil and vertical stratified soil on the pipeline induced voltage when the buried oil and gas pipeline is parallel to the transmission line. It can be seen from the study that the maximum coating voltage along the pipeline is mainly related to the soil resistivity around the ground device of the tower struck by lightning. In the design stage of the pipeline and transmission line, the field investigation should be done and the transmission line should be arranged on the side with low soil resistivity.

articleTitle: An Iterative Heuristic Method to Determine Radial Topology for Distribution System Restoration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Coordinating multiple local power sources can restore critical loads after the major outages caused by extreme events. Maintaining radial topology after restoration is essential for distribution system, while determining the topology for online decision is a challenge. In this paper, a graph theory-based iterative heuristic method to determine the radial topology applied in distribution system restoration is proposed. The proposed method is validated by one snapshot and multi-period critical distribution system restoration models on different cases. The case studies indic ate that the proposed method can determine radial topology in a few seconds and ensure the restoration capacity.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Scattering Characteristics on DALI Controlled Plasma-covered Target
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electromagnetic scattering experiment and measurement system of plasma-covered target were established by DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface) control system. The imaging measurement results were obtained through background signal processing, so as to analyze the electromagnetic characteristics of the large blunt cone model under plasma cladding, and the influence of plasma on the target electromagnetic characteristics was analyzed. Based on the simulation calculation and experimental results, the electromagnetic (EM) wave scattering mechanism of the plasma covered target was analyzed, and the electromagnetic scattering analysis model and ground simulation measurement system of the plasma covered target are established.

articleTitle: Field Measurement of Surface Polarization Voltage Around Guangzhou Metro
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the development of subway in China is very rapid, which brings great convenience for people to travel. However, because the subway is not completely insulated from the ground, stray currents can be generated. A measurement scheme was designed to measure the actual geodetic polarization voltage of line 4, Science City and Jinfeng metro line 6 of Guangzhou Metro. The effect of stray current on geodetic polarization voltage is studied. The results show that the potential around the subway system fluctuates all the time. The polarization voltage around the subway is related to the current position of the subway. Moreover, it has been proved that the stray current of subway can affect the geodetic polarization voltage. The polarization voltage caused by stray current can be as high as tens to hundreds of volts.

articleTitle: Research on the Parameters of LC Resonant Filter of Ship High-power Rectifier Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the ship's high-power power electronic equipment completes the transformation of the form of electric energy, the low-frequency harmonics generated will affect the quality of the electric power and pose a threat to the safe and stable operation of the ship's electric power system. Due to the limited internal space of the ship, the size and weight of the filter will be limited. To this end, the LC resonance filtering scheme can be used to eliminate low-frequency harmonic interference at a specific frequency. To study the effect of different LC resonator parameters on the surge current of the resonant branch, a mathematical model with an LC resonant filter on the DC output side of the three-phase uncontrolled rectifier circuit was established, and the surge current flowing through the resonant branch was calculated. It is compared with the established equipment simulation model. At the same time, the mathematical model is combined with the visualization method to establish a four-dimensional model of surge current, and the validity of the mathematical model is verified through experiments, which provides a new way for the selection range of LC resonant filter parameters.

articleTitle: Theoretical Calculation, Simulation and Experimental Analysis of Cavitation Threshold of Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bubble is a serious threaten to the insulation performance of oil-paper insulation system in oil-immersed transformer. The vibration will cause alternating pressure changes in oil and then produce cavitation bubbles. However, the cavitation threshold have not been studied in the electrical field. In this paper, the cavitation threshold in transformer oil is calculated by using the relevant theories of fluid mechanics and bubble dynamics, and then the cavitation threshold under different gas contents is obtained by combining experiment and simulation. It is found that the two results have good consistency. The results show that the cavitation threshold of transformer oil decreases with the increase of gas content and temperature, but presents a certain saturation characteristic with the increase of gas content.

articleTitle: Mechanical Fault Diagnosis of Circuit Breaker Based on Autoencoder Neural Network and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mechanical faults is one of the main faults that occur in the circuit breaker. The vibration signal generated during the opening and closing process of the circuit breaker can effectively reflect its operating state. In this paper, the vibration signal of the circuit breaker under normal and fault conditions is collected by the self made online monitor of the circuit breaker, and the vibration signal is analyzed and processed by using autoencoder neural network and support vector machine. The experimental results show that the autoencoder neural network can effectively extract the characteristics of the vibration signal of the circuit breaker; the support vector machine is used to diagnose the signal, and the high accuracy is obtained on the experimental samples.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis Method for Microhydropower Cluster-Contained Power Distribution Network Based on Voltage-Controlled Current Source Equivalent Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Having equivalence to the conventional constant voltage-sourced series impedance model is impossible because the excitation control system has a strong nonlinear impact on the fault output current of the distributed microhydropower during fault ride- through. Therefore, this paper builds a VCCS fault-equivaient model of the microhydropower cluster by studying its fault features. On this basis, this paper implements fault analysis for the microhydropower- containedpower distribution network and thenprovides an iterative fault component algorithm with consideration of fault ride-through features of the microhydropower. Finally, system modelling and simulation are conducted on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform. The results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is more accurate than the conventional method.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Ionic Wind Thruster with Auxiliary Ring Electrode Configuration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Ionic wind could convert electrical energy to kinetic energy with no need rotating parts, which has attracted wide attention in the field of propulsion, the improvement method of ionic wind thruster performance has been a potential research direction. In this paper, an auxiliary ring electrode structure is designed to adjust the ionization and acceleration process of particles. The reduced electric field and discharge characteristics are investigated to demonstrate the influence of ring electrode to the energy and spatial distribution of particles. Besides, the ionic wind thrust parameters such as ionic wind velocity profiles, thruster and electrical-to-kinetic energy conversion efficiency are further studied to illustrate the improvement effect of auxiliary ring electrode on ionic wind characteristics. These phenomena are investigated by considering the ionization and acceleration process of particles under the effect of auxiliary ring electrode. The results illustrate that the arrangement of auxiliary ring electrode would be a method to improve the ionic wind thrust performance.

articleTitle: Research on Design Method of External Coil of Electromagnetic Rail Launch Equivalent Test Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is difficult to study the interaction mechanism between electromagnetic energy and metal materials directly in the electromagnetic rail launcher. Based on the existing test conditions, under the condition of tens of kiloamperes of current, the loading mode of long pulse current combined with external magnetic field is adopted, which is equivalent to the extreme environment of electromagnetic thermodynamic synthesis in the process of electromagnetic rail launching. In this paper, through theoretical calculation and ANSYS simulation, the magnetic field distribution of circular, rectangular, elliptic and straight slot coils are compared, and the influence of elliptic parameters on the magnetic field is emphatically analyzed. The ratio of long axis to short axis of ellipse when the magnetic field distribution is relatively uniform is obtained by simulated annealing algorithm. The conclusion shows that when the external coil is elliptic and the ratio of long axis to short axis is about 1.6, the magnetic field, current density and electromagnetic force on the metal sample can be equivalent to the electromagnetic rail launch condition.

articleTitle: Daily Dispatching Optimization Model of Virtual Power Plant with Integrated Energy Buildings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to make rational use of resources to improve the terminal energy utilization rate and improve the reliability of day ahead optimization, this paper studies the optimal dispatching potential of virtual power plant with integrated energy buildings considering the uncertain factors such as load forecasting error. Taking into consideration the system security constraints, the day ahead optimal scheduling model of the virtual power plant with comprehensive energy buildings is established to minimize the economic costs including operation and depreciation costs and is solved combining the strategy of dynamically adjusting inertia weights based on S- curve with particle swarm optimization and differential hybrid algorithm. We then analyze the simulation results of buildingtype virtual power plant in summer and winter scenarios, which verify the effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

Author Keywords: the strategy of dynamically adjusting inertia weight

articleTitle: A Numerical Modeling Study on The Influence of Flow Field Inlet Direction on The Performance of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) has advantages of high energy conversion efficiency and pollution free, and is one of the ideal energy devices. As a key component, flow field design influences the useful life, mass transfer and overall output performance of PEMFC, and has always been a research hotspot. In this paper, three-dimensional numerical models of parallel flow field have been established to study the influence of vertical inlet direction and horizontal inlet direction on the PEMFC’s performance. The results show that parallel flow field with horizonal inlet has higher net power output and also has significant advantages over the uniform distribution of pressure, oxygen mass fraction and temperature.

articleTitle: Global Suppression of DC Bias Based Optimal Configuration of Capacitor Blocking Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The capacitor blocking device (CBD) has a good effect on suppressing DC offset of a single transformer. However, incorrect configuration of CBDs will cause the bias current to shift, which will increase the bias current of other transformers in the regional grid. This paper proposes an improved multi-objective discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm (MODPSO) to optimize the configuration of the CBDs from a global perspective. First, analyze the flow path of the bias current in the AC power grid, and then build the earth-grid equivalent resistance model. Secondly, the mathematical model is constructed with the minimum number of the CBDs installed and the minimum sum of the transformer neutral current as the optimization objective. And the concept of adaptive inertia weight and particle mutation is introduced into the improved MODPSO, so as to find the Pareto optimal frontier of this problem. Finally, the correctness and superiority of the algorithm are verified through calculation examples, and the optimal configuration of the CBDs is determined accordingly.

articleTitle: Flashover Characteristics of Epoxy Insulator in SF6/CF4 Gas Mixture at Low Temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Extremely cold weather may damage the internal insulation performance of gas insulated electrical equipment, resulting in threats to the reliability of the equipment. The surface flashover characteristics of insulator in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>/CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gas mixture at low temperature are obtained. The results show that when temperature decreases from 20°C to -50°C, the flashover voltage first decreases, then increases, and finally decreases. Compared with the experimental results in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, gas, it is found that the variation trend of flashover voltage is similar, but the variation degree in the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>/CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> mixed gas is less than that in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas. The flashover voltage in 0.7MPa 50%SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>/50%CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> is slightly lower than that in 0.5MPa SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, and the gap becomes larger as temperature decreases. When temperature is higher than -35°C, using 0.5MPa pure SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas or 0.7MPa 50%SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>/50%CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gas mixture can both ensure that the surface insulation performance does not decrease significantly at lower temperature compared with that at 20 °C. However, the surface flashover voltage in 0.7MPa 50%SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>/50%CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gas mixture at -50°C is about 30% lower than that at 20°C, indicating that the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> content in the gas mixture should be reduced at -50°C.

articleTitle: Improved High-Precision Extraction Algorithm for Resistive Current of Three Phase Arresters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The on-line monitoring of arrester resistive leakage current can effectively judge the operation of arresters. The fundamental current and the third harmonic current are the key indicators to judge the aging and damp of arrester, which are particularly important for the on-line monitoring of Metal oxide surge arrester (MOA). However, due to the influence of interphase interference and harmonic voltage of power grid, the accuracy of on-line monitoring results is not high and there are large errors. In this paper, the self capacitance and stray capacitance of three-phase arrester are calculated to separate the capacitive current from the total leakage current, so as to effectively reduce the influence of interphase interference. At the same time, the influence of grid harmonics on resistive third harmonic current is compensated to improve the accuracy of resistive leakage current. The algorithm builds a simulation model on the MATLAB / Simulink platform, obtains the capacitance values by using the algorithm, and verifies the correctness of the algorithm by evaluating the error between the extracted resistive current value and the ideal resistive current value. In addition, by analyzing the influence of interphase interference under different voltage fluctuations and different total harmonic distortion rate of power grid, it is proved that the algorithm can effectively reduce the influence of interphase interference.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Electromagnetic-Thermal Coupling Characteristics of Flux Switching PM Linear Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the electromagnetic-thermal coupling characteristics of the primary integrated and primary separated flux switching PM linear motor are compared. The thermal analysis models of primary integrated and primary separated flux switching PM linear motor are established. The steady temperature and transient temperature rise of two kinds of motors are calculated in rated operation respectively. Based on the calculation of temperature rise, the influence of motor temperature rise on the permanent magnet in different primary structures is analyzed. In addition, the influence on the electromagnetic properties of motors are investigated. The no-load EMF and load thrust of different primary structures at different temperature are compared. It is concluded that the electromagnetic performance of the primary separated flux switching PM linear motor is less affected by the temperature rise of the motor, and it is more suitable for the long-term operation of the working field.

articleTitle: The Research of Multi-port Energy Router Based on Cascade Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the types of energy are getting more plentiful and the scale of energy is increasing, the distributed energy access and consumption method represented by micro-grid is increasingly growing in voltage level. This article presents an idea of a multi-port energy router based on cascade framework in order to decrease the extra equipment input and redundancy brought by the voltage raising of micro-grid. The router is composed of multiple cascaded DC/DC transformers; it has one input port and numbers of output ports. The input end is facing to micro-grid system with high voltage level, the output end is facing to multiple load demands, and it will provide flexible power output in accordance with power demand of load sides. In addition, in order to realize the coordination control of different output ends, this article puts forward the method of distributed power control. This method could realize independent power control of each port, and receive coordination orders from dispatch center; Which could greatly increase the controllability of micro-grid. In the end, a three-port cascaded energy router that is built based on SIMULINK proves the feasibility of scenario presented in this article and the effectiveness of distributed control.

articleTitle: Front-end Stage Design of a Two-stage Grid-tied PV Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Two-stage grid-tied PV inverters with a Boost and an H-bridge inverter are widely used. The efficiency improvement and leakage current suppression are the two main challenges for such a two-stage design. This paper presents a design method for the front-end stage. Firstly, the diodes in the Boost are replaced by the SiC MOSFETs to reduce the conduction loss, and the parameters of the Boost are optimized to increase the efficiency. Secondly, the parasitic capacitors of the SiC MOSFETs are considered, so that the CM filter design in the front-end can compromise the leakage current suppression. The effectiveness and validity are verified on a 1kW two-stage inverter.

articleTitle: A Metro Traction Power Load Forecasting Model Based on Dynamic Passenger Flow
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to economic and environmental considerations, energy consumption by subway trains has attracted wide attention. This paper proposes a forecast model of train traction power consumption based on 24-hour dynamic passenger flow. The model considers the influence of passenger mass on traction energy consumption. Besides calculating the power consumption, the train traction transmission system’s equivalent circuit model is introduced in the power load forecasting model. Finally, a Beijing metro line was selected for the case study. The simulation results show that the proposed prediction model can improve traction power consumption accuracy compared with the traditional method, and the error of traction power load forecasting is within 5%.

articleTitle: Surface Charge Accumulation and Trap Characteristics of SiO2/SR Composite
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicone rubber (SR) is an insulating material widely used in DC cable accessories. Its interface is a weak area of insulation and there is a problem of charge accumulation. Hydrated silica (SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>•nH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O) is a reinforcing agent commonly used in SR, and its main component is SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. This article is based on polymethylvinylsiloxane, doped with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> particles of different mass fractions. The attenuation of the isothermal surface potential of the sample was tested. Combined with the isothermal surface potential attenuation model, the trap characteristics of the sample are obtained. The results show that the doped SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> introduces a large number of traps on the surface of the SR, among which deep traps are the main ones. Based on the principle of molecular dynamics, simulation calculations of related molecules were carried out, and the results were consistent with the experimental results. The Si-O-Si bond formed by SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SR and the hydroxyl group on the surface of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> introduce impurity trap energy levels between the original forbidden band and conduction band, thereby affecting the surface charge transfer. The results of the research provide help for the design of DC cable accessories.

articleTitle: Fractal analysis of positive streamer branching produced with field ionization in gaseous, liquid, and supercritical CO2
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Field ionization is adopted as a streamer initiation mechanism in highly pressurized CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, using a 3D particle model. The field ionization is implemented into the 3D model through Zener’s model. Streamer evolution is classified into three stages; inception cloud formation, main streamer channels, and subsequent streamer branching independent of the medium state. The comparison of average electron density, electric field, and the length of streamer in three thermodynamic states of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is presented. Box counting method is used to calculate the fractal value (D) for positive streamer pattern in gaseous, liquid, and supercritical (SC) CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. The figures of streamer discharge obtained from the 3D simulation model are fractal with fractal dimension for gaseous, liquid phase, and SC- CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as 1.577, 1.578, and 1.587. The results of fractal analysis of positive streamer branching in this paper are consistent with the fractal values of streamer in the SC-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> through experiments in literature.

articleTitle: An Explicit MPTC Method for Improving Dynamic Performance of SPM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel explicit model predictive torque control (EMPTC) method is proposed to achieve optimal transient torque behavior of the surface mount permanent-magnet synchronous machine (SPM). The proposed method uses single-step prediction based on discrete model of the SPM drive. The transient-state duration is estimated, and the proposed EMPTC method is implemented during the transient state. A space voltage vector with an optimal phase then is applied to the motor using space vector modulation (SVM). Comparative investigation of the proposed strategy with deadbeat method were carried out. The simulation results indicate that the proposed method can achieve faster dynamic response while maintaining the same level of calculation amount.

articleTitle: Calculation of branch short circuit asymmetrical current considering breaking sequences
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale of power grid interconnection, the grid connection is becoming more and more closely, and the grid resistance ratio is also increasing, which slows down the attenuation of the DC component of the short-circuit current, and affects the checking of the breaking capacity of the circuit breaker. At present, in practice, only the periodic component of the short circuit point is considered in checking the breaking capacity of the circuit breaker, and the short-circuit asymmetric current affected by the DC component is not considered. A method is proposed to calculate the DC component of the short circuit current flowing through the circuit breaker directly in this paper. Firstly, the fault point is divided into two parts by node splitting method, and the node impedance matrix is modified based on the branch-adding method. Then, the DC component of the short-circuit current can be obtained by using the transfer impedance obtained by the modified node impedance matrix. Finally, the maximum short-circuit asymmetric current flowing through the circuit breaker branch is calculated and compared with the symmetric component of the short-circuit point. It is suggested that the former should be used to check the breaking capacity of the circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Research on The Ignition Performance of Embedded Multichannel Plasma Igniter under Extreme Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Using the extreme environment test system, the ignition experiment of semiconductor igniter (SI) and embedded multichannel plasma igniter (EMPI) was carried out based on the component combustion chamber, and the influence of low- temperature on ignition performance was explored. The energy dissipation increases in the ignition environment of low- temperature and normal-pressure, which makes ignition difficult, and the flame intensity is weakened. The strong penetrating ability of the EMPI can compensate for the adverse effects of low-temperature cooling and has wider low-temperature ignition boundary. The EMPI can generate sparks with a deeper penetration depth, significantly shorten the ignition time.

articleTitle: Improved Implementation and Analysis of Modal Frequency Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Resonance seriously affects power quality and stable operation of power grid. Resonance modal analysis (RMA) provides a convenient way for locating the resonance frequency. However, the modal frequency sensitivity calculation process is complex and its relationship between each component has not been studied. In this paper. A parallel RLC branch is used to improve the implementation of modal frequency sensitivity. Then, the relationship between modal frequency sensitivity and each component and resonance frequency is analyzed. The proposed improved method provides guidance for suppressing resonance and resonance frequency shift.

articleTitle: A Restart Method for PMSM Driving a High-Inertia Load with a Single DC-link Shunt Resistor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the application of inverter with a single DC-link shunt resistor, in order to realize the speed sensor-less control of the motor the DC-link current is used to reconstruct the motor phase current. Since there is no speed sensor, the actual position and speed of the motor at the time of re-starting remain unknown. This paper presents a method for re-starting a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) driving a high-inertia load with a single DC-link shunt resistor. When the line back-EMF amplitude is lower than the DC-link voltage, the half bridge of the inverter adopts a specific impulse conduction mode to instantaneous short-circuit two of the three phases of the motor. And, the negative peak envelope of the DC-link current response has the same frequency with the motor line back EMF, also the amplitude is proportional to the motor line back EMF. The actual rotor position and speed is determined by analyzing the phase relationship and detecting the characteristic points of the DC-link current peak. The experimental results show that the proposed method can re-start the PMSM with high-inertia load using a single DC-link current sample, and has the advantages of low parameter sensitivity, easy engineering realization, and strong versatility.

articleTitle: Parametric Sensitivity Analysis and Torque Characteristic Optimization of the PMSM with Non- uniformly Partitioned Halbach Array
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the torque performance of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), a novel PMSM with non-uniformly partitioned Halbach array (NU-HA) is proposed in this paper. The orthogonal experiments are carried out based on FEA to analyze the structural parameters sensitivities to the average torque (Ave-T) and torque ripple ratio (TRR) of the proposed PMSM with NU-HA. Based on abundant FEA parametric simulations, the Kriging surrogate model is adopted to establish the mathematical model of the PMSM with NU-HA, which may be used for the further optimization. It is found that the maximum relative error is less than 3%, and the determination coefficient is basically close to 1, verifying the accuracy of the mathematical model. In order to improve the Ave- T and reduce the TRR, the structural parameters of the novel PMSM are optimized by using the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA II). Through multi-objective optimization, the TRR is significantly reduced from 34.2% to 2.05%, and the Ave- T is improved by 2.02%.

Author Keywords: the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Pollution Characteristics of Ground Materials for HVDC Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a wire-tube electrode system is used to simulate the pollution characteristics of ground materials for HVDC transmission lines. The results show that under the same experimental conditions, the pollution mass of the ground conducting materials is greater than that of the ground insulating materials, and the pollution mass of the ground materials after the corona discharge is significantly greater than that of the ground material before the corona discharge. With the increase of pollution accumulation time, the intensity of corona discharge increases gradually, the pollution rate on the ground conducting materials increases gradually, and the pollution rate on the ground insulating materials decreases gradually. The pollution mass increases linearly with the concentration of particulate matter before corona discharge, while with the increase of the concentration of particulate matter, the pollution mass shows a trend of gradually saturation after corona discharge. With the increase of conductor diameter, the pollution mass of the ground materials decreases gradually. By covering the dielectric film on high-voltage conductor, pollution can be obviously inhibited.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy Live-line Calibrator for Current Transformer in power Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional current transformer calibrator for distribution network does not meet the requirements of live-line calibration due to functional and structural reasons. In order to improve the calibration accuracy and solve the problem of live-line calibration, a high-precision clamp-type current transformer was selected as the standard sensor, and impedance adjustment circuit was applied to realize the compensation of current transformer ratio error and angle error; an innovative AD acquisition and data processing program was used to effectively reduce the error during signal conditioning; the calibrator can directly measure the current signal of the current transformer to realize the live line calibration of the current transformer of the distribution network. The test results show that the accuracy of the current transformer calibrator can reach 0.05% without power interruption, which improves the efficiency of on-site calibrator and reduces the loss caused by the current transformer calibration.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Speed Control of PMSM Based on Improved Super Twisting Algorithm Considering Lumped Disturbance Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a nonlinear speed control strategy based on improved super twisting algorithm (ISTA) considering lumped disturbance compensation (LDC) is proposed for the control of permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs). A new function is proposed to replace the sign function in super twisting algorithm, which relieves the chattering phenomenon and improves the control smoothness. Moreover, to further improve the dynamic performance of the control system, lumped disturbance compensation is utilized with the load torque estimated online by a discrete reduced order observer. The performance of the proposed control method is analyzed comparatively.

articleTitle: Regional Comprehensive Energy Optimization Based on Multi-energy Complementation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of economic optimization of distributed energy systems, comprehensively considering the three aspects of power generation cost, environmental cost, and maintenance cost, a relatively accurate model of distributed micro-sources is established, and the characteristics of changing conditions during operation are considered. The power generation efficiency and heating efficiency of the gas turbine and waste heat boiler are affected by the actual load. Compared with the traditional optimal dispatching of power grids, the optimal dispatching model of integrated energy is more complicated. First of all, while considering the balance of electric power, it is also necessary to ensure the balance of supply and demand of heating load and cooling load. Finally, by improving the traditional particle swarm algorithm, changing its inertia factor and learning factor, the convergence speed and stability of the model solution are improved. Using calculation examples to analyze, the results improve the economy of the system and the flexibility of system adjustment.

articleTitle: Integrated Modeling and Dynamic Characteristics Analysis of Low Voltage Intelligent Electromagnetic Switch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Low voltage electromagnetic switches are widely used in distribution systems, its action characteristic is related to the performance of the switch, also affects the power quality of the network. This article took the intelligent electromagnetic switch as the research object, established its 3D simulation model. Introduce the 3D model into the Recurdyn multi-body dynamics software, and then use Simulink to build an intelligent control circuit. Through the electro-magnetic-mechanical integrated simulation, the dynamic characteristic parameters such as the closing speed, closing time and bounce time of the contact during the pull-in process of the prototype ware obtained. The influence of different coil reference currents, contact springs and reaction springs on the contact bounce of the prototype was analyzed from the perspective of dynamics. The research has a good reference significance for improving the action characteristics of electromagnetic switch.

articleTitle: Architecture and business model of power grid marketing and distribution integration system based on middle platform technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper briefly describes the development status and construction requirements of the power grid marketing and distribution integration (MDI for short). It puts forward the overall architecture of MDI system based on the middle platform technology, expounds its technical architecture, and studies the key business model of the MDI system. At present the system has been applied as a pilot in the Customer Service Center of SGCC and interconnected with 27 provincial companies.
