The application results show that the system can realize data integration and sharing, which has good promotion value, and its system technical architecture and business model can provide useful experience for the construction of similar products.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Characteristics of Plasma Channel in An Interdigitated GaAs Photoconductive Semiconductor Switch at nJ Optical Excitation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To explore the transient characteristics and stability of gallium arsenide photoconductive semiconductor switches (GaAs PCSS) in high gain (HG) mode, the GaAs PCSS with interdigitated electrodes whose gaps are in the order of ~μm, is performed at 1-kHz optical excitation. The spatio-temporal characteristics of the plasma channel consisted of a large number of photo-generated electron-hole pairs are demonstrated by the simulation of Monte Carlo. The results show that HG mode at 1-kHz repetitive operation can be achieved with the special electrode structure under nJ optical excitation and the generation of the plasma channel can be attributed to the accumulation of high-density electron-hole pairs and the transportation of the high-density filamentary current.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Fault Location Based on Sequence Current Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the low automation level of distribution network, the limited available monitoring data and the difficulty in fault location, this paper proposes a fault location method based on sequence current matching idea, which only uses the monitoring data of the first end of feeder in substation to realize fault location. The fault branch is located by matching the actual fault data with the data in node fault library. And then calculate the fault distance using the curve function of the fault branch, the fault distance is determined and the actual fault point is found. The analysis of an example shows that this method has a good positioning effects.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Nonsingular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Three-dimensional Single Machine Infinite Bus System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel adaptive backstepping nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode controller is investigated for the chaotic dynamic behavior of a third-order single machine infinite bus power system. The backstepping control strategy is employed to decompose the power system model into three subsystems, and guarantees the progressive convergence of each subsystem through virtual control. Meanwhile, a novel nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control is designed to improve the convergence speed by making the last subsystem converge in a finite time. At the same time, high-order derivatives of state variables are avoided, and an adaptive rate is introduced to eliminate the interference of uncertain parameters on the system. The effectiveness, robustness and superiority of the controller are verified in simulation results.

Author Keywords: single machine infinite bus power system

articleTitle: Deadbeat control of MMC with reduced sensors for robustness enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As common submodule (SM) capacitor voltage measuring method of modular multilevel converter(MMC) requiring large number of voltage sensors, submodule voltage measuring technique based on observation is then introduced to reduce voltage sensors. However, observed submodule capacitor voltage has a strong dependence on the parameters, which will reduce the robustness of MMC control system. In this paper, a deadbeat control method for MMC with reduced sensors is proposed to enhance the robustness, which is just uses the arm bridge current and the load current reference value as the control input to improve the robustness of the operation performance. Simulation and experimental results have proven the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

Author Keywords: reduced number of capacitor voltage sensors

articleTitle: Design of power insurance products based on risk management in spot market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To future deepen the electric market reforms, it is a need to strengthen market transaction risk management. In the electricity spot market, clearing price fluctuate rapidly with large fluctuations. Market participants may suffer significant losses due to improper trading strategies or unexpected failure to complete the contract. However, the existing risk control methods can't be effective and sustainable, which still base on administrative means. Therefore, it is necessary to study risk management methods which is matched with the construction of power market. This paper proposes a series of power financial insurance products to alleviate risks faced by market participants. First, the transaction risk in spot market is determined to be insurable, which is judged by the analysis of the scope and composition of the insurable risk. Second, power insurance products such as market income insurance, market price insurance and accident insurance were designed, which also been explained in detail by case studies. Finally, an illustrative example is proposed to demonstrate the risk aversion effects of insurance products and financial derivative products, thereby proving the validity and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Voltage Management Strategy for Distribution Network with TCLs Equivalent Energy Storage Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a voltage regulation strategy with thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) equivalent energy storage model to alleviate voltage magnitude. Then, a voltage management model incorporating TCLs is developed as a multi-objective optimization model that collectively minimizes demand response (DR) cost, network loss and voltage deviation. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method achieves lower network loss and maintains safe voltage levels under renewable power injection. Finally, the proposed method is verified by testing examples.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Composite Insulator Companies Based on the Randomized Procedure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the production characteristics of composite insulator companies, the independent random states had been calculated in the productions of composite insulator by the statics which had been get from the supervision of UHV projects on the base of stochastic process theory. The method of signal statics chain about the period by the project and time has been brought up and the distribution of normal state and other states of production have been showed. The production capacity has been described by the stratification of Markov chain with the Cascade model of the normal state and other states of production. The stratification rule is that the mutual independence had been regarded as so that the each production capacity of composite insulator companies could been compared.

articleTitle: Comparative study on the characteristics of terahertz narrow passband of different plasma photonic crystals with defects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the terahertz wave propagation in four types of microplasma photonic crystals (MPPC) with defects is simulated using COMSOL RF module. The effects of defect size and electron density on the characteristics of the terahertz narrow passband of these MPPC are investigated. In one-dimensional plasma photonic crystals, the central frequency and bandwidth of the narrow passband can be tuned in a wide range by adjusting the electron density and defect layer thickness. When the thickness of the defect layer increases from 150 μm to 250 μm, the central frequency of the narrow passband is reduced from 0.9 THz to 0.7 THz. When the electron density changes from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> to 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, narrow passband bandwidth rises from 10 GHz to 15 GHz, and the central frequency of the narrow passband shifts from about 0.75 THz to 0.77 THz.

articleTitle: Study on Levitation Characteristics of the Superconducting EDS Maglev Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The levitation and guidance system of the superconducting electrodynamic levitation(EDS) maglev vehicle includes superconducting magnets and 8-shaped levitation coils. Based on the dynamic theory, the mathematical model of the levitation system is established. Levitation characteristics of the superconducting EDS maglev vehicle are analyzed. The levitation force and guiding force of the vehicle will gradually increase to saturation as the speed increases, and the magnetic resistance will first increase and then decrease. The magnetic resistance is much smaller than the levitation force, and the buoyancy-to-resistance ratio is large. It proves that the vehicle has a good buoyancy-to- resistance ratio when running at high speed. And the levitation stiffness is conducive to the stable operation of the vehicle. It is also concluded that as the vehicle sinks, the levitation force will first increase and then decrease.

articleTitle: Comparison of different controling strategies of an integrated ground source energy system operated in a passive office building
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing pressure from energy-saving and emission reduction, buildings of Ultra-low energy targets and Near-zero energy targets based on passive techniques are promoted rapidly in China. As the final link of building energy conservation, the efficient operation and control of energy systems are quite important for passive buildings. In this paper, as for the well-used integrated ground source energy systems, physical simulation and actual measurements are carried out to compare the adaptability of different operation strategies. Specifically, after calibrated via measurements, three typical controlling strategies are simulated and compared, including temperature control, temperature difference control and timing starting control. When making comparison, indexes of Predicted Mean Vote (MPV) and Predicted Percentage Dissatisfied (PPD) are adopted. Finally, by comparing the thermal comfort and energy consumption under different control strategies, the optimal operation strategy of different seasons was suggested for passive buildings in the cold region of China.

articleTitle: Analytical Optimization of Surface-Mounted Machines With Odd-/Even-Piece Halbach Magnets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An analytical optimization technique for surface-mounted electrical machines having odd-/even-piece Halbach magnets has been proposed. The magnetic fields caused by the odd-/even-piece Halbach arranged magnets are solved. The electromagnetic parameters are analyzed and derived for odd- /even-piece Halbach machines. For the purpose of maximizing the electromagnetic torque, the optimal radian ratio of each magnet piece and/or the orientation angle of each side-magnet can be analytically determined. The performances of optimized three-/four-piece Halbach machines are better than those of corresponding conventional Halbach machines. The analytically optimized results are validated with a finite-element method.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Acoustic Detection Method for the Dispersion of Nanocomposite Dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nanocomposite dielectrics have attracted more and more attention in the field of insulation due to their good mechanical and electrical properties. The dispersion of nano fillers in dielectrics has a great influence on the properties of materials. However, the detection of dispersion mainly depends on scanning electron microscopy, which has a narrow detection field and damages the samples. There is no non-destructive testing method that can measure it quickly and quantitatively. Based on the principle of nonlinear acoustics, this paper theoretically analyzes the mechanical relationship between uniform dispersion and agglomeration of nanoparticles, and preliminarily reveals the nonlinear source of agglomeration. Then the test samples with different dispersion degree were prepared, and the dispersion of the samples was characterized by scanning electron microscopy. Finally, the relationship between nonlinear coefficient and nanoparticle dispersion was explored by nonlinear ultrasonic testing. The experimental results provide a new idea for the evaluation of nanoparticle dispersion by nonlinear acoustic method.

articleTitle: Research on overcurrent stability of HTS cable for energy pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since High temperature superconducting(HTS) cable has almost no loss and strong current carrying capacity, it is widely used in the field of long distance and large capacity transmission technology. In the process of transmission, the HTS cable will inevitably be impacted by the overcurrent fault current. In this process, the cable will generate a lot of heat, which may make the superconductor quench. It will affect the current carrying capacity of HTS cable and cause potential safety hazard. Therefore, it is necessary to study the over-current stability of HTS cables. This paper mainly studies the over-current stability of 1kA HTS cable. Firstly, the temperature distribution of two different structures HTS DC cables are studied by the finite element simulation method under different over-current faults. The ability to withstand HTS current over-current is analyzed. Then, the stability of the HTS cable over-current in the temperature range of 85-90K is studied, and the current impact test of the selected HTS tape is carried out in different temperature ranges. The critical current after the impact is measured by the impact current of 480A, 700A, 900A and 2000A respectively. The influence of the over-current on the superconducting tape is analyzed. Finally, the over-current stability of the HTS tape is summarized.

articleTitle: Research on the Service Life of High-Voltage Vacuum Circuit Breaker of High-speed Train
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vacuum circuit breaker (VCB) is an essential component of the high-speed train power supply system. The state of the high-voltage vacuum circuit breaker is critical to the safe and stable operation of the high-speed train. Due to the different special working conditions, the life characteristics of high-voltage vacuum circuit breakers for high-speed trains are different from those of ordinary high-voltage vacuum circuit breakers. The working principle, structure, and failure mechanism of vacuum circuit breakers are analyzed to solve this problem. A method based on the degradation trajectory is proposed to establish a performance degradation model. To study the service life of the vacuum circuit breaker, the opening and closing time test of the vacuum circuit breaker and the main circuit resistance value test experiment were carried out. According to the test results, the service life was predicted using its degradation model. The results show that under the current operating conditions of the mobile unit, the vacuum circuit breaker has reached the service life when the operating mileage is 4.717 820 million kilometers, which provides an important reference for the condition monitoring, maintenance, and repair of the high-voltage vacuum circuit breaker for the high-speed train.

articleTitle: Research on Statistical Downscaling Method of Meteorological Data Based on Photovoltaic Power Forecast
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of traditional photovoltaic power prediction, a statistical downscaling method embedded with high-precision meteorological data is proposed. In this method, It can effectively make up for the insufficiency of future meteorological changes in the forecast area and provide more accurate meteorological data for photovoltaic power forecasting. The basis of this approach is that regional meteorological changes are conditional on large-scale weather. The statistical downscaling method takes the large-scale numerical forecast product as the forecast factor, establishes the statistical model between the regional forecast quantity and the large-scale forecast factor by using the historical data, and realizes the downscaling of the numerical forecast product. The simulation experiment is carried out using the weather forecast data of a certain area. The experiment shows that the method can effectively improve the error influence caused by the lower resolution, and it has practical significance.

articleTitle: Unit Commitment with Concentrating Solar Power Plant Considering Receiver Operation Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Concentrating solar power (CSP) is developing rapidly and becoming a promising alternative to utilize solar energy. Equipped with thermal energy storage (TES), CSP is operational flexible which is beneficial for the operation of the power grid. The central receiver of CSP switches its operation mode under fluctuating solar irradiance to maximize solar energy collection and ensure the operation safety. This paper establishes a detailed CSP model which incorporates the operation mode of the central receiver to improve the model accuracy. A unit commitment model is proposed for the optimal dispatch with CSP under high renewable energy penetration to analyze the benefits of CSP both economically and technically. The results of the IEEE 30-node system show that CSP with TES improves the dispatchability and reduces both operation cost and renewable energy curtailment at various scenarios.

articleTitle: Simulation of Capacitive Circuit Discharge in Gas Environment Based on PIC-MCC Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The output short circuit of switch changer applied in coal mine can be equivalent to capacitor short circuit discharge. In order to study the micro process of capacitor short circuit discharge and the influence of voltage and capacitance value on discharge characteristics, the PIC/MCC method was used to establish a two-dimensional needle-plate electrostatic model. By changing the voltage between electrodes and the size of external capacitance, it is found that the voltage amplitude and capacitance have a significant effect on the discharge degree of the needle plate, and the influence of capacitance capacity is not as great as that of voltage. With the increase of voltage and capacity parameters, the average energy of the electron increases gradually, the maximum current also increases, and the voltage discharge speed accelerates. Due to the enhancement of the electric fieldBetween the poles, the energy obtained by the electrons is relatively high, the speed of motion is accelerated, and collide to ionize more particles.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive Equivalent Modeling for Small Signal Stability Analysis of Wind Farm under Wind Speed Variation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy generation, the increase of wind turbines makes stability analysis difficult. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a self- adaptive equivalent modeling of wind farm with various wind speed for small signal analysis. Firstly, the frequency domain model of wind farm is constructed, and the small signal impedance model of wind turbines is changed to the external circuit by Schur transform. Then, we decompose the dynamic characteristics of the wind turbines, compare the system’s eigenvalues under the dominant mode and categorize the turbines. The number of equivalent turbines is determined by turbine control parameters and network topology. Finally, the equivalent parameters are calculated to build the equivalent model. The simulation result, based on the MATLAB/Simulink platform, verifies the rationality of the proposed self-adaptive equivalent modeling method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive economic evaluation system of distribution network considering emergency resources
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the current situation of the research on the economics of distribution network, this paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation index system for the economics of the distribution network considering emergency resource scheduling. Including financial evaluation indicators considering life cycle cost (LCC), reliability evaluation index and emergency resource scheduling index. Then select the subjective and objective combination of analytic hierarchy process and entropy method to determine the index weight, in order to make the indicator weights more realistic and effective. Finally, analyze an example of distribution network planning in a certain area to verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Model predictive control for PMSM drives with switching frequency optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the conventional model predictive control (MPC) of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with virtual voltage vector, this paper proposes a control strategy, in which the innovation lies in that the switching frequency can be significantly decreased. In the proposed control strategy, firstly, all the basic voltage vectors are used to predict the current by using the current prediction equation of PMSM, then values of cost function are calculated and sorted, and the four voltage vectors that minimize cost function are chosen as the candidate voltage vectors; secondly, the operation of the motor in the next control period is considered, the candidate voltage vectors is used to predict the current in the next control period, and the voltage vector with the minimum cost function is selected as the optimal vector to control the drive signal of the inverter. The simulation results show that the optimization effect of the proposed MPC control strategy will become more obvious with the increase of the speed, and the switching frequency, torque ripple and current harmonic can be reduced while the system is running at a higher speed, so as to realize the overall optimization of the system performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Strategy for Synchronous Reluctance Starter Generator at Low Voltage DC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The More Electric Aircraft and All Electric Aircraft are very important development directions of airplane in the future, which calls for high integration and reliability in their power systems. Recently switched reluctance motor and the three-stage brushless synchronous motor are widely used in the aeronautic starter/generator system. Considering the reliability and maintainability of the power system, as well as the power density and loss characteristics of the motor, synchronous reluctance motor can be used as both starter and generator. This paper develops a new scheme of starter/generator system using synchronous reluctance motor and DC/DC converter for low voltage high power drive situation.

articleTitle: Observation of a suspected positive space leader in long air gaps
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to get more details about the leader propagation in long positive sparks, experiments were conducted in a rod-plane air gap with a length of 74 cm. The low-density area was imaged using a Schlieren system with spatial and temporal resolutions of 70 μm/pixel and 5 μs. Moreover, the discharge current and applied switching impulse were recorded synchronously. A suspected space leader is observed for the first time. By analyzing typical experimental results, it is assumed that there may be four stages included in the incepting and developing processes of a positive space stem and a leader: (1) the first corona streamers is initiated around the electrode tip; (2) a bipolar system or a pilot is formed; (3) the space stem is transited to a space leader; (4) electrode leader and the space leader are connected to each other. Comparing the phenomenon in positive discharge with that in negative discharges, it can be found that: (1) the propagation sequence of the bipolar system in both polarities discharges is very similar; (2) the size of the bipolar system in positive discharges is smaller.

articleTitle: Research on HSI Chromaticity of Visible Light Image in Dielectric Barrier Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Because of the convenience of image acquisition in visible light band, the HSI chromaticity index based on visible image is proposed to characterize the discharge state of DBD in this paper. By extracting the average values of H hue index, S saturation index and I intensity index of discharge digital image, it is found that: 1) With the increase of exposure time of camera, H and S of discharge image in atmospheric pressure air and low-pressure air are basically unchanged, while I is increased, which shows that H and S can overcome the influence of shooting parameters to reflect the discharge state. 2) With the increase of voltage of the power, H and S in atmospheric pressure air discharge gradually increase and then remain unchanged, while H and S in low-pressure air, atmospheric argon and nitrogen basically remain unchanged. 3) With the increase of frequency of the power, H and S in atmospheric pressure air discharge changes irregularly, while H and S in low-pressure air, atmospheric argon and nitrogen basically remain unchanged. These results show that hue and saturation of image can distinguish the filamentous mode and glow mode. It means that even if only light of visible spectrum emitted from plasma is captured, the color method can provide sufficient discharge information for economic and convenient use in discharge state detection.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Monitoring and Simulation of Permanent Magnet Generator of Turbogenerator Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important component of large three-stage turbine-generator set, Permanent Magnet Generator (hereinafter called PMG) plays an important role in the safety and stable of the generator set. By studying the structure and load characteristics of pilot exciter, analyze the main failure modes of the PMG; Through SIMULINK model simulation, study the realization method of PMG fault monitoring criterion. This article introduces the model and simulation data of the ground short-circuit fault in detail, and the simulation verifies the effectiveness of using the zero sequence voltage to identify the ground short-circuit fault

articleTitle: 3D simulation and optimization design of the grading electrode for high altitude 500kV substation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electrical wiring in substation is complex, the hardware structure is diverse, and the phenomenon of electric field concentration is serious. In order to make substation have good electrical characteristics, three-dimensional finite element method is used to simulate and calculate the surface field strength of main fitting according to the actual layout of substation. The distribution of potential and electric field of typical equipment in high altitude substation is simulated and calculated. Electric field distribution of grading ring was calculated by considering the tube diameter and ring diameter. The approved parameters of grading ring were gained in terms of controlling the electric field intensity. The results of optimization calculation can provide reference for design and optimization on fitting and have great significance to improve the safe and reliable operation of high altitude substation .

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Electric Trees Based on Fractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The main electric trees simulation models based on fractal theory are the NPW model and the WZ model. In this paper, the effects of the parameters in these two models on the simulation results are compared, and numerical simulations of the epoxy resin CY1311 and CT200 are done with the WZ model. The results show that the fractal dimension of the electric trees is smaller in materials with high breakdown field strength, indicating that increasing the threshold breakdown voltage of the material is an effective measure to suppress the electric trees.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Fault Diagnosis Technology of Isolating Switch Based on Electric Torque
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Isolating switch is a high-voltage switchgear used in the power system, but because of its large number, wide distribution and frequent faults, if the fault type cannot be diagnosed in time and accurately and corrected, it will have a greater impact on the safety of the power grid. Therefore, it is imperative to propose new technologies for fault diagnosis of disconnectors. This paper focuses on how to intelligently diagnose mechanical faults of isolating switches, and proposes a mechanical fault diagnosis technology based on electric torque detection. By comparing and analyzing the operating torque-rotation curve of the GW4A-126 isolating switch in the normal state and the stuck state, it shows that this technology can accurately determine the type and degree of mechanical failure. This technology can provide reference for the installation, debugging, overhaul and maintenance of the isolation switch.

articleTitle: Dimension of Stem Channel after Streamer Corona under Positive Switching Impulses
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A Schlieren system was established to observe the dimension of stem channel near the high-voltage electrode under positive switching impulses. Stems with two different shapes after the first streamer corona were distinguished from the Sclieren images, i.e., the cylinder-shaped one and the frustum-shaped one. The thermal radius and axial length were measured for both types of stems. The measurements were compared with that used in the simulaiton of leader initiation. Moreover, more experiments were carried out under different conditions (voltage rising rate and curvature radius of electrode). The results show that the curvature radius of electrode has a great influence on the type and dimension of a stem.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Control System Based on Asymmetric Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power system is a complex nonlinear dynamic system composed of many units, such as power generation equipment, transformer, transmission and distribution lines and electrical equipment. It is difficult to establish an accurate mathematical model and obtain satisfactory dynamic performance with traditional control theory and method. Liquid level control system is a typical non-linear, time-varying and uncertain control object. Based on conventional fuzzy algorithm, the steady-state control of liquid level control system can be realized, but there are also some problems such as poor dynamic performance and long steady-state response time. In terms of these problems, an intelligent control system based on asymmetric fuzzy algorithm is presented. Simulation results show that excellent dynamic performance can be obtained for the liquid control system with the proposed asymmetric fuzzy, and the steady-state convergence time is shorter than the conventional fuzzy control system.

articleTitle: An Interactive Control Strategy of STATCOM and VDCOL for Suppressing Weak Receiving Commutation Failure of HVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the probability of commutation failure in HVDC weak receiving system, and improve the recovery characteristics of the DC system after a fault, an interactive control strategy of STATCOM and VDCOL (Voltage Dependent Current Order Limiter) was proposed. AC voltage compensation was derived based on the Current -time Area, and added to the STATCOM constant AC voltage control of outer loop to adjust the reactive power of the STATCOM output. Meanwhile, an additional DC current control functions was applied to LCC-HVDC system VDCOL. Simulation in PSCAD/EMTDC showed that the proposed interactive control strategy can restrain commutation failure effectively when the short-circuit fault occurs in the AC bus of the weak receiving system, and the improved VDCOL can strengthen the ability of the DC system to resume stable operation as soon as possible.

articleTitle: An Improved Field Weakening Control of IPMSM with Fuzzy Anti-Windup Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at mitigating the regulator saturation, regulators for speed and current loop in field-oriented control (FOC) system are enhanced by adopting fuzzy anti- windup PI controller. The model of interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSMs) is established using Simulink by advanced current angle flux weakening (FW) strategies. Speed response and torque control of IPMSM is simulated in several situation. Comparing with the performance of fuzzy control, traditional anti-windup regulator and fuzzy anti-windup PI controller, the consequences display that the regulator combines the robustness of fuzzy PI control with the anti-saturation characteristics of anti-windup regulator.

articleTitle: The Structure Design of a New Railway Stabilized Voltage Supply Transformer Based on the Power Quality Optimization of Traction Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the key equipment in electrified railway, power transformer is mainly responsible for obtaining electricity from traction network. The output voltage can supply a large number of different types of non-traction loads along the line. However, in the face of frequent voltage fluctuation and rich harmonic content of the traction network, it is commonly difficult to obtain electricity for traditional power transformers. Moreover, the unbalanced secondary load and large negative-sequence current of the traditional power transformer pose a serious threat to the power quality of electrified railways. Therefore, aimed at the voltage characteristics of traction network, this paper analyzes the equivalent magnetic circuit and equivalent circuit of power transformer. Based on the optimization of the power quality of the traction network, resonant capacitors and filtering inductors are utilized to form a resonant filter. As a result, in this study, based on magnetic shunt with air gap and resonant circuit, a new structure design of anti-harmonic stabilized voltage transformer is proposed. The Maxwell simulation results show that the new structure design can stabilize voltage and suppress harmonic. Meanwhile, the power quality of traction network can be optimized effectively, which proves that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Influence of turbulent jet flow on flow field and development of APPJ
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Atmospheric pressure plasma jet is a novel and promising method to generate thermally nonequilibrium plasma, but the length and temperature of the plasma jet can be significantly influenced by the turbulent jet flow. In the present paper, effect of flow on laminar flow length, jet length and bullet velocity under different material conditions are studied and development of the plasma bullet are investigated.

articleTitle: Research on Control Method Based on Space Thermionic Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper firstly analyzes the basic operation principle of the thermionic power system (TPS) and explains the characteristics of different modes. Secondly, a two-level domain dual-loop control method with front-end voltage regulation is proposed. And an experimental prototype is built. Finally, the experimental verification results are given to verify the effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: Power outage classification prediction method based on bagging ensemble learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power outage prediction can provide reference for power companies' power outage decision-making, reduce frequency of power outages on the user side, and improve reliability of low-voltage power supply. In this paper, Bagging Ensemble model is used to predict the power failure problem. First, paper construct spatial location matrix of different regions according to geographic location relationship of different regions, and construct spatial features through QR matrix decomposition. Then, bagging ensemble learning framework is used to randomly resample the data, train different base classifiers, and integrate classifiers according to the combination strategy. Finally, paper use integrated learning model to make predictions on the data. The common classification model evaluation index and AOC curve are used to measure performance of model. Experimental results show prediction model proposed in this paper has good performance for classification prediction of outage data.

articleTitle: Traceability Method of 100kA Impulse Current Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impulse current is a transient current waveform, which has a short duration and cannot be repeated, so it is difficult to evaluate the influencing factors of measurement errors. This paper studies the traceability method and uncertainty evaluation model of impulse current measurement device, and the influencing factors of measurement error are analyzed. The impulse calibrator which can output standard double exponential impulse current waveform with specific time parameters (8/20) is developed. The peak value and time parameters can be traced back to the national standards of DC voltage and capacitance, inductance and resistance. The measuring system consists of standard impulse shunt and measuring instrument, whose peak current and time parameters can be traced respectively. The impulse scale factor of the impulse current measuring system is the product of the impulse scale factors of shunt and digital recorder. Finally, the performance of the measuring system is evaluated, and the expanded uncertainty of scale factor and time parameter is 0.4% (k=2) and 0.8% (k=2) respectively.

articleTitle: Ambient Data-driven Oscillation Modes Extraction Using Output-only Observer/Kalman Filter Identification and Dynamic Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A output-only observer/kalman filter identification and dynamic mode decomposition data-driven method (O<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>KID-DMD) is introduced to develop the modal extraction from ambient data. The proposed method first uses the output-only observer/kalman filter identification technology to process the ambient data output of power systems into ringdown data, and will get its Markov parameter. Subsequently, uses the dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) to obtain the low-dimensional approximate matrix of system from the obtained Markov parameter. Finally, by performing eigenvalue decomposition, the oscillation frequency, damping ratio and mode shapes can be reliably extracted. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on the IEEE simulation system and actual system measurement data.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Transient Overvoltage of Offshore Wind Farm Transmission System by 220kV Long-distance AC Submarine Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the offshore wind power transmission system(WPTS) through the AC submarine cable(SC), as the scale of the offshore wind farm(WF) gradually increases and the SC distance of the transmission system continues to increase, the high capacitance characteristics of the long SC will cause a large overvoltage along the SC line, which has an impact on the safe operation of offshore WFs and onshore power grids. Aiming at engineering reality, this paper builds an electromagnetic transient simulation model in PSCAD/EMTDC, and simulates and calculates the power frequency overvoltage(PFOV) along the SC line under different short-circuit capacities of the system, different active power output of offshore WFs, and different fault points. Using the MultipleRun component, this paper calculates the overvoltage along the SC for three-phase asynchronous closing and the opening overvoltage of a reignition of the circuit breaker. The research results show that the dual-terminal high-impedance configuration has a certain limiting effect on the PFOV and operating overvoltage of the submarine cable.

articleTitle: Design and evaluation of a novel controllable leakage flux permanent magnet motor with wide speed ranges
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel type of controllable leakage flux interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (CLF-IPMSM) with wide speed ranges. The leakage flux of the machine can be controlled by the q-axis current. When VLF-PMSM is under high speed and light load, there will be a considerable leakage flux inside the rotor, which reduces the flux-weakening current. However, when the motor is under low speed and heavy load, there will be little or no leakage flux inside the rotor, enhancing its torque output capacity. Therefore, the motor can maintain high efficiency in a wide speed range. The performance of VLF-IPM is compared with that of conventional IPM by the 2D finite element analysis method, and the results verified that CLF-IPMSM could maintain high efficiency in a wide speed range.

articleTitle: Switching Mechanism and Simulation Study of Vacuum Type On-load Tap Changer in Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The on-load tap changer (OLTC) is an important component in converter transformer, which is responsible for maintaining the stability of DC voltage and adjusting the trigger angle. With the complex operating conditions and the increase of switching capacity, the resistor type on-load tap changer with vacuum interrupters are widely used. The structure and working principle of vacuum type on-load tap changer are analyzed in this paper. In order to analyze the internal electrical characteristics of the on-load tap changer, a simulation model is built by PSCAD. The recovery voltage of interrupters and circulating current formulas are deduced. The simulation results are consistent with the theoretical analysis, which verifies the correctness of the simulation model. On this basis, it is pointed out that a large transition resistor leads to high recovery voltage of vacuum interrupter in the main branch, while a small transition resistor leads to large switched current of vacuum interrupter in the transition branch. Since the transition resistor is related to the breaking capacity of vacuum interrupter, the selection of the value of transition resistance should consider the match between the step voltage and the load current.

articleTitle: Water cooling structure design and temperature field analysis of low floor direct drive permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The advantages and research status of the Low floor vehicles are introduced. Taking a 46.6kW, 196r /min water-cooled low-floor direct drive permanent magnet synchronous motor as an example, the electromagnetic loss of the motor under continuous working condition is calculated, and the coupling analysis and calculation of the temperature field and fluid field of the motor under the original water-cooled structure are carried out. The correctness of the simulation is verified through the prototype experiment test. Based on the original water-cooled structure, three new water-cooled structures were designed and improved. By comparing the temperature field and fluid field of the original water-cooled structure, the best water-cooled scheme was selected, which provided a basis for the optimal water-cooled design of the direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous motor for low-floor vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on the Insulation Degradation Detective Method of Wall Bushing in 40.5kVAir-insulated Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The insulation state of wall bushing has an important influence on the operation reliability of 40.5kV switchgear. Live detection is an effective means to detect the insulation defects of switchgear. Ultrasonic, ultra-high frequency, transient earth voltage, ozone concentration analysis and other partial discharge detection techniques have certain advantages in the qualitative and positioning of abnormal discharge of metal parts in switchgear. In this study, wall bushing insulation breakdown is divided into air insulation breakdown and epoxy insulation breakdown. Two types of insulation faults are diagnosed and analyzed based on the corresponding live detection methods. Two types of insulation discharge characteristics are recovery by ultraviolet imaging and ultra-high frequency partial discharge detection after disintegration. The results show that the wall bushing insulation defects can be located and characterized by ultra-high frequency method, ultrasonic method, and ozone concentration detection method.

articleTitle: Distortion Electric Field and Reduction Method of Houses Platform Near 1000kV AC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: China is now rapidly developing ultra-high voltage (UHV) AC transmission lines to meet the needs of national economic development. Due to the limited land resources, the choice of line corridor has become a design problem The proximity of lines to be close to residential area causes the electric field distortion and partial exceedances at residential buildings, which causes public concern. This paper uses the finite element method to calculate the distortion field intensity distribution law of the roof and platform observation surface near the 1000kV AC double-circuit transmission line, and explores the effect of reduction of the trees on the power frequency electric field by establishing different heights of the cypress tree model The results show that the maximum value of the distortion field is generally found at the top corners and edges near the line. When the tree is higher than the house, the effect of reduction for trees on the electric field becomes better, as the distance between tree and house decreases.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Distribution Network Operation Control System Based on Synchronous Phasor Measurement Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the large-scale distributed generation and interactive load in distribution network, the introduction of synchronous phasor measurement technology can improve the observability of distribution network. This paper designs a distribution network operation control system based on synchronous phasor measurement information, fully considers the type and processing method of synchronous phasor measurement data in the system, designs a reasonable hardware and software architecture, sets up a mass data bus network and a high-speed data bus network according to the functional distribution on the hardware, and layers the distributed frame on the software. In the architecture design, the data flow direction and information exchange scheme of external system are proposed, and the integration mode of functional modules is designed according to the application requirements. Through the application of the distribution network operation control system based on synchronous phasor measurement information, the access problems of large-scale distributed generators, electric vehicles and interactive loads are solved, which provides a platform basis for the future upgrading and transformation of distribution network automation.

articleTitle: Moisture Induced Weight Gain Relation to Capacitance Loss Characteristic of Film Capacitors under Harsh Enviroment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ambient moisture would diffuse into the film capacitor under the humid environment. The corrosion of electrodes would occur under ac voltage stress with the participation of the moisture, which results in a decrease of the capacitance. Thus, the moisture ingress is harmful to long-term reliable operation of film capacitors. In this paper, the process of moisture ingress is analyzed based on the Fick’s second law. An accelerated aging is carried out for two types of film capacitors to obtain the capacitance change and the weight gain. A staged fitting analysis is used to describe the capacitance change curves of capacitor samples. The effect of the moisture ingress on the lifetime of film capacitors is studied. The results indicate that the encapsulating material which provides better moisture resistance can slow down the electrode corrosion and significantly improve the lifetime of the film capacitors.

articleTitle: Research on Performances of Slotted/Slotless High-Speed PM BLDC Motors with Different PM Magnetizations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper deals with the electromagnetic analysis and comparison of the slotted and slotless high-speed permanent magnet (PM) brushless de (BLDC) motors adopting four different PM magnetizations (i.e., parallel magnetization, radial magnetization, Halbach array with parallel and radial magnetizations) through a two-dimensional finite element method (2-D FEM). The models and specifications of the two motors are established and tabulated firstly. Then, the electromagnetic performances include magnetic field distribution, no-load back-EMF, and electromagnetic torque are analyzed. Furtherly, the losses of the slotted and slotless motors with the four PM magnetizations are calculated under no-load and rated load operations. Finally, the two motors’ efficiency with different PM magnetizations are performed and compared as well. The suitable scheme of this kind of high-speed PM BLDC motor is recommended.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Strategy of Electric Vehicles Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As more and more plug-in electric vehicles(EVs) are connected 'to the power grid, EVs have also become one of the most widely used flexible loads. They will take an important part in the autonomous power systems and will have a large impact in the power frequency fluctuations. In this paper, considering the uncertainty of family EVs travel law and the maintenance of the state of charge(SoC) of the EVs’ power battery, an adaptive comprehensive control strategy of EV cluster participating in the primary frequency control(PFR) of the power grid is investigated, which applies fuzzy control and variable coefficient droop control. The strategy is applied to a single area primary frequency modulation model with EVs. Finally, simulations are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed comprehensive control strategy.

articleTitle: Simulation Investigation on Anti-DC Current Transformer with Double Core
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Effect of anti DC bias of current transformer is important for Measurement and protection. This paper proposes a simulation model of current trans-former with double core based on simulink boxtool of matlab. The magnetization characteristics of air gap core is studied according to the Jiles- atherton theory. The effect of anti DC bias of current transformer with double core is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of weather factors and outage duration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The correlation analysis of weather factors and outage duration can provide reference for enterprises to make decisions in advance when weather changes, which guarantees stable operation of power grid system. Therefore, aiming at the correlation between weather factors and outage duration, this paper researches linear correlation and nonlinear correlation between them from Pearson correlation coefficient and distance correlation coefficient. Secondly, the gbdt algorithm model is used to measure the contribution ratio of different weather factors in the prediction model by establishing the prediction model between weather influencing factors and response variables, so as to obtain the correlation between different weather factors and outage duration. Finally, the experiment is carried out on a real data set. According to the analysis of the experimental results, the correlation between weather factors and outage duration is described.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Evaluation System of Electricity Retail Companies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the environment of the deregulated electricity retail market, credit management issues for electricity retail companies have become increasingly prominent. Based on the actual situation of electricity market transactions, this paper introduces a credit evaluation system composed of internal and external evaluation indicators and realizes the application of the evaluation system. This paper provides a reference for constructing a credit evaluation system for electricity market entities.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Configuration Method of Park microgrid Based on Electric Energy Router Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of AC-DC hybrid microgrid and the widespread application of power electric components, AC-DC hybrid park micro-grid based on the topology of electric energy router application(EERA) emerged. In this paper, the matching of the DC/AC devices and DC/DC devices capacity in the planning stage be optimized based on the port model of the electric energy router application. At the same time, the economic operation of the park microgrid is realized by quantifying the life loss cost of energy storage. Therefore, a bi-level optimization model that takes into account both the economic operation of the park microgrid and the investment of PV-energy storage combined power generation system containing the electric energy routers application is proposed. Given the different characteristics of the operating variables and planning variables, the optimization target is solved by the method of combining improved particle swarm algorithm using the Shannon information entropy model and mixed-integer quadratic programming (MIQP) based on the ideas of hierarchical decoupling. Through simulation calculation in different scenarios, it is verified that the effectiveness of the model and the feasibility of the algorithm. Finally, this model can provide a certain reference for the configuration of the park microgrid capacity based on the electric energy router application.

articleTitle: Speed Sensorless Control of Synchronous Reluctance Motor At Full Speed Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) is a special synchronous motor that completely utilizes reluctance torque to operate. Because of its low cost, solid structure and no risk of demagnetization at high temperatures, it has gradually attracted attention in recent years. In order to increase the reliability of the control system and take advantage of the low cost of synchronous reluctance motor, a sensorless control strategy in wide speed range is introduced in this paper. In low speed range, a high frequency voltage injection method is used to get the rotor position information. In middle or higher speed range, an active flux observer is introduced to realize the vector control. For the purpose of maintaining the stability, we adopted a weighted function method during the switching between these two observation methods. Finally, the proposed method is verified by experiments on a 5.5-kw SynRM which can work well down to 0 rpm and up to 1500rpm.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Double Frequency Square Wave Voltage Injection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the process of rotor position detection based on single frequency sinusoidal voltage injection in static reference frame, when filter method and direct calculation method are used to eliminate the dc component, the removal effect is not ideal and the result is easily affected by the change of inductance. A double frequency square wave voltage injection method was proposed to detect the rotor position at low speed. This method combines the advantages of high injected frequency of square-wave voltage injection method and simple signal processing of sinusoidal voltage injection method. The high frequency square wave signals with different frequencies are injected into the α and β axes respectively, and the corresponding high frequency response current is decomposed into the sum of sinusoidal signals of different frequencies by Fourier decomposition. After the high frequency signal is extracted, the position signal is demodulated by multiplying it with the fixed frequency cosine modulation wave. After passing through a filter, the four response currents containing the rotor position information are obtained, and the dc component is eliminated by the difference of the response current. Finally, the rotor position is estimated by using the two- phase type locked loop. The experimental results show that the proposed method is insensitive to the variation of inductance, and can accurately estimate the rotor position at low speed, with good stability and dynamic performance.

Author Keywords: Double frequency square wave voltage injection

articleTitle: A Chaotic FHSS based Power Line Communication Method in Parallel Buck Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power line communication (PLC) has a great potential since no extra signal transmission line is required. Due to the demand for transmission safety and reduced electromagnetic interference (EMI), this paper introduces a novel chaotic frequency hopping spread spectrum (FHSS) based PLC method, which can improve the demodulation reliability and EMC performance. This proposed method implements the online PLC for parallel Buck converters by labeling channels where carrier waves with different frequencies pass through. The simulation verification, power spectrum density (PSD) analysis and experiments are carried out to validate the proposed chaotic FHSS-based PLC. This study also illuminates the possibility of introducing chaos code division multiple access (CDMA) based butterfly effect into DC power lines connecting multiple switched power supplies.

articleTitle: Benefit Evaluation for Industrial Users Utilizing User-Side Energy Storages Participating Auxiliary Services
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Industrial users can obtain benefits and cut their electricity bills by installing energy storage devices to provide auxiliary services to the power system. Under the two-part tariff, user-side energy storage can participate in different auxiliary services including peaking shaving, demand management, demand response, and emergency power supply. In order to maximize the benefits of users, a benefit evaluation for industrial users utilizing user-side energy storages participating auxiliary services is proposed. Based on the analytic hierarchy process (AHP), the model evaluates the benefits of industrial users by taking various indices in the criterion layer, including the net income, investment cost, payback period, and return on investment of energy storage in the life cycle. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified by the simulation of an industrial user in Guangxi, China.

articleTitle: Improving Quality Factor of Ferrite-Core Inductors Applied in Inductive Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Structural designs of the ferrite core and copper winding to improve the Q value of inductors for IPT (inductive power transfer) applications are studied via simulations and experiments. Magnetic circuit analysis and loss decomposition analysis are conducted to qualitatively assess the inductor performance. Improving Q is realized from two aspects: core shape design and winding pattern design. Geometry of the ferrite core resembles that of a pot core. Multiple small air gaps with optimized parameters are inserted into the magnetic circuit to reduce the flux density inside the core and the resultant core loss. A solenoidal winding is adopted and the impacts of winding parameters are studied. Part of the optimization measures are verified via experiments and effectiveness of the proposed measures is validated. Meanwhile, simulations show that conductive plates can be adopted for magnetic shield and the impact on Q value is acceptable.

articleTitle: Structural loads suppression for floating offshore wind turbine via Optimized Pitch Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Considering the drastic wave in the sea lead to fatigue loads, which would deteriorate the performance of the floating offshore wind turbine (FOWT), an optimized pitch controller is adopted to decrease the structural loads in this study. The complex coupled model is firstly established for the semi-submersible FOWT. Subsequently, a series of simulation experiments are carried out based on the proposed coupled model. Simulation results demonstrate that the pitch controller based on particle swarm optimization results in more stable power output and less structural loads than ordinary controller.

articleTitle: Topology and Control Strategy of Push-pull DC Autotransformer Suitable for Interconnecting LCC-HVDC and VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: By combining the topological deductive law of DC autotransformer and modular multi-level converter, this paper proposes a new type of DC transformer topology suitable for interconnecting line commutated converter based HVDC system (LCC-HVDC) and voltage source converter based HVDC system (VSC-HVDC), namely push-pull DC autotransformer (PPDAT). PPDAT establishes a certain degree of direct electrical coupling between LCC-HVDC and VSC-HVDC, which has the advantages of high transmission efficiency and high operational reliability. And PPDAT has the abilities to track LCC-HVDC voltage polarity changes and isolate DC faults due to the adopt of full bridge sub-module in the upper bridge arm. In this paper, the topological structure, operating principle, steady state control strategy and DC fault protection strategy of PPDAT are analyzed in detail. Finally, the correctness of theoretical analysis is verified by the simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: A Redundancy Design of Wireless Power Transfer System for Satellite Slip Ring with High Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) technology provides a feasible way to solve the problems of poor reliability, low life and difficult maintenance of satellite slip ring power supply system. In this paper, a novel redundancy design method of magnetic coupling mechanism with high reliability and long life is proposed, and the topology of wireless power supply circuit and magnetic coupling mechanism are designed and analyzed. The proposed magnetic coupling mechanism can achieve mutual inductance fluctuation less than 1% when rotating 360 degrees and its loss distribution is given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Total Cost of Ownership of Electric Forklifts with lithium-ion battery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Batteries, with support of governments and industry, have flourished in recent years, which appears to be one of the most promising power sources in the global transportation field. In addition to being widely used in passenger cars, batteries are also applied in off-road vehicles. Forklift is one of off-road vehicles and the proportion of electric forklift is increasing on the whole. Since the commonly used battery on forklifts is lead-acid battery, which brings great burden to the environment, it is necessary to seek for potential substitute for lead-acid battery. Benefiting from the maintenance-free nature and long lifetimes, forklift powered by lithium-ion battery is proposed in this paper. Total cost of ownership (TCO) is used to compare the economic competitiveness of forklifts powered by two different kinds of batteries. The data and conclusion in this paper may provide some references for consumers, vehicle manufactures and policymakers on electric forklifts.

articleTitle: The optimal configuration of energy storage capacity of the regional integrated energy system considering the integrated demand response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to decouple the traditional thermal- determined electric constraints and promotes wind power consumption, this paper presents an optimal configuration model of electric-heat energy storage capacity of regional integrated energy system (RIES) considering the integrated demand response. This model uses energy storage device to realize thermoelectric decoupling of combined heat and power (CHP) units on the source side, and uses the dispatchable value of the integrated demand response (IDR) on the load side. The model optimizes the allocation of electric-heat energy storage capacity to minimize the total annual cost of the RIES. The calculation results show that the model reduces the configuration capacity of energy storage, improves the system economy and promotes the consumption of wind energy.

Author Keywords: optimal configuration of energy storage capacity

articleTitle: Wind energy forecasting framework based on new perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a green renewable energy, in recent years, wind energy has been vigorously developed and utilized by countries all over the world. However, the randomness and nonlinearity of wind itself hinder the process of massive combination of wind energy. Therefore, high-precision wind energy forecasting exerts a great significance on wind power grid. To enhance the forecast quality, this research proposes a new combination model. First, The original data is disintegrated into nonlinear component and linear component by variational mode decomposition (VMD), which discovering hidden information to clean noise and decrease interference with predictions, and then Long Short Term Memory neural networks (LSTM) and ARIMA model are established according to the statistical characteristics, and the ultimate forecasting results are obtained. The research case illustrates that the integrated model is superior to the estimated performance of conventional forecast models, which also implies that it is active for the VMD disintegration model to select the forecast method suitable for the component characteristics to increase the estimated capability of the model. The combination method based on data decomposition and component characteristics proposed in this article is conducive to the valid operation of wind power scheduling, reducing the impact on wind power accommodation space, and raising the stability behavior of power grid running.

articleTitle: A State of Charge Estimation Method Based on APSO-PF for Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved method for estimating the state of charge (SOC) of lithium-ion battery. Firstly, a first-order resistor and capacitance (RC) model is introduced. Secondly, the SOC and open-circuit voltage (OCV) relationship is identified through the constant current charge-discharge test, and the least-squares algorithm is used to identify the model parameters. Thirdly, an improved adaptive approach is proposed to solve the problems of particle swarm optimization (PSO), and adaptive particle swarm optimized particle filtering (APSO-PF) is proposed to estimate the SOC of li-ion battery Finally, two dynamic operation conditions are given to show the efficiency of APSO-PF by comparing with the application of particle filter (PF), particle swarm optimized particle filtering (PSO-PF) and APSO-PF in SOC estimation.

articleTitle: An Improved High-Order Sliding Mode Observer for IPMSM Sensorless Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of chattering and poor observation accuracy of traditional high order sliding mode observer (THSMO), a sensorless control scheme of interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) based improved high order sliding mode observer (IHSMO) is proposed. By contrast with the THSMO, the hyperbolic function is employed instead of nonlinear sign function as the switching function in IHSMO, and the stability is analyzed by using the idea of equivalent control and Lyapunov function. On this basis, to avoid the influence of rotational velocity change on position estimation accuracy, a self-adjusting observer gain is designed with the velocity. Finally, the proposed IHSMO scheme is verified and contrasted with traditional method by an IPMSM experimental platform.

articleTitle: Harmonic Optimal Power Flow considering Harmonic Coupling Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: as the installation scale of distributed generations in the distribution network continues to increase, the distribution network has more flexible scheduling resources. However, a large number of power electronic devices in distributed power generations pose a threat to the power quality of the distribution network. Based on the frequency coupling matrix, a harmonic optimal power flow model considering harmonic coupling factors is established. Using the method of convex relaxation, the original non-convex model is transformed into a semi-definite programming model that can be solved by mature planning software. An actual township distribution network example is used to verify the rationality of the model proposed.

articleTitle: Research on start criterion of automatic reclosing of low voltage circuit breaker based on wavelet packet and neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: After the 10kV distribution network trips due to fault, the 0.4kV low-voltage circuit breakers in each distribution room can not avoid the reclosing time of 10kV distribution network, resulting in the loss of voltage fault or under voltage fault, resulting in the collective trip of low-voltage circuit breakers. Because the low-voltage circuit breaker does not have the function of automatic reclosing, manual on-site closing greatly reduces the reliability of low-voltage distribution network power supply. In order to realize the function of automatic reclosing of low-voltage circuit breaker and improve the reliability of power supply in low-voltage distribution network, a new criterion of automatic reclosing of low-voltage circuit breaker based on wavelet packet and neural network is proposed in this paper. Firstly, all kinds of fault current signals of low voltage distribution network are decomposed by wavelet packet, and the energy eigenvalues of each frequency band are used as the input of BP neural network. Then determine whether the faults of the distribution network occur in the high voltage side or the low voltage side, and determine their fault types, and together with the input voltage signal of the circuit breaker to form the low voltage circuit breaker automatic reclosing start decision criteria. Finally, through modeling and simulation verification, the results show that the method is simple in principle and easy to implement, and can be used as the automatic reclosing criterion of low-voltage circuit breaker to improve the reliability of low-voltage distribution network power supply.

articleTitle: Investigation on Hydrogen Removal Efficiency of Helium Taylor Discharge Cleaning on J-TEXT Tokamak
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The hydrogen absorbed on the first wall of the tokamak device will desorbed during the experiment. This additional hydrogen makes plasma density increase so that the plasma density cannot be controlled at experimental setting value. In this paper, in order to remove the adsorbed hydrogen on the first wall of the vacuum chamber as much as possible before the formal experiment, we measured the desorption rate of hydrogen in helium Taylor discharge cleaning and helium Taylor discharge cleaning with baking. Experimental results show that the use of helium Taylor discharge cleaning on J-TEXT can effectively remove hydrogen in the main vacuum chamber. The next experiments of adjusting the discharge cleaning parameters were carried out to measure the desorption rate change of hydrogen. And the best Taylor discharge cleaning parameters were determined according to the highest hydrogen desorption rate.

articleTitle: Review on Optimal Operation Models and Intelligent Solving Algorithms of Cascade Hydropower Stations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The optimal operation of cascade power stations is not only one of the main development directions for the comprehensive exploitation, utilization and management of water resources, but also an important strategic direction for the sustainable development of national energy. This article starting with the overview and composition of the cascade power station group, expounds the operation characteristics and task requirements of cascade hydropower under different time scales, and provides a comprehensive overview of the objective functions and constraints of medium and long-term scheduling, short-term scheduling, and day-ahead scheduling. Then this article analyzes and compares the current intelligent solution algorithms for optimal operation of cascade hydropower stations at home and abroad, and finally gives an outlook on the future research about the participation of cascade hydropower in the electricity market.

articleTitle: Research on Improving the Interoperability of Electric Vehicle Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Current electric vehicles have problems such as low charging efficiency, low output power, and poor interoperability during the wireless charging process. This is due to differences in the design parameters of different manufacturers or the offset of the coil. This article uses parameters closely related to the nature of the system: normalized angular frequency A, quality factor Q, Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> to simplify the analysis of the LCC-LCC electric vehicle wireless power transfer system, and obtain a simplified mathematical model. Then use the above model to analyze the nature of the system. A method is proposed to improve the interoperability of the system by adjusting the frequency. Finally, the feasibility of the above theory is verified by simulation and experiment. Provide a reference for the research on the interoperability of electric vehicle wireless power transfer.

articleTitle: Cascading Failure Risk Assessment in Power Grid Based On the Line Outage Rate
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The risk of cascading failure in power grid can be integrated the possibility and severity of cascading failure severity. The possibility in traditional risk assessment only considered the line failure rate, but the line overload outage is one of the important reasons lead to cascading failure too.
