In order to consider the complex uncertainty in actual power system, according to the line protection actions, environmental and weather factors and human errors caused by the line fault and line overload to get the line outage probability, further set up cascading failure risk assessment model of power grid considering line outage rate .The simulation of the WSCC-9 buses system proved that the proposed method is with correctness and objectivity, provided with engineering value.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Positive Streamers Characteristics in Dry and Humid Air
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Streamers are a rapidly moving ionization front in gas, liquid, or solid. In this work, photoionization model of dry and humid air is integrated into a macroscopic 3D streamer discharge mechanism. By calculating the electric field and charge field in 3D streamer, the charge transport in streamer channel is described by the law of charge conservation. Streamer discharge results of positive streamer in dry and humid air within 50ns are obtained by simulation. The results show that the macroscopic values of streamer discharge will change. Compared with dry air, the channel electric field of streamer discharge increases in humid air, but its propagation velocity and diameter decrease. For a single streamer, water molecules weaken the photoionization rate of streamer head, so streamer branches more frequently in humid air.

articleTitle: A Discussion of Eigenvalue-based and Impedance- based Methods in VSC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the penetration rate of distributed energy in the power system continues increasing, the stability of the power system is affected by more factors. However, the small signal modeling method used for system stability analysis lacks a consensus. In this paper, the voltage source converter (VSC) system is used as an example to discuss the pros and cons of two methods. Building the full-order state-space model in time-domain and in frequency-domain, the impedance model has also been built. The time-domain system simulation has developed to verify the accuracy of two models in MATLAB/simulink. On the basis of the existing models, the impact of the system parameters will be analyzed.

articleTitle: Model Linearization Analysis for Three-Phase Unbalanced Phase-Locked Loop Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper initiatively models the open-loop transfer functions of the phase-locked loop (PLL) methods such as DDSRF-PLL, DSOGI-PLL, and DCCF-PLL which are usually employed under three-phased unbalanced grid voltage conditions. First, DDSRF-PLL is divided into two structures, and DSOGI- PLL is divided into four structures through the adjustment of these PLL structures. Secondly, the open-loop transfer functions can be derived for the above seven PLL structures at the rated grid frequency through the model analysis and linearization of them, respectively. When the parameters of these PLL structures satisfy a certain relationship, we can come to a conclusion through comparison of the open-loop transfer functions of these PLL structures that some of the PLL structures are identical to each others. Finally, the PLL structure with the best overall performance index including stability and frequency response characteristics can be determined through the comparative analysis of the phase margins and crossover frequencies of the PLL structures with different open-loop transfer functions, which can be further validated through the simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Diagnosis Method of Transformer Winding Fault Based on Bald Eagle Search Optimizing Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the most widely used method of winding fault detection is frequency response analysis (FRA). To surmount the defects of slow convergence and low classification accuracy caused by inappropriate parameter selection of support vector machines (SVM), this paper proposes a transformer winding fault classification method based on bald eagle search (BES) algorithm to optimize the kernel parameter g and the penalty coefficient C in the SVM model, denoted as BES-SVM. The analysis of transformer winding faults shows that the BES- SVM model can diagnose faults more accurately. Compared with the traditional SVM and PSO-SVM methods, this method has higher diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: Loss Minimization Control of PMSM Using Gradient Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, loss minimization control method (LMC) based on gradient descent algorithms (GDA) is aimed at enhancing the efficiency of permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSMs) in high-speed operation. This approach reduces the power loss by controlling the magnitude of the torque component of the d-axis current in terms of the gradient of power loss. Besides, this kind of search-based method can avoid the influence of changes in motor parameters on control. Maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) and id = 0 control are also simulated so as to verify the effects of LMC. Compared with these two methods, the simulation results of LMC indicate that this approach could improve the efficiency of the PMSM.

articleTitle: Analysis of Short-time Withstand Current and Peak Withstand Current Test of 500kV AC Fault Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of power system, the level of short circuit current is also increasing rapidly. As an effective method to limit short circuit current, fault current limiter (FCL) is more and more widely used. There are many kinds of fault current limiters according to their working principles. Compared with other types of fault current limiters, the fault current limiter based on high coupled split reactor (HCSR) has many advantages. Under normal operation condition, this type of fault current limiter shows very small leakage inductance. When short circuit fault occurs, it will change into current limiting reactor. The capacity of fault current limiter to withstand short-time withstand current and peak withstand current is an important evaluation index, and the reasonable equivalent test method is very important. In this paper, combined with the research of 500 kV and above voltage level AC fault current limiter, the test methods of short-time withstand current and peak withstand current of fault current limiter based on HCSR are comprehensively analyzed, so as to meet the requirements of short-time withstand current and peak withstand current test of fault current limiter based on HCSR.

Author Keywords: short-time withstand current and peak withstand current test

articleTitle: A Novel Zero-Pole Cancellation Design for Current Control of Bi-directional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The bi-directional DC-DC converter is always adopted for the battery/supercapacitor to realize flexible power management. The current and voltage control of the DC-DC converter is the fundamental for the realization of the power management. This paper focuses on the inner current control of the DC-DC converter and proposes a novel state-space-based control method. A zero-pole cancellation algorithm is proposed to design the control parameters. Consequently, the proposed control method can accomplish outstanding dynamic response. Finally, the experimental results are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Assistant Decision-Making Method for Main & Distribution Power Grid Integration Based on Deep Deterministic Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper studies the technology of generating DDPG (deep deterministic policy gradient) by using the deep dual network and experience pool network structure, and puts forward the sampling strategy gradient algorithm to randomly select actions according to the learned strategies (action distribution) in the continuous action space, based on the dispatching control system of the power dispatching control center of a super city power grid, According to the actual characteristics and operation needs of urban power grid, The developed refined artificial intelligence on-line security analysis and emergency response plan intelligent generation function realize the emergency response auxiliary decision-making intelligent generation function. According to the hidden danger of overload and overload found in the online safety analysis, the relevant load lines of the equipment are searched automatically. Through the topology automatic analysis, the load transfer mode is searched to eliminate or reduce the overload or overload of the equipment. For a variety of load transfer modes, the evaluation index of the scheme is established, and the optimal load transfer mode is intelligently selected. Based on the D5000 system of Metropolitan power grid, a multi-objective and multi resource coordinated security risk decision-making assistant system is implemented, which provides integrated security early warning and decision support for the main network and distribution network of city power grid. The intelligent level of power grid dispatching management and dispatching operation is improved. The state reality network can analyze the joint state observations from the action reality network, and the state estimation network uses the actor action as the input. In the continuous action space task, DDPG is better than dqn and its convergence speed is faster.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Reconfiguration of Distribution Network Based on Reconfiguration Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the heavy curtailment of wind and solar power under the high permeability of renewable energy, a dynamic reconfiguration strategy for improving the distribution network’s ability of accepting renewable distributed generation (RDG) is proposed. Firstly, according to the predicted unconstrained output of RDG, static reconfiguration is carried out with the goal of maximizing output of RDG in each unit time period, and multiple optimal network structures in each period are extracted to form an optimal switch set to expand the search space. Secondly, the concept of reconfiguration effectiveness is proposed based on the amount of increase in the average output of RDG, which guides the dynamic partition of time intervals. At the same time, in order to satisfy the constraint of switching operation times, the selection of the optimal network structure is carried out during dynamic partition of time intervals, and the improved bacterial foraging algorithm (IBFA) based on adaptive adjustment of optimization direction is proposed to solve this problem. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the modified PG&E69-bus system.

articleTitle: Rotor Stress Analysis of a High-Speed Permanent Magnet Machine Considering Multi-Layer and Multi-Angle Winding of Carbon Fiber Sleeve
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the design of high-speed permanent magnet (PM) machines (HSPMMs), the first consideration is whether the rotor can meet the stress requirements. In this paper, considering multi-layer and multi-angle winding of carbon fiber sleeve (CFS), the stress of a bread-type rotor of an HSPMM with 80 kW, 60000 rpm is studied in detail. First, the optimization analysis of the rotor stress is carried out to determine the PM material, rotor diameter, CFS thickness, and interference between the CFS and the PM. Then, the temperature field calculation of the HSPMM is performed to analyze the rotor thermal stress more precisely. Finally, the detailed stress analysis of the rotor with multi-layer and multi-angle winding CFS is carried out based on the thermal-stress coupling, and the PM rotors suitable for mass and prototype production are designed respectively.

articleTitle: Site Selection of Energy Integrated Hub Station Based on CPS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The energy hub(EH) integrates data center, energy storage station, and charging station, forming a hub-type node that gathers power flow, information flow, and business flow. Therefore, the reasonable location of EH contributes to the smooth and reliable operation of the cyber-physical system (CPS) of the power grid. This paper proposed a CPS-based EH location planning model according to the influence on the reliability and delay of the information system, as well as the load fluctuation and load saturation of the power system. Then the simulation of the IEEE30-node system was carried out in MATLAB/Simulink. The optimal site for EH was node 6 through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Finally, the improvement of the information system delay and power system flow fluctuation after the installation of EH at different nodes was compared through the simulation, and the effectiveness of the proposed location model was verified.

articleTitle: A Novel SiC Device Modeling With Power Stage and Gate Driver Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Miller capacitor (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gd</inf>) and common source inductor (L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">scom</inf>) are two major feedback parameters across gate driver loop and power loop for power devices. Silicon Carbide (SiC) power transistors have fast switching speed but are more inclined to be affected by parasitics, such as overshoots, oscillations and cross-talk. To ensure a reliable and efficient SiC switching, the impacts of miller capacitor and common source inductor need to be identified and quantified. Since these two parameters are coupled between two loops, a comprehensive analytical analysis is quite complicated and requires massive computation. Therefore, a novel SiC device modeling based upon C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gd</inf> and L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">scom</inf> decoupling is proposed. By extracted the equivalent model for C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gd</inf> and L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">scom</inf> at different switching intervals, gate driver loop and main power loop can be fully decoupled. By doing so, the designs and optimizations for the two loops will be more straightforward and precise. With the proposed decoupling modeling approach, the decoupled equivalent circuit is verified to have descent accuracy in predicting the actual SiC switching transients.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experimental Validation of a New Topology of Parallel Hybrid Excitation Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new topology of parallel hybrid excitation machine (PHEM) with rated power of 500kW is proposed and analyzed. The proposed PHEM axially combines a permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) with a brushless field excitation machine (BFEM), thus inheriting the advantages of the two machines, i.e. the high power density of PMSM and the field-regulating capability of BFEM. First, the configuration and operation principle of the PHEM are analyzed. Then, the performances, including no-load, rated-load and short-circuit fault, of the first axial part (i.e. the PMSM) and the second axial part (i.e. the BFEM) are investigated by 2D and 3D finite element analysis (FEA), respectively. Also, the overall performances of the PHEM are predicted and analyzed. Finally, a prototype of the 500kW PHEM is built and tested. The experimental results have verified the theoretical analyses of the PHEM.

articleTitle: Operation Control Strategy of DC Microgrid Based on E-router
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The structure of DC microgrid is important to realize the efficient and flexible access of DC distributed power and load to power grid. In this paper, an operation control strategy of DC microgrid based energy router is proposed. The components of the system are connected to different types of ports of the energy router. On the basis of DC bus voltage stability within the rated range, for different system operation modes, the "nine-zone diagram" is built under the operating area division of voltage and power. The power control is conducted by changing the port control mode of the energy router in different areas, so as to decrease the frequent changes of energy storage power output caused by system disturbance. Finally, the power interconnection of DC system, the influence of control mode to the stability of energy storage charging and discharging in each area under different operation mode are verified through PSCAD.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Threat-Detection Method for Power Monitoring System Based on Attack Chain Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The network attacks targeted at the Power Monitoring System (PMS) become much more complex and covert. However, traditional security protection methods cannot well detect such unknown attacks or multi-step attacks, which leads to a constant threat. How to use the massive log and warning data generated from various types of traditional security equipment to effectively detect and trace the advanced network threats becomes more and more important. This paper proposes an extended attack-chain based knowledge graph model to detect the threat lurked in the network of the PMS.

articleTitle: Wind Power Time Series Missing Data Imputation Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large scale integration of wind farms, wind power prediction with high accuracy becomes more important. Many research focuses on developing advanced and complex methods to improve the prediction accuracy based on statistical learning, which is highly dependent on the data set. But due to the wind curtailment or the equipment fault, there are some missing data in the wind power time series and enhancing the data quality of training data is crucial. Most research about wind power imputation is based on the power and wind speed curve. However, for some wind farms and the dispatching center, there are no complete wind speed data available. Therefore, we developed a generative adversarial network (GAN) based method for the wind power time series correction. When there is no wind speed measurement, it still can impute wind power. Besides, it can take into consideration the wind power distribution when imputing the wind power time series. Compare to the traditional way such as mean value filled method and other machine learning methods, it has higher imputation accuracy. Case studies on the field wind farm data showed that it outperformed other classical imputation methods.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Suppression Measures Against Severe Ice-Shedding of Ultra-high Voltage Alternating Current Ultra-Long Span Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the section across valleys and rivers, it is often necessary to set up ultra-high voltage alternating current (UHVAC) ultra-long span transmission line. UHVAC ultra-long span is more prone to phase-to-phase flashover, conductor breaking and damage on insulation due to the larger span, larger diameter of conductor and more splits when ice-shedding occurs. Based on the three-degree-of-freedom (3DOF) transmission line dynamic model independently developed by Tsinghua University, the relationship between the severity of ice-shedding and different ice-shedding conditions were analyzed and the influence of short span sections on both sides was also discussed. In this paper, three kinds of spacer installation methods were applied to the model under severe ice-shedding conditions. According to the calculation, it was found that suppression effects were different and the transmission model can meet the safety requirements.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting of Central China based on DPSO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate short-term load forecasting for a specific area plays an important role in power system operation. However, the load exhibits high volatility, making it challenging. In light of the superiority of deep learning models, this present study goes further by focusing on the optimization of the input feature structure of the well-established long short-term memory (LSTM) model for short-term electricity load. Discrete particle swarm optimization (DPSO) algorithm is proposed to determine the feature structure of the LSTM model to achieve better predictability of short-term load. The real data from the area of Central China including four provinces was used to justify the proposed DPSO-LSTM model by comparing with the state-of-art counterparts including standard LSTM and recurrent neural networks (RNN) models. The results show that the DPSO-LSTM model exhibits strong predictive power on both daily load and peak daily load data sets, demonstrating the effectiveness of DPSO-LSTM in short-term load forecasting.

articleTitle: Dynamic Compensation Control Strategy of Brushless Doubly Fed Generation System During low voltage ride through
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Brushless Doubly Fed Generator (BDFG) fully meets the needs of current industry requirements, due to no brush gear and higher reliability, so it has huge commercial promise and potential in the field of wind power generation in the development of wind power generation. To promote the process, an improved dynamic compensation control strategy is proposed to reduce the overcurrent and current oscillations caused in power winding (PW) during low voltage ride through (LVRT) and on an experimental platform, the utility of the new algorithm has been proved Keywords—Brushless Doubly Fed Generator; low voltage ride through; control strategy.

articleTitle: Deepening Research on State Space Analytical Model of HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The state-space analytical model can reflect the high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system's transient characteristics quickly and accurately. In order to overcome the problems of the traditional state-space model. For example, the inaccuracy of the DC current when the sudden change of current in the snubber circuit. Therefore a state-space analytical algorithm considering the thyristor snubber circuit is proposed. In this paper, the snubber current is added as the state variable to the state equation of the converter. And the coefficient matrix is used to represent the initial value of the state variable under different working conditions. Besides, the implicit trapezoid method is used for calculation, which effectively improves the calculation accuracy of the differential equation of the primary equipment. According to the data exchange between the control system and primary equipment, a complete HVDC analytical model consists of the converter, DC line, and control system is established using the state-space theory and solved by the backward Euler method. Furthermore, the simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC proved the accuracy and validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Supportive Analysis of Battery Energy Storage System on Electricity Market Scheduling Considering Load and Wind Power Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of battery energy storage system (BESS) brings opportunities to the power system application. The BESSs of small and medium sizes have been widely used as the companion of the renewable energy sources. It provides the local support for their participation in market. The systematic support of the large-scale BESS is pretty complicated to consider the network constraints and the global optimization. In this paper, the BESS is studied to provide the support for the multi-period market scheduling. the BESS as the pure reserve service provider is optimally dispatched considering the load and wind power fluctuation. The BESS is comprehensive evaluated by the total cost reduction with the its support. The simulation has demonstrated a typical case and provided the quantitative result on the PJM test system.

articleTitle: Stator-Flux-Oriented Decoupling Control Strategy for Dual Three-Phase Permanent Magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Thanks to the excellent features of power density and efficiency, the dual three-phase permanent magnet motor (DTP-PMSM) has attracted more and more attentions in drive applications. However, the conventional finite control set strategies of DTP-PMSM drives exhibit the poor steady-state performance. To improve the steady-state performance of DTP-PMSM, a decoupling control strategy based on stator flux orientation is studied in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model of the DTP-PMSM in the stator-flux-oriented xy rotating coordinate system is analyzed. The components of torque and flux can be decoupled, respectively and the principle of stator-flux-oriented decoupling control strategy is farther deduced. Then, a stator-flux-oriented decoupling control system is established considering all of the torque, flux linkage and harmonic currents. Finally, experiments on a DTP-PMSM are carried out to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on double-12-slot Winding Permanent Magnet Propulsion System Based on All-SiC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the application of all-SiC power module in double-12-slot winding permanent magnet propulsion systems, the key characteristics of all-SiC power module, such as temperature rise and conversion efficiency, are compared and analyzed. Compared with similar Si IGBT power module, the overall efficiency of all-SiC power module is increased by about 1.5%, which is more in line with the application requirements of double-12-slot winding permanent magnet propulsion systems. The double-12-slot winding permanent magnet propulsion systems are introduced in detail, which includes basic composition, topology and control system architecture. The synchronous operation conditions of double power windings are analyzed. Under the conditions of the same driving pulse, the same line delay and the same switching characteristics, the pulse time difference of double power windings is less than 30 ns. Finally, the mean phase errors between windings with the same slot are measured within 0.1 degrees, and the phase consistency is high. Experiments on the speed regulation performance of the propulsion module in full speed range under no-load/load conditions are completed. The results show that the all-SiC power module has good load capacity. Load current synchronization can be better realized to avoid the pulse induced current between the same slot windings.

Author Keywords: double-12-slot winding permanent magnet propulsion systems

articleTitle: Loss Analysis and Calculation of Magnetic Coupler in Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The efficiency of the wireless charging system is affected by the loss of magnetic coupler. In this paper, the calculation methods of Litz wire loss and core loss of magnetic coupler are analyzed. As for the loss of aluminum plate, the conventional direct calculation method is inaccurate. In this paper, a technique based on mesh generation combined with finite element analysis is proposed to calculate the loss of aluminum plate, and a lkW wireless charging experimental platform is built for experimental verification. The results show that the proposed method is closer to the actual value than the direct calculation method, and the loss error of the aluminum plate calculated by the proposed method is less than 5%.

articleTitle: A Temperature Monitoring Method for Power Electronic Converter Based on Infrared Image and Object Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power electronic converters are more and more widely used, and abnormal temperature of converter components is the most important factor of converter failure. In order to improve the reliability of the converter design, it is necessary to monitor the temperature of key components in the converter during the prototype test stage. The temperature measurement method of infrared thermal images has rich temperature information, wide coverage, and does not affect the original circuit design. It is widely used in circuit temperature measurement occasions. However, in the current automatic temperature measurement methods, it is necessary to manually establish a standard matching template for the infrared thermal image of the circuit to be tested, which indicates a large workload and poor versatility. This paper proposes a method for fully automatic temperature monitoring of converter components. This method is based on a deep learning target detection algorithm, which can automatically identify the type of converter components, obtain partial infrared thermal images of components through heterogeneous image registration, and achieve accurate component temperature monitoring. The advantages of this method are: 1) there is no need to manually establish a standard template for each converter, and the versatility is good; 2) it is fully automatically when the monitoring the temperature of converter components without manual intervention; 3) it is easy to implement and promote due to low cost of hardware system. Finally, the experimental results verify the feasibility and accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: Breaking Arc Model of Intelligent AC Contactor and Arc Extinguishing Analysis of Metal Plates
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The breaking arc of intelligent AC contactor has an important effect on the performance and electrical life of contactor. In this paper, based on the magneto hydrodynamic theory (MHD) and the dynamic layering mesh technology, the mathematical model of air arc in the breaking process of intelligent AC contactor is established and the arc motion in arc extinguishing chamber and the metal plates cutting arc process are simulated and the validity of simulation model is verified by experiment. On this basis, the arcing characteristics of the zero-front-breaking arc under AC4 condition is studied. The arc extinguishing performance, arc motion, arc root transfer and the arc extinguishing chamber flow field of four different metal plates and magnetic field matching schemes are investigated. The research shows that the plates have a blocking effect on arc motion, and the greater the thickness of plates, the more difficult the arc cutting is. Dense plates arrangement has great hindrance to arc flow. For the zero-front-breaking arc, the arc extinguishing ability is hard to be improved by increasing the plate number. For the zero-front-breaking arc, the arc extinguishing performance can be effectively improved by appropriately reducing the thickness of the plates and applying external magnetic field.

articleTitle: Dielectric Strength of 9%C4F7N/91%CO2 Gas Mixture Under Three Typical Voltage Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to master the dielectric strength of the environment friendly insulating gas C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture under different voltage waveforms, so as to provide the basis for its replacement of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>,. The breakdown tests of 9%C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/91%CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas mixture under power frequency, lightning impulse and switching impulse voltages are carried out with plate-plate electrode, and the test results are compared with SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, under the same pressure. The results show that the breakdown voltage of 9% C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/91%CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas mixture is higher than 80% of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, at the same pressure under three kinds of voltage, which indicates that the optimized ratio has a certain application prospect. The breakdown voltage under switching impulse voltage waveform is lower than the power frequency breakdown voltage and lightning impulse breakdown voltage under the same conditions, which indicates that the rise steepness of voltage waveform has a certain influence on the breakdown voltage even in a nearly uniform electric field. In addition, it is also found that whether the electrode is polished or not will also have a significant impact on the breakdown voltage, which should be paid special attention to in gas breakdown test.

articleTitle: Medium and Long–Term Electricity Forecasting Method Based on Solow Model: A Case of Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate electricity forecasting is very significant to power system. Modern smart grid has huge data and complex structure, and the nonlinear relationship between influencing factors and electricity demand is complex, random and changeable. Only by making full use of large amounts of data, accurate, stable and reliable medium and long-term electricity prediction can be made. Based on the traditional Solow Model, this paper proposes an Extended Solow Model by analyzing a lot of economic data and extracting key influencing factors. With the real load data of Hubei power grid, the experimental results show that the Extended Solow Model proposed by this paper can effectively improve the forecasting accuracy of 1.40% compared with the traditional Solow Model.

articleTitle: Research on the Current Carrying Capacity of an HTS Power Cable Used in Energy Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of long-distance large-capacity DC power transmission technology, and the advantage of the integrated energy pipeline simultaneously transmits electric energy and LNG, high-temperature superconducting(HTS) cable plays an important role in energy pipeline carrier because of its advantages of zero resistance, high efficiency transmission and cooling capacity sharing. HTS cables work in liquid nitrogen, and HTS cables can realize the cold energy sharing of transmission fuel and electricity. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the current carrying capacity of HTS cable based on the research of energy pipeline. In this paper, two different structures of HTS cable, coaxial bipolar and single core bipolar cable core, are analyzed by electromagnetic simulation. According to the anisotropy of each superconducting material, the influence of magnetic field on the critical current of different structures is analyzed. In order to verify the accuracy of this design, a HTS DC cable with rated current of 1000A at 90K is completed, and the relevant data parameters are given. Finally, a series of current carrying capacity tests were carried out on the HTS DC current sample, including the critical current test under different temperature, the temperature rise of the inner and outer layers of the cable core. The test results and current carrying capacity were analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Response Day-Ahead Scheduling Model for Multi-type Residential Customers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As residential customers can participate in demand response (DR) by lots of ways, it is challenging to formulate DR strategies to improve the regulation capability of the power system. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes a DR day-ahead scheduling model that considers different strategies for multiple-type residential customers. Firstly, according to the residential customers’ participation modes, the customers are classified into three types: hosting users, negotiating users and load aggregators (LA), and the corresponding regulation strategies for the flexible loads are developed. Secondly, the DR day-ahead scheduling model is established, the objective function is minimizing the customers’ discomfort, and the constraint condition considers the demand response request. Finally, a case study is performed to show the effect within DR through the model.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Strategies to Minimize Torque Ripples for Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, two novel strategies are proposed to minimize the torque ripple of switched reluctance motor (SRM), the first approach combines torque sharing function (TSF) with direct instantaneous torque control (DITC), and the second technique is the integration of model predictive control (MPC) and TSF. Firstly, the basic principles of two methods are introduced in detail and their control block diagrams are illustrated for comparison. Secondly, the proposed two control schemes are verified by the simulation in Matlab/Simulink. Finally, the simulation results show that the correctness of two schemes in terms of decrease the torque ripple. In addition, the steady and dynamic state performances of the two algorithms are compared in this paper. The study demonstrates that the MPC+TSF scheme can provide lower torque ripple and better control performance.

articleTitle: Stability Simulation Verification of the Variable Frequency AC Power System under Different Loads
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Variable frequency AC power system is an important development direction for the main power supply system of civil aircraft. In this paper, a method of using Saber simulation software to build More-Electric Aircraft electrical system is proposed. This paper introduces the electrical system of the More-Electric Aircraft first, and then uses the Saber simulation software to build and analyze an accurate simulation model of the power supply system and two typical loads. The stability of the variable frequency AC power system is analyzed by equipping different electrical loads under different working conditions. The simulation results show that the 230 V variable frequency AC power system can quickly recover to a stable state after sudden loading, power halving and sudden unloading with lighting loads and 3 kW constant power loads, which lays the foundation for further research on the power stability of variable frequency AC power systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of PLL Parameters' influence on the Stability of DFIG System under Weak Grid Conditions and its Active Configuration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In modern power systems with high penetration rates of renewable energy, its grids impedance cannot be ignored and varies dramatically in response to the changes of grid operation mode. The doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) connected to this type of weak grid easily suffers from stability and performance problems. This is due to the increased interaction between the traditional phase-locked loop (PLL) and the weak grid. However, in practical applications, the control parameters of the traditional PLL are usually constant parameters designed under strong grid conditions, which greatly hinders the grid adaptability of DFIG and affects the stability of DFIG in weak grids. In order to reveal the interaction mechanism between the PLL and the weak grid, this paper focuses on the influence of the PLL bandwidth parameter on the impedance characteristics of the DFIG based on the sequence impedance model of DFIG system considering PLL. Then the safe and stable operating area of DFIG is obtained and deduced. Based on this, an adaptive PLL parameter control strategy is proposed. Finally, time-domain simulation (MATLAB / Simulink) verifies the validity of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of DSIM and SIMULINK Simulation Based on MMC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Because of its multi-level output, easy expansion and high modularity, Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) is increasingly used in many fields such as high-voltage direct current transmission and renewable energy power generation systems. Because there are many switching devices in the MMC system, the electromagnetic interference (EMI) generated by them has a non-negligible impact on the stable operation of the system. At the same time, the current mainstream simulation software is based on time dispersion, and it often takes a long time to simulate power electronic circuits. After adding stray parameters, the circuit exhibits strong rigidity, and the time cost is greatly increased. The DSIM simulation software introduced in this article uses a discrete state event-driven approach, which is different from the previous time-driven approach. This simulation mechanism greatly shortens the time cost and makes the power electronics simulation more convenient. In addition, it can also simulate the transient process of switching devices, so more accurate simulation results can be obtained. This article describes the simulation mechanism of DSIM simulation software and compares the simulation results of DSIM and Simulink to show the outstanding advantages of DSIM software in simulating power electronic circuits.

articleTitle: Adoptive Control of Injector for Polymer Electrolyte Membrane Fuel Cell Hydrogen Feeding System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this work, the adaptive control of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> injector is proposed to reduce the pressure fluctuation in the PEMFC H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> feeding subsystem, which will reduce the mechanical damage on the membrane. Based on the comparative study on a simplified model, the effectiveness is verified to realizes the self-tuning of the controller’s parameter K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> and reduce the pressure fluctuation more than 50% under the situation of changing internal states. On the other hand, limitation of the application is also discussed. This work sheds a light on PEMFC intelligent control to realize higher performance and longer durability in future.

articleTitle: The Energy-Based Control Frame and its Limitation for Half-Bridge MMC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy-based control (EBC) for the half-bridge modular multilevel converter (MMC) is emerging as a promising control scheme in decoupling the AC and DC dynamics and enhancing the small-signal stability. The basic principle of EBC is to introduce new control freedom for regulating the DC component of the arm output voltage. This paper proposes a general control frame for EBC, considering multiple control objectives and structures. The advantage of EBC is highlighted by a comparison analysis of the eigenvalues with the conventional vector-based control (VBC) scheme. The limitation of EBC on the feasible operation zone is revealed by analyzing the positivity condition for the arm modulation signal. The limited capability of providing capacitive reactive power is validated by electromagnetic simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Method of Comprehensive Energy User Load in Load-intensive City Smart Park
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The load of industrial users in a load-intensive urban smart park is taken as the research object, and a device-based model of energy use for smart park users is established. Considering various load constraints, the comprehensive energy user load model is constructed, the model is analyzed and the solution algorithm is determined to be the genetic algorithm. It can be seen from the calculation example that the load modeling method can realize the load optimization operation of industrial users in the smart park. The load modeling method can provide a basis for further operation scheduling, thereby reducing energy waste in smart parks.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Grid Voltage Sag for Offshore Wind Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the offshore wind converters are connected to the grid by high voltage direct current, the voltage sag will lead to the disconnection of wind turbines. Therefore, the research of low voltage ride through (LVRT) is increasingly important, whose premise is to detect the grid voltage amplitude quickly and accurately. Firstly, this paper briefly concludes several traditional methods of detecting voltage sag, among which dq transformation based on synchronous rotating frame (SRF) is more suitable for offshore wind power converter due to its accuracy and timeliness. This paper then introduces the principle of dq transformation based SRF phase locked loop (SRF-PLL) as well as its improvement scheme in detail, compares and analyzes the characteristics of delayed signal cancelation (DSC), double second-order generalized integrator (DSOGI) and adaptive notch filter (ANF). Finally, an idea of selecting and improving the traditional method of detecting voltage sag is proposed. This paper distinguishes the differences between the existing traditional detection methods and the improved dq transformations, and provides an idea for selecting and improving the detection method of grid voltage sag suitable for LVRT of offshore wind power converters.

articleTitle: Design and development of an improved calibrator for the DC electronic transformer in HVDC system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The direct current (DC) electronic transformer is widely used in high-voltage DC (HVDC) transmission systems as primary equipment, and its steady-state accuracy is necessary to be calibrated for safe and reliable operation of the electrical power system. Usually, the method of calibration is to compare the outputs of the standard transformer and the test object with the same source, and the high-precision digital multimeter (DMM) is used to convert the analog output into digital form with the synchronous pulse per second (PPS) triggering. The DMM acquires a series of data after each trigger firstly, then the sampling data are transmitted to the host computer, thus the sampling is noncontinuous. Besides, the DMM can’t ensure the precise synchronization of sampling only based on the PPS. These factors affect the calibration result. Therefore, a control scheme of continuous and synchronous sampling for the DMM is proposed, and an improved DC electronic transformer calibrator is designed and developed. The test results under laboratory conditions show that the DC steady-state accuracy of the calibrator can reach up to 0.05 accuracy class.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based on Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fast and accurate transient stability assessment (TSA) is significant for power system. Topological information is often ignored by some machine learning methods, which may have a profound influence for TSA. For the purpose of improving the assessment accuracy and the adaptability to topology changes for online TSA, graph convolutional network (GCN) is introduced. GCN can aggregate node features and topological information. A jumping knowledge layer is added to prevent overfitting by concatenating the output of every GCN layer. Steady-state features of power system that are got through state estimation from the SCADA system are employed as the input. Tests on IEEE 39-Bus system indicate that the GCN model has a higher performance than some other methods. Several system topology changes are considered, and good adaptability to different topologies is indicated.

articleTitle: An Open-circuit Fault Diagnosis Method of Power Converter for Doubly Salient Electro-magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power converter is the weakest link in the doubly salient electro-magnet motor (DSEM) drive system. The system will be in an unbalanced working state under fault, and the entire system will not work in severe cases. Therefore, the fault diagnosis of the power converter is the key to improve the reliability of the DSEM drive system. This paper aims at the bridge converter in the DSEM drive system, under the premise of not affecting the normal operation of DSEM drive system, according to the different working characteristics of the power converter under normal and open-circuit fault, by changing the installation position of the current sensor, a new power switch open-circuit fault diagnosis scheme is proposed. Compared with the traditional phase current detection scheme, this scheme has the advantages of simple diagnosis method, no complicated calculation, and fast fault location speed. The effectiveness and rapidity of the proposed method are verified by fault simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Analysis of physical and chemical properties of insulation paperboard during thermal aging based on molecular simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to understand the degradation mechanism of thermal aging process of insulation paperboard from the microscopic level. In this paper, molecular simulation method was used to construct the cellulose model of insulation paperboard, and different temperatures were applied to study the change process of microscopic performance indicators. The results showed that the increase of temperature will lead to the increase of the mean square displacement of molecules, accelerate the movement of molecules, increase the internal kinetic energy and potential energy of molecules, and reduce the number of hydrogen bonds and other forms of non-bonding interaction energy such as van der Waals force, thereby leading to the instability of intermolecular chemical bonds and accelerating the decomposition of cellulose. Moreover, compared with pure cellulose, the mean square displacement of cellulose in oil is larger and the number of hydrogen bonds is less, which indicates that the increase of temperature in oil will make the molecular movement more intense and easier to crack. With the increase of temperature, the shear modulus and Young's modulus of cellulose model decrease, while the Cauchy pressure increases, which indicates that the increase of temperature will increase the ductility of insulating paper, but reduce its rigidity and weaken its deformation resistance. In this paper, the effect of temperature rise on the physical and chemical properties of pressboard is explained from the microscopic point of view.

articleTitle: Co-simulation study on airflow field and dynamic electric field of high voltage SF6 circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low calculation efficiency of the dynamic electric field of the arc extinguishing chamber, based on the commercial fluid simulation software, a joint simulation technology of air flow field and dynamic electric field is developed in this paper. The grid independence was verified by establishing a test model, and the results were compared with the classical electrostatic field calculation results. The results show that the joint simulation method of airflow field and dynamic electric field developed in this paper can accurately calculate the dynamic electric field of the arc extinguisher, greatly improve the calculation efficiency of the dynamic electric field, and establish a foundation and accumulate experience for the simulation and analysis of the electrical breakdown of the arc extinguisher after arc.

articleTitle: Research on Influence of Voltage and Moisture on Frequency Domain Spectroscopy of Epoxy Resin
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy resin and Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/epoxy resin composite materials are widely used in electrical equipment insulation. In order to evaluate the effectiveness of frequency domain spectroscopy (FDS) for epoxy resin and alumina/epoxy resin composite insulation damp defects, in this paper, two kinds of insulation samples are prepared to study the influence of voltage and moisture on FDS curves of two insulation materials by using dielectric response test platform. The results show that the applied voltage has little effect on the high frequency range (1Hz-5kHz for pure epoxy resin , 20mHz-5kHz for Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/epoxy resin) of FDS curves, while the tanδ of low frequency band decreases with the increase of voltage. With the decrease of water content, the low frequency band of FDS curve decreases gradually, while the Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/epoxy resin curve decreases over the entire frequency band (1mHz-5kHz). Since moisture has the greatest influence on tanδ of the two insulations at 0.01 Hz, this frequency point can be used as the characteristic frequency for diagnosing damping defects of the two insulations.

articleTitle: A Precise Model of Power SiC Schottky Barrier Diodes for Circuit Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a model of silicon carbide Schottky barrier diodes (SiC SBDs) for circuit simulation is proposed, and device parameters are extracted detailed. This model accurately considers the reverse I-V characteristic of the diode and simplifies the dependence relationship of conduction resistance on temperature. The voltage controlled current source of the conventional model is separated into two current sources, forward bias current source and reverse leakage current source. The parameters in the proposed model are all extracted from the datasheet. This proposed new model has been implemented in the PSpice circuit simulator. More accuracy is obtained from this new model than that from the conventional PSpice simulation model. Meanwhile, a prototype of buck converter is established to compare the performance of silicon carbide SBD and silicon (Si) diode.

articleTitle: Reliability and Weak Link Analysis of Power Distribution Systems: a case of Songjiang
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With rapid development of Shanghai, the reliability of distribution network has been put forward higher and higher requirements. In this paper, the reliability index of Shanghai Songjiang distribution network is calculated by the analytic calculation method of distribution system reliability index, and the sensitivity calculation method is put forward on the basis of this method, which provides a theoretical basis for the identification of weak links. Firstly, the M-segment-N-tie-switch unit of distribution system is constructed, then the power supply path matrix(PSPM) and fault incidence matrix(FIM) are respectively established. The fault situation of the line is classified into 3 types, and the reliability index calculation and sensitivity analysis of the influencing factors are carried out based on FIMs. Finally, the reliability index of a distribution line in Songjiang District of Shanghai is calculated by this method, and the weak links in the power supply reliability of Shanghai Songjiang distribution network are identified, and the construction scheme to improve the reliability of Shanghai Songjiang distribution network is put forward.

articleTitle: Dynamic Economic Dispatch with CHP and Wind Power Considering Different Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It has always been a hot and difficult issue in the field to effectively deal with wind curtailment in a combined heat and power (CHP) system. In this paper, a CHP dynamic economic dispatch (ED) model which considers the different adjustment time scales of heating system and power system is proposed. The objective of the proposed model is to minimize the generation cost of all units under the operating constraints of the CHP system. Moreover, electric boilers are utilized to handle wind curtailment by decoupling power generation from heat demand. Since the proposed CHP dynamic ED model is highly nonlinear, the cuckoo search algorithm (CSA) is applied during solutions. Finally, a 9-bus and 6-node CHP test system is performed to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Loss Allocation for Bilateral Transactions Based on Complex Power Tracing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the bilateral power market with an open transmission grid, how to allocate the transmission loss reasonably and fairly is an important problem faced by the power market. Based on the original method, this paper applies this method to the loss allocation of bilateral transactions. The method proposed in this paper is as follows: Based on the complex power flow tracing method which is based on circuit theory, the transmission loss is allocated on the load side and the source side respectively, and then the responsibility transmission loss is obtained by averaging the responsibility of both the source side and the load side. The IEEE-5 bus system is analyzed and calculated, and the method is compared with the transaction incremental allocation method and the traditional power flow tracing to verify the rationality of the method.

articleTitle: Degradation of Metallized Film Capacitors under Co-60γ Radiation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an energy storage element, capacitors are gradually being used in various complex environments. When subjected to high-energy radiation, the internal and surface of the dielectric material wilt accumulate charges and cause discharge, and it will cause irreversible changes in the physical and chemical structure of the dielectric, which will affect the performance of the capacitor. In this paper, polypropylene film and metallized film capacitors have been tested, and the effect of gamma-ray irradiation on the crystallinity of polypropylene film, the basic parameters of metallized film capacitors (relative permittivity, dielectric loss and ESR), voltage maintaining performance and space charge polarization characteristics are studied. The preliminary results show that when the total radiation dose is small (less than 100kGy), the relative permittivity of the capacitor does not change significantly before and after the radiation. When the absorbed dose reaches 1000kGy, the relative permittivity of the capacitor decreases by 5.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>%; irradiation will cause the voltage maintaining capacity of the capacitor to decrease. When the absorbed dose increases from 0kGy to 1000kGy, the voltage drop within 10s of the capacitor increases from 1.62% to 6.54%; with the increase of the radiation dose, the crystallinity of the film gradually decreases, and the space charge polarization degree of the metallized film capacitor gradually increases. When the radiation dose increases from 0kGy to 1000kGy, the film crystallinity changes from 48.56 reduced to 34.52%, Q/A increased from 0.5 to 3.56.

articleTitle: Cogging Torque Reduction of Halbach Array Permanent Magnet Motor Based on Magnetic Field Energy Equivalence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic field energy equivalence concept is incorporated into rotor topology design to reduce the cogging torque for the permanent magnet (PM) motor. The effect of the magnetization direction and the width ratio of the Halbach array PM on cogging torque is investigated. Firstly, based on magnetic field energy equivalence principle, the magnetomotive force (MMF) and magnetic permeance characteristics of the Halbach array PM motor are analyzed, and then the analytical expression of cogging torque is derived. After qualitative analysis, the magnetization direction and PM width ratio are identified and optimized as key parameters for reducing the cogging torque. Through the rational design of key parameters, the PM MMF characteristics of the Halbach array PM motor are changed, significantly contributing to the cogging torque reduction. Then, electromagnetic performance comparative analysis of traditional radial and Halbach array PM motors are carried out by finite element analysis (FEA). Finally, the theoretical analysis and the FEA results verify the effectiveness of the magnetic field energy equivalence principle for cogging torque reduction of the proposed Halbach array PM Motor.

articleTitle: Study on the Dynamic Performance of Solar Space Heating System with Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The main problems restricting the development of solar heating systems are the low energy density and instability of solar energy. The problems of seasonal mismatch between energy supply with demand and the instability can be solved effectively, through the application of seasonal thermal energy storage technology in the solar space heating system. In this paper, a solar district heating system model (basically composed of a solar collector’s array, a seasonal thermal energy storage, a buffer tank, an auxiliary natural gas-fired boiler and controllers) has been established based on the dynamic simulations platform TRNSYS. The variation law of the key parameters and dynamic operation characteristics of the system are obtained, which provides an important reference for the popularization and application of solar space heating system with seasonal thermal energy storage. And the solar fraction of the system can be reached as much as 96.7 % with the low temperature district heating technology.

articleTitle: Critical Load Restoration in Urban Distribution System Considering Multiple Participants
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Extreme events such as natural disasters can cause severe damage to the power system and lead to outages. After outages, various power sources, such as distributed generations (DGs) and microgrids, can be used to restore the critical loads in the urban distribution system (UDS). However, microgrids are usually operated by different owners and they have different preference on feeding their own loads or participating in the UDS restoration under the power outage scenario. In this paper, a critical load restoration method is proposed considering the preference of multiple participants. First, the concept of virtual flow decomposition for a microgrid participant is proposed to distinguish that the loads in it are restored by internal or external energy. Based on the virtual flow decomposition, a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) for critical load restoration is proposed to maximize the weighted load restoration time considering the preference of participants. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on a modified IEEE 13-node test system.

articleTitle: A portable pulsed plasma jet generator based on piezoelectric transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A plasma jet generator based on piezoelectric transformer is designed in this paper. Different from the past, This paper used selective harmonic control method, which can control the amplitude and phase of harmonics quantitatively. By inputting a specific waveform to the piezoelectric transformer, the characteristic that the piezoelectric transformer can transfer multiple harmonicsto pulsed votage. Based on this, Piezoelectric transformer can output quasi pulse voltage. Compared with sinusoidal voltage, The plasma jet produced by quasi pulse voltage shows some different characteristics.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Resonant Network for CLLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: CLLC converter is widely used due to its bidirectional symmetry, high efficiency, and low reactive power. In the resonant network, the design of the inductance ratio (resonant inductance L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>/magnetizing inductance L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>) determines ZVS realization, circulation loss, and dv/dt. The existing L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>/L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> method only considers the realization of ZVS. And it can’t give the precise boundary of ZVS because there are too many assumptions. As a result, the existing design method cannot give an optimal value. This paper proposes an optimal design method for L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>/L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> based on CLLC resonant converter. It can reduce circulation loss and dv/dt while ensuring soft-switching. And this method gives a precise boundary of ZVS by establishing a dead zone model. By using this, an optimal region of L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>/L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> can be given. Finally, a 4kW, 500kHz bidirectional CLLC platform is designed based on GaN Hemts devices. The experiment verifies the precision of the proposed optimal design method.

articleTitle: Joint Equilibrium Analysis of Wholesale Electricity Market and Energy Storage Trading Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In power systems insufficient off-peak-load cycling capacity will impose a negative impact on the accommodation of renewable energy. The development and application of energy storage (ES) technology provide an effective way to mitigate this problem. To attract investment in ES technology and examine the market value of ES, it is necessary to introduce a market-oriented operation mechanism of ES technology considering the target of renewable energy accommodation in off-peak-load periods. Specifically, an energy storage aggregator (ESA) purchases ES resources from an ES trading market and participates in the wholesale electricity market competition. To attract the ESA’s participation in renewable energy accommodation in off-peak-load periods, an incentive compensation for the ESA in off-peak-load periods is introduced. Furthermore, based on the operation mechanism, a multi-period joint equilibrium model for the wholesale electricity market and ES trading market is developed. In the wholesale electricity market, conventional generators and ESA bid via the supply function and Cournot mode respectively. In the ES trading market, ES customers bid via the supply function. Numerical results illustrate the effectiveness and reasonableness of the proposed mechanism.

articleTitle: IoT Device to Detect Fuse Status in Overhead Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article deals with the development of a sensor with embedded communication, to be used in overhead distribution grids in order to monitor fuses arranged along the feeder, using a low cost IoT communication grid. The developed device has as main objective to assist in the fast and effective location of defects related to the current that cause the fuse to burn, either by short circuits or overload, in a simple and practical way, showing a great improvement in decision making in sending the field team to more assertive repairs. As a consequence, the consumer present in the project area who will benefit from the performance of this monitoring system will notice an increase in speed in the correction of power failure events caused by short circuits in the grid, observing a constant improvement in service quality. The study is part of an R&D (Research and Development) project from ENEL Distribution São Paulo, named "Urban Futurability". It was carried out in a region with a high-density load with the predominance of commercial consumers, in the city of São Paulo, Brazil.

articleTitle: The on-site detection technique for silicone oil level in high voltage cable terminal using infrared image processing techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Oil-filled high voltage cable terminals are widely used in urban power transmission networks. It is a common issue that the oil leakage poses troubles on the reliability of the cable lines. This paper proposes a technique to evaluate the oil level in the cable terminal using infrared imaging technique and corresponding image processing algorithm. In this paper, Canny operator and the threshold value of the sum of pixels are utilized to extract the region of interest. The peak envelop curve and its gradient curve are obtained to identity the oil level in the terminal. An on-site detection case of an oil-leaked terminal verifies the proposed technique.

articleTitle: A New SPWM Strategy for Five-Level ANPC Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The five-level active neutral-point clamped (5L- ANPC) converter has the advantages of large output power, small number of floating capacitors, and only one midpoint of the bus. In recent years, it has received extensive attention from scholars. However, the existing modulation strategies still have some drawbacks. For sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM), the DC side voltage utilization is low and the calculation of the NP potential balance control is complicated. For space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM), the digital implementation is difficult. This paper proposes a new SPWM strategy for 5L-ANPC converters based on the essential connection between SVPWM and SPWM. This strategy first equates SVPWM to SPWM, and then achieves free selection of switching sequence by injecting zero-sequence voltage. It can effectively suppress NP potential fluctuations, and achieve NP potential balance. According to the voltage offset of the floating capacitor, the equivalent PD-SPWM type is adjusted in real time to realize the control and balance of the voltage of the floating capacitor. This strategy is an optimized modulation algorithm with high degrees of freedom, high DC voltage utilization, and it is very easy to implement digitally.

articleTitle: Medium-Long Term Load Forecasting Model Based On System Dynamics And ImPACT Equation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development showing more emphasis on sustainable development, innovative development, and environmental protection, the future power demand will be increasingly affected by renewable energy, technological progress, environmental protection policy. Because of the lack of consideration of the above factors in the existing references, this paper proposes a medium-long term load forecasting model based on system dynamics and the ImPACT equation, which comprehensively considers the above factors. Based on the improved system dynamics model, the prediction results are compared with the traditional system dynamics model which only considers the traditional factors, and the electricity consumption of China from 2020 to 2050 under different development scenarios is predicted. This paper studies the impact of renewable energy, technological progress, and environmental protection policy on future electricity consumption by setting high, middle, and low scenarios of these three factors. The research results of this paper can provide important basic information for future power system planning.

articleTitle: A Sizing Method for Flexible Resources in Isolated Microgrids Considering Time Division of Load Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the adaptability of isolated microgrids (IMs) with uncertain renewable generation and load, an investigation of the sizing method for flexible resources (FRs) is of great significance. This paper proposes a sizing method considering the time division of the load response to determine the size of the FRs. According to probability density of the renewable generation and load response, a stochastic scenario set is generated. Power characteristic analysis and probability statistics methods are combined with the traditional fuzzy cluster method to divide the time of the load response. Then, a bilevel sizing model for FRs is established. The investment cost of the FRs is calculated in the upper level, and the operation cost and performance indicators are calculated in the lower level. A bilevel sizing algorithm for FRs that combines the pattern search (PS) algorithm and CPLEX is designed to obtain the optimal size and electricity price of different load response periods. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method and improve the traditional time division method.

articleTitle: Active Current Transferring Modular Multilevel Converter With DC Fault Blocking Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid blocking of DC fault is the bottleneck problem in DC transmission/distribution technology development. Aiming at the problems that high cost and/or high losses issue arises with using of DC circuit breaker or modular multilevel converter (MMC) based on improved DC-blocking submodule when clearing faults, an active-current-transferring MMC with the ability of blocking DC fault is proposed in this paper. A current breaking branch, an arm blocking branch and an energy absorption branch are introduced to the conventional MMC topology. After the DC fault occurs, the fault current is actively transferred by disconnecting the current breaking branch and the redirection of the bridge arm current is realized, and then the half-bridge submodule is used to absorb the internal fault energy of MMC. Meanwhile, the additional full-bridge submodules in the energy absorption branch are used to absorb the fault energy on the line side during blocking period, thereby achieving fast blocking of short circuit fault. Finally, the simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Improved differential evolution algorithm for integrated energy system scheduling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Optimization models for an arbitrary integrated energy system (IES) are usually of high dimensions, and thus cannot be directly solved by classical optimization algorithms. To tackle this challenge, this paper analyzes advantages and disadvantages of common heuristic algorithms, and the differential evolution algorithm (DE) is selected for its fast convergence speed and robustness. Considering the fact that the results of traditional DE often contain some infeasible values, an improved DE algorithm by adding a filtration step is proposed to avoid infeasible values and improve the overall accuracy. To deal with the operational constraints of the IES that are difficult to handle by DE algorithms, the sequential unconstrained miniaturization technique is further adapted. Case studies are conducted for two typical objectives, i.e., operational cost minimization, carbon emission minimization, to illustrate the improved accuracy and applicability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Suppression Method of Sub-/Super-synchronous Oscillation in D-PMSG Wind Farm Grid-connected Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The sub-synchronous oscillations (SSO) caused by the grid integration of wind power have seriously threatened the safe and stable operation of the power system. Therefore, the suppression schemes of SSO have attracted extensive attention from the academic and industrial communities. However, the existing SSO suppression methods have the limitations of either changing dynamic performance of the direct drive permanent magnet synchronous generators (D-PMSG) wind farm, complex control schemes, or high control cost. To address these problems, a novel SSO suppression method based on the phase-locked loop (PLL) additional control is proposed in this paper. First, impedance sensitivity and the poles of the D-PMSG wind farm system are studied, the decrease of PLL’s bandwidth is found to be important and benefit to the grid-integrated stability. Secondly, a suppression scheme with additional damping at the PLL is proposed to indirectly reduce the bandwidth of the PLL once SSO occurs. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed suppression method is verified in time-domain simulations that SSO converges only in 1 second.

articleTitle: A Novel DCX Based on ZVZCS Full-Bridge Cells with Voltage-doubler Rectifier for DC Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a high power dc transformer (DCX) suitable for dc grids, containing two full-bridge cells in series connection both in input and output side. The proposed DCX uses a special but simple control strategy to enable it to work in discontinuous conduction mode, which can realize zero current switching for the main full-bridge cell in the whole load range. Consequently, the switching loss is reduced and the system efficiency is improved. The performance is verified by the simulation model established in the software PLECS.
